//! Complete independent canonical owner and ordinary immutable-label controls.
use super::*;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::{SkeletonObservation, SkeletonTerminal, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS};
use crate::hir::ExpressionId;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
const CAP: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
fn function() -> ResolvedFunction {
    crate::hir::resolve(
        &crate::check(
            "module ordinary.labels; @id(\"f\") fn main()->i64 {1}",
            "labels.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap()
    .functions[0]
        .clone()
}
fn graph(
    f: &ResolvedFunction,
    width: usize,
    cycle: bool,
    unequal: bool,
) -> (Automaton, usize, usize, usize) {
    let mut a = Automaton::default();
    let mut b = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
    let sink = a.node(f, &mut b).unwrap();
    let left = a.node(f, &mut b).unwrap();
    let right = a.node(f, &mut b).unwrap();
    for (side, root) in [left, right].into_iter().enumerate() {
        for n in 0..width {
            let node = a.node(f, &mut b).unwrap();
            // Distinct Rc and identifier backing on each side must compare
            // through complete content, never source-address identity.
            let label = Label::Observation(Rc::new(SkeletonObservation::Boolean {
                expression: ExpressionId::from_owned(format!(
                    "label.{n}.{}",
                    usize::from(unequal && side == 1)
                )),
                value: n % 2 == 0,
            }));
            a.movement(f, &mut b, root, label, node).unwrap();
            for terminal in [
                SkeletonTerminal::Success,
                SkeletonTerminal::Failure,
                SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch,
            ] {
                // Duplicate labels/targets retain exact accepted multiplicity.
                for _ in 0..2 {
                    a.movement(f, &mut b, node, Label::End(terminal), sink)
                        .unwrap();
                }
            }
        }
        if cycle {
            a.epsilon(f, &mut b, root, root).unwrap();
        }
    }
    (a, sink, left, right)
}
type States = Vec<(Vec<(usize, u64)>, usize)>;
type Signatures = Vec<((u64, Vec<(Label, usize)>), usize)>;
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct Run {
    result: Result<Option<bool>, String>,
    states: States,
    signatures: Signatures,
    remaining: usize,
    spent: usize,
}
fn run(
    old: bool,
    f: &ResolvedFunction,
    a: &Automaton,
    sink: usize,
    roots: (usize, usize),
    weight: u64,
    work: usize,
) -> Run {
    let mut b = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(work);
    b.remaining = work;
    let mut states = Vec::new();
    let mut signatures = Vec::new();
    macro_rules! compare {
        ($c:ident) => {{
            let first = $c.id(f, vec![(roots.0, weight)], &mut b)?;
            let second = $c.id(f, vec![(roots.1, weight)], &mut b)?;
            if !b.pays_allocations() {
                // Full-state diagnostic capture belongs only to the unobserved
                // comparison. Funded controls exercise the real owner without
                // adding an unpriced test-output clone inside its account.
                states = $c
                    .states
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(key, value)| (key.as_slice().to_vec(), *value))
                    .collect();
                signatures = $c
                    .ids
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(key, value)| (key.clone(), *value))
                    .collect();
            }
            Ok(first.zip(second).map(|(x, y)| x == y))
        }};
    }
    let result: Result<Option<bool>, Diagnostic> = (|| {
        if old {
            let mut c = super::super::Canonicalizer::new(a, sink);
            compare!(c)
        } else {
            let mut c = Canonicalizer::new(a, sink);
            compare!(c)
        }
    })();
    Run {
        result: result.map_err(|d| d.json()),
        states,
        signatures,
        remaining: b.remaining,
        spent: b.skeleton_spent,
    }
}

#[test]
fn whole_immediate_source_inverse_changes_only_the_two_ordinary_dispatch_arms() {
    let before = include_str!("ordinary_labels.before.txt");
    assert_eq!(before.len(), 55814);
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(before.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "b6471558eaf00c76a99472843a9d96a58a11fe9e5779f50fdccbfc6f0011aa51"
    );
    let current = include_str!("../inline_singleton.rs");
    let mut restored = current
        .strip_suffix("\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod ordinary_labels;\n")
        .unwrap()
        .to_owned();
    assert_eq!(
        restored
            .matches("AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder | AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved => {")
            .count(),
        2
    );
    restored = restored.replace(
        "AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder | AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved => {",
        "AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder => {",
    );
    for indent in ["                ", "            "] {
        let marker =
            format!("{indent}AllocationPayer::SelectedReservation => {{}}\n{indent}_ => {{");
        assert_eq!(restored.matches(&marker).count(), 1);
        restored = restored.replacen(&marker, &format!("{indent}AllocationPayer::SelectedReservation => {{}}\n{indent}AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved => {{}}\n{indent}_ => {{"), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(restored.as_bytes(), before.as_bytes());
}

#[test]
fn ordinary_borrowed_labels_keep_all_weighted_states_full_labels_and_terminals() {
    let f = function();
    for width in [0, 1, 2, 3, 8] {
        for unequal in [false, true] {
            let (a, sink, left, right) = graph(&f, width, false, unequal);
            for weight in [1, 2, 7] {
                let old = run(
                    true,
                    &f,
                    &a,
                    sink,
                    (left, right),
                    weight,
                    MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS,
                );
                let current = run(
                    false,
                    &f,
                    &a,
                    sink,
                    (left, right),
                    weight,
                    MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS,
                );
                assert_eq!(
                    current, old,
                    "width={width} weight={weight} unequal={unequal}"
                );
                assert_eq!(current.result, Ok(Some(!unequal || width == 0)));
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn every_small_original_work_cut_cycle_and_multiplicity_overflow_keeps_six_fields() {
    let f = function();
    let (a, sink, left, right) = graph(&f, 2, false, false);
    let complete = run(true, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
    let work = MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS - complete.remaining;
    for cut in 0..=work {
        assert_eq!(
            run(false, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, cut),
            run(true, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, cut),
            "cut={cut}"
        );
    }
    let current = run(
        false,
        &f,
        &a,
        sink,
        (left, right),
        u64::MAX,
        MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS,
    );
    let old = run(
        true,
        &f,
        &a,
        sink,
        (left, right),
        u64::MAX,
        MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS,
    );
    assert_eq!(current, old);
    assert_eq!(current.result, Ok(None));
    let (a, sink, left, right) = graph(&f, 2, true, false);
    let old = run(true, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
    let current = run(false, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
    assert!(old.result.is_err());
    assert_eq!(current, old);
}

#[test]
fn same_invocation_authentication_rejects_foreign_function_and_stays_failed() {
    let f = function();
    let foreign = f.clone();
    let (a, sink, root, _) = graph(&f, 2, false, false);
    let mut b = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
    let mut c = Canonicalizer::new(&a, sink);
    assert!(c.id(&f, vec![(root, 1)], &mut b).unwrap().is_some());
    let before = (b.remaining, b.skeleton_remaining, b.skeleton_spent);
    let first = c.id(&foreign, vec![(root, 1)], &mut b).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(first.code, "SPX-H006");
    assert_eq!(
        (b.remaining, b.skeleton_remaining, b.skeleton_spent),
        before
    );
    assert_eq!(
        c.id(&f, vec![(root, 1)], &mut b).unwrap_err().code,
        "SPX-H006"
    );
}

#[test]
fn existing_funded_route_keeps_exact_short_zero_and_full_owner_drop() {
    let f = function();
    let (a, sink, left, right) = graph(&f, 3, false, false);
    let (ample, refused, paid) = crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(CAP, || {
        run(false, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS)
    });
    assert_eq!(ample.result, Ok(Some(true)));
    assert!(!refused && paid > 0);
    for cap in [paid, paid - 1, 0] {
        let (actual, refused, _) = crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(cap, || {
            run(false, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS)
        });
        assert_eq!(actual.result.is_ok(), cap == paid);
        assert_eq!(refused, cap != paid);
        let (_, metrics) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
            drop(crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(cap, || {
                run(false, &f, &a, sink, (left, right), 1, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS)
            }));
        });
        assert!(!metrics.invalid);
        assert_eq!(metrics.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(metrics.allocated, metrics.freed);
    }
    for old in [true, false] {
        let (_, metrics) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
            drop(run(
                old,
                &f,
                &a,
                sink,
                (left, right),
                1,
                MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS,
            ));
        });
        assert!(!metrics.invalid);
        assert_eq!(metrics.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(metrics.allocated, metrics.freed);
        eprintln!(
            "complete canonical owner with full-state diagnostic capture old={old} {metrics:?}"
        );
    }
}
//! Invocation-owned receiving storage for the shared-history heapsort.
//! Only empty capacities survive a comparison; paths remain the sole root owners.
use super::super::*;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_budget::ByteFailure;
use std::rc::Rc;

// No frame borrows a path slot. Sorting may move every path between calls.
// Rc handles keep immutable contents alive; equality always reads those contents.
enum Frame {
    RootItems {
        next: usize,
    },
    Node(Rc<ObservationDag>),
    SeqItems {
        node: Rc<ObservationDag>,
        next: usize,
    },
}
struct Cursor {
    pending: Vec<Frame>,
    yielded: Option<Observation>,
    current: Option<Frame>,
}
struct Pair {
    left: Cursor,
    right: Cursor,
    ordering: Ordering,
}
const PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>();
// Concrete retained owners and aggregate initializers. Receiving storage is
// represented by fields, not inferred from repeated call-stack addresses.
const TRIVIAL_GUARD: usize = 2 * size_of::<bool>();
const RECEIVERS: usize = 2 * size_of::<Pair>() + 4 * size_of::<Cursor>();
// Surviving invocation transports are still paid at each old frontier. Only
// pending/current/yielded and ordering themselves belong to the retained bank.
const PREPARE_CALL: usize = 2 * PAYMENT
    + 4 * size_of::<&mut Cursor>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Frame>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
// Method receivers and completion/lent-refusal transports occur once per
// invocation. They cannot pay for the unbounded structural loop below.
const ADVANCE_CALL: usize = PAYMENT
    + 4 * size_of::<&mut Cursor>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>();
// Every other former ADVANCE_CALL role is renewed before each actual pop,
// including exhaustion. The two explicit mutable receiving views are new.
const FRAME_STEP: usize = 3 * PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Vec<Frame>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Option<Frame>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Frame>() // moved match and resumed-frame constructor
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<Frame>>() // pop/take transports; retained slot is separate
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>() // clone input/return and moved handles
    + 4 * size_of::<Observation>() // clone input/return and yielded assignment
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Observation>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::iter::Rev<std::slice::Iter<'static, Rc<ObservationDag>>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&ObservationDagKind>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[Observation]>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + size_of::<[usize; 8]>()
    + 8 * size_of::<bool>();
// A Cat can have arbitrarily many children even while the pending Vec is
// warm. Pay every iterator attempt, including its final None, and the actual
// clone, moved frame, push and handle teardown transports before forming them.
type Children<'a> = std::iter::Rev<std::slice::Iter<'a, Rc<ObservationDag>>>;
const CAT_CHILD_STEP: usize = PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Children<'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Frame>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Vec<Frame>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
const COMPARE_CALL: usize = 2 * size_of::<(
    &mut Pair,
    &SkeletonPath,
    &SkeletonPath,
    &ResolvedFunction,
    &mut ReplayBudget,
)>() + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Option<Observation>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observation>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&SkeletonObservation>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Ordering>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();

impl Cursor {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pending: Vec::new(),
            yielded: None,
            current: None,
        }
    }
    fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.yielded = None;
        self.current = None;
        self.pending.clear();
    }
    fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        observations: &Observations,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        self.clear();
        // Keep the old authentication and growth frontier, including no-growth
        // calls. A reused backing is the actual backing acquired on an earlier
        // comparison, never a credit or a guessed maximum.
        budget.reserve_compact_vec(
            function,
            &mut self.pending,
            2,
            "enumerated HIR initial cursor backing",
        )?;
        self.pending.push(Frame::RootItems { next: 0 });
        if let Some(prefix) = &observations.prefix {
            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(Rc::clone(prefix)));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    // Return only completion. The actual observation receiver lives in self;
    // neither a returned reference nor a slice iterator crosses a path swap.
    fn next(
        &mut self,
        observations: &Observations,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        self.yielded = None;
        if budget.lent_skeleton {
            return Err(budget.compact_refusal(
                function,
                "enumerated HIR cursor cannot spend a lent skeleton allowance",
                "",
            ));
        }
        loop {
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                FRAME_STEP,
                "enumerated HIR cursor frame receiving renewal",
            )?;
            self.current = self.pending.pop();
            if self.current.is_none() {
                break;
            }
            budget.charge_compact(function, 1, "enumerated HIR cursor traversal")?;
            match self.current.take().expect("the popped frame was present") {
                Frame::RootItems { next } => {
                    if let Some(item) = observations.items.get(next) {
                        self.yielded = Some(Rc::clone(item));
                        self.pending.push(Frame::RootItems { next: next + 1 });
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                Frame::SeqItems { node, next } => {
                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &node.kind else {
                        unreachable!("sequence cursor frame retains its immutable node")
                    };
                    if let Some(item) = items.get(next) {
                        self.yielded = Some(Rc::clone(item));
                        self.pending.push(Frame::SeqItems {
                            node,
                            next: next + 1,
                        });
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                Frame::Node(node) => match &node.kind {
                    ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {
                        budget.reserve_compact_vec(
                            function,
                            &mut self.pending,
                            2,
                            "enumerated HIR sequence cursor backing",
                        )?;
                        let prefix = prefix.as_ref().map(Rc::clone);
                        // Move this handle into the resume frame; do not clone
                        // the Seq node merely to remember its items.
                        self.pending.push(Frame::SeqItems { node, next: 0 });
                        if let Some(prefix) = prefix {
                            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(prefix));
                        }
                    }
                    ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) => {
                        budget.reserve_compact_vec(
                            function,
                            &mut self.pending,
                            children.len(),
                            "enumerated HIR concatenation cursor backing",
                        )?;
                        let mut children = children.iter().rev();
                        loop {
                            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                                function,
                                CAT_CHILD_STEP,
                                "enumerated HIR concatenation child receiving renewal",
                            )?;
                            let Some(child) = children.next() else {
                                break;
                            };
                            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(Rc::clone(child)));
                        }
                    }
                    ObservationDagKind::Alt(_) => {
                        return Err(budget.compact_refusal(
                            function,
                            "enumerated HIR history cannot contain merged alternatives",
                            "",
                        ))
                    }
                },
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
impl Pair {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            left: Cursor::new(),
            right: Cursor::new(),
            ordering: Ordering::Equal,
        }
    }
    fn order(
        &mut self,
        a: &SkeletonPath,
        b: &SkeletonPath,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        let result = self.compare(a, b, function, budget);
        // Clear on BOTH outcomes before the caller can swap. On failure this
        // is infallible handle teardown: it cannot replace the chosen status.
        // Every node still has an original path root, so no DAG is destroyed.
        self.left.clear();
        self.right.clear();
        result
    }
    fn compare(
        &mut self,
        a: &SkeletonPath,
        b: &SkeletonPath,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            2 * PREPARE_CALL + COMPARE_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR paired cursor receivers",
        )?;
        self.left.prepare(&a.observations, function, budget)?;
        self.right.prepare(&b.observations, function, budget)?;
        loop {
            // Retained fields survive. Pay invocation transports here; next
            // separately renews every dynamic frame and Cat-child attempt.
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                2 * ADVANCE_CALL,
                "enumerated HIR paired cursor next receivers",
            )?;
            self.left.next(&a.observations, function, budget)?;
            // Right still advances when left is exhausted.
            self.right.next(&b.observations, function, budget)?;
            match (&self.left.yielded, &self.right.yielded) {
                (Some(a), Some(b)) => {
                    self.ordering = a.as_ref().cmp(b.as_ref());
                    if self.ordering != Ordering::Equal {
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                (None, None) => {
                    self.ordering = a.terminal.cmp(&b.terminal);
                    return Ok(());
                }
                (None, Some(_)) => {
                    self.ordering = Ordering::Less;
                    return Ok(());
                }
                (Some(_), None) => {
                    self.ordering = Ordering::Greater;
                    return Ok(());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
fn sift(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    mut root: usize,
    end: usize,
    pair: &mut Pair,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
    loop {
        budget.charge_compact(function, 1, "enumerated HIR content sort traversal")?;
        if end < 2 || root > (end - 2) / 2 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut child = root * 2 + 1;
        if child + 1 < end {
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                ORDER_CALL,
                "enumerated HIR sibling order call receivers",
            )?;
            pair.order(&paths[child], &paths[child + 1], function, budget)?;
            if pair.ordering == Ordering::Less {
                child += 1;
            }
        }
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            ORDER_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR parent order call receivers",
        )?;
        pair.order(&paths[root], &paths[child], function, budget)?;
        if pair.ordering != Ordering::Less {
            return Ok(());
        }
        paths.swap(root, child);
        root = child;
    }
}
pub(super) fn sort(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR content sort receivers")?;
    // The original len receiver is part of SORT_CALL. Pay the new branch
    // before querying it; a singleton performs no comparison and therefore
    // must not acquire either cursor or its receiving bank.
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
        function,
        TRIVIAL_GUARD,
        "enumerated HIR trivial content sort guard",
    )?;
    let len = paths.len();
    if len < 2 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
        function,
        RECEIVERS,
        "enumerated HIR reusable content sort receiving bank",
    )?;
    let mut pair = Pair::new();
    for root in (0..len / 2).rev() {
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, root, len, &mut pair, function, budget)?;
    }
    for end in (1..len).rev() {
        paths.swap(0, end);
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, 0, end, &mut pair, function, budget)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

// TEST_ONLY_ORIGINAL_WARM_INVOICE
pub(super) fn verify_original_warm_invoice(
    observations: &Observations,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    frames: usize,
    attempts: usize,
    child_attempts: usize,
) {
    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, RECEIVERS + PREPARE_CALL + ADVANCE_CALL,
        "test original bank structural ownership").unwrap();
    let mut cursor = Cursor::new();
    cursor.prepare(observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
    cursor.next(observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, PREPARE_CALL,
        "test original bank warm prepare").unwrap();
    cursor.prepare(observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
    let capacity = cursor.pending.capacity();
    let pointer = cursor.pending.as_ptr();
    let bytes = crate::bounded_output::active_remaining().unwrap();
    let work = budget.remaining;
    let ((), heap) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, ADVANCE_CALL,
            "test original bank warm invocation").unwrap();
        cursor.next(observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
    });
    assert!(!heap.invalid && heap.allocated == 0);
    assert_eq!(cursor.pending.capacity(), capacity);
    assert_eq!(cursor.pending.as_ptr(), pointer);
    assert_eq!(work - budget.remaining, frames);
    assert_eq!(bytes - crate::bounded_output::active_remaining().unwrap(),
        ADVANCE_CALL + attempts * FRAME_STEP + child_attempts * CAT_CHILD_STEP);
    assert!(cursor.pending.is_empty() && cursor.current.is_none() && cursor.yielded.is_none());
}
//! Fund the complete legacy owner search before its first owned construction.
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ReplayBudget;
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;
use crate::hir::ResolvedFunction;
use std::mem::size_of;

// The independently retained owner helper calls validate_owner for every
// candidate, dropping its owned fixed diagnostic on a rejected candidate.
// Fund the whole possible result for each visit, including an unused bank for
// the matching candidate. Generic execution IDs also clone real String bytes.
const CANDIDATE_ERROR: usize =
    "lexical function owner differs from canonical result/body identities".len();
const FINAL_ERROR: usize =
    "unregistered lexical function requires an explicit authenticated execution context".len();
type Call<'a> = (
    &'a dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    &'a ResolvedFunction,
    &'a mut ReplayBudget,
);
type Payment<'a> = (&'a mut ReplayBudget, &'a ResolvedFunction, usize, &'a str);
type Instances<'a> = std::slice::Iter<'a, crate::hir::ResolvedFunctionInstance>;
const PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<Payment<'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>();
// One next attempt is prepaid before iteration. Each successful visit buys
// the next attempt, including terminal None, before inspecting the ID bytes.
const INSTANCE_STEP: usize = 2 * PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Instances<'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&crate::hir::ResolvedFunctionInstance>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&crate::hir::ResolvedFunctionInstance>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&crate::hir::FunctionInstanceId>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&str>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>();
const CONTROLS: usize = 2 * PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<Call<'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<crate::hir::FunctionExecutionId, Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&[ResolvedFunction]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&[crate::hir::ResolvedFunctionInstance]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Instances<'static>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + INSTANCE_STEP;

pub(super) fn owner(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<crate::hir::FunctionExecutionId, Diagnostic> {
    if budget.pays_allocations() {
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            CONTROLS + FINAL_ERROR,
            "ordinary execution owner receiving controls",
        )?;
        let functions = program.functions();
        budget.reserve_array::<[u8; CANDIDATE_ERROR]>(
            function,
            functions.len(),
            "ordinary execution owner candidate diagnostics",
        )?;
        let instances = program.function_instances();
        for instance in instances {
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                INSTANCE_STEP + CANDIDATE_ERROR,
                "ordinary generic owner visit and diagnostic",
            )?;
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                instance.id.as_str().len(),
                "ordinary generic execution owner clone",
            )?;
        }
    }
    // Preserve the complete old search, clone/drop order, candidate validation,
    // missing/ambiguous selection, six public fields and returned owner.
    crate::hir::lexical_exit::owner(program, function)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

#[cfg(test)]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn custody(path: &str, current: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let digest = |bytes: &[u8]| format!("{:x}", crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(bytes)));
    assert_eq!(
        digest(include_bytes!("ordinary/inverse.json")),
        "31b422b59b3d10e7b2f0bab5c009f5d3477734c375d2ce723f9c0d2335447575"
    );
    let binding: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("ordinary/inverse.json")).unwrap();
    let row = &binding[path];
    assert_eq!(current.len() as u64, row["length"].as_u64().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(digest(current), row["sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    let mut bytes = current.to_vec();
    for edit in row["edits"].as_array().unwrap().iter().rev() {
        let start = usize::try_from(edit["start"].as_u64().unwrap()).unwrap();
        let end = usize::try_from(edit["end"].as_u64().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            bytes.get(start..end).unwrap(),
            edit["current"].as_str().unwrap().as_bytes()
        );
        bytes.splice(
            start..end,
            edit["before"].as_str().unwrap().as_bytes().iter().copied(),
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(bytes.len() as u64, row["before_length"].as_u64().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(digest(&bytes), row["before_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    bytes
}
//! Full original search remains the independent result/diagnostic oracle.
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage_refusal;
use crate::hir::{ExpressionId, ResolvedProgram};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

const SOURCE: &str = r#"module ordinary.owner;
@id("first") fn first()->i64 {0}
@id("identity") fn identity<T>(value:T)->T {value}
@id("main") fn main()->i64 {identity<i64>(1)}
"#;

fn program() -> ResolvedProgram {
    crate::hir::resolve(&crate::check(SOURCE, "ordinary-owner.spx").unwrap()).unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn cold_original_search_keeps_every_owner_six_field_error_and_actual_paid_drop() {
    let program = program();
    assert!(!program.function_instances.is_empty());
    for function in program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .chain(program.function_instances.iter().map(|i| &i.function))
    {
        let expected = crate::hir::lexical_exit::owner(&program, function);
        assert!(expected.is_ok());
        let observe = |limit, floor| {
            with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
                assert!(crate::bounded_output::set_active_floor(floor));
                let result = measure(|| {
                    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
                    let before = (budget.remaining, budget.skeleton_remaining);
                    let actual = owner(&program, function, &mut budget);
                    let success = actual.is_ok();
                    if success {
                        assert_eq!(actual, expected);
                        assert_eq!((budget.remaining, budget.skeleton_remaining), before);
                    } else {
                        assert_eq!(actual.as_ref().unwrap_err().code, "SPX-H006");
                    }
                    drop(actual);
                    drop(budget);
                    success
                });
                let ledger = crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::ClassifierLedger::capture();
                let first = ledger.first_refusal();
                if first.is_some() {
                    let remaining = crate::bounded_output::active_remaining();
                    for retry in [0, 1] {
                        assert!(!crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(retry));
                        assert_eq!(ledger.first_refusal(), first);
                        assert_eq!(crate::bounded_output::active_remaining(), remaining);
                    }
                }
                crate::bounded_output::clear_active_floor();
                result
            })
        };
        let full = observe(usize::MAX, 0);
        assert!(full.0.0 && !full.1 && full.3.is_none());
        for (limit, floor, success) in [
            (0, 0, false),
            (full.2 - 1, 0, false),
            (full.2, 0, true),
            (full.2, 1, false),
        ] {
            let actual = observe(limit, floor);
            assert_eq!(actual.0.0, success);
            assert_eq!(actual.1, !success);
            assert_eq!(actual.3.is_some(), !success);
            let metrics = actual.0.1;
            assert!(!metrics.invalid && metrics.live == 0);
            assert_eq!(metrics.allocated, metrics.freed);
            assert!(metrics.allocated <= actual.2 && actual.2 <= limit);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn missing_and_ambiguous_results_keep_complete_original_diagnostics_without_work_changes() {
    let original = program();
    let mut missing = original
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.name == "main")
        .unwrap()
        .clone();
    missing.body.id = ExpressionId::from_owned("forged.body".to_owned());
    let mut repeated = original.clone();
    repeated.functions.push(repeated.functions[0].clone());
    for (program, function) in [(&original, &missing), (&repeated, &repeated.functions[0])] {
        let expected = crate::hir::lexical_exit::owner(program, function);
        assert!(expected.is_err());
        let (((), metrics), refused, paid, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
                let before = (budget.remaining, budget.skeleton_remaining);
                let actual = owner(program, function, &mut budget);
                assert_eq!(actual, expected); // all six Diagnostic fields
                assert_eq!((budget.remaining, budget.skeleton_remaining), before);
                drop(actual);
                drop(budget);
            })
        });
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
        assert!(!metrics.invalid && metrics.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(metrics.allocated, metrics.freed);
        assert!(metrics.allocated <= paid);
    }
}

#[test]
fn exact_original_owner_helper_and_both_original_adapters_remain_source_bound() {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let digest = |bytes: &[u8]| format!("{:x}", crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(bytes)));
    let original = include_str!("owner_before.rs.txt");
    let current = include_str!(concat!(
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
        "/src/hir/lexical_exit/owner.rs"
    ));
    assert_eq!(current, original);
    assert_eq!(
        digest(current.as_bytes()),
        "3011442d86bb6ffa452684b58a7ebb78c60d36ba383588f0704729ac38749eec"
    );
    // Owner identity comparisons are the unchanged streaming, allocation-free
    // helpers, not a reconstructed identity String hidden behind the search.
    assert_eq!(
        digest(include_bytes!(concat!(
            env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
            "/src/hir/ids.rs"
        ))),
        "1eceacba63ce7ce7cbeb99ebe1ecfa05b3bdc25b679c6f74fadaa0b5b3a0284e"
    );
    let wrapper = include_str!("../ordinary.rs");
    assert_eq!(
        wrapper
            .matches("crate::hir::lexical_exit::owner(program, function)")
            .count(),
        1
    );
    assert!(FINAL_ERROR >= "lexical function execution owner is ambiguous".len());
    for (path, compiled, before) in [
        (
            "src/cleanup_plan/replay/selected_owner.rs",
            include_str!("../../selected_owner.rs"),
            include_str!("selected_owner_before.rs.txt"),
        ),
        (
            "src/cleanup_plan/replay/selected_owner/paid.rs",
            include_str!("../paid.rs"),
            include_str!("paid_before.rs.txt"),
        ),
        (
            "src/cleanup_plan/replay/path_join/frontier_tests/custody.rs",
            include_str!("../../path_join/frontier_tests/custody.rs"),
            include_str!("frontier_custody_before.rs.txt"),
        ),
    ] {
        let restored = super::custody(path, compiled.as_bytes());
        assert_eq!(restored, before.as_bytes());
        assert!(
            std::panic::catch_unwind(|| super::custody(
                path,
                &(compiled.to_owned() + " ").into_bytes()
            ))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| super::custody(path, before.as_bytes())).is_err());
    }
}
//! Last-use release before either independent typed-control comparison.
use super::{case_proof::Attempt, StatusCases, StatusSources};
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::{expression_facts::Facts, leaf_index::Leaves, ReplayBudget};
use crate::cleanup_plan::StorageId;
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;
use crate::hir::ResolvedFunction;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::mem::size_of;

// The tuple owns the actual five moved values. Tuple fields drop in the same
// reverse-declaration order as the old lexical exit. Every referenced Program,
// Function, helper and continuation owner remains outside this scratch tuple.
type Scratch<'hir> = (
    StatusSources<'hir>,
    Leaves,
    BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    StatusCases<'hir>,
    Facts<'hir>,
);
const PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
// Initializer and drop argument/formal are separate moved packet owners; none
// of the earlier constructors' backing or receiver payments is credited here.
pub(super) const RELEASE: usize = 2 * size_of::<Scratch<'static>>() + PAYMENT;
pub(super) const ATTEMPT: usize = 2 * size_of::<Attempt<'static, 'static>>() + PAYMENT;

macro_rules! finish_structure {
    ($program:ident, $function:ident, $budget:ident, $helpers:ident, $continuations:ident;
     $statuses:ident, $leaves:ident, $storage:ident, $cases:ident, $facts:ident, $attempt:ident) => {{
        $budget.reserve_bytes($function, super::last_use::ATTEMPT,
            "completed status attempt release transport")?;
        // complete() already fixed the affine token's successful state. Drop
        // neither queries a payer nor changes the selected diagnostic here.
        drop($attempt);
        finish_structure!($program, $function, $budget, $helpers, $continuations;
            $statuses, $leaves, $storage, $cases, $facts)
    }};
    ($program:ident, $function:ident, $budget:ident, $helpers:ident, $continuations:ident;
     $statuses:ident, $leaves:ident, $storage:ident, $cases:ident, $facts:ident) => {{
        $budget.reserve_bytes($function, super::last_use::RELEASE,
            "ordinary structure scratch release transport")?;
        drop(($statuses, $leaves, $storage, $cases, $facts));
        validate_typed_control_skeleton_with_index(
            $program, $function, $budget, $helpers, $continuations)
    }};
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;
//! #885 whole ordinary ABI with an actual lexical status/initial-edge owner.
//! SOURCE WIP: typed receiving ledger and independent controls pending review.
use super::case_certified::retained_lookup;
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::StorageParent;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::expression_facts::arena::retained::Session;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_receiving::{
    prepare_into, refuse_into, reserve_into, Failure,
};
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn validate_structure_with_budget_storage<'hir>(
    program: &'hir dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &'hir ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'hir>>,
    continuations: Option<&mut continuation_storage::Storage<'hir>>,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    #[cfg(test)]
    let _operation = crate::bounded_output::stage_debits::operation_guard(
        crate::bounded_output::stage_debits::Operation::ReplayStructure,
    );
    #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
    let _exclusive_operation = crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::operation_guard(
        crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::Operation::ReplayStructure,
    );
    let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;
    if helpers.is_some_and(|index| {
        !program
            .full_program()
            .is_some_and(|full| index.matches_program(full))
    }) {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup replay helper index belongs to a different typed program",
        ));
    }
    // Reconstruct the ordinary schema first, preserving all its current-source
    // probes/error order. A private source-held projection adds allocation
    // branches; neither its attached v20 string nor an ordinary context selects it.
    let ordinary_schema =
        schema::paid_summary::selected_with_budget(program, function, helpers, budget)?;
    let expected_schema = if allocation_paths::current(program, function).is_some() {
        crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V20
    } else {
        ordinary_schema
    };
    if plan.schema != expected_schema {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            format_args!(
                "uses cleanup-plan schema `{}` instead of HIR-derived `{expected_schema}`",
                plan.schema
            ),
        ));
    }
    if lexical_cert::requires_lexical(function) {
        return lexical_replay::validate_with_index(program, function, budget, helpers);
    }
    if plan.lexical_control.is_some() {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "function without lexical exits carries a lexical-control certificate",
        ));
    }
    validate_replay_size_budget(function)?;
    budget.charge(
        function,
        plan_structure_units(plan),
        "structural validation",
    )?;
    let expression_facts = expression_facts::with_budget(function, budget)?;
    ordinary_inventory::validate_inventory_coverage(program, function, budget)?;
    let status_cases =
        expression_facts::receiving::StatusCases::validate(program, function, budget)?;
    let storage = validate_slots_paid(function, budget)?;
    let leaves = collect_leaves_paid(function, budget)?;
    let statuses = 'status_publication: {
        let facts = &expression_facts;
        let proof = &status_cases;
        let mut attempt = case_proof::begin_receiving!(proof, function, budget);
        if let Facts::Tree(tree) = facts {
            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::validate_status_sources(function, tree)?;
            budget.reserve_bytes(function, CONTROL_BYTES, "retained status full controls")?;
            attempt.complete(function, budget)?;
            break 'status_publication StatusSources {
                function,
                budget,
                ledger: ClassifierLedger::capture(),
                ids: None,
            };
        }
        let expressions: &dyn Lookup = facts;
        let mut ids = Directory::new(function, budget, "cleanup status identity directory")?;
        // This direct borrowed predicate replaces the absent complete:false
        // initializer in the unchanged, already-funded lexical begin frame.
        if matches!(
            &budget.payer,
            &crate::cleanup_plan::replay::allocation::AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder
                | &crate::cleanup_plan::replay::allocation::AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved
        ) {
            // Pay the complete new lexical selection receivers before length
            // inspection. This is an additional real fee, never credit from the proof
            // or either insertion owner. The tree lane above retains its old path.
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                3 * std::mem::size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
                    + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, &str, usize)>(
                    )
                    + std::mem::size_of::<&ReplayBudget>()
                    + std::mem::size_of::<&Vec<crate::cleanup_plan::StatusSource>>()
                    + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                    + 4 * std::mem::size_of::<bool>(),
                "certified held-prefix selection controls",
            )?;
            budget.charge(function, 2, "certified held-prefix selection")?;
            if function.cleanup_plan.status_sources.len() >= 3 {
                let mut prefix_owner = ids.held_prefix(function, budget)?;
                budget.reserve_bytes(
                    function,
                    std::mem::size_of::<usize>(),
                    "status case row ordinal",
                )?;
                budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal")?;
                let mut ordinal = 0usize;
                // Peel exactly the first row; all its old guards and receiving
                // payments precede new selection. The remaining old loop is intact.
                let source = &function.cleanup_plan.status_sources[ordinal];
                if !prefix_owner.insert(function, &source.id, budget)? {
                    return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                        function,
                        semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                    ));
                }
                // Retain the actual first lookup's borrowed payload, only through this
                // immutable source's producer match. Pay its complete receiving pointer
                // and one assignment step; no previous result/header credit is used.
                budget.reserve_bytes(
                    function,
                    std::mem::size_of::<&Option<CallFact<'_>>>(),
                    "retained status fact receiving control",
                )?;
                budget.charge(function, 1, "retained status fact receiving assignment")?;
                // Selection and owner formation occur only at the actual
                // first old lookup frontier. No future loop is precharged.
                budget.reserve_bytes(function, 0, "expression-fact arena lookup authentication")?;
                budget.charge(function, 0, "expression-fact arena lookup authentication")?;
                budget.reserve_bytes(
                    function,
                    retained_lookup::SELECT_BYTES,
                    "retained expression-fact selection controls",
                )?;
                if matches!(
                    &budget.payer,
                    &crate::cleanup_plan::replay::allocation::AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder
                ) && function.cleanup_plan.status_sources.len() >= retained_lookup::MIN_ROWS
                {
                    if let Facts::Arena(arena) = facts {
                        if arena.len() != 0 {
                            budget.reserve_bytes(
                                function,
                                Session::OLD_SCRATCH
                                    + Session::acquisition_bytes()
                                    + Failure::acquisition_bytes(),
                                "retained expression-fact owner acquisition",
                            )?;
                            budget.charge(
                                function,
                                12,
                                "retained expression-fact owner initialization",
                            )?;
                            #[cfg(test)]
                            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_receiving::observe_site(1);
                            let mut failure = Failure {
                                error: None,
                                function,
                                budget,
                            };
                            let mut received = None;
                            let mut session = Session::new_prepaid(arena, function, budget);
                            loop {
                                let source = &function.cleanup_plan.status_sources[ordinal];
                                {
                                    if !reserve_into!(
                                        session.budget,
                                        function,
                                        failure,
                                        Session::into_query_bytes(),
                                        "ordinary fact query actual and formal receiving"
                                    ) {
                                        return Err(failure
                                            .error
                                            .take()
                                            .expect("query frontier selected first error"));
                                    }
                                }
                                if !session.fact_into(
                                    &source.id.expression,
                                    &mut received,
                                    &mut failure,
                                ) {
                                    return Err(failure
                                        .error
                                        .take()
                                        .expect("fact query selected first error"));
                                }
                                let Some(fact) = received else {
                                    return Err(
                                        <Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                                            function,
                                            semantic_refusal::Atom::UnknownStatus(
                                                source.id.expression.clone(),
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                                };
                                let budget = &mut *session.budget;
                                match (&source.id.lane, &source.producer) {
                                    (
                                        StatusLane::OperationFailure | StatusLane::OwnerAdmission,
                                        StatusProducer::PropagatedCall { callee },
                                    ) => {
                                        // The payload reference is a second simultaneous receiving
                                        // control; the eliminated lookup's result is not a credit.
                                        budget.reserve_bytes(
                                            function,
                                            std::mem::size_of::<&CallFact<'_>>(),
                                            "retained status call receiving control",
                                        )?;
                                        budget.charge(
                                            function,
                                            1,
                                            "retained status call receiving assignment",
                                        )?;
                                        let Some(call) = fact else {
                                            return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "propagated-call status source does not name a call expression",
                    ));
                                        };
                                        if call.callee.as_ref() != callee {
                                            return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "propagated-call status source names the wrong callee",
                    ));
                                        }
                                    }
                                    (
                                        StatusLane::OperationFailure,
                                        StatusProducer::CheckedArithmetic {
                                            normalized_cases, ..
                                        },
                                    ) => {
                                        // Complete independent discovery proved the exact held row.
                                        // No case value is read here and no second case directory exists.
                                        proof.member(function, source, ordinal, budget)?;
                                        let _ = normalized_cases;
                                    }
                                    (
                                        StatusLane::AllocationFailure,
                                        StatusProducer::CheckedAllocation {
                                            normalized_cases, ..
                                        },
                                    ) if function.cleanup_plan.schema
                                        == crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V20
                                        && *normalized_cases
                                            == [
                                                crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::PayloadRefused,
                                                crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::SizeOverflow,
                                            ] => {}
                                    (
                                        StatusLane::ContractFalse,
                                        StatusProducer::ContractFalse { .. },
                                    ) => {}
                                    _ => {
                                        return Err(replay_error(
                                            function,
                                            "status source lane does not match its producer",
                                        ));
                                    }
                                }
                                budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal increment")?;
                                ordinal += 1;
                                if ordinal == function.cleanup_plan.status_sources.len() {
                                    break;
                                }
                                let source = &function.cleanup_plan.status_sources[ordinal];
                                let budget = &mut *session.budget;
                                if !prefix_owner.insert(function, &source.id, budget)? {
                                    return Err(
                                        <Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                                            function,
                                            semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedStatus(
                                                source.id.expression.clone(),
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    );
                                }
                                // Retain the actual first lookup's borrowed payload, only through this
                                // immutable source's producer match. Pay its complete receiving pointer
                                // and one assignment step; no previous result/header credit is used.
                                budget.reserve_bytes(
                                    function,
                                    std::mem::size_of::<&Option<CallFact<'_>>>(),
                                    "retained status fact receiving control",
                                )?;
                                budget.charge(
                                    function,
                                    1,
                                    "retained status fact receiving assignment",
                                )?;
                            }
                            prefix_owner.freeze(function, session.budget)?;
                            session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                function,
                                CONTROL_BYTES,
                                "retained status full controls",
                            )?;
                            attempt.complete(function, session.budget)?;
                            let statuses = StatusSources {
                                function,
                                budget: session.budget,
                                ledger: ClassifierLedger::capture(),
                                ids: Some(ids),
                            };
                            super::super::regions_entry::validate_regions(
                                function,
                                &storage,
                                session.budget,
                            )?;
                            super::super::regions_entry::validate_entry(
                                function,
                                &storage,
                                &leaves,
                                session.budget,
                            )?;
                            if !std::ptr::eq(function, statuses.function)
                                || !std::ptr::eq(session.budget, statuses.budget)
                            {
                                return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "status directory belongs to another function or budget",
                                ));
                            }
                            if !statuses.ledger.current() {
                                return Err(session.budget.budget_refusal(
                                    function,
                                    "retained status invocation owner changed",
                                    "",
                                ));
                            }
                            // Authenticate the unchanged payer even though retaining the directory allocates nothing.
                            session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                function,
                                0,
                                "retained cleanup status directory",
                            )?;
                            session.budget.charge(
                                function,
                                0,
                                "retained cleanup status directory",
                            )?;
                            let status_ids = statuses.ids.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
                                replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "retained status directory has no metered keys",
                                )
                            })?;
                            for (index, edge) in plan.edges.iter().enumerate() {
                                if edge.id.0 != u32_index(function, index, "cleanup edge")?
                                    || !block_exists(function, edge.from)
                                    || !block_exists(function, edge.to)
                                {
                                    return Err(replay_error(
                                        function,
                                        "cleanup edge has a non-contiguous ID or unknown endpoint",
                                    ));
                                }
                                match &edge.condition {
                                    EdgeCondition::Always => {}
                                    EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, _)
                                    | EdgeCondition::VariantCase {
                                        scrutinee: expression,
                                        ..
                                    }
                                    | EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {
                                        scrutinee: expression,
                                        ..
                                    } => {
                                        session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                            function,
                                            0,
                                            "expression-fact arena lookup authentication",
                                        )?;
                                        session.budget.charge(
                                            function,
                                            0,
                                            "expression-fact arena lookup authentication",
                                        )?;
                                        session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                            function,
                                            Session::into_edge_local_bytes()
                                                + Session::into_edge_query_bytes(),
                                            "retained expression-fact query result controls",
                                        )?;
                                        if !session.fact_edge_into_prepaid(
                                            expression,
                                            &mut received,
                                            &mut failure,
                                        ) {
                                            return Err(failure
                                                .error
                                                .take()
                                                .expect("edge query selected first error"));
                                        }
                                        #[allow(
                                            clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
                                            reason = "bare pattern avoids a new Option method receiving boundary"
                                        )]
                                        if let None = received {
                                            return Err(replay_error(function,
                        format_args!("cleanup plan references unknown expression `{expression}`")));
                                        }
                                    }
                                    EdgeCondition::StatusZero(source)
                                    | EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(source) => {
                                        require_status_paid(
                                            function,
                                            status_ids,
                                            source,
                                            session.budget,
                                        )?;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            // One prepaid terminal producer: every false guard immediately returns.
                            if !reserve_into!(
                                session.budget,
                                function,
                                failure,
                                StorageParent::ACQUISITION_CONTROLS
                                    + StorageParent::TERMINAL_CONTROLS
                                    + std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                                    + 3 * std::mem::size_of::<&str>()
                                    + std::mem::size_of::<bool>(),
                                "retained transition parent and terminal controls"
                            ) {
                                return Err(failure
                                    .error
                                    .take()
                                    .expect("parent acquisition payment"));
                            }
                            let Some(transition_parent) = statuses.ledger.storage_parent() else {
                                refuse_into!(
                                    session.budget,
                                    function,
                                    failure,
                                    "ordinary builder already failed",
                                    ""
                                );
                                return Err(failure
                                    .error
                                    .take()
                                    .expect("missing transition parent"));
                            };
                            // Keep the existing fully paid output/error slots through
                            // the last transition query; never lend scratch to callbacks.
                            macro_rules! transition_fact {
                                ($query:expr) => {{
                                    session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                        function,
                                        0,
                                        "expression-fact arena lookup authentication",
                                    )?;
                                    session.budget.charge(
                                        function,
                                        0,
                                        "expression-fact arena lookup authentication",
                                    )?;
                                    session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                        function,
                                        Session::into_edge_local_bytes()
                                            + Session::into_edge_query_bytes()
                                            + std::mem::size_of::<Option<&Option<CallFact<'_>>>>(),
                                        "retained transition expression-fact query controls",
                                    )?;
                                    if !session.fact_edge_into_prepaid(
                                        $query,
                                        &mut received,
                                        &mut failure,
                                    ) {
                                        return Err(failure
                                            .error
                                            .take()
                                            .expect("transition query selected first error"));
                                    }
                                    received
                                }};
                            }
                            macro_rules! require_transition_expression {
                                ($query:expr) => {
                                    #[allow(clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
                                        reason = "bare receiving pattern forms no Option-method boundary")]
                                    if let None = transition_fact!($query) {
                                        return Err(replay_error(function,
                                            format_args!("cleanup plan references unknown expression `{}`", $query)));
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            macro_rules! transition_callback_prepare {
                                () => {
                                    if !reserve_into!(
                                        session.budget,
                                        function,
                                        failure,
                                        StorageParent::CURRENT_CONTROLS
                                            + std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                                            + 3 * std::mem::size_of::<&str>()
                                            + std::mem::size_of::<bool>(),
                                        "retained transition callback identity controls"
                                    ) {
                                        return Err(failure.error.take().expect(
                                            "callback guard payment selected first error",
                                        ));
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            macro_rules! transition_callback_complete {
                                () => {
                                    if !transition_parent.current() {
                                        // The original prepaid renderer keeps the complete
                                        // sticky-builder diagnostic; no foreign debit.
                                        refuse_into!(
                                            session.budget,
                                            function,
                                            failure,
                                            "ordinary builder already failed",
                                            ""
                                        );
                                        return Err(failure
                                            .error
                                            .take()
                                            .expect("callback identity refusal"));
                                    }
                                };
                            }
                            // Helpers borrow only the original budget; scratch remains inaccessible
                            // until the complete callback sequence has returned successfully.
                            let expressions: &dyn Lookup = facts;
                            {
                                let storage = &storage;
                                let leaves = &leaves;
                                let statuses = status_ids;
                                // Preserve the original directory constructor's zero/current/sticky checks.
                                session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                    function,
                                    0,
                                    "cleanup referenced exit directory",
                                )?;
                                session.budget.charge(
                                    function,
                                    0,
                                    "cleanup referenced exit directory",
                                )?;
                                let mut committed_calls = Directory::new(
                                    function,
                                    session.budget,
                                    "cleanup committed call directory",
                                )?;
                                for (index, block) in plan.blocks.iter().enumerate() {
                                    if block.id.0 != u32_index(function, index, "cleanup block")?
                                        || usize::try_from(block.region.0)
                                            .ok()
                                            .is_none_or(|region| region >= plan.regions.len())
                                    {
                                        return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "cleanup block has a non-contiguous ID or unknown region",
            ));
                                    }
                                    let mut selected = None;
                                    for transition in &block.transitions {
                                        match transition {
                                            CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination } => {
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    destination,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, binding } => {
                                                transition_callback_prepare!();
                                                renewal::validate_binding(
                                                    program,
                                                    function,
                                                    at,
                                                    binding,
                                                    helpers,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                transition_callback_complete!();
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    binding,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::Renew {
                                                at,
                                                source,
                                                destination,
                                            } => {
                                                transition_callback_prepare!();
                                                renewal::validate_binding(
                                                    program,
                                                    function,
                                                    at,
                                                    destination,
                                                    helpers,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                transition_callback_complete!();
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    source,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    destination,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::Transfer {
                                                at,
                                                source,
                                                destination,
                                            } => {
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                let source_flags = helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    source,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                let destination_flags = helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    destination,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                let mut source_directory = Directory::new(
                                                    function,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                    "cleanup transfer source flag directory",
                                                )?;
                                                for flag in source_flags {
                                                    source_directory.insert(
                                                        function,
                                                        flag,
                                                        session.budget,
                                                    )?;
                                                }
                                                let mut destination_directory = Directory::new(
                                                    function,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                    "cleanup transfer destination flag directory",
                                                )?;
                                                for flag in destination_flags {
                                                    destination_directory.insert(
                                                        function,
                                                        flag,
                                                        session.budget,
                                                    )?;
