                                                }
                                                let source_flags = source_directory;
                                                let destination_flags = destination_directory;
                                                if source_flags.len() != destination_flags.len()
                                                    || !source_flags.is_disjoint(
                                                        &destination_flags,
                                                        function,
                                                        session.budget,
                                                    )?
                                                {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "cleanup transfer has incompatible structural places",
                        ));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase {
                                                at,
                                                source,
                                                variant,
                                                case,
                                            } => {
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    source,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                transition_callback_prepare!();
                                                let Some(cases) =
                                                    program.declarations().variant_cases(variant)
                                                else {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "variant authentication references a non-variant declaration",
                        ));
                                                };
                                                if !cases
                                                    .iter()
                                                    .any(|candidate| candidate.id == *case)
                                                {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "variant authentication references a foreign case",
                        ));
                                                }
                                                let slot = function
                        .cleanup_plan
                        .slots
                        .iter()
                        .find(|slot| slot.storage == source.storage)
                        .ok_or_else(|| {
                            replay_error(function, "variant authentication source has no slot")
                        })?;
                                                if !matches!(
                                                    &slot.ty,
                                                    ResolvedType::Nominal { declaration, .. } if declaration == variant
                                                ) {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "variant authentication source type disagrees with its variant",
                        ));
                                                }
                                                transition_callback_complete!();
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::TransferVariant {
                                                at,
                                                source,
                                                destination,
                                                variant,
                                            } => {
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                let source_flags = helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    source,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                let destination_flags = helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    destination,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                if source_flags.len() != destination_flags.len()
                        || function
                            .cleanup_plan
                            .slots
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|slot| {
                                slot.storage == source.storage
                                    || slot.storage == destination.storage
                            })
                            .any(|slot| {
                                !matches!(
                                    &slot.ty,
                                    ResolvedType::Nominal { declaration, .. }
                                        if declaration == variant
                                )
                            })
                    {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "variant transfer has incompatible conditional inventories",
                        ));
                    }
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {
                                                at,
                                                destination,
                                                variant,
                                            } => {
                                                require_transition_expression!(at);
                                                helpers::validate_place(
                                                    function,
                                                    destination,
                                                    storage,
                                                    leaves,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                let slot = function
                        .cleanup_plan
                        .slots
                        .iter()
                        .find(|slot| slot.storage == destination.storage)
                        .ok_or_else(|| {
                            replay_error(function, "variant initialization has no destination slot")
                        })?;
                                                if !destination.projections.is_empty()
                                                    || !matches!(
                                                        &slot.ty,
                                                        ResolvedType::Nominal { declaration, .. }
                                                            if declaration == variant
                                                    )
                                                    || !matches!(
                                                        &slot.field_liveness_shape,
                                                        FieldLivenessShape::Variant { declaration, .. }
                                                            if declaration == variant
                                                    )
                                                {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "variant initialization destination disagrees with its variant",
                        ));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => {
                                                let Some(Some(fact)) = transition_fact!(call)
                                                else {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "call commit does not name a call expression",
                        ));
                                                };
                                                // Lexical return domains duplicate postcondition bodies, so one
                                                // call legitimately commits once per proof domain; the typed
                                                // skeleton comparison counts those per-domain commits exactly.
                                                if !committed_calls.insert(
                                                    function,
                                                    call,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )? && plan.lexical_control.is_none()
                                                {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                                                        function,
                                                        "call has more than one atomic commit",
                                                    ));
                                                }
                                                transition_callback_prepare!();
                                                let params = resolved_call::resolved_call_param_view(
                        program,
                        function,
                        find_resolved_expression(function, call).ok_or_else(|| {
                            replay_error(function, "call commit expression is absent")
                        })?,
                        &fact.callee,
                        fact.instance,
                        fact.type_arguments.as_slice(),
                    )
                    .map_err(|_| {
                        replay_error(
                            function,
                            format_args!("call commit has unknown callee `{}`", fact.callee),
                        )
                    })?;
                                                if params.len() != fact.arguments.len() {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "call commit callee signature has inconsistent arity",
                        ));
                                                }
                                                if !resolved_call::owned_parameter_indices_match(
                                                    &params,
                                                    arguments,
                                                    function,
                                                    |ty| type_needs_drop(program, function, ty),
                                                )? {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "call commit does not contain every and only owned droppable parameter",
                        ));
                                                }
                                                transition_callback_complete!();
                                                let mut previous = None;
                                                let mut consumed = Directory::new(
                                                    function,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                    "cleanup consumed flag directory",
                                                )?;
                                                for argument in arguments {
                                                    if previous.is_some_and(|value| {
                                                        value >= argument.parameter_index
                                                    }) {
                                                        return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "call-commit parameters are not in strict signature order",
                            ));
                                                    }
                                                    previous = Some(argument.parameter_index);
                                                    let index = usize::try_from(argument.parameter_index).map_err(|_| {
                            replay_error(function, "call-commit parameter index does not fit usize")
                        })?;
                                                    let Some(expected_expression) =
                                                        fact.arguments.get(index)
                                                    else {
                                                        return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "call-commit parameter index exceeds call arity",
                            ));
                                                    };
                                                    match &argument.source.storage {
                                                        StorageId::CallArgument {
                                                            call: storage_call,
                                                            parameter_index,
                                                            value_expression,
                                                        } if storage_call == call
                                                            && parameter_index
                                                                == &argument.parameter_index
                                                            && value_expression
                                                                == expected_expression
                                                            && argument
                                                                .source
                                                                .projections
                                                                .is_empty() => {}
                                                        _ => {
                                                            return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "call commit does not consume its matching whole argument epoch",
                                ));
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    for flag in helpers::validate_place(
                                                        function,
                                                        &argument.source,
                                                        storage,
                                                        leaves,
                                                        session.budget,
                                                    )? {
                                                        if !consumed.insert(
                                                            function,
                                                            flag,
                                                            session.budget,
                                                        )? {
                                                            return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "atomic call commit consumes overlapping argument epochs",
                                ));
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { source } => {
                                                require_status_paid(
                                                    function,
                                                    statuses,
                                                    source,
                                                    session.budget,
                                                )?;
                                                if selected.replace(source).is_some() {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "cleanup block selects more than one failure status",
                        ));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {
                                                validate_staged_target(function, source)?;
                                                match source {
                                                    StagedCopyResultSource::Body {
                                                        expression,
                                                        ..
                                                    } => {
                                                        if expression != &function.body.id {
                                                            return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "body Copy-result stage names another expression",
                                ));
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    StagedCopyResultSource::TryResidual {
                                                        expression,
                                                        operand,
                                                        ..
                                                    }
                                                    | StagedCopyResultSource::TryOptionNone {
                                                        expression,
                                                        operand,
                                                        ..
                                                    } => {
                                                        require_transition_expression!(expression);
                                                        require_transition_expression!(operand);
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    match &block.terminator {
                                        CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {
                                            validate_owned_edge_unique(function, block.id, *edge)?;
                                            if !matches!(
                                                plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].condition,
                                                EdgeCondition::Always
                                            ) && !(matches!(
                                                function.cleanup_plan.schema,
                                                CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V6
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V7
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V8
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V9
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V10
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V11
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V12
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V13
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V15
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V16
                                                    | crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V17
                                                    | crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V18
                                                    | crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V19
                                                    | CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V14
                                            ) && matches!(
                                                plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].condition,
                                                EdgeCondition::VariantCase { matches: true, .. }
                                            )) {
                                                return Err(replay_error(
                                                    function,
                                                    "goto edge is conditional",
                                                ));
                                            }
                                        }
                                        CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {
                                            if edges.len() != 2 || edges[0] == edges[1] {
                                                return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "cleanup branch must own exactly two distinct edges",
                    ));
                                            }
                                            for edge in edges {
                                                validate_owned_edge_unique(
                                                    function, block.id, *edge,
                                                )?;
                                            }
                                            validate_branch_pair(
                                                function,
                                                &plan.edges[edges[0].0 as usize].condition,
                                                &plan.edges[edges[1].0 as usize].condition,
                                            )?;
                                        }
                                        CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {
                                            if usize::try_from(exit.0)
                                                .ok()
                                                .is_none_or(|value| value >= plan.exits.len())
                                            {
                                                return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "cleanup block references an unknown or repeated exit",
                    ));
                                            }
                                            // The eliminated insert authenticated even an already-paid
                                            // slot. Keep both zero checks before the original owner read.
                                            session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                                function,
                                                0,
                                                "cleanup referenced exit directory",
                                            )?;
                                            session.budget.charge(
                                                function,
                                                0,
                                                "cleanup referenced exit directory",
                                            )?;
                                            if plan.exits[exit.0 as usize].from != block.id {
                                                // Only a malformed owner needs a bounded previous-block
                                                // proof. Pay every control and step before these new reads.
                                                session.budget.reserve_bytes(
                                                    function,
                                                    exit_prefix::CONTROL_BYTES,
                                                    "cleanup prior exit reference controls",
                                                )?;
                                                session.budget.charge(
                                                    function,
                                                    exit_prefix::PROBE_UNITS,
                                                    "cleanup prior exit reference proof",
                                                )?;
                                                let mut probe = exit_prefix::Probe {
                                                    owner: plan.exits[exit.0 as usize].from,
                                                    current: block.id,
                                                    exit: *exit,
                                                    previous: None,
                                                    repeated: false,
                                                };
                                                if probe.owner.0 < probe.current.0 {
                                                    probe.previous =
                                                        plan.blocks.get(probe.owner.0 as usize);
                                                    if let Some(previous) = probe.previous {
                                                        probe.repeated = previous.id == probe.owner
                                                            && matches!(previous.terminator,
                                    CleanupTerminator::Exit(seen) if seen == probe.exit);
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                if probe.repeated {
                                                    return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "cleanup block references an unknown or repeated exit",
                        ));
                                                }
                                                return Err(replay_error(
                                                    function,
                                                    "cleanup exit is owned by the wrong block",
                                                ));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                drop(failure);
                                let budget = session.budget;
                                let mut expected_calls = Directory::new(
                                    function,
                                    budget,
                                    "cleanup expected call directory",
                                )?;
                                for (expression, fact) in
                                    expressions.entries_paid(function, budget)?
                                {
                                    if fact.is_some() {
                                        expected_calls.insert(function, expression, budget)?;
                                    }
                                }
                                // Control-flow-dead calls after an abrupt exit are never lowered, so the
                                // lexical profile checks commit coverage in the typed skeleton instead.
                                if plan.lexical_control.is_none()
                                    && !committed_calls.same_keys(
                                        &expected_calls,
                                        function,
                                        budget,
                                    )?
                                {
                                    return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup plan does not contain exactly one atomic commit for every call",
        ));
                                }
                            }
                            expression_facts::receiving::validate_exits_retained(
                                program,
                                function,
                                &storage,
                                &leaves,
                                &BTreeSet::new(),
                                budget,
                                &statuses,
                            )?;
                            structural_maps::validate_reference_coverage(function, budget)?;
                            structural_control::validate_ordinary_cfg(function, budget)?;
                            if !cleanup_inert_path_product_can_be_summarized(function)?
                                && !status_only_paths_can_be_summarized(function)
                                && !cleanup_inert_large_decisions_can_be_summarized(function)
                            {
                                validate_path_states::<Diagnostic>(
                                    program, function, &storage, &leaves, budget, None, helpers,
                                )?;
                                validate_typed_control_skeleton_with_index(
                                    program,
                                    function,
                                    budget,
                                    helpers,
                                    continuations,
                                )?;
                            }
                            return Ok(());
                        }
                    }
                }
                let Some(fact) = expressions.fact(function, &source.id.expression, budget)? else {
                    return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                        function,
                        semantic_refusal::Atom::UnknownStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                    ));
                };
                match (&source.id.lane, &source.producer) {
                    (
                        StatusLane::OperationFailure | StatusLane::OwnerAdmission,
                        StatusProducer::PropagatedCall { callee },
                    ) => {
                        // The payload reference is a second simultaneous receiving
                        // control; the eliminated lookup's result is not a credit.
                        budget.reserve_bytes(
                            function,
                            std::mem::size_of::<&CallFact<'_>>(),
                            "retained status call receiving control",
                        )?;
                        budget.charge(function, 1, "retained status call receiving assignment")?;
                        let Some(call) = fact else {
                            return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "propagated-call status source does not name a call expression",
                            ));
                        };
                        if call.callee.as_ref() != callee {
                            return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "propagated-call status source names the wrong callee",
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                    (
                        StatusLane::OperationFailure,
                        StatusProducer::CheckedArithmetic {
                            normalized_cases, ..
                        },
                    ) => {
                        // Complete independent discovery proved the exact held row.
                        // No case value is read here and no second case directory exists.
                        proof.member(function, source, ordinal, budget)?;
                        let _ = normalized_cases;
                    }
                    (
                        StatusLane::AllocationFailure,
                        StatusProducer::CheckedAllocation {
                            normalized_cases, ..
                        },
                    ) if function.cleanup_plan.schema
                        == crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V20
                        && *normalized_cases
                            == [
                                crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::PayloadRefused,
                                crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::SizeOverflow,
                            ] => {}
                    (StatusLane::ContractFalse, StatusProducer::ContractFalse { .. }) => {}
                    _ => {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "status source lane does not match its producer",
                        ));
                    }
                }
                budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal increment")?;
                ordinal += 1;
                while ordinal < function.cleanup_plan.status_sources.len() {
                    let source = &function.cleanup_plan.status_sources[ordinal];
                    if !prefix_owner.insert(function, &source.id, budget)? {
                        return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                            function,
                            semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                        ));
                    }
                    // Retain the actual first lookup's borrowed payload, only through this
                    // immutable source's producer match. Pay its complete receiving pointer
                    // and one assignment step; no previous result/header credit is used.
                    budget.reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        std::mem::size_of::<&Option<CallFact<'_>>>(),
                        "retained status fact receiving control",
                    )?;
                    budget.charge(function, 1, "retained status fact receiving assignment")?;
                    let Some(fact) = expressions.fact(function, &source.id.expression, budget)?
                    else {
                        return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                            function,
                            semantic_refusal::Atom::UnknownStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                        ));
                    };
                    match (&source.id.lane, &source.producer) {
                        (
                            StatusLane::OperationFailure | StatusLane::OwnerAdmission,
                            StatusProducer::PropagatedCall { callee },
                        ) => {
                            // The payload reference is a second simultaneous receiving
                            // control; the eliminated lookup's result is not a credit.
                            budget.reserve_bytes(
                                function,
                                std::mem::size_of::<&CallFact<'_>>(),
                                "retained status call receiving control",
                            )?;
                            budget.charge(
                                function,
                                1,
                                "retained status call receiving assignment",
                            )?;
                            let Some(call) = fact else {
                                return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "propagated-call status source does not name a call expression",
                                ));
                            };
                            if call.callee.as_ref() != callee {
                                return Err(replay_error(
                                    function,
                                    "propagated-call status source names the wrong callee",
                                ));
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            StatusLane::OperationFailure,
                            StatusProducer::CheckedArithmetic {
                                normalized_cases, ..
                            },
                        ) => {
                            // Complete independent discovery proved the exact held row.
                            // No case value is read here and no second case directory exists.
                            proof.member(function, source, ordinal, budget)?;
                            let _ = normalized_cases;
                        }
                        (
                            StatusLane::AllocationFailure,
                            StatusProducer::CheckedAllocation {
                                normalized_cases, ..
                            },
                        ) if function.cleanup_plan.schema
                            == crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V20
                            && *normalized_cases
                                == [
                                    crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::PayloadRefused,
                                    crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::SizeOverflow,
                                ] => {}
                        (StatusLane::ContractFalse, StatusProducer::ContractFalse { .. }) => {}
                        _ => {
                            return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "status source lane does not match its producer",
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                    budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal increment")?;
                    ordinal += 1;
                }
                prefix_owner.freeze(function, budget)?;
                budget.reserve_bytes(function, CONTROL_BYTES, "retained status full controls")?;
                attempt.complete(function, budget)?;
                break 'status_publication StatusSources {
                    function,
                    budget,
                    ledger: ClassifierLedger::capture(),
                    ids: Some(ids),
                };
            }
        }
        let prefix_owner = directory::StatusInsertionOwner::new(function, &ids, budget)?;
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            std::mem::size_of::<usize>(),
            "status case row ordinal",
        )?;
        budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal")?;
        let mut ordinal = 0usize;
        // This paid ordinal advances only after the complete fallible row body.
        // A direct while-index keeps that frontier without an Enumerate carrier.
        while ordinal < function.cleanup_plan.status_sources.len() {
            let source = &function.cleanup_plan.status_sources[ordinal];
            if !ids.insert_certified(function, &source.id, budget, &prefix_owner)? {
                return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                    function,
                    semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                ));
            }
            // Retain the actual first lookup's borrowed payload, only through this
            // immutable source's producer match. Pay its complete receiving pointer
            // and one assignment step; no previous result/header credit is used.
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                std::mem::size_of::<&Option<CallFact<'_>>>(),
                "retained status fact receiving control",
            )?;
            budget.charge(function, 1, "retained status fact receiving assignment")?;
            let Some(fact) = expressions.fact(function, &source.id.expression, budget)? else {
                return Err(<Diagnostic as semantic_refusal::Error>::structural(
                    function,
                    semantic_refusal::Atom::UnknownStatus(source.id.expression.clone()),
                ));
            };
            match (&source.id.lane, &source.producer) {
                (
                    StatusLane::OperationFailure | StatusLane::OwnerAdmission,
                    StatusProducer::PropagatedCall { callee },
                ) => {
                    // The payload reference is a second simultaneous receiving
                    // control; the eliminated lookup's result is not a credit.
                    budget.reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        std::mem::size_of::<&CallFact<'_>>(),
                        "retained status call receiving control",
                    )?;
                    budget.charge(function, 1, "retained status call receiving assignment")?;
                    let Some(call) = fact else {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "propagated-call status source does not name a call expression",
                        ));
                    };
                    if call.callee.as_ref() != callee {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "propagated-call status source names the wrong callee",
                        ));
                    }
                }
                (
                    StatusLane::OperationFailure,
                    StatusProducer::CheckedArithmetic {
                        normalized_cases, ..
                    },
                ) => {
                    // Complete independent discovery proved the exact held row.
                    // No case value is read here and no second case directory exists.
                    proof.member(function, source, ordinal, budget)?;
                    let _ = normalized_cases;
                }
                (
                    StatusLane::AllocationFailure,
                    StatusProducer::CheckedAllocation {
                        normalized_cases, ..
                    },
                ) if function.cleanup_plan.schema
                    == crate::cleanup_plan::CLEANUP_PLAN_SCHEMA_V20
                    && *normalized_cases
                        == [
                            crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::PayloadRefused,
                            crate::cleanup_plan::AllocationCase::SizeOverflow,
                        ] => {}
                (StatusLane::ContractFalse, StatusProducer::ContractFalse { .. }) => {}
                _ => {
                    return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "status source lane does not match its producer",
                    ));
                }
            }
            budget.charge(function, 1, "status case row ordinal increment")?;
            ordinal += 1;
        }
        drop(prefix_owner);
        budget.reserve_bytes(function, CONTROL_BYTES, "retained status full controls")?;
        attempt.complete(function, budget)?;
        StatusSources {
            function,
            budget,
            ledger: ClassifierLedger::capture(),
            ids: Some(ids),
        }
    };
    expression_facts::receiving::validate_regions(function, &storage, budget)?;
    expression_facts::receiving::validate_entry(function, &storage, &leaves, budget)?;
    expression_facts::receiving::validate_blocks_and_edges_retained(
        program,
        function,
        &expression_facts,
        &storage,
        &leaves,
        helpers,
        budget,
        &statuses,
    )?;
    expression_facts::receiving::validate_exits_retained(
        program,
        function,
        &storage,
        &leaves,
        &BTreeSet::new(),
        budget,
        &statuses,
    )?;
    structural_maps::validate_reference_coverage(function, budget)?;
    structural_control::validate_ordinary_cfg(function, budget)?;
    if !cleanup_inert_path_product_can_be_summarized(function)?
        && !status_only_paths_can_be_summarized(function)
        && !cleanup_inert_large_decisions_can_be_summarized(function)
    {
        validate_path_states::<Diagnostic>(
            program, function, &storage, &leaves, budget, None, helpers,
        )?;
        validate_typed_control_skeleton_with_index(
            program,
            function,
            budget,
            helpers,
            continuations,
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
use super::*;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::{ReplayBudget, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS};
use crate::hir::ResolvedProgram;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

const CAP: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
fn fixture() -> ResolvedProgram {
    crate::hir::resolve(&crate::check(
        "module release.scratch; @id(\"f\") fn f(x:i64)->i64 requires x>=0 ensures result>=0 {x+1} @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 { f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4) }",
        "release.spx").unwrap()).unwrap()
}
fn hash(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    format!("{:x}", crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(bytes)))
}
fn run(program: &ResolvedProgram, old: bool, work: usize) -> (Option<String>, usize, usize) {
    let function = program.functions.iter().find(|f| f.name == "main").unwrap();
    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
    budget.remaining = work;
    let result = match crate::cleanup_plan::replay::reserve_program_skeleton_work(
        program,
        std::iter::once(function),
        &mut budget,
    ) {
        Err(error) => Err(error),
        Ok(_) => {
            if old {
                super::super::before_structure_release::validate_structure_with_budget_storage(
                    program,
                    function,
                    &mut budget,
                    None,
                    None,
                )
            } else {
                super::super::ordinary_cross_phase::validate_structure_with_budget_storage(
                    program,
                    function,
                    &mut budget,
                    None,
                    None,
                )
            }
        }
    };
    (
        result.err().map(|d| d.json()),
        budget.remaining,
        budget.skeleton_spent,
    )
}

#[test]
fn full_immediate_receiver_and_exact_release_only_inverse_remain_independent() {
    let before = include_str!("whole.before.txt");
    assert_eq!(before.len(), 86698);
    assert_eq!(
        hash(before.as_bytes()),
        "fa232cdadb3ff7ea321caa04554d8dc2c237928b976af5890f6ed555c276b1ec"
    );
    let compiled = include_str!("before.rs");
    assert_eq!(compiled, &before[..compiled.len()]);
    assert!(before[compiled.len()..].starts_with("#[cfg(test)]"));
    let mut current = include_str!("../ordinary_cross_phase.rs").to_owned();
    for (indent, attempt) in [
        ("                                ", ", attempt"),
        ("        ", ""),
    ] {
        let after = format!("finish_structure!(program, function, budget, helpers, continuations;\n{indent}    statuses, leaves, storage, status_cases, expression_facts{attempt})?;");
        let old = format!("validate_typed_control_skeleton_with_index(\n{indent}    program,\n{indent}    function,\n{indent}    budget,\n{indent}    helpers,\n{indent}    continuations,\n{indent})?;");
        assert_eq!(current.matches(&after).count(), 1);
        current = current.replacen(&after, &old, 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(current.as_bytes(), before.as_bytes());
}

#[test]
fn whole_ordinary_and_funded_receivers_keep_work_and_complete_diagnostics() {
    let program = fixture();
    for work in [0, 1, 2, 5, 16, 64, 256, 4096, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS] {
        assert_eq!(run(&program, false, work), run(&program, true, work));
        let (old, old_refused, _) =
            crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(CAP, || run(&program, true, work));
        let (current, current_refused, _) =
            crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(CAP, || run(&program, false, work));
        assert_eq!(current, old);
        assert_eq!(current_refused, old_refused);
    }
    for mode in 0..3 {
        let mut program = fixture();
        let owner = program
            .functions
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|f| f.name == "main")
            .unwrap();
        let body = owner.body.id.clone();
        let mut changed = false;
        for block in &mut owner.cleanup_plan.blocks {
            for transition in &mut block.transitions {
                if let crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, .. } = transition
                {
                    if !changed {
                        *call = if mode == 0 {
                            body.clone()
                        } else {
                            crate::hir::ExpressionId::from_owned(format!("missing.release.{mode}"))
                        };
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assert!(changed);
        if mode == 2 {
            owner.cleanup_plan.schema = "foreign.release";
        }
        let before = format!("{program:?}");
        let old = run(&program, true, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
        let current = run(&program, false, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
        assert!(old.0.is_some());
        assert_eq!(current, old, "all six fields mode={mode}");
        assert_eq!(format!("{program:?}"), before);
    }
}

#[test]
fn independent_release_invoice_and_exact_short_zero_sticky_full_drop() {
    type Owners = (
        StatusSources<'static>,
        Leaves,
        BTreeSet<StorageId>,
        StatusCases<'static>,
        Facts<'static>,
    );
    let payment = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
        + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
    assert_eq!(RELEASE, 2 * size_of::<Owners>() + payment);
    assert_eq!(
        ATTEMPT,
        2 * size_of::<Attempt<'static, 'static>>() + payment
    );
    let program = fixture();
    let (old_ample, old_refused, _) =
        crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(CAP, || run(&program, true, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS));
    assert!(
        old_ample.0.is_none() && !old_refused,
        "complete immediate-old ample result={old_ample:?}, refused={old_refused}"
    );
    let (ample, refused, paid) = crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(CAP, || {
        run(&program, false, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS)
    });
    assert!(
        ample.0.is_none() && !refused,
        "complete current ample result={ample:?}, refused={refused}"
    );
    assert_eq!(ample, old_ample);
    for cap in [paid, paid - 1, 0] {
        let ((result, retry), refused, used) = crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(cap, || {
            let result = run(&program, false, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);
            let function = program.functions.iter().find(|f| f.name == "main").unwrap();
            let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
            let retry = budget.reserve_bytes(function, 0, "release restored account retry");
            (result, retry)
        });
        if cap == paid {
            assert!(result.0.is_none() && retry.is_ok() && !refused);
            assert_eq!(used, paid);
        } else {
            assert!(result.0.is_some() && retry.is_err() && refused);
        }
        let (_, allocation) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
            drop(crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage(cap, || {
                run(&program, false, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS)
            }));
        });
        assert!(!allocation.invalid);
        assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

#[test]
fn actual_whole_receiver_reports_physical_storage_without_forecast_credit() {
    let program = fixture();
    for old in [true, false] {
        let (_, allocation) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
            drop(run(&program, old, MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS));
        });
        assert!(!allocation.invalid);
        assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
        eprintln!("ordinary structure last-use old={old} allocation={allocation:?}");
    }
}
//! Invocation-owned receiving storage for the shared-history heapsort.
//! Only empty capacities survive a comparison; paths remain the sole root owners.
use super::*;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_budget::ByteFailure;
use std::rc::Rc;

// No frame borrows a path slot. Sorting may move every path between calls.
// Rc handles keep immutable contents alive; equality always reads those contents.
enum Frame {
    RootItems {
        next: usize,
    },
    Node(Rc<ObservationDag>),
    SeqItems {
        node: Rc<ObservationDag>,
        next: usize,
    },
}
struct Cursor {
    pending: Vec<Frame>,
    yielded: Option<Observation>,
    current: Option<Frame>,
}
struct Pair {
    left: Cursor,
    right: Cursor,
    ordering: Ordering,
}
const PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>();
// Concrete retained owners and aggregate initializers. Receiving storage is
// represented by fields, not inferred from repeated call-stack addresses.
const TRIVIAL_GUARD: usize = 2 * size_of::<bool>();
const RECEIVERS: usize = 2 * size_of::<Pair>() + 4 * size_of::<Cursor>();
// Surviving invocation transports are still paid at each old frontier. Only
// pending/current/yielded and ordering themselves belong to the retained bank.
const PREPARE_CALL: usize = 2 * PAYMENT
    + 4 * size_of::<&mut Cursor>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Frame>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
// Method receivers and completion/lent-refusal transports occur once per
// invocation. They cannot pay for the unbounded structural loop below.
const ADVANCE_CALL: usize = PAYMENT
    + 4 * size_of::<&mut Cursor>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>();
// Every other former ADVANCE_CALL role is renewed before each actual pop,
// including exhaustion. The two explicit mutable receiving views are new.
const FRAME_STEP: usize = 2 * PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Vec<Frame>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Option<Frame>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Frame>() // moved match and resumed-frame constructor
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<Frame>>() // pop/take transports; retained slot is separate
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>() // clone input/return and moved handles
    + 4 * size_of::<Observation>() // clone input/return and yielded assignment
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Observation>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::iter::Rev<std::slice::Iter<'static, Rc<ObservationDag>>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&ObservationDagKind>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[Observation]>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + size_of::<[usize; 8]>()
    + 8 * size_of::<bool>();
// Only a Node can invoke the backing-reservation producer. Pay its actual
// call plus this new renewal call at that branch, before either can form its
// transports. Item/resume/exhaustion frames never invoke the growth producer.
const NODE_STEP: usize = 2 * PAYMENT;
// A Cat can have arbitrarily many children even while the pending Vec is
// warm. Pay every iterator attempt, including its final None, and the actual
// clone, moved frame, push and handle teardown transports before forming them.
type Children<'a> = std::iter::Rev<std::slice::Iter<'a, Rc<ObservationDag>>>;
const CAT_CHILD_STEP: usize = PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Children<'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Frame>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Vec<Frame>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
const COMPARE_CALL: usize = 2 * size_of::<(
    &mut Pair,
    &SkeletonPath,
    &SkeletonPath,
    &ResolvedFunction,
    &mut ReplayBudget,
)>() + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Option<Observation>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observation>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&SkeletonObservation>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Ordering>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();

impl Cursor {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pending: Vec::new(),
            yielded: None,
            current: None,
        }
    }
    fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.yielded = None;
        self.current = None;
        self.pending.clear();
    }
    fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        observations: &Observations,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        self.clear();
        // Keep the old authentication and growth frontier, including no-growth
        // calls. A reused backing is the actual backing acquired on an earlier
        // comparison, never a credit or a guessed maximum.
        budget.reserve_compact_vec(
            function,
            &mut self.pending,
            2,
            "enumerated HIR initial cursor backing",
        )?;
        self.pending.push(Frame::RootItems { next: 0 });
        if let Some(prefix) = &observations.prefix {
            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(Rc::clone(prefix)));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    // Return only completion. The actual observation receiver lives in self;
    // neither a returned reference nor a slice iterator crosses a path swap.
    fn next(
        &mut self,
        observations: &Observations,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        self.yielded = None;
        if budget.lent_skeleton {
            return Err(budget.compact_refusal(
                function,
                "enumerated HIR cursor cannot spend a lent skeleton allowance",
                "",
            ));
        }
        loop {
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                FRAME_STEP,
                "enumerated HIR cursor frame receiving renewal",
            )?;
            self.current = self.pending.pop();
            if self.current.is_none() {
                break;
            }
            budget.charge_compact(function, 1, "enumerated HIR cursor traversal")?;
            match self.current.take().expect("the popped frame was present") {
                Frame::RootItems { next } => {
                    if let Some(item) = observations.items.get(next) {
                        self.yielded = Some(Rc::clone(item));
                        self.pending.push(Frame::RootItems { next: next + 1 });
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                Frame::SeqItems { node, next } => {
                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &node.kind else {
                        unreachable!("sequence cursor frame retains its immutable node")
                    };
                    if let Some(item) = items.get(next) {
                        self.yielded = Some(Rc::clone(item));
                        self.pending.push(Frame::SeqItems {
                            node,
                            next: next + 1,
                        });
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                Frame::Node(node) => {
                    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                        function,
                        NODE_STEP,
                        "enumerated HIR node growth receiving renewal",
                    )?;
                    match &node.kind {
                        ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {
                            budget.reserve_compact_vec(
                                function,
                                &mut self.pending,
                                2,
                                "enumerated HIR sequence cursor backing",
                            )?;
                            let prefix = prefix.as_ref().map(Rc::clone);
                            // Move this handle into the resume frame; do not clone
                            // the Seq node merely to remember its items.
                            self.pending.push(Frame::SeqItems { node, next: 0 });
                            if let Some(prefix) = prefix {
                                self.pending.push(Frame::Node(prefix));
                            }
                        }
                        ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) => {
                            budget.reserve_compact_vec(
                                function,
                                &mut self.pending,
                                children.len(),
                                "enumerated HIR concatenation cursor backing",
                            )?;
                            let mut children = children.iter().rev();
                            loop {
                                budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                                    function,
                                    CAT_CHILD_STEP,
                                    "enumerated HIR concatenation child receiving renewal",
                                )?;
                                let Some(child) = children.next() else {
                                    break;
                                };
                                self.pending.push(Frame::Node(Rc::clone(child)));
                            }
                        }
                        ObservationDagKind::Alt(_) => {
                            return Err(budget.compact_refusal(
                                function,
                                "enumerated HIR history cannot contain merged alternatives",
                                "",
                            ))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
impl Pair {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            left: Cursor::new(),
            right: Cursor::new(),
            ordering: Ordering::Equal,
        }
    }
    fn order(
        &mut self,
        a: &SkeletonPath,
        b: &SkeletonPath,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        let result = self.compare(a, b, function, budget);
        // Clear on BOTH outcomes before the caller can swap. On failure this
        // is infallible handle teardown: it cannot replace the chosen status.
        // Every node still has an original path root, so no DAG is destroyed.
        self.left.clear();
        self.right.clear();
        result
    }
    fn compare(
        &mut self,
        a: &SkeletonPath,
        b: &SkeletonPath,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            2 * PREPARE_CALL + COMPARE_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR paired cursor receivers",
        )?;
        self.left.prepare(&a.observations, function, budget)?;
        self.right.prepare(&b.observations, function, budget)?;
        loop {
            // Retained fields survive. Pay invocation transports here; next
            // separately renews every dynamic frame and Cat-child attempt.
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                2 * ADVANCE_CALL,
                "enumerated HIR paired cursor next receivers",
            )?;
            self.left.next(&a.observations, function, budget)?;
            // Right still advances when left is exhausted.
            self.right.next(&b.observations, function, budget)?;
            match (&self.left.yielded, &self.right.yielded) {
                (Some(a), Some(b)) => {
                    self.ordering = a.as_ref().cmp(b.as_ref());
                    if self.ordering != Ordering::Equal {
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                }
                (None, None) => {
                    self.ordering = a.terminal.cmp(&b.terminal);
                    return Ok(());
                }
                (None, Some(_)) => {
                    self.ordering = Ordering::Less;
                    return Ok(());
                }
                (Some(_), None) => {
                    self.ordering = Ordering::Greater;
                    return Ok(());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
fn sift(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    mut root: usize,
    end: usize,
    pair: &mut Pair,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
    loop {
        budget.charge_compact(function, 1, "enumerated HIR content sort traversal")?;
        if end < 2 || root > (end - 2) / 2 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut child = root * 2 + 1;
        if child + 1 < end {
            budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                ORDER_CALL,
                "enumerated HIR sibling order call receivers",
            )?;
            pair.order(&paths[child], &paths[child + 1], function, budget)?;
            if pair.ordering == Ordering::Less {
                child += 1;
            }
        }
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            ORDER_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR parent order call receivers",
        )?;
        pair.order(&paths[root], &paths[child], function, budget)?;
        if pair.ordering != Ordering::Less {
            return Ok(());
        }
        paths.swap(root, child);
        root = child;
    }
}
pub(super) fn sort(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), ByteFailure> {
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR content sort receivers")?;
    // The original len receiver is part of SORT_CALL. Pay the new branch
    // before querying it; a singleton performs no comparison and therefore
    // must not acquire either cursor or its receiving bank.
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
        function,
        TRIVIAL_GUARD,
        "enumerated HIR trivial content sort guard",
    )?;
    let len = paths.len();
    if len < 2 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
        function,
        RECEIVERS,
        "enumerated HIR reusable content sort receiving bank",
    )?;
    let mut pair = Pair::new();
    for root in (0..len / 2).rev() {
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, root, len, &mut pair, function, budget)?;
    }
    for end in (1..len).rev() {
        paths.swap(0, end);
        budget.reserve_compact_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, 0, end, &mut pair, function, budget)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
