//! Ordinary enumerated storage sharing; never an alternative/state union.
//! Sequence nodes use the existing prepaid iterative destruction frontier.
use super::super::*;
use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::mem::size_of;
use super::super::flat_probe;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_budget::compact_try;

// Actual selector, moved node kind, result, payment and borrowed receivers.
// The existing first clone work debit precedes these new controls.
const NODE_CALL: usize = 2 * size_of::<ObservationDag>() // Rc::new actual/formal node aggregate
    + 2 * size_of::<ObservationDagKind>() // moved actual + owned formal
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>() // actual/formal work
    + size_of::<Result<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>, Diagnostic>>()
    + size_of::<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>() // successful node receiver
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>() // checked release multiplication/addition
    + size_of::<Option<std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<dag_storage::DestructionScratch>>>>()
    + size_of::<Result<Option<std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<dag_storage::DestructionScratch>>>, Diagnostic>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>() // edge count, release count, bound, backing byte price
    + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>() // work, scratch, header and failure controls
    + 8 * size_of::<&ReplayBudget>() + 8 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + 8 * size_of::<&str>() + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const SHARE_CONTROLS: usize = NODE_CALL
    + size_of::<Observations>() // moved tail/header publication
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>() // renewal query actual/formal
    + size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>() + 12 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>() + 2 * size_of::<&[ExprSkeletonPath]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>() // actual/formal marker query
    + 2 * size_of::<&Option<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>() // borrowed Option view
    + size_of::<Option<usize>>() // marker comparison literal
    + size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupBlock>>()
    + size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupTransition>>();
pub(super) const DISPATCH_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * size_of::<Option<&std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const EXTEND_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * NODE_CALL // at most Seq head and Cat join
    + 2 * size_of::<Observations>() // moved actual + formal target
    + 2 * size_of::<&Observations>() + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>()
    + size_of::<Result<Observations, Diagnostic>>()
    + size_of::<Option<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>() // optional head
    + 4 * size_of::<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>() // head, prefix borrow clone, joined, publication
    + size_of::<Vec<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>() // Cat backing owner
    + size_of::<Vec<Observation>>() // copied suffix owner
    + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>() + 4 * size_of::<usize>();
pub(super) const PREPEND_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * NODE_CALL // leaf head and Cat join
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Observations>() + 2 * size_of::<Observation>()
    + size_of::<Vec<Observation>>() + size_of::<Vec<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 3 * size_of::<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>() + 4 * size_of::<usize>();

macro_rules! share {
    ($work:ident, $prefix:ident) => {{
        // Two scalar results reuse the original paid split's finite probe
        // storage before prefix_fusion acquires that same lexical frame.
        // prefix_fusion owns the compile-time whole-layout inequality.
        if matches!(&$work.budget.payer, &AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder)
            && $work.budget.admission == AdmissionMode::Ordinary
            && !$work.budget.selected() && !$work.budget.merge_paths
            && !$work.budget.lent_skeleton
            && $work.function.cleanup_plan.lexical_control.is_none()
            && $prefix.observations.items.len() >= 4096
        {
            $work.budget.reserve_bytes(
                $work.function,
                $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::enumerated_prefix::SHARE_CONTROLS,
                "enumerated HIR prefix selector and publication receivers",
            )?;
            if $prefix.observations.prefix.as_ref().is_none_or(|node|
                    node.ordinal == Some($crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::enumerated_prefix::SEQUENCE_MARKER))
                && $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::enumerated_prefix::without_renewal(
                    $work,
                )?
            {
                let kind = $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::ObservationDagKind::Seq(
                    $prefix.observations.prefix.take(),
                    std::mem::take(&mut $prefix.observations.items),
                );
                $prefix.observations.prefix = Some(
                    $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::enumerated_prefix::node(
                        $work, kind,
                    )?,
                );
            }
        }
    }};
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) use share;

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn without_renewal(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    for block in &work.function.cleanup_plan.blocks {
        work.budget
            .charge(work.function, 1, "enumerated HIR renewal exclusion block")?;
        for transition in &block.transitions {
            work.budget.charge(
                work.function,
                1,
                "enumerated HIR renewal exclusion transition",
            )?;
            if matches!(
                transition,
                CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { .. } | CleanupTransition::Renew { .. }
            ) {
                return Ok(false);
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(true)
}

// Private representation marker only; content cursors still reconstruct every
// observation. It grants no equality, ordering, admission or work authority.
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const SEQUENCE_MARKER: usize = usize::MAX;

// Dedicated sequence storage: original clone/extension work uses the held
// skeleton loan; all additional bound/destruction traversal uses ordinary free
// work. Existing node layout is reused without reusing its ordinal constructor.
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn node(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
    kind: ObservationDagKind,
) -> Result<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>, Diagnostic> {
    // Caller prepays SHARE_CONTROLS before constructing the moved kind or
    // forwarding its Result. No carrier is paid retrospectively here.
    if work.budget.lent_skeleton || work.budget.merge_paths || work.budget.selected() {
        return Err(work.budget.budget_refusal(
            work.function,
            "enumerated HIR sequence storage requires ordinary free-work ownership",
            "",
        ));
    }
    let edges = kind.edges();
    let release = edges
        .checked_mul(2)
        .and_then(|count| count.checked_add(1))
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            work.budget.budget_refusal(
                work.function,
                "enumerated HIR immutable release work overflowed",
                "",
            )
        })?;
    work.budget.charge(
        work.function,
        release,
        "enumerated HIR immutable bound and release",
    )?;
    if matches!(&kind, ObservationDagKind::Alt(_)) {
        return Err(work.budget.budget_refusal(
            work.function,
            "enumerated HIR cannot construct merged alternatives",
            "",
        ));
    }
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        BOUND_CALL,
        "enumerated HIR destruction bound call receivers",
    )?;
    let bound = sequence_pending_bound(work, &kind)?.ok_or_else(|| {
        work.budget.budget_refusal(
            work.function,
            "enumerated HIR destruction bound overflowed",
            "",
        )
    })?;
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        FRONTIER_CALL,
        "enumerated HIR frontier call receivers",
    )?;
    let scratch = sequence_frontier(work, bound)?;
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        physical_clone::rc_backing_bytes::<ObservationDag>(),
        "enumerated HIR immutable sequence node",
    )?;
    Ok(std::rc::Rc::new(ObservationDag {
        ordinal: Some(SEQUENCE_MARKER),
        kind,
        pending_bound: Some(bound),
        scratch,
    }))
}

// Cursor frames borrow stable immutable node/slice storage; no Rc clone and no
// pointer identity participates in semantic comparison. Alt is always refused.
enum Frame<'a> {
    Node(&'a ObservationDag),
    Items(std::slice::Iter<'a, Observation>),
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) struct Cursor<'a> {
    pending: Vec<Frame<'a>>,
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const CURSOR_STORAGE: usize = 2 * size_of::<Cursor<'static>>();
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const CURSOR_CALL: usize =
    4 * size_of::<&mut Cursor<'static>>()
        + 4 * size_of::<Frame<'static>>()
        + 4 * size_of::<Option<Frame<'static>>>()
        + 4 * size_of::<Option<&SkeletonObservation>>()
        + 4 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
        + size_of::<Result<Option<&SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic>>()
        + 10 * size_of::<usize>()
        + 8 * size_of::<bool>()
        + 8 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
        + 8 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
        + 4 * size_of::<&Observations>()
        + 4 * size_of::<&str>();

impl<'a> Cursor<'a> {
    pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pending: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
    pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        observations: &'a Observations,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        self.pending.clear();
        budget.reserve_vec(
            function,
            &mut self.pending,
            2,
            "enumerated HIR initial cursor backing",
        )?;
        self.pending.push(Frame::Items(observations.items.iter()));
        if let Some(prefix) = &observations.prefix {
            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(prefix));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn next(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<Option<&'a SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {
        if budget.lent_skeleton {
            return Err(budget.budget_refusal(
                function,
                "enumerated HIR cursor cannot spend a lent skeleton allowance",
                "",
            ));
        }
        while let Some(frame) = self.pending.pop() {
            budget.charge(function, 1, "enumerated HIR cursor traversal")?;
            match frame {
                Frame::Items(mut items) => {
                    if let Some(item) = items.next() {
                        // The popped slot is still within paid capacity.
                        self.pending.push(Frame::Items(items));
                        return Ok(Some(item.as_ref()));
                    }
                }
                Frame::Node(node) => match &node.kind {
                    ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, items) => {
                        budget.reserve_vec(
                            function,
                            &mut self.pending,
                            2,
                            "enumerated HIR sequence cursor backing",
                        )?;
                        self.pending.push(Frame::Items(items.iter()));
                        if let Some(prefix) = prefix {
                            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(prefix));
                        }
                    }
                    ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) => {
                        budget.reserve_vec(
                            function,
                            &mut self.pending,
                            children.len(),
                            "enumerated HIR concatenation cursor backing",
                        )?;
                        for child in children.iter().rev() {
                            self.pending.push(Frame::Node(child));
                        }
                    }
                    ObservationDagKind::Alt(_) => {
                        return Err(budget.budget_refusal(
                            function,
                            "enumerated HIR history cannot contain merged alternatives",
                            "",
                        ))
                    }
                },
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }
}

const ORDER_CALL: usize = 4 * size_of::<&SkeletonPath>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    + size_of::<Result<Ordering, Diagnostic>>()
    + size_of::<Ordering>();
fn order(
    a: &SkeletonPath,
    b: &SkeletonPath,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Ordering, Diagnostic> {
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        2 * CURSOR_STORAGE + 2 * CURSOR_CALL,
        "enumerated HIR paired cursor receivers",
    )?;
    let mut left = Cursor::new();
    let mut right = Cursor::new();
    left.prepare(&a.observations, function, budget)?;
    right.prepare(&b.observations, function, budget)?;
    loop {
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            2 * CURSOR_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR paired cursor next receivers",
        )?;
        let x = left.next(function, budget)?;
        let y = right.next(function, budget)?;
        match (x, y) {
            (Some(a), Some(b)) => {
                let order = a.cmp(b);
                if order != Ordering::Equal {
                    return Ok(order);
                }
            }
            (None, None) => return Ok(a.terminal.cmp(&b.terminal)),
            (None, Some(_)) => return Ok(Ordering::Less),
            (Some(_), None) => return Ok(Ordering::Greater),
        }
    }
}

const SORT_CALL: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut [SkeletonPath]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    // Eight scalar receiver bytes, type-only: no runtime array is constructed.
    + size_of::<[usize; 8]>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::iter::Rev<std::ops::Range<usize>>>()
    + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
fn sift(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    mut root: usize,
    end: usize,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    loop {
        budget.charge(function, 1, "enumerated HIR content sort traversal")?;
        if end < 2 || root > (end - 2) / 2 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut child = root * 2 + 1;
        if child + 1 < end {
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                ORDER_CALL,
                "enumerated HIR sibling order call receivers",
            )?;
            if order(&paths[child], &paths[child + 1], function, budget)? == Ordering::Less {
                child += 1;
            }
        }
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            ORDER_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR parent order call receivers",
        )?;
        if order(&paths[root], &paths[child], function, budget)? != Ordering::Less {
            return Ok(());
        }
        paths.swap(root, child);
        root = child;
    }
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const ENTRY_CALL: usize = 4 * size_of::<&[SkeletonPath]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut [SkeletonPath]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    + size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
    + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const HIR_QUERY_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * size_of::<
    &Option<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>,
>() + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn sort(
    paths: &mut [SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    // Preserve the former ordering algorithm on flat inputs. Ordinary entry
    // query receivers are charged separately; Selected/Oracle never call here.
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        flat_probe::CALL,
        "enumerated HIR sort flat probe call",
    )?;
    if compact_try!(flat_probe::all_flat(paths, function, budget)) {
        paths.sort();
        return Ok(());
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR content sort receivers")?;
    let len = paths.len();
    for root in (0..len / 2).rev() {
        budget.reserve_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, root, len, function, budget)?;
    }
    for end in (1..len).rev() {
        paths.swap(0, end);
        budget.reserve_bytes(function, SORT_CALL, "enumerated HIR sift call receivers")?;
        sift(paths, 0, end, function, budget)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn equal(
    left: &[SkeletonPath],
    right: &[SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        flat_probe::CALL,
        "enumerated HIR left flat probe call",
    )?;
    let left_flat = compact_try!(flat_probe::all_flat(left, function, budget));
    let both_flat = if left_flat {
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            flat_probe::CALL,
            "enumerated HIR right flat probe call",
        )?;
        compact_try!(flat_probe::all_flat(right, function, budget))
    } else {
        false
    };
    if both_flat {
        return Ok(left == right);
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        ORDER_CALL
            + 4 * size_of::<&[SkeletonPath]>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
        "enumerated HIR equality receivers",
    )?;
    if left.len() != right.len() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    // Own both concrete iterator values and the Zip before forming them.
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        ZIP_INIT,
        "enumerated HIR equality zip initializer",
    )?;
    let mut pairs = left.iter().zip(right.iter());
    loop {
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            ZIP_NEXT,
            "enumerated HIR equality zip next receivers",
        )?;
        let Some((left, right)) = pairs.next() else {
            break;
        };
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            ORDER_CALL,
            "enumerated HIR equality order call receivers",
        )?;
        if order(left, right, function, budget)? != Ordering::Equal {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
    Ok(true)
}


pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn extend(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
    target: Observations,
    suffix: &Observations,
) -> Result<Observations, Diagnostic> {
    let prefix = suffix
        .prefix
        .as_ref()
        .expect("shared suffix observed by caller");
    let head = if target.items.is_empty() {
        target.prefix
    } else {
        Some(node(
            work,
            ObservationDagKind::Seq(target.prefix, target.items),
        )?)
    };
    let joined = match head {
        None => prefix.clone(),
        Some(head) => {
            work.budget.reserve_array::<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>(
                work.function,
                2,
                "enumerated HIR concatenation backing",
            )?;
            node(work, ObservationDagKind::Cat(vec![head, prefix.clone()]))?
        }
    };
    work.budget
        .reserve_clone(work.function, &suffix.items, "ordinary DAG suffix tail")?;
    Ok(Observations {
        prefix: Some(joined),
        items: suffix.items.clone(),
    })
}
pub(super) fn prepend(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
    target: &mut Observations,
    observation: Observation,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    work.budget
        .reserve_array::<Observation>(work.function, 1, "enumerated HIR prepend head")?;
    let head = node(work, ObservationDagKind::Seq(None, vec![observation]))?;
    work.budget.reserve_array::<std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>>(
        work.function,
        2,
        "enumerated HIR prepend concatenation",
    )?;
    let prefix = target
        .prefix
        .as_ref()
        .expect("shared prepend caller")
        .clone();
    target.prefix = Some(node(work, ObservationDagKind::Cat(vec![head, prefix]))?);
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
thread_local! {
    static ORIGINAL: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
}
#[cfg(test)]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn original_selected() -> bool {
    ORIGINAL.with(std::cell::Cell::get)
}
#[cfg(test)]
pub(super) fn with_original<T>(operation: impl FnOnce() -> T) -> T {
    struct Restore(bool);
    impl Drop for Restore {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            ORIGINAL.with(|flag| flag.set(self.0));
        }
    }
    let previous = ORIGINAL.with(|flag| flag.replace(true));
    let _restore = Restore(previous);
    operation()
}
#[cfg(test)]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn old_sequence(
    prefixes: Vec<ExprSkeletonPath>,
    suffixes: &[ExprSkeletonPath],
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
) -> Result<Vec<ExprSkeletonPath>, Diagnostic> {
    before::sequence_skeleton_paths(prefixes, suffixes, work)
}

// New callers own these argument/return transports before forwarding them.
type Scratch = dag_storage::DestructionScratch;
type ScratchRc = std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Scratch>>;
type NodeRc = std::rc::Rc<ObservationDag>;
const PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>();
const BOUND_CALL: usize = 2
    * size_of::<(&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>, &ObservationDagKind)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic>>();
const FRONTIER_CALL: usize = PAYMENT // original frontier zero-reservation transport
    + 2 * size_of::<(&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>, usize)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<Option<ScratchRc>, Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>();
// pending_bound was a new borrowed call too: explicit match transport and fold.
fn sequence_pending_bound(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
    kind: &ObservationDagKind,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic> {
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        PAYMENT
            + 2 * size_of::<&ObservationDagKind>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&Option<NodeRc>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Option<&NodeRc>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&NodeRc>()
            + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
        "enumerated HIR destruction bound borrowed query",
    )?;
    match kind {
        ObservationDagKind::Seq(None, _) => Ok(Some(0)),
        ObservationDagKind::Seq(Some(child), _) => {
            Ok(child.pending_bound.map(|bound| bound.max(1)))
        }
        ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) | ObservationDagKind::Alt(children) => {
            work.budget.reserve_bytes(
                work.function,
                PAYMENT
                    + 2 * size_of::<&Vec<NodeRc>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, NodeRc>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<std::iter::Enumerate<std::slice::Iter<'static, NodeRc>>>(),
                "enumerated HIR destruction bound fold initializer",
            )?;
            let mut bound = children.len();
            let mut pending = children.iter().enumerate();
            loop {
                work.budget.reserve_bytes(work.function,
                    PAYMENT + 2 * size_of::<&mut std::iter::Enumerate<std::slice::Iter<'static, NodeRc>>>()
                        + 2 * size_of::<Option<(usize, &NodeRc)>>() + 2 * size_of::<(usize, &NodeRc)>()
                        + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
                        + 3 * size_of::<usize>() + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
                    "enumerated HIR destruction bound fold next")?;
                let Some((ordinal, child)) = pending.next() else {
                    break;
                };
                let Some(child_bound) = child.pending_bound else {
                    return Ok(None);
                };
                let Some(total) = ordinal.checked_add(child_bound) else {
                    return Ok(None);
                };
                bound = bound.max(total);
            }
            Ok(Some(bound))
        }
    }
}
fn sequence_frontier(
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
    required: usize,
) -> Result<Option<ScratchRc>, Diagnostic> {
    // Same original sticky check and capacity algorithm. The old frontier is
    // untouched; only this new call route acquires these additional receivers.
    work.budget
        .reserve_bytes(work.function, 0, "ordinary destruction frontier")?;
    if required == 0 {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        PAYMENT + 2 * size_of::<&Option<ScratchRc>>() + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
        "enumerated HIR scratch presence query",
    )?;
    if work.ordinary_scratch.is_none() {
        work.budget.reserve_bytes(
            work.function,
            PAYMENT // this receiver-fee call
                + PAYMENT // the real scratch-header backing call below
                + 2 * size_of::<Scratch>()
                + 2 * size_of::<std::cell::RefCell<Scratch>>()
                + 2 * size_of::<ScratchRc>()
                + 2 * size_of::<Option<ScratchRc>>()
                + 2 * size_of::<Vec<NodeRc>>(),
            "enumerated HIR scratch initializer receivers",
        )?;
        work.budget.reserve_bytes(
            work.function,
            physical_clone::rc_backing_bytes::<std::cell::RefCell<Scratch>>(),
            "ordinary destruction scratch header",
        )?;
        work.ordinary_scratch = Some(std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::RefCell::new(Scratch {
            pending: Vec::new(),
            registered_edges: 0,
            next_ordinal: 0,
        })));
    }
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        PAYMENT
            + 2 * size_of::<&Option<ScratchRc>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Option<&ScratchRc>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&ScratchRc>()
            + 2 * size_of::<ScratchRc>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&str>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&std::cell::RefCell<Scratch>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<std::cell::RefMut<'static, Scratch>>()
            + 4 * size_of::<&Vec<NodeRc>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
            + 4 * size_of::<bool>(),
        "enumerated HIR scratch clone borrow and capacity query",
    )?;
    let scratch = work
        .ordinary_scratch
        .as_ref()
        .expect("funded scratch header")
        .clone();
    {
        let mut frontier = scratch.borrow_mut();
        if !frontier.pending.is_empty() {
            return Err(work.budget.budget_refusal(
                work.function,
                "ordinary destruction frontier is active",
                "",
            ));
        }
        if required > frontier.pending.capacity() {
            work.budget.reserve_bytes(
                work.function,
                PAYMENT // this receiver-fee call
                    + PAYMENT // the real replacement-array backing call below
                    + 2 * size_of::<(usize, usize)>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<Result<usize, Diagnostic>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<Vec<NodeRc>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<(&mut Vec<NodeRc>, usize)>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), std::collections::TryReserveError>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<&Vec<NodeRc>>()
                    + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
                "enumerated HIR scratch replacement allocator receivers",
            )?;
            let capacity =
                physical_storage::replay_growth_capacity(frontier.pending.capacity(), required)
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        work.budget.budget_refusal(
                            work.function,
                            "ordinary destruction frontier capacity overflowed",
                            "",
                        )
                    })?;
            work.budget.reserve_array::<NodeRc>(
                work.function,
                capacity,
                "ordinary destruction frontier",
            )?;
            let mut replacement = Vec::new();
            replacement.try_reserve_exact(capacity).map_err(|_| {
                work.budget.budget_refusal(
                    work.function,
                    "ordinary destruction frontier allocation failed",
                    "",
                )
            })?;
            if replacement.capacity() != capacity {
                return Err(work.budget.budget_refusal(
                    work.function,
                    "ordinary destruction frontier capacity disagrees with its reservation",
                    "",
                ));
            }
            frontier.pending = replacement;
        }
    }
    Ok(Some(scratch))
}
#[cfg_attr(
    not(test),
    allow(dead_code, reason = "Complete original flat probe control bank")
)]
const FLAT_CALL: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&[SkeletonPath], &ResolvedFunction, &mut ReplayBudget)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, SkeletonPath>>();
#[cfg_attr(
    not(test),
    allow(
        dead_code,
        reason = "Complete original flat probe used by independent regression controls"
    )
)]
fn all_flat(
    paths: &[SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    // Root dispatch excludes borrowed-work ownership; a direct caller must
    // likewise reject it before spending a new metadata traversal debit.
    if budget.lent_skeleton {
        return Err(budget.budget_refusal(
            function,
            "enumerated HIR flat probe cannot spend a lent skeleton allowance",
            "",
        ));
    }
    let mut pending = paths.iter();
    loop {
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            2 * PAYMENT
                + 2 * size_of::<&mut std::slice::Iter<'static, SkeletonPath>>()
                + 2 * size_of::<Option<&SkeletonPath>>()
                + 2 * size_of::<&SkeletonPath>()
                + 2 * size_of::<&Option<NodeRc>>()
                + 2 * size_of::<bool>(),
            "enumerated HIR flat representation probe receivers",
        )?;
        budget.charge(function, 1, "enumerated HIR flat representation probe")?;
        let Some(path) = pending.next() else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        if path.observations.prefix.is_some() {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
}
type PathZip = std::iter::Zip<
    std::slice::Iter<'static, SkeletonPath>,
    std::slice::Iter<'static, SkeletonPath>,
>;
const ZIP_INIT: usize = PAYMENT
    + 4 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, SkeletonPath>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<PathZip>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[SkeletonPath]>();
const ZIP_NEXT: usize = PAYMENT
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut PathZip>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<(&SkeletonPath, &SkeletonPath)>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<(&SkeletonPath, &SkeletonPath)>();
//! Complete old heap algorithm remains the independently executable receiver.
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage_refusal;
use crate::test_allocation_observer::{measure, Metrics};

fn program() -> ResolvedProgram {
    let checked = crate::check(
        "module receiving_sort; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {0}",
        "receiving-sort.spx",
    )
    .unwrap();
    crate::hir::resolve(&checked).unwrap()
}
fn dag(kind: ObservationDagKind) -> Rc<ObservationDag> {
    Rc::new(ObservationDag {
        ordinal: Some(SEQUENCE_MARKER),
        kind,
        pending_bound: None,
        scratch: None,
    })
}
fn item(function: &ResolvedFunction, value: bool) -> Observation {
    Rc::new(SkeletonObservation::Boolean {
        expression: function.body.id.clone(),
        value,
    })
}
fn fixture(function: &ResolvedFunction, count: usize, width: usize) -> Vec<SkeletonPath> {
    (0..count)
        .map(|index| {
            // Independently allocated equal histories, empty Seq/Cat sentinels,
            // shared siblings, and both a Seq prefix and a root tail.
            let leaf = dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(
                None,
                (0..width).map(|_| item(function, true)).collect(),
            ));
            let prefix = dag(ObservationDagKind::Cat(vec![
                dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(None, Vec::new())),
                leaf.clone(),
                dag(ObservationDagKind::Cat(Vec::new())),
                dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(
                    Some(leaf),
                    vec![item(function, index % 3 == 0)],
                )),
            ]));
            SkeletonPath {
                observations: Observations {
                    prefix: Some(prefix),
                    items: if index % 4 == 0 {
                        Vec::new()
                    } else {
                        vec![item(function, index % 2 == 0)]
                    },
                },
                terminal: match index % 3 {
                    0 => SkeletonTerminal::Success,
                    1 => SkeletonTerminal::Failure,
                    _ => SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch,
                },
            }
        })
        .rev()
        .collect()
}
fn contents(paths: &[SkeletonPath]) -> Vec<(Vec<SkeletonObservation>, SkeletonTerminal)> {
    fn append(node: &ObservationDag, out: &mut Vec<SkeletonObservation>) {
        match &node.kind {
            ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, items) => {
                if let Some(prefix) = prefix {
                    append(prefix, out);
                }
                out.extend(items.iter().map(|item| item.as_ref().clone()));
            }
            ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) | ObservationDagKind::Alt(children) => {
                for child in children {
                    append(child, out);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    paths
        .iter()
        .map(|path| {
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            if let Some(prefix) = &path.observations.prefix {
                append(prefix, &mut out);
            }
            out.extend(
                path.observations
                    .items
                    .iter()
                    .map(|item| item.as_ref().clone()),
            );
            (out, path.terminal)
        })
        .collect()
}
#[derive(Debug)]
struct Run {
    result: Result<(), String>,
    paths: Vec<(Vec<SkeletonObservation>, SkeletonTerminal)>,
    remaining: usize,
    skeleton_remaining: usize,
    skeleton_spent: usize,
    refused: bool,
    refusal_spent: bool,
    paid: usize,
    heap: Metrics,
    sticky: Option<String>,
}
fn run(
    current: bool,
    input: &[SkeletonPath],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    work: usize,
    bytes: usize,
    floor: usize,
    lent: bool,
) -> Run {
    let mut paths = input.to_vec();
    let (
        (
            result,
            snapshot,
            remaining,
            skeleton_remaining,
            skeleton_spent,
            refusal_spent,
            heap,
            sticky,
        ),
        refused,
        paid,
        _,
    ) = with_limit_usage_refusal(bytes, || {
        let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(work);
        assert!(matches!(budget.payer, AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder));
        budget.remaining = work;
        budget.lent_skeleton = lent;
        assert!(crate::bounded_output::set_active_floor(floor));
        let (result, heap) = measure(|| {
            if current {
                super::super::sort(&mut paths, function, &mut budget)
            } else {
                before::sort(&mut paths, function, &mut budget)
            }
        });
        let snapshot = contents(&paths);
        let result = result.map_err(|error| error.json());
        let sticky = if budget.refusal_spent || crate::bounded_output::active_refused() {
            Some(
                budget
                    .reserve_compact_bytes(function, 0, "post-sort sticky control")
                    .unwrap_err()
                    .into_diagnostic()
                    .json(),
            )
        } else {
            None
        };
        (
            result,
            snapshot,
            budget.remaining,
            budget.skeleton_remaining,
            budget.skeleton_spent,
            budget.refusal_spent,
            heap,
            sticky,
        )
    });
    Run {
        result,
        paths: snapshot,
        remaining,
        skeleton_remaining,
        skeleton_spent,
        refused,
        refusal_spent,
        paid,
        heap,
        sticky,
    }
}
fn same_work(old: &Run, new: &Run) {
    assert_eq!(old.result, new.result);
    assert_eq!(old.paths, new.paths);
    assert_eq!(old.remaining, new.remaining);
    assert_eq!(old.skeleton_remaining, new.skeleton_remaining);
    assert_eq!(old.skeleton_spent, new.skeleton_spent);
    assert_eq!(old.refusal_spent, new.refusal_spent);
    assert_eq!(old.refused, new.refused);
    assert_eq!(old.sticky, new.sticky);
}
#[test]
fn every_work_cut_keeps_complete_content_terminal_multiplicity_and_partial_permutation() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    for count in [0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 12] {
        let paths = fixture(function, count, 3);
        let old = run(false, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, false);
        let visits = usize::MAX - old.remaining;
        for work in (0..=visits + 1).chain([usize::MAX]) {
            same_work(
                &run(false, &paths, function, work, usize::MAX, 0, false),
                &run(true, &paths, function, work, usize::MAX, 0, false),
            );
        }
        same_work(
            &run(false, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, true),
            &run(true, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, true),
        );
    }
}
#[test]
fn real_backings_are_reused_across_swaps_and_early_mismatches() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let paths = fixture(function, 32, 64);
    let old = run(false, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, false);
    let new = run(true, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, false);
    same_work(&old, &new);
    assert!(new.heap.allocations < old.heap.allocations);
    assert!(new.heap.allocated < old.heap.allocated);
    assert!(new.paid < old.paid, "old={old:?} new={new:?}");
    assert!(ADVANCE_CALL < CURSOR_CALL);
    assert!(2 * PREPARE_CALL + COMPARE_CALL < 2 * CURSOR_STORAGE + 2 * CURSOR_CALL);
    // Both executions use the exact same real ActiveBuilder cap. The old
    // admitted cap must still admit the replacement; the replacement's exact
    // cap is also tested against the full prior algorithm, not a byte estimate.
    let same_cap = run(true, &paths, function, usize::MAX, old.paid, 0, false);
    same_work(&old, &same_cap);
    let prior_at_new_cap = run(false, &paths, function, usize::MAX, new.paid, 0, false);
    assert!(prior_at_new_cap.result.is_err());
    assert!(prior_at_new_cap.refused || prior_at_new_cap.refusal_spent);
    assert!(!old.heap.invalid && !new.heap.invalid);
    // This window retains the budget's refusal backing. The separate complete
    // cold invocation below includes that budget and every input's final Drop.
}
#[test]
fn exact_physical_limit_floor_and_sticky_failure_keep_all_diagnostic_fields() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let paths = fixture(function, 7, 8);
    let healthy = run(true, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, false);
    assert!(healthy.result.is_ok());
    for floor in [0, 1, 64] {
        let exact = run(
            true,
            &paths,
            function,
            usize::MAX,
            healthy.paid + floor,
            floor,
            false,
        );
        assert_eq!(exact.result, healthy.result);
        assert_eq!(exact.paths, healthy.paths);
        assert_eq!(exact.paid, healthy.paid);
        let short = run(
            true,
            &paths,
            function,
            usize::MAX,
            healthy.paid + floor - 1,
            floor,
            false,
        );
        assert!(short.result.is_err());
        assert!(short.refused || short.refusal_spent);
        assert!(short.sticky.is_some());
    }
    // Mixed cuts are deterministic even where the physically wider initial
    // frame and retained bank intentionally change byte refusal frontiers.
    for work in [0, 1, 3, 17, 64, usize::MAX] {
        for bytes in [0, 1, healthy.paid / 2, healthy.paid] {
            let a = run(true, &paths, function, work, bytes, 0, false);
            let b = run(true, &paths, function, work, bytes, 0, false);
            same_work(&a, &b);
            assert_eq!(a.paid, b.paid);
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn alt_refusal_and_left_exhaustion_still_visit_the_original_right_frontier() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let mut paths = fixture(function, 2, 0);
    paths[0].observations = Observations {

        items: Vec::new(),
    };
    paths[1].observations = Observations {
        prefix: Some(dag(ObservationDagKind::Alt(Vec::new()))),
        items: Vec::new(),

        same_work(
            &run(false, &paths, function, work, usize::MAX, 0, false),

    let new = run(true, &paths, function, usize::MAX, usize::MAX, 0, false);

        .result
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("cannot contain merged alternatives"));
}

#[test]
fn paired_capacity_grows_only_when_needed_and_retains_no_path_handles_between_calls() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let shallow = fixture(function, 2, 1);
    let wide = |value| SkeletonPath {
        observations: Observations {
            prefix: Some(dag(ObservationDagKind::Cat(
                (0..33)
                    .map(|_| dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(None, vec![item(function, value)])))
                    .collect(),
            ))),
            items: Vec::new(),
        },
        terminal: SkeletonTerminal::Success,
    };
    let mut paths = vec![wide(true), wide(false)];
    let original_counts: Vec<_> = paths
        .iter()
        .map(|path| Rc::strong_count(path.observations.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()))
        .collect();
    let ((), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
        budget
            .reserve_compact_bytes(function, RECEIVERS, "test paired bank")
            .unwrap();
        let mut pair = Pair::new();
        pair.order(&shallow[0], &shallow[1], function, &mut budget)
            .unwrap();
        let small = pair.left.pending.capacity();
        pair.order(&paths[0], &paths[1], function, &mut budget)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(pair.left.pending.capacity() > small);
        let pointers = (pair.left.pending.as_ptr(), pair.right.pending.as_ptr());
        let capacity = (pair.left.pending.capacity(), pair.right.pending.capacity());
        for _ in 0..8 {
            paths.swap(0, 1);
            pair.order(&paths[0], &paths[1], function, &mut budget)
                .unwrap();
            assert!(pair.left.pending.is_empty() && pair.right.pending.is_empty());
            assert!(pair.left.yielded.is_none() && pair.right.yielded.is_none());
            assert_eq!(
                (pair.left.pending.as_ptr(), pair.right.pending.as_ptr()),
                pointers
            );
            assert_eq!(
                (pair.left.pending.capacity(), pair.right.pending.capacity()),
                capacity
            );
        }
        for (path, count) in paths.iter().zip(original_counts) {
            assert_eq!(
                Rc::strong_count(path.observations.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()),
                count
            );
        }
    });
    assert!(!refused);
}
#[test]
fn complete_cold_invocation_including_owned_input_drop_releases_every_backing() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let cold = |current| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut paths = fixture(function, 32, 32);
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                if current {
                    super::super::sort(&mut paths, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
                } else {
                    before::sort(&mut paths, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
                }
                // Input construction, the complete algorithm and terminal destruction
                // share one observation. No retained external node masks final Drop.
                drop(paths);
                drop(budget);
            })
        })
    };
    let (((), old), old_refused, _, _) = cold(false);
    let (((), new), new_refused, _, _) = cold(true);
    assert!(!old_refused && !new_refused);
    assert!(!old.invalid && !new.invalid);
    assert_eq!(old.live, 0);
    assert_eq!(new.live, 0);
    assert!(new.allocations < old.allocations);
    assert!(new.allocated < old.allocated);
}
#[test]
fn unwind_releases_temporary_handles_while_original_paths_still_own_every_node() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let paths = fixture(function, 2, 3);
    let root = paths[0].observations.prefix.as_ref().unwrap();
    let original = Rc::strong_count(root);
    let ((), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let result = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
            let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
            budget
                .reserve_compact_bytes(function, RECEIVERS, "test unwind bank")
                .unwrap();
            let mut pair = Pair::new();
            pair.left
                .prepare(&paths[0].observations, function, &mut budget)
                .unwrap();
            assert!(Rc::strong_count(root) > original);
            pair.left
                .next(&paths[0].observations, function, &mut budget)
                .unwrap();
            panic!("test receiving bank unwind");
        }));
        assert!(result.is_err());
        assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(root), original);
    });
    assert!(!refused);
}

#[test]
fn singleton_shared_sort_never_acquires_a_cursor_or_receiving_bank() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let paths = fixture(function, 1, 8);
    // One original flat-probe work unit admits this nonflat singleton. The
    // shared heapsort has no comparisons, no swaps and no traversal work.
    let old = run(false, &paths, function, 1, usize::MAX, 0, false);
    let new = run(true, &paths, function, 1, usize::MAX, 0, false);
    same_work(&old, &new);
    assert!(new.result.is_ok());
    assert_eq!(new.remaining, 0);
    assert_eq!(new.paid, old.paid + TRIVIAL_GUARD);
    assert_eq!(new.heap, old.heap);
    let exact = run(true, &paths, function, 1, new.paid, 0, false);
    assert_eq!(exact.result, new.result);
    assert_eq!(exact.paths, new.paths);
    assert_eq!(exact.paid, new.paid);
    assert_eq!(exact.remaining, 0);
}

#[test]
fn every_deep_empty_frame_and_warm_cat_child_attempt_renews_its_actual_invoice() {
    let program = program();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    for depth in [0, 1, 17, 257] {
        for children in [0, 1, 33, 129] {
            let mut prefix = dag(ObservationDagKind::Cat(
                (0..children)
                    .map(|_| dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(None, Vec::new())))
                    .collect(),
            ));
            for _ in 0..depth {
                prefix = dag(ObservationDagKind::Seq(Some(prefix), Vec::new()));
            }
            let observations = Observations {
                prefix: Some(prefix),
                items: Vec::new(),
            };
            // Each Seq has a node and an exhausted item frame. The Cat node
            // and exhausted root-items frame add two; pop also attempts None.
            let frames = 2 * depth + 2 * children + 2;
            let attempts = frames + 1;
            let child_attempts = children + 1;
            let ((), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                budget
                    .reserve_compact_bytes(
                        function,
                        RECEIVERS + PREPARE_CALL + ADVANCE_CALL,
                        "test structural cursor ownership",
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                let mut cursor = Cursor::new();
                cursor
                    .prepare(&observations, function, &mut budget)
                    .unwrap();
                cursor.next(&observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
                assert!(cursor.pending.is_empty() && cursor.yielded.is_none());
                budget
                    .reserve_compact_bytes(
                        function,
                        PREPARE_CALL,
                        "test warm structural cursor prepare",
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                cursor
                    .prepare(&observations, function, &mut budget)
                    .unwrap();
                let capacity = cursor.pending.capacity();
                let pointer = cursor.pending.as_ptr();
                let bytes = crate::bounded_output::active_remaining().unwrap();
                let work = budget.remaining;
                let ((), heap) = measure(|| {
                    budget
                        .reserve_compact_bytes(
                            function,
                            ADVANCE_CALL,
                            "test warm structural cursor invocation",
                        )
                        .unwrap();
                    cursor.next(&observations, function, &mut budget).unwrap();
                });
                assert!(!heap.invalid);
                assert_eq!(heap.allocated, 0, "all pending backing is already warm");
                assert_eq!(cursor.pending.capacity(), capacity);
                assert_eq!(cursor.pending.as_ptr(), pointer);
                assert_eq!(work - budget.remaining, frames);
                assert_eq!(
                    bytes - crate::bounded_output::active_remaining().unwrap(),
                    ADVANCE_CALL
                        + attempts * FRAME_STEP
                        + child_attempts * CAT_CHILD_STEP
                        + (depth + children + 1) * NODE_STEP
                );
                assert!(
                    cursor.pending.is_empty()
                        && cursor.current.is_none()
                        && cursor.yielded.is_none()
                );

                before_frame_pricing::verify_original_warm_invoice(
                    &observations,
                    function,
                    frames,
                    attempts,
                    child_attempts,
                );

                let mut old_budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                old_budget
                    .reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        CURSOR_STORAGE + CURSOR_CALL,
                        "test original structural cursor ownership",
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                let mut old = before::Cursor::new();
                old.prepare(&observations, function, &mut old_budget)
                    .unwrap();
                old_budget
                    .reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        CURSOR_CALL,
                        "test original structural cursor invocation",
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                let old_work = old_budget.remaining;
                assert!(old.next(function, &mut old_budget).unwrap().is_none());
                assert_eq!(old_work - old_budget.remaining, frames);
            });
            assert!(!refused);
        }
    }
}

//! One invocation's explicitly paid insertion receivers and terminal report.
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::btree_node_upper;
use super::{Diagnostic, ReplayBudget, ResolvedFunction};
use crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::ClassifierLedger;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_budget::ByteFailure;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, marker::PhantomData, mem::size_of};

pub(super) struct Insertions<T> {
    pub(super) failed: bool,
    refusal: Option<Diagnostic>,
    entry: bool,
    function: *const ResolvedFunction,
    budget: *const ReplayBudget,
    ledger: ClassifierLedger,
    owned: usize,
    held: usize,
    marker: PhantomData<fn() -> T>,
}
impl<T: Ord> Insertions<T> {
    // Aggregate initializer, named mutable result and caller receiving owner;
    // the Result<Self> wrapper remains separate, plus constructor/payment Results,
    // inert ledger return, refusal None/Some/take and terminal Diagnostic moves.
    pub(super) fn controls() -> usize {
        3 * size_of::<Self>()
            + size_of::<Result<Self, Diagnostic>>()
            + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
            + size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()
            + 3 * size_of::<Option<Diagnostic>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
            + size_of::<&mut Self>()
            + size_of::<&mut Option<Diagnostic>>()
            + 5 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
            + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
            + ClassifierLedger::insertion_terminal_controls()
            // At most one positive-payment failure reaches conversion. Pay its
            // actual/formal compact values and Diagnostic construction/return
            // once, before any entry; sticky failure forbids reuse.
            + 2 * size_of::<ByteFailure>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
    }
    // A single entry's actual method/gateway/positive-reservation receivers.
    // Each entry consumes this bank and pays the next bank afresh. The final
    // unused entry remains reserved: no reset, refund or allowance donation.
    pub(super) fn entry_controls() -> usize {
        2 * size_of::<&mut Self>()
            + 4 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
            + 4 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
            + size_of::<&mut Option<Diagnostic>>()
            + size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
            + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls()
    }
    pub(super) fn acquire(
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<Self, Diagnostic> {
        if budget.pays_allocations() {
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                Self::controls() + Self::entry_controls(),
                "ownership insertion receiving controls",
            )?;
        }
        let node = btree_node_upper::<Box<T>, ()>().unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
        let owned = node
            .checked_add(size_of::<T>())
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(2 * size_of::<Box<T>>()))
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(Self::entry_controls()))
            .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
        let held = node.saturating_add(Self::entry_controls());
        let mut result = Self {
            failed: false,
            refusal: None,
            entry: true,
            function: std::ptr::from_ref(function),
            budget: std::ptr::from_ref(budget),
            ledger: ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving(),
            owned,
            held,
            marker: PhantomData,
        };
        result.ledger.capture_current_into();
        Ok(result)
    }
    fn authenticate(&mut self, function: &ResolvedFunction, budget: &mut ReplayBudget) {
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        assert!(self.entry);
        self.entry = false;
        // Compare exact receiver identity before querying a possibly foreign
        // payer. The held ledger poisons only its original owner on mismatch.
        if self.function != std::ptr::from_ref(function)
            || self.budget != std::ptr::from_ref(budget)
            || !self.ledger.current()
        {
            self.ledger.reject_storage();
            self.refusal = Some(Diagnostic::io("SPX-H006", String::new()));
            self.failed = true;
            return;
        }
        budget.authenticate_zero_into(
            function,
            "incoming ownership state authority",
            &mut self.refusal,
        );
        self.failed = self.refusal.is_some();
    }
    pub(super) fn insert_owned(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        target: &mut BTreeSet<Box<T>>,
        value: T,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) {
        self.authenticate(function, budget);
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        if target.contains(&value) {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                Self::entry_controls(),
                "ownership duplicate receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error.into_diagnostic());
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
        } else {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                self.owned,
                "incoming ownership state node, box and receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error.into_diagnostic());
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
            target.insert(Box::new(value));
        }
        self.entry = true;
    }
    pub(super) fn insert_held(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        target: &mut BTreeSet<Box<T>>,
        value: Box<T>,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) {
        self.authenticate(function, budget);
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        if target.contains(value.as_ref()) {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                Self::entry_controls(),
                "ownership held duplicate receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error.into_diagnostic());
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
        } else {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                self.held,
                "incoming held ownership state node and receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error.into_diagnostic());
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
            target.insert(value);
        }
        self.entry = true;
    }
    // One terminal publication: callers return immediately. The owner remains
    // failed after the report moves, so neither backing nor a bank can revive.
    pub(super) fn failure(&mut self) -> Diagnostic {
        assert!(self.failed);
        self.refusal
            .take()
            .expect("ownership insertion report moves once")
    }
}

//! Producer branch-join normalization for one deduplicated incoming state.
//!
//! The builder's `merge_states` re-keys conditional variant roots at every
//! ordinary branch join, including a join whose arms carry identical ownership.
//! The incoming `BTreeSet` collapses those identical arms to one state, so the
//! replay must still apply the same join at that block. Loop exits and cleanup
//! exit continuations never merge, and keep their single incoming order.
//!
//! Every root comparison, classifier initialization, edge visit, probe and the
//! self-join itself debit the caller's `ReplayBudget` before they run. The
//! block's `join_units` covers live order and renewals only, never this work.
use super::*;

/// Lazily classified so plans whose conditional roots never cross their key
/// order pay no classification work or storage.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct BranchJoins(Option<Vec<usize>>);

/// A block reached by any edge other than an unconditional `Goto`.
const MIXED: usize = usize::MAX;

/// Keys one `BTreeMap` search may visit in the declaration index: at most
/// eleven per node, and each B-tree level at least doubles its entries.
const INDEX_SEARCH_COMPARISONS: usize = 11 * usize::BITS as usize;

/// Upper bound on the work of one derived `CleanupPlace` comparison: every
/// identity byte, discriminant, fingerprint and projection boundary it reads.
fn place_key_units(
    place: &CleanupPlace,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic> {
    budget.charge(function, 1, "branch join estimate visits")?;
    budget.charge(
        function,
        place.projections.len(),
        "branch join estimate visits",
    )?;
    Ok((|| {
        let storage = match &place.storage {
            StorageId::Value(value) => value.as_str().len().checked_add(1)?,
            StorageId::Temporary(expression) => expression.as_str().len(),
            StorageId::CallArgument {
                call,
                value_expression,
                ..
            } => call
                .as_str()
                .len()
                .checked_add(value_expression.as_str().len())?
                .checked_add(1)?,
            StorageId::ProvisionalResult => 0,
        };
        place
            .projections
            .iter()
            .try_fold(storage.checked_add(2)?, |n, id| {
                n.checked_add(id.as_str().len())?.checked_add(1)
            })
    })())
}

fn root_pair_units(
    left: &CleanupPlace,
    right: &CleanupPlace,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic> {
    let left = place_key_units(left, function, budget)?;
    let right = place_key_units(right, function, budget)?;
    Ok(left
        .zip(right)
        .and_then(|(a, b)| a.checked_add(b)?.checked_add(1)))
}

/// `join_conditional_variants(v, v)` before its domain lookups: both root
/// indices (4n searches), the key-set check (n) and the indexed probes (n),
/// each search visiting at most n roots; then per variant its identity
/// comparison, two declaration-index searches (the domain bound's and the
/// join's), both case indices and the case union (12c² case comparisons),
/// the count check and the joined identity.
fn self_join_units(
    variants: &[ReplayConditionalVariant],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic> {
    let n = variants.len();
    let mut key = 0;
    for value in variants {
        budget.charge(function, 1, "branch join estimate visits")?;
        let Some(size) = place_key_units(&value.root, function, budget)? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        key = key.max(size);
    }
    let Some(mut units) = n
        .checked_mul(n)
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(5))
        .and_then(|v| v.checked_add(n))
        .and_then(|v| key.checked_mul(2)?.checked_add(1)?.checked_mul(v))
    else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    for value in variants {
        budget.charge(function, 1, "branch join estimate visits")?;
        budget.charge(function, value.cases.len(), "branch join estimate visits")?;
        let c = value.cases.len();
        let case_key = value
            .cases
            .iter()
            .fold(0_usize, |max, (id, _)| max.max(id.as_str().len()));
        let root = place_key_units(&value.root, function, budget)?;
        let next = (|| {
            let variant = value.variant.as_str().len().checked_add(1)?;
            units
                .checked_add(variant)?
                .checked_add(
                    INDEX_SEARCH_COMPARISONS
                        .checked_mul(2)?
                        .checked_mul(variant)?,
                )?
                .checked_add(
                    c.checked_mul(c)?
                        .checked_mul(12)?
                        .checked_mul(case_key.checked_mul(2)?.checked_add(1)?)?,
                )?
                .checked_add(1)?
                .checked_add(root?)?
                .checked_add(variant)
        })();
        let Some(next) = next else { return Ok(None) };
        units = next;
    }
    Ok(Some(units))
}

/// The closed-domain loop of `join_conditional_variants(v, v)` for one
/// variant: per declared case two searches over at most c case keys, one
/// flag-history comparison and one clone of the case identity and flags.
fn domain_units(
    value: &ReplayConditionalVariant,
    domain: &[crate::hir::ResolvedVariantCaseDeclaration],
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Diagnostic> {
    // Each scan is prepaid separately before touching its first element.
    budget.charge(function, value.cases.len(), "branch join estimate visits")?;
    let c = value.cases.len();
    let case_key = value
        .cases
        .iter()
        .fold(0_usize, |max, (id, _)| max.max(id.as_str().len()));
    budget.charge(function, value.cases.len(), "branch join estimate visits")?;
    let flags = value
        .cases
        .iter()
        .fold(0_usize, |max, (_, flags)| max.max(flags.len()));
    budget.charge(function, domain.len(), "branch join estimate visits")?;
    Ok(domain.iter().try_fold(0_usize, |units, declared| {
        let id = declared.id.as_str().len();
        units
            .checked_add(
                c.checked_mul(2)?
                    .checked_mul(id.checked_add(case_key)?.checked_add(1)?)?,
            )?
            .checked_add(flags.checked_mul(2)?)?
            .checked_add(id)?
            .checked_add(2)
    }))
}

impl BranchJoins {
    /// Two or more predecessors, each reaching `block` through its own
    /// unconditional `Goto`: the exact CFG shape every `merge_states` emits.
    fn contains(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        block: BlockId,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
        if self.0.is_none() {
            let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;
            // One debit for the zeroed shape per block, one visit per edge
            // and this probe. A refusal caches nothing, so every retry pays.
            let units = plan
                .blocks
                .len()
                .checked_add(plan.edges.len())
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(1))
                .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
            budget.charge(function, units, "branch join classification")?;
            budget.reserve_array::<usize>(function, plan.blocks.len(), "branch join shapes")?;
            let mut inputs = vec![0_usize; plan.blocks.len()];
            for edge in &plan.edges {
                let Some(count) = inputs.get_mut(edge.to.0 as usize) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let goto = plan.blocks.get(edge.from.0 as usize).is_some_and(|from| {
                    matches!(&from.terminator, CleanupTerminator::Goto(id) if *id == edge.id)
                });
                let always = matches!(edge.condition, EdgeCondition::Always);
                *count = if *count != MIXED && goto && always {
                    *count + 1
                } else {
                    MIXED
                };
            }
            self.0 = Some(inputs);
        } else {
            budget.charge(function, 1, "branch join classification")?;
        }
        Ok(self
            .0
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|inputs| inputs.get(block.0 as usize))
            .is_some_and(|count| *count != MIXED && *count >= 2))
    }

    /// Apply the producer join to one deduplicated state at a branch join.
    /// Roots already in key order are exactly what the join yields; anything
    /// else replays the same closed-domain join of the state with itself. An
    /// owning break's exact rejoin is never re-keyed and performs no work.
    pub(super) fn normalize(
        &mut self,
        program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        block: BlockId,
        exact_join: bool,
        conditional_variants: Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>, Diagnostic> {
        if exact_join {
            return Ok(conditional_variants);
        }
        let mut crossed = false;
        for pair in conditional_variants.windows(2) {
            let units = root_pair_units(&pair[0].root, &pair[1].root, function, budget)?;
            budget.charge(
                function,
                units.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
                "branch join root order",
            )?;
            if pair[0].root >= pair[1].root {
                crossed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if !crossed || !self.contains(function, block, budget)? {
            return Ok(conditional_variants);
        }
        let units = self_join_units(&conditional_variants, function, budget)?;
        budget.charge(
            function,
            units.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
            "branch join conditional roots",
        )?;
        for value in &conditional_variants {
            budget.charge(function, 1, "branch join estimate visits")?;
            let domain = program
                .declarations()
                .variant_cases(&value.variant)
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let units = domain_units(value, domain, function, budget)?;
            budget.charge(
                function,
                units.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
                "branch join conditional cases",
            )?;
        }
        join_conditional_variants(
            program,
            function,
            &conditional_variants,
            &conditional_variants,
            budget,
        )
    }
}


//! Topological cleanup-CFG replay and ownership-only join normalization.

use super::*;
use std::borrow::Borrow;
mod boxed_states;
mod branch_join;
mod storage;
mod transition;
use transition::{
    append_dead_flags, execute_replay_transition, replay_exit, require_normal_flow_state,
    state_for_edge, ExitFlow,
};
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] // Keep the independently held phase index explicit.
pub(super) fn validate_path_states<E: semantic_refusal::Error>(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    storage: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    lexical: Option<&lexical_cert::LexicalAuth>,
    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'_>>,
) -> Result<(), E> {
    #[cfg(test)]
    let _operation = crate::bounded_output::stage_debits::operation_guard(
        crate::bounded_output::stage_debits::Operation::ReplayPathStates,
    );
    #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
    let _exclusive_operation = crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::operation_guard(
        crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::Operation::ReplayPathStates,
    );
    // Authenticate the absence once before path traversal. The source/HIR
    // wrapper certificate identifies a conditional Step transfer, which must
    // never acquire the one-leaf renewal authority of another profile.
    if let Some(auth) = lexical {
        for assignment in auth.wrapper_cancels.values() {
            if ordinary_renewals::lookup(program, function, assignment, helpers, budget)?.is_some()
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "owning Break conditional Step has unexpected renewal authority",
                )
                .into());
            }
        }
    }
    let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;
    let storage_regions = storage::storage_regions(function, budget)?;
    // Exact ownership state each lexical loop body must restore, captured once
    // from the state on its true-condition edge.
    let mut loop_entries = BTreeMap::<usize, PathState>::new();
    let no_extra_disposal = BTreeSet::<StorageId>::new();
    let mut contract_sources = BTreeMap::new();
    for source in plan
        .status_sources
        .iter()
        .filter(|source| source.id.lane == StatusLane::ContractFalse)
    {
        storage::insert_map(
            function,
            &mut contract_sources,
            source.id.expression.clone(),
            source.id.clone(),
            budget,
            "contract status lookup",
        )?;
    }

    let mut initial = PathState {
        renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
        live_order: Vec::new(),
        conditional_variants: Vec::new(),
        pending_failure: None,
        selected_failure: None,
        staged_copy_result: None,
        published: false,
        returned: None,
    };
    for place in &plan.entry_state.live_owned_parameters {
        let flags = storage::validate_place(function, place, storage, leaves, budget)?;
        budget.reserve_vec(
            function,
            &mut initial.live_order,
            flags.len(),
            "entry live flags",
        )?;
        append_dead_flags(function, &mut initial, flags, "entry state")?;
    }
    for entry in &plan.entry_state.conditional_owned_parameters {
        budget.reserve_array::<(DeclarationId, Vec<LivenessFlagId>)>(
            function,
            entry.cases.len(),
            "conditional entry cases",
        )?;
        let mut cases = Vec::with_capacity(entry.cases.len());
        for case in &entry.cases {
            budget.reserve_array::<LivenessFlagId>(
                function,
                case.live_places.len(),
                "conditional entry flags",
            )?;
            let mut flags = Vec::with_capacity(case.live_places.len());
            for place in &case.live_places {
                let under = storage::validate_place(function, place, storage, leaves, budget)?;
                if under.len() != 1 || place.projections.first() != Some(&case.case) {
                    return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "conditional entry case does not name exact case-qualified leaves",
                    )
                    .into());
                }
                flags.push(under[0]);
            }
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                case.case.as_str().len(),
                "conditional entry case identity",
            )?;
            cases.push((case.case.clone(), flags));
        }
        budget.reserve_vec(
            function,
            &mut initial.conditional_variants,
            1,
            "conditional entry variants",
        )?;
        budget.reserve_bytes(
            function,
            entry.variant.as_str().len(),
            "conditional entry variant identity",
        )?;
        initial.conditional_variants.push(ReplayConditionalVariant {
            root: CleanupPlace {
                storage: entry.storage.clone(),
                projections: Vec::new(),
            },
            variant: entry.variant.clone(),
            cases,
        });
    }

    budget.reserve_array::<BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>>(
        function,
        plan.blocks.len(),
        "incoming state frontier",
    )?;
    let mut incoming = vec![BTreeSet::<Box<PathState>>::new(); plan.blocks.len()];
    let mut insertions = boxed_states::Insertions::<PathState>::acquire(function, budget)?;
    insertions.insert_owned(
        function,
        &mut incoming[plan.entry.0 as usize],
        initial,
        budget,
    );
    if insertions.failed {
        return Err(insertions.failure().into());
    }
    budget.reserve_array::<usize>(function, plan.blocks.len(), "cleanup predecessor counters")?;
    let mut remaining_predecessors = vec![0_usize; plan.blocks.len()];
    for block in &plan.blocks {
        for successor in block_successors(function, block.id) {
            remaining_predecessors[successor.0 as usize] = remaining_predecessors
                [successor.0 as usize]
                .checked_add(1)
                .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "too many cleanup predecessors"))?;
        }
    }
    // A validated acyclic CFG schedules each block at most once. Hold its
    // complete queue capacity so push_back never grows an uncharged frontier.
    budget.reserve_array::<BlockId>(function, plan.blocks.len(), "cleanup ready queue")?;
    let mut queue = VecDeque::with_capacity(plan.blocks.len());
    queue.push_back(plan.entry);
    let mut terminal_paths = 0_usize;
    let mut successful_paths = 0_usize;
    let mut branch_joins = branch_join::BranchJoins::default();

    while let Some(block_id) = queue.pop_front() {
        let states = std::mem::take(&mut incoming[block_id.0 as usize]);
        if states.is_empty() {
            return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "reachable cleanup block has no incoming ownership state",
            )
            .into());
        }
        let join_units =
            states
                .len()
                .saturating_mul(states.iter().fold(1_usize, |total, state| {
                    total
                        .saturating_add(state.live_order.len())
                        .saturating_add(renewal::retained_units(state))
                }));
        budget.charge(function, join_units, "all-path ownership replay")?;
        // A single incoming state is already its complete unique control group.
        // Keep every validation/join/transition/exit and scheduling step below;
        // no control-key clone, grouping map/set, or held insertion is needed.
        if states.len() == 1 {
            let block = &plan.blocks[block_id.0 as usize];
            // An owning break's fragment rejoins its wrapper's parent: every
            // incoming state must agree exactly, with no ownership or history
            // repair by the generic join below.
            let exact_join = lexical.is_some_and(|auth| auth.exact_joins.contains(&block_id));
            if exact_join && states.len() != 1 {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "owning break fragment does not rejoin its parent with exact ownership state",
                )
                .into());
            }
            validate_control_group_with_budget(function, &states, block_id, budget)?;
