            // The validated singleton already owns the complete joined fields.
            // Consume it once; neither original vector nor any nested identity
            // is cloned, replaced from a clone, or temporarily reinitialized.
            let mut state = *states
                .into_iter()
                .next()
                .expect("replay control group is non-empty");
            // Identical branch arms still require their original normalization.
            // Move the original vector into that same producer and receive its
            // result back into the same field. Partial failure drops the moved
            // input and every remaining state field through their original owners.
            state.conditional_variants = branch_joins.normalize(
                program,
                function,
                block_id,
                exact_join,
                state.conditional_variants,
                budget,
            )?;
            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                <E as lexical_boundary::Policy>::check(
                    function,
                    auth,
                    block_id,
                    &state,
                    storage,
                    &storage_regions,
                    leaves,
                    budget,
                )?;
            }
            for transition in &block.transitions {
                renewal::charge_transition(function, transition, &state, budget)?;
                execute_replay_transition::<E>(
                    program, function, transition, &mut state, storage, leaves, helpers, budget,
                )?;
            }
            match &block.terminator {
                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {
                    require_normal_flow_state(function, &state, block_id)?;
                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];
                    let state =
                        state_for_edge(function, state, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                    insertions.insert_owned(
                        function,
                        &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                        state,
                        budget,
                    );
                    if insertions.failed {
                        return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                    }
                }
                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {
                    require_normal_flow_state(function, &state, block_id)?;
                    // Initial selection receivers are paid before len/index queries.
                    // This is a new metadata refusal frontier, not clone backing.
                    budget.reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        std::mem::size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&str>()
                            + 4 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<bool>()
                            + 3 * std::mem::size_of::<&Vec<EdgeId>>(),
                        "branch final-state selection controls",
                    )?;
                    if edges.len() == 2 {
                        let edge = &plan.edges[edges[0].0 as usize];
                        budget.charge(
                            function,
                            renewal::retained_units(&state),
                            "renewal branch history clone",
                        )?;
                        let cloned = if storage::empty_renewals::selected(&state, budget) {
                            let payload = storage::empty_renewals::reserve(
                                function,
                                &state,
                                budget,
                                "ownership branch clone",
                            )?;
                            storage::empty_renewals::copy(payload)
                        } else {
                            storage::reserve_state_clone(
                                function,
                                &state,
                                budget,
                                "ownership branch clone",
                            )?;
                            state.clone()
                        };
                        let next =
                            state_for_edge(function, cloned, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                        if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                            lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                function,
                                auth,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &next,
                                &mut loop_entries,
                                budget,
                            )?;
                        }
                        insertions.insert_owned(
                            function,
                            &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                            next,
                            budget,
                        );
                        if insertions.failed {
                            return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                        }
                        // The earlier sibling owns its independent clone. The final
                        // sibling receives the original state, with identical work.

                        let edge = &plan.edges[edges[1].0 as usize];
                        budget.charge(
                            function,
                            renewal::retained_units(&state),
                            "renewal branch history clone",
                        )?;
                        let next =
                            state_for_edge(function, state, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                        if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                            lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                function,
                                auth,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &next,
                                &mut loop_entries,
                                budget,
                            )?;
                        }
                        insertions.insert_owned(
                            function,
                            &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                            next,
                            budget,
                        );
                        if insertions.failed {
                            return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Complete old fallback for low-level malformed cardinality.
                        for edge in edges {
                            let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];
                            budget.charge(
                                function,
                                renewal::retained_units(&state),
                                "renewal branch history clone",
                            )?;
                            let cloned = if storage::empty_renewals::selected(&state, budget) {
                                let payload = storage::empty_renewals::reserve(
                                    function,
                                    &state,
                                    budget,
                                    "ownership branch clone",
                                )?;
                                storage::empty_renewals::copy(payload)
                            } else {
                                storage::reserve_state_clone(
                                    function,
                                    &state,
                                    budget,
                                    "ownership branch clone",
                                )?;
                                state.clone()
                            };
                            let next = state_for_edge(
                                function,
                                cloned,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &contract_sources,
                            )?;
                            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                                lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    &edge.condition,
                                    &next,
                                    &mut loop_entries,
                                    budget,
                                )?;
                            }
                            insertions.insert_owned(
                                function,
                                &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                                next,
                                budget,
                            );
                            if insertions.failed {
                                return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit_id) => {
                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit_id.0 as usize];
                    let extra = lexical
                        .and_then(|auth| auth.item_disposals.get(exit_id))
                        .unwrap_or(&no_extra_disposal);
                    match replay_exit(
                        function,
                        exit,
                        state,
                        &storage_regions,
                        storage,
                        leaves,
                        extra,
                        budget,
                    )? {
                        ExitFlow::Edge(edge, continued) => {
                            let target = plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to;
                            if let Some(assignment) =
                                lexical.and_then(|auth| auth.wrapper_cancels.get(exit_id))
                            {
                                // The authenticated hidden Step has no
                                // one-leaf reservation. Preserve every unrelated
                                // history; unexpected authority fails closed.
                                if continued.renewals.contains_key(assignment) {
                                    return Err(replay_error(function,
                                        "owning Break conditional Step has unexpected renewal history").into());
                                }
                            }
                            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                                lexical_flow::check_break(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    exit,
                                    &continued,
                                    &loop_entries,
                                    leaves,
                                )?;
                            }
                            insertions.insert_owned(
                                function,
                                &mut incoming[target.0 as usize],
                                continued,
                                budget,
                            );
                            if insertions.failed {
                                return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                            }
                        }
                        ExitFlow::Latch(latched) => {
                            let auth = lexical.ok_or_else(|| {
                                replay_error(function, "loop latch outside the lexical profile")
                            })?;
                            if let Some(entry) = lexical_cert::latch_resume(plan, exit.id) {
                                // A certified continue enters its finite generated
                                // advancement fragment, whose own latch checks entry.
                                insertions.insert_owned(
                                    function,
                                    &mut incoming[entry.0 as usize],
                                    latched,
                                    budget,
                                );
                                if insertions.failed {
                                    return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                                }
                            } else {
                                lexical_flow::check_latch(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    exit,
                                    &latched,
                                    &loop_entries,
                                )?;
                                terminal_paths =
                                    terminal_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                        replay_error(function, "too many terminal cleanup paths")
                                    })?;
                            }
                        }
                        ExitFlow::Terminal => {
                            terminal_paths = terminal_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                replay_error(function, "too many terminal cleanup paths")
                            })?;
                            if matches!(
                                exit.continuation,
                                ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. }
                                    | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit
                            ) {
                                successful_paths =
                                    successful_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                        replay_error(function, "too many successful cleanup paths")
                                    })?;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for successor in block_successors(function, block_id) {
                let remaining = &mut remaining_predecessors[successor.0 as usize];
                *remaining = remaining.checked_sub(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                    replay_error(function, "cleanup predecessor count underflowed")
                })?;
                if *remaining == 0 {
                    queue.push_back(successor);
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        let mut groups = BTreeMap::<ControlKey, BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>>::new();
        for state in states {
            let key = if storage::atomic_controls::selected(&state, budget) {
                let payload = storage::atomic_controls::reserve(function, &state, budget)?;
                storage::atomic_controls::copy(payload)
            } else {
                storage::reserve_control_clone(function, &state, budget)?;
                (
                    state.pending_failure.clone(),
                    state.selected_failure.clone(),
                    state.staged_copy_result.clone(),
                    state.published,
                    state.returned.clone(),
                )
            };
            if !groups.contains_key(&key) {
                storage::reserve_btree_node::<ControlKey, BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>>(
                    function,
                    budget,
                    "ownership control groups",
                )?;
            }
            let group = groups.entry(key).or_default();
            insertions.insert_held(function, group, state, budget);
            if insertions.failed {
                return Err(insertions.failure().into());
            }
        }
        let block = &plan.blocks[block_id.0 as usize];
        for states in groups.into_values() {
            // An owning break's fragment rejoins its wrapper's parent: every
            // incoming state must agree exactly, with no ownership or history
            // repair by the generic join below.
            let exact_join = lexical.is_some_and(|auth| auth.exact_joins.contains(&block_id));
            if exact_join && states.len() != 1 {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "owning break fragment does not rejoin its parent with exact ownership state",
                )
                .into());
            }
            validate_control_group_with_budget(function, &states, block_id, budget)?;
            let (live_order, mut conditional_variants) =
                joined_ownership_state(program, function, &states, budget)?;
            // Identical branch arms deduplicate to one state; the producer
            // still joined them. An exact break rejoin is never re-keyed.
            if states.len() == 1 {
                conditional_variants = branch_joins.normalize(
                    program,
                    function,
                    block_id,
                    exact_join,
                    conditional_variants,
                    budget,
                )?;
            }
            let mut state = *states
                .into_iter()
                .next()
                .expect("replay control group is non-empty");
            state.live_order = live_order;
            state.conditional_variants = conditional_variants;
            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                <E as lexical_boundary::Policy>::check(
                    function,
                    auth,
                    block_id,
                    &state,
                    storage,
                    &storage_regions,
                    leaves,
                    budget,
                )?;
            }
            for transition in &block.transitions {
                renewal::charge_transition(function, transition, &state, budget)?;
                execute_replay_transition::<E>(
                    program, function, transition, &mut state, storage, leaves, helpers, budget,
                )?;
            }
            match &block.terminator {
                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {
                    require_normal_flow_state(function, &state, block_id)?;
                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];
                    let state =
                        state_for_edge(function, state, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                    insertions.insert_owned(
                        function,
                        &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                        state,
                        budget,
                    );
                    if insertions.failed {
                        return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                    }
                }
                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {
                    require_normal_flow_state(function, &state, block_id)?;
                    // Initial selection receivers are paid before len/index queries.
                    // This is a new metadata refusal frontier, not clone backing.
                    budget.reserve_bytes(
                        function,
                        std::mem::size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<&str>()
                            + 4 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                            + std::mem::size_of::<bool>()
                            + 3 * std::mem::size_of::<&Vec<EdgeId>>(),
                        "branch final-state selection controls",
                    )?;
                    if edges.len() == 2 {
                        let edge = &plan.edges[edges[0].0 as usize];
                        budget.charge(
                            function,
                            renewal::retained_units(&state),
                            "renewal branch history clone",
                        )?;
                        let cloned = if storage::empty_renewals::selected(&state, budget) {
                            let payload = storage::empty_renewals::reserve(
                                function,
                                &state,
                                budget,
                                "ownership branch clone",
                            )?;
                            storage::empty_renewals::copy(payload)
                        } else {
                            storage::reserve_state_clone(
                                function,
                                &state,
                                budget,
                                "ownership branch clone",
                            )?;
                            state.clone()
                        };
                        let next =
                            state_for_edge(function, cloned, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                        if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                            lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                function,
                                auth,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &next,
                                &mut loop_entries,
                                budget,
                            )?;
                        }
                        insertions.insert_owned(
                            function,
                            &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                            next,
                            budget,
                        );
                        if insertions.failed {
                            return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                        }
                        // The earlier sibling owns its independent clone. The final
                        // sibling receives the original state, with identical work.

                        let edge = &plan.edges[edges[1].0 as usize];
                        budget.charge(
                            function,
                            renewal::retained_units(&state),
                            "renewal branch history clone",
                        )?;
                        let next =
                            state_for_edge(function, state, &edge.condition, &contract_sources)?;
                        if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                            lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                function,
                                auth,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &next,
                                &mut loop_entries,
                                budget,
                            )?;
                        }
                        insertions.insert_owned(
                            function,
                            &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                            next,
                            budget,
                        );
                        if insertions.failed {
                            return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Complete old fallback for low-level malformed cardinality.
                        for edge in edges {
                            let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];
                            budget.charge(
                                function,
                                renewal::retained_units(&state),
                                "renewal branch history clone",
                            )?;
                            let cloned = if storage::empty_renewals::selected(&state, budget) {
                                let payload = storage::empty_renewals::reserve(
                                    function,
                                    &state,
                                    budget,
                                    "ownership branch clone",
                                )?;
                                storage::empty_renewals::copy(payload)
                            } else {
                                storage::reserve_state_clone(
                                    function,
                                    &state,
                                    budget,
                                    "ownership branch clone",
                                )?;
                                state.clone()
                            };
                            let next = state_for_edge(
                                function,
                                cloned,
                                &edge.condition,
                                &contract_sources,
                            )?;
                            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                                lexical_flow::capture_loop_entry(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    &edge.condition,
                                    &next,
                                    &mut loop_entries,
                                    budget,
                                )?;
                            }
                            insertions.insert_owned(
                                function,
                                &mut incoming[edge.to.0 as usize],
                                next,
                                budget,
                            );
                            if insertions.failed {
                                return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit_id) => {
                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit_id.0 as usize];
                    let extra = lexical
                        .and_then(|auth| auth.item_disposals.get(exit_id))
                        .unwrap_or(&no_extra_disposal);
                    match replay_exit(
                        function,
                        exit,
                        state,
                        &storage_regions,
                        storage,
                        leaves,
                        extra,
                        budget,
                    )? {
                        ExitFlow::Edge(edge, continued) => {
                            let target = plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to;
                            if let Some(assignment) =
                                lexical.and_then(|auth| auth.wrapper_cancels.get(exit_id))
                            {
                                // The authenticated hidden Step has no
                                // one-leaf reservation. Preserve every unrelated
                                // history; unexpected authority fails closed.
                                if continued.renewals.contains_key(assignment) {
                                    return Err(replay_error(function,
                                        "owning Break conditional Step has unexpected renewal history").into());
                                }
                            }
                            if let Some(auth) = lexical {
                                lexical_flow::check_break(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    exit,
                                    &continued,
                                    &loop_entries,
                                    leaves,
                                )?;
                            }
                            insertions.insert_owned(
                                function,
                                &mut incoming[target.0 as usize],
                                continued,
                                budget,
                            );
                            if insertions.failed {
                                return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                            }
                        }
                        ExitFlow::Latch(latched) => {
                            let auth = lexical.ok_or_else(|| {
                                replay_error(function, "loop latch outside the lexical profile")
                            })?;
                            if let Some(entry) = lexical_cert::latch_resume(plan, exit.id) {
                                // A certified continue enters its finite generated
                                // advancement fragment, whose own latch checks entry.
                                insertions.insert_owned(
                                    function,
                                    &mut incoming[entry.0 as usize],
                                    latched,
                                    budget,
                                );
                                if insertions.failed {
                                    return Err(insertions.failure().into());
                                }
                            } else {
                                lexical_flow::check_latch(
                                    function,
                                    auth,
                                    exit,
                                    &latched,
                                    &loop_entries,
                                )?;
                                terminal_paths =
                                    terminal_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                        replay_error(function, "too many terminal cleanup paths")
                                    })?;
                            }
                        }
                        ExitFlow::Terminal => {
                            terminal_paths = terminal_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                replay_error(function, "too many terminal cleanup paths")
                            })?;
                            if matches!(
                                exit.continuation,
                                ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. }
                                    | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit
                            ) {
                                successful_paths =
                                    successful_paths.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                                        replay_error(function, "too many successful cleanup paths")
                                    })?;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for successor in block_successors(function, block_id) {
            let remaining = &mut remaining_predecessors[successor.0 as usize];
            *remaining = remaining
                .checked_sub(1)
                .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "cleanup predecessor count underflowed"))?;
            if *remaining == 0 {
                queue.push_back(successor);
            }
        }
    }

    if terminal_paths == 0 || successful_paths == 0 {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup CFG has no replayable terminal success path",
        )
        .into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

type ControlKey = (
    Option<StatusSourceId>,
    Option<StatusSourceId>,
    Option<StagedCopyResultSource>,
    bool,
    Option<ReturnedSource>,
);

/// The borrowed prefix is exactly the sorted set previously copied into
/// `checked`. Keep the complete history union: pairwise checks alone miss a
/// cycle assembled from three or more individually compatible histories.
#[cfg(test)]
fn validate_control_group(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<PathState>,
    block: BlockId,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    validate_control_group_with_budget(function, states, block, &mut ReplayBudget::new())
}
fn validate_control_group_with_budget<K: Ord + Borrow<PathState>>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<K>,
    block: BlockId,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    for state in states {
        validate_join_compatibility(
            function,
            states.range::<K, _>(..state).map(|prior| prior.borrow()),
            state.borrow(),
            block,
            budget,
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

fn joined_ownership_state<K: Ord + Borrow<PathState>>(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<K>,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(Vec<LivenessFlagId>, Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>), Diagnostic> {
    let mut states = states.iter().map(|state| state.borrow());
    let first = states
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "cleanup join has no incoming states"))?;
    storage::reserve_ownership_clone(function, first, budget)?;
    let mut live_order = first.live_order.clone();
    let mut conditional_variants = first.conditional_variants.clone();
    for state in states {
        live_order = join_live_orders(function, &live_order, &state.live_order, budget)?;
        conditional_variants = join_conditional_variants(
            program,
            function,
            &conditional_variants,
            &state.conditional_variants,
            budget,
        )?;
    }
    Ok((live_order, conditional_variants))
}

fn join_live_orders(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    left: &[LivenessFlagId],
    right: &[LivenessFlagId],
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Vec<LivenessFlagId>, Diagnostic> {
    let mut flags = BTreeSet::new();
    for flag in left.iter().chain(right).copied() {
        storage::insert_set(function, &mut flags, flag, budget, "joined live flags")?;
    }
    let mut successors = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut indegree = BTreeMap::new();
    for flag in &flags {
        storage::insert_map(
            function,
            &mut successors,
            *flag,
            BTreeSet::new(),
            budget,
            "join successor lookup",
        )?;
        storage::insert_map(
            function,
            &mut indegree,
            *flag,
            0u32,
            budget,
            "join indegrees",
        )?;
    }
    for history in [left, right] {
        for pair in history.windows(2) {
            if storage::insert_set(
                function,
                successors
                    .get_mut(&pair[0])
                    .expect("joined replay flag is indexed"),
                pair[1],
                budget,
                "join successor edge",
            )? {
                *indegree
                    .get_mut(&pair[1])
                    .expect("joined replay flag is indexed") += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    let mut ready = BTreeSet::new();
    for (flag, degree) in &indegree {
        if *degree == 0 {
            storage::insert_set(function, &mut ready, *flag, budget, "join ready flags")?;
        }
    }
    budget.reserve_array::<LivenessFlagId>(function, flags.len(), "joined live history")?;
    let mut joined = Vec::with_capacity(flags.len());
    while let Some(flag) = ready.pop_first() {
        joined.push(flag);
        for successor in successors[&flag].iter().copied() {
            let degree = indegree
                .get_mut(&successor)
                .expect("joined replay flag is indexed");
            *degree -= 1;
            if *degree == 0 {
                storage::insert_set(function, &mut ready, successor, budget, "join ready flags")?;
            }
        }
    }
    if joined.len() != flags.len() {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup join has conflicting initialization histories",
        ));
    }
    Ok(joined)
}

fn join_conditional_variants(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    left: &[ReplayConditionalVariant],
    right: &[ReplayConditionalVariant],
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>, Diagnostic> {
    let left_len = left.len();
    let right_len = right.len();
    let mut left_index = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut right_index = BTreeMap::new();
    for variant in left {
        storage::insert_map(
            function,
            &mut left_index,
            &variant.root,
            variant,
            budget,
            "left conditional roots",
        )?;
    }
    for variant in right {
        storage::insert_map(
            function,
            &mut right_index,
            &variant.root,
            variant,
            budget,
            "right conditional roots",
        )?;
    }
    let left = left_index;
    let right = right_index;
    if left.len() != left_len || right.len() != right_len || left.keys().ne(right.keys()) {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup join disagrees on conditional variant roots",
        ));
    }
    budget.reserve_array::<ReplayConditionalVariant>(
        function,
        left.len(),
        "joined conditional variants",
    )?;
    let mut joined = Vec::with_capacity(left.len());
    for (root, left_variant) in left {
        let right_variant = right[root];
        if left_variant.variant != right_variant.variant {
            return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "cleanup join disagrees on conditional variant identity",
            ));
        }
        let mut left_cases = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut right_cases = BTreeMap::new();
        for (case, flags) in &left_variant.cases {
            storage::insert_map(
                function,
                &mut left_cases,
                case,
                flags,
                budget,
                "left conditional cases",
            )?;
        }
        for (case, flags) in &right_variant.cases {
            storage::insert_map(
                function,
                &mut right_cases,
                case,
                flags,
                budget,
                "right conditional cases",
            )?;
        }
        let domain = program
            .declarations()
            .variant_cases(&left_variant.variant)
            .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "cleanup join variant has no closed domain"))?;
        let mut cases = Vec::new();
        for declared in domain {
            let flags = match (left_cases.get(&declared.id), right_cases.get(&declared.id)) {
                (Some(left), Some(right)) if left == right => *left,
                (Some(left), Some(right)) if left.is_empty() => *right,
                (Some(left), Some(right)) if right.is_empty() => *left,
                (Some(_), Some(_)) => {
                    return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "cleanup join disagrees on conditional case payload liveness",
                    ));
                }
                (Some(flags), None) | (None, Some(flags)) => *flags,
                (None, None) => continue,
            };
            budget.reserve_vec(function, &mut cases, 1, "joined conditional cases")?;
            budget.reserve_array::<LivenessFlagId>(
                function,
                flags.len(),
                "joined conditional case flags",
            )?;
            budget.reserve_bytes(function, declared.id.as_str().len(), "joined case identity")?;
            cases.push((declared.id.clone(), flags.clone()));
        }
        let mut case_union = BTreeSet::new();
        for case in left_cases.keys().chain(right_cases.keys()) {
            storage::insert_set(
                function,
                &mut case_union,
                *case,
                budget,
                "joined case domain",
            )?;
        }
        if cases.len() != case_union.len() {
            return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "cleanup join conditional state references a foreign case",
            ));
        }
        storage::reserve_variant_identity(function, root, &left_variant.variant, budget)?;
        joined.push(ReplayConditionalVariant {
            root: root.clone(),
            variant: left_variant.variant.clone(),
            cases,
        });
    }
    Ok(joined)
}

// Test entry to the complete independently compiled edge receiver.
pub(super) fn edge_before(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: PathState,
    condition: &EdgeCondition,
    contract_sources: &BTreeMap<ExpressionId, StatusSourceId>,
) -> Result<PathState, Diagnostic> {
    transition::state_for_edge(function, state, condition, contract_sources)
}

pub(super) fn validate_group_before(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>,
    block: BlockId,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    validate_control_group_with_budget(function, states, block, budget)
}
pub(super) fn join_before(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(Vec<LivenessFlagId>, Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>), Diagnostic> {
    joined_ownership_state(program, function, states, budget)
}
//! Precharge actual owned clone carriers. Shared identity Arcs allocate nothing
//! when cloned; projection/type/case containers retain their actual backing.
use super::*;
use std::mem::size_of;
pub(super) mod atomic_controls;
pub(super) mod empty_renewals;
fn array<T>(count: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    count.checked_mul(size_of::<T>())
}
fn place(place: &CleanupPlace) -> Option<usize> {
    array::<DeclarationId>(place.projections.len())
}
fn ty(ty: &ResolvedType) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut stack = [None; crate::cache_codec::MAX_DEPTH + 1];
    stack[0] = Some((ty, 0usize));
    let mut len = 1;
    let mut bytes = 0usize;
    let mut work = 65_536usize;
    while len != 0 {
        let (value, next) = stack[len - 1]?;
        if next == 0 {
            work = work.checked_sub(1)?;
            let owned = match value {
                ResolvedType::Function { parameters, .. } => {
                    array::<ResolvedType>(parameters.len())?
                        .checked_add(size_of::<ResolvedType>())?
                }
                ResolvedType::Nominal { arguments, .. } => array::<ResolvedType>(arguments.len())?,
                ResolvedType::TypeParameter { .. } => 0,
                ResolvedType::Never
                | ResolvedType::Unit
                | ResolvedType::I64
                | ResolvedType::I32
                | ResolvedType::Char
                | ResolvedType::U8
                | ResolvedType::Usize
                | ResolvedType::F32
                | ResolvedType::F64
                | ResolvedType::Bool
                | ResolvedType::String
                | ResolvedType::ArrayU8(_)
                | ResolvedType::Bytes
                | ResolvedType::Str
                | ResolvedType::SliceU8
                | ResolvedType::StringMap
                | ResolvedType::OnceFunction
                | ResolvedType::OnceFunctionI64
                | ResolvedType::OnceFunctionI64Pair
                | ResolvedType::MutFunctionI64 => 0,
            };
            bytes = bytes.checked_add(owned)?;
        }
        let child = match value {
            ResolvedType::Function { parameters, result } => parameters
                .get(next)
                .or_else(|| (next == parameters.len()).then_some(result.as_ref())),
            ResolvedType::Nominal { arguments, .. } => arguments.get(next),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some(child) = child {
            if len == stack.len() {
                return None;
            }
            stack[len - 1] = Some((value, next + 1));
            stack[len] = Some((child, 0));
            len += 1;
        } else {
            len -= 1;
        }
    }
    Some(bytes)
}
fn staged(source: &StagedCopyResultSource) -> Option<usize> {
    match source {
        StagedCopyResultSource::Body { instance, .. } => ty(instance),
        StagedCopyResultSource::TryResidual {
            source_instance,
            target_instance,
            ..
        }
        | StagedCopyResultSource::TryOptionNone {
            source_instance,
            target_instance,
            ..
        } => ty(source_instance)?.checked_add(ty(target_instance)?),
    }
}
fn returned(source: &ReturnedSource) -> Option<usize> {
    match source {
        ReturnedSource::Scalar(_) => Some(0),
        ReturnedSource::Owned(value) => place(value),
    }
}
fn variant(value: &ReplayConditionalVariant) -> Option<usize> {
    value.cases.iter().try_fold(
        place(&value.root)?.checked_add(array::<(DeclarationId, Vec<LivenessFlagId>)>(
            value.cases.len(),
        )?)?,
        |n, (_, flags)| n.checked_add(array::<LivenessFlagId>(flags.len())?),
    )
}
fn state_bytes(state: &PathState) -> Option<usize> {
    let node = crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::btree_node_upper::<
        ExpressionId,
        crate::cleanup_plan::renewal_history::RenewalHistory,
    >()?;
    let mut bytes = node
        .checked_add(array::<LivenessFlagId>(state.live_order.len())?)?
        .checked_add(array::<ReplayConditionalVariant>(
            state.conditional_variants.len(),
        )?)?;
    for history in state.renewals.values() {
        bytes = bytes
            .checked_add(node)?
            .checked_add(history.clone_payload_bytes()?)?;
    }
    for value in &state.conditional_variants {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(variant(value)?)?;
    }
    if let Some(value) = &state.staged_copy_result {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(staged(value)?)?;
    }
    if let Some(value) = &state.returned {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(returned(value)?)?;
    }
    Some(bytes)
}
#[track_caller]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn reserve_btree_node<K, V>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    phase: &str,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::btree_node_upper::<K, V>().unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
        phase,
    )
}
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn reserve_state_clone(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &PathState,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    phase: &str,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if state.staged_copy_result.is_some() {
        budget.reserve_array::<Option<(&ResolvedType, usize)>>(
            function,
            crate::cache_codec::MAX_DEPTH + 1,
            "clone type scratch",
        )?;
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, state_bytes(state).unwrap_or(usize::MAX), phase)
}
pub(super) fn reserve_ownership_clone(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &PathState,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let bytes = (|| {
        state.conditional_variants.iter().try_fold(
            array::<LivenessFlagId>(state.live_order.len())?.checked_add(array::<
                ReplayConditionalVariant,
            >(
                state.conditional_variants.len(),
            )?)?,
            |n, value| n.checked_add(variant(value)?),
        )
    })();
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
        "joined ownership clone",
    )
}
pub(super) fn reserve_control_clone(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &PathState,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if state.staged_copy_result.is_some() {
        budget.reserve_array::<Option<(&ResolvedType, usize)>>(
            function,
            crate::cache_codec::MAX_DEPTH + 1,
            "control clone type scratch",
        )?;
    }
    let bytes = (|| {
        let mut bytes = 0usize;
        if let Some(value) = &state.staged_copy_result {
            bytes = bytes.checked_add(staged(value)?)?;
        }
        if let Some(value) = &state.returned {
            bytes = bytes.checked_add(returned(value)?)?;
        }
        Some(bytes)
    })();
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
        "ownership group control clone",
    )
}

#[track_caller]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn insert_set<K: Ord>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    target: &mut BTreeSet<K>,
    value: K,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    phase: &str,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    if target.contains(&value) {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    reserve_btree_node::<K, ()>(function, budget, phase)?;
    Ok(target.insert(value))
}
#[track_caller]
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn insert_map<K: Ord, V>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    target: &mut BTreeMap<K, V>,
    key: K,
    value: V,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    phase: &str,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !target.contains_key(&key) {
        reserve_btree_node::<K, V>(function, budget, phase)?;
    }
    target.insert(key, value);
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn reserve_variant_identity(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    root: &CleanupPlace,
    _id: &DeclarationId,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        place(root).unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
        "joined variant identity",
    )
}

// Count through the existing ordered leaf index before its exact Vec copy.
// Preserve the unknown-storage refusal before attempting any reservation.
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn validate_place(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    place: &CleanupPlace,
    known: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Vec<LivenessFlagId>, Diagnostic> {
    if !known.contains(&place.storage) {
        return crate::cleanup_plan::replay::validate_place(function, place, known, leaves);
    }
    if !budget.pays_allocations() {
        return crate::cleanup_plan::replay::validate_place(function, place, known, leaves);
    }
    let matches = |leaf: &crate::cleanup_plan::replay::Leaf| {
        leaf.place.storage == place.storage
            && leaf.place.projections.starts_with(&place.projections)
    };
    let count = leaves.values().filter(|leaf| matches(leaf)).count();
    if count == 0 {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup place has no droppable leaf",
        ));
    }
    budget.reserve_array::<LivenessFlagId>(function, count, "entry place leaves")?;
    let mut result = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    result.extend(
        leaves
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(flag, leaf)| matches(leaf).then_some(*flag)),
    );
    Ok(result)
}
pub(super) fn storage_regions(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<StorageId, CleanupRegionId>, Diagnostic> {
    let mut regions = BTreeMap::new();
    for region in &function.cleanup_plan.regions {
        for storage in &region.slots {
            if regions.contains_key(storage) {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "cleanup storage has multiple owning regions during replay",
                ));
            }
            reserve_btree_node::<StorageId, CleanupRegionId>(
                function,
                budget,
                "storage region index",
            )?;
            regions.insert(storage.clone(), region.id);
        }
    }
    Ok(regions)
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn cloned_state_payload_counts_owned_buffers_but_not_shared_identity_handles() {
        let mut state = PathState {
            renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
            live_order: vec![LivenessFlagId(1), LivenessFlagId(2)],
            conditional_variants: Vec::new(),
            pending_failure: None,
            selected_failure: None,
            staged_copy_result: None,
            published: false,
            returned: None,
        };
        let root = crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::btree_node_upper::<
            ExpressionId,
            crate::cleanup_plan::renewal_history::RenewalHistory,
        >()
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            state_bytes(&state),
            array::<LivenessFlagId>(2).unwrap().checked_add(root)
        );
        let history = crate::cleanup_plan::renewal_history::RenewalHistory::new(
            state.live_order.clone(),
            Some(LivenessFlagId(1)),
        );
        let payload = history.clone_payload_bytes().unwrap();
        state
            .renewals
            .insert(ExpressionId::from_owned("renewal".to_owned()), history);
        assert_eq!(
            state_bytes(&state),
            array::<LivenessFlagId>(2)
                .unwrap()
                .checked_add(root)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(root))
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(payload))
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn conditional_clone_literal_backing_keeps_projection_cases_and_flags() {
        let shared = DeclarationId::new("variant:é\0.long.shared");
        let value = ReplayConditionalVariant {
            root: CleanupPlace {
                storage: StorageId::ProvisionalResult,
                projections: vec![shared.clone(), shared.clone()],
            },
            variant: shared.clone(),
            cases: vec![
                (shared.clone(), vec![LivenessFlagId(1)]),
                (
                    DeclarationId::compiler(crate::hir::CompilerDeclaration::Vec),
                    vec![LivenessFlagId(2), LivenessFlagId(3)],
                ),
            ],
        };
        let expected = 2 * size_of::<DeclarationId>()
            + 2 * size_of::<(DeclarationId, Vec<LivenessFlagId>)>()
            + 3 * size_of::<LivenessFlagId>();
        let former_string_payload = 4 * shared.as_str().len() + "core.vec".len();
        assert!(former_string_payload > 0);
        assert_eq!(variant(&value), Some(expected));
        let (_, observed) = crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| {
            let copy = value.clone();
            assert_eq!(copy, value);
            drop(copy);
        });
        assert!(!observed.invalid);
        assert_eq!(observed.allocations, 4);
        assert_eq!(observed.allocated, expected);
        assert_eq!(observed.freed, expected);
        assert_eq!(observed.live, 0);
    }
    #[test]
    fn exact_clone_charge_and_one_short_refusal_precede_clone_and_remain_sticky() {
        let parsed =
            crate::check("module joins; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {0}", "join.spx").unwrap();
        let function = crate::hir::resolve(&parsed).unwrap().functions.remove(0);
        let state = PathState {
            renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
            live_order: vec![LivenessFlagId(1), LivenessFlagId(2)],
            conditional_variants: Vec::new(),
            pending_failure: None,
            selected_failure: None,
            staged_copy_result: None,
            published: false,
            returned: None,
        };
        let bytes = state_bytes(&state).unwrap();
        let mut exact = ReplayBudget::new();
        exact.admission = AdmissionMode::SelectedRetained;
        exact.payer = AllocationPayer::SelectedReservation;
        exact.physical = Some(Box::new(
            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::PhysicalReservation::new(bytes),
        ));
        reserve_state_clone(&function, &state, &mut exact, "test state clone").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state.clone(), state);
        let mut short = ReplayBudget::new();
        short.admission = AdmissionMode::SelectedRetained;
        short.payer = AllocationPayer::SelectedReservation;
        short.physical = Some(Box::new(
            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::PhysicalReservation::new(bytes - 1),
        ));
        let mut destination = Vec::new();
        let first =
            reserve_state_clone(&function, &state, &mut short, "test state clone").unwrap_err();
        if reserve_state_clone(&function, &state, &mut short, "test state clone").is_ok() {
            destination.push(state.clone());
        }
        assert!(destination.is_empty());
        let later =
            reserve_state_clone(&function, &state, &mut short, "test state clone").unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(first.code, later.code);
        assert_eq!(state.live_order, vec![LivenessFlagId(1), LivenessFlagId(2)]);
        reserve_state_clone(
            &function,
            &state,
            &mut ReplayBudget::new(),
            "legacy state clone",
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
}
//! Ordinary control-key cloning for one present, structurally atomic result type.
//! Compound types and every other payer retain the original complete receiver.
use super::*;

/// An immutable, affine proof of the exact selected staged result. No reference
/// to the PathState or its unselected live/renewal/variant containers escapes.
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) struct Payload<'a> {
    pending: &'a Option<StatusSourceId>,
    selected: &'a Option<StatusSourceId>,
    staged: &'a StagedCopyResultSource,
    published: bool,
    returned: &'a Option<ReturnedSource>,
}

fn controls_bytes() -> usize {
    // Producer/receiving views, outward Result, and returned key carrier.
    2 * size_of::<Payload<'_>>()
        + size_of::<Result<Payload<'_>, Diagnostic>>()
        + size_of::<ControlKey>()
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn selected(
    state: &PathState,
    budget: &ReplayBudget,
) -> bool {
    matches!(budget.payer, AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder)
        && budget.admission == AdmissionMode::Ordinary
        && matches!(
            state.staged_copy_result.as_ref(),
            Some(StagedCopyResultSource::Body { instance, .. })
                if empty_renewals::clone_leaf(instance)
        )
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn reserve<'a>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &'a PathState,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<Payload<'a>, Diagnostic> {
    if !selected(state, budget) {
        return Err(Diagnostic::io_static(
            "SPX-H006",
            "atomic control clone requires an ordinary builder and an atomic body result",
        ));
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, controls_bytes(), "atomic control clone carriers")?;
    let bytes = state.returned.as_ref().map_or(Some(0), returned);
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX),
        "ownership group control clone",
    )?;
    // Atomic result metadata has no child container: no census cursor exists
    // in this constructor. Source immutability keeps the selection true until
    // this borrowed payload is consumed. Returned projections are still paid.
    Ok(Payload {
        pending: &state.pending_failure,
        selected: &state.selected_failure,
        staged: state.staged_copy_result.as_ref().expect("selected result"),
        published: state.published,
        returned: &state.returned,
    })
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn copy(payload: Payload<'_>) -> ControlKey {
    (
        payload.pending.clone(),
        payload.selected.clone(),
        Some(payload.staged.clone()),
        payload.published,
        payload.returned.clone(),
    )
}


//! Ordinary builder branch clones reconstruct an empty renewal map directly.
//! The original clone and census remain complete for every other route.
use super::*;

/// The receiving constructor cannot clone the original renewal map: this
/// affine borrowed carrier contains only the other seven state fields.
pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) struct Payload<'a> {
    live_order: &'a Vec<LivenessFlagId>,
    conditional_variants: &'a Vec<ReplayConditionalVariant>,
    pending_failure: &'a Option<StatusSourceId>,
    selected_failure: &'a Option<StatusSourceId>,
    staged_copy_result: &'a Option<StagedCopyResultSource>,
    published: bool,
    returned: &'a Option<ReturnedSource>,
}

fn controls_bytes() -> usize {
    // Producer view, outward Result and receiving view are separately priced.
    2 * size_of::<Payload<'_>>() + size_of::<Result<Payload<'_>, Diagnostic>>()
}

pub(super) fn clone_leaf(ty: &ResolvedType) -> bool {
    matches!(
        ty,
        ResolvedType::Never
            | ResolvedType::Unit
            | ResolvedType::I64
            | ResolvedType::I32
            | ResolvedType::Char
            | ResolvedType::U8
            | ResolvedType::Usize
            | ResolvedType::F32
            | ResolvedType::F64
            | ResolvedType::Bool
            | ResolvedType::String
            | ResolvedType::ArrayU8(_)
            | ResolvedType::Bytes
            | ResolvedType::Str
            | ResolvedType::SliceU8
            | ResolvedType::TypeParameter { .. }
            | ResolvedType::OnceFunction
            | ResolvedType::OnceFunctionI64
            | ResolvedType::OnceFunctionI64Pair
            | ResolvedType::MutFunctionI64
    )
}

fn needs_type_scratch(source: &StagedCopyResultSource) -> bool {
    match source {
        StagedCopyResultSource::Body { instance, .. } => !clone_leaf(instance),
        StagedCopyResultSource::TryResidual {
            source_instance,
            target_instance,
            ..
        }
        | StagedCopyResultSource::TryOptionNone {
            source_instance,
            target_instance,
            ..
        } => !clone_leaf(source_instance) || !clone_leaf(target_instance),
    }
}

fn staged_bytes(source: &StagedCopyResultSource) -> Option<usize> {
    if needs_type_scratch(source) {
        staged(source)
    } else {
        Some(0)
    }
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn selected(
    state: &PathState,
    budget: &ReplayBudget,
) -> bool {
    matches!(budget.payer, AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder)
        && budget.admission == AdmissionMode::Ordinary
        && state.renewals.is_empty()
}

fn payload_bytes(state: &PathState) -> Option<usize> {
    if !state.renewals.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut bytes = array::<LivenessFlagId>(state.live_order.len())?.checked_add(array::<
        ReplayConditionalVariant,
    >(
        state.conditional_variants.len(),
    )?)?;
    for value in &state.conditional_variants {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(variant(value)?)?;
    }
    if let Some(value) = &state.staged_copy_result {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(staged_bytes(value)?)?;
    }
    if let Some(value) = &state.returned {
        bytes = bytes.checked_add(returned(value)?)?;
    }
    Some(bytes)
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn reserve<'a>(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &'a PathState,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    phase: &str,
) -> Result<Payload<'a>, Diagnostic> {
    if !selected(state, budget) {
        return Err(Diagnostic::io_static(
            "SPX-H006",
            "empty renewal clone requires an ordinary builder and an empty map",
        ));
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, controls_bytes(), phase)?;
    // Atomic type tags have no child containers, so no cursor is constructed.
    // Compound types keep the complete original depth/work census and scratch.
    if state
        .staged_copy_result
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(needs_type_scratch)
    {
        budget.reserve_array::<Option<(&ResolvedType, usize)>>(
            function,
            crate::cache_codec::MAX_DEPTH + 1,
            "clone type scratch",
        )?;
    }
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, payload_bytes(state).unwrap_or(usize::MAX), phase)?;
    Ok(Payload {
        live_order: &state.live_order,
        conditional_variants: &state.conditional_variants,
        pending_failure: &state.pending_failure,
        selected_failure: &state.selected_failure,
        staged_copy_result: &state.staged_copy_result,
        published: state.published,
        returned: &state.returned,
    })
}

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay::path_join) fn copy(payload: Payload<'_>) -> PathState {
    PathState {
        renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
        live_order: payload.live_order.clone(),
        conditional_variants: payload.conditional_variants.clone(),
        pending_failure: payload.pending_failure.clone(),
        selected_failure: payload.selected_failure.clone(),
        staged_copy_result: payload.staged_copy_result.clone(),
        published: payload.published,
        returned: payload.returned.clone(),
    }
}


#![allow(
    clippy::duplicate_mod,
    reason = "The complete fixture intentionally compiles independently against current and predecessor owner types."
)]
//! Independent pre-change copied-prefix oracle; never runtime authority.
use super::{
    validate_control_group, BTreeMap, BTreeSet, BlockId, Diagnostic, LivenessFlagId, PathState,
    ResolvedFunction,
};
fn function() -> ResolvedFunction {
    let parsed =
        crate::check("module joins; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {0}", "join.spx").unwrap();
    crate::hir::resolve(&parsed).unwrap().functions.remove(0)
}
fn state(history: &[u32]) -> PathState {
    PathState {
        renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
        live_order: history.iter().map(|flag| LivenessFlagId(*flag)).collect(),
        conditional_variants: Vec::new(),
        pending_failure: None,
        selected_failure: None,
        staged_copy_result: None,
        published: false,
        returned: None,
    }
}
fn copied_prefix(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    states: &BTreeSet<PathState>,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    let mut checked = BTreeSet::new();
    for state in states {
        super::validate_join_compatibility(
            function,
            checked.iter(),
            state,
            BlockId(7),
            &mut super::ReplayBudget::new(),
        )?;
        checked.insert(state.clone());
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn same_outcome(function: &ResolvedFunction, states: &BTreeSet<PathState>) {
    let before = copied_prefix(function, states)
        .err()
        .map(|d| (d.code, d.message));
    let after = validate_control_group(function, states, BlockId(7))
        .err()
        .map(|d| (d.code, d.message));
    assert_eq!(after, before);
}
#[test]
fn borrowed_prefix_preserves_joint_history_cycle_and_every_sorted_prefix_diagnostic() {
    let function = function();
    let histories: &[&[u32]] = &[&[], &[1], &[2], &[1, 2], &[2, 3], &[3, 1], &[2, 1], &[1, 3]];
    for mask in 0..(1usize << histories.len()) {
        let states = histories
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(i, _)| mask & (1usize << *i) != 0)
            .map(|(_, history)| state(history))
            .collect();
        same_outcome(&function, &states);
    }
    let cycle = [state(&[1, 2]), state(&[2, 3]), state(&[3, 1])]
        .into_iter()
        .collect();
    let diagnostic = validate_control_group(&function, &cycle, BlockId(7)).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(diagnostic.code, "SPX-H006");
    assert_eq!(
        diagnostic.message,
        format!("cleanup plan for function `{}` failed independent replay: cleanup join at block 7 has conflicting initialization histories", function.id)
    );
    // Every pair is compatible; omitting the full prefix would miss this cycle.
    for pair in [
        [&[1, 2][..], &[2, 3][..]],
        [&[2, 3][..], &[3, 1][..]],
        [&[1, 2][..], &[3, 1][..]],
    ] {
        let states = pair.into_iter().map(state).collect();
        validate_control_group(&function, &states, BlockId(7)).unwrap();
    }
}
#[test]
fn duplicate_states_and_incompatible_control_keep_exact_results_and_input_payloads() {
    let function = function();
    let original = state(&[4, 5]);
    let states = [original.clone(), original.clone()]
        .into_iter()
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    assert_eq!(states.len(), 1);
    same_outcome(&function, &states);
    assert_eq!(states.first(), Some(&original));
    let mut foreign = original.clone();
    foreign.published = true;
    let states = [original.clone(), foreign].into_iter().collect();
    same_outcome(&function, &states);
    let diagnostic = validate_control_group(&function, &states, BlockId(7)).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(diagnostic.code, "SPX-H006");
    assert_eq!(
        diagnostic.message,
        format!("cleanup plan for function `{}` failed independent replay: cleanup join at block 7 has incompatible control states", function.id)
    );
    assert!(states.contains(&original));
}

#[test]
fn boxed_prefix_keeps_every_history_union_and_control_disagreement() {
    let function = function();
    let histories: &[&[u32]] = &[&[], &[1], &[2], &[1, 2], &[2, 3], &[3, 1], &[2, 1], &[1, 3]];
    for mask in 0..(1usize << histories.len()) {
        let states: BTreeSet<_> = histories
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(i, _)| mask & (1usize << *i) != 0)
            .map(|(_, history)| state(history))
            .collect();
        let expected = copied_prefix(&function, &states).err();
        let boxed: BTreeSet<_> = states.into_iter().map(Box::new).collect();
        let actual = super::validate_control_group_with_budget(
            &function,
            &boxed,
            BlockId(7),
            &mut super::ReplayBudget::new(),
        )
        .err();
        assert_eq!(actual, expected);
    }
    let mut foreign = state(&[4, 5]);
    foreign.published = true;
    let raw: BTreeSet<_> = [state(&[4, 5]), foreign].into_iter().collect();
    let expected = copied_prefix(&function, &raw).unwrap_err();
    let boxed = raw.into_iter().map(Box::new).collect();
    let actual = super::validate_control_group_with_budget(
        &function,
        &boxed,
        BlockId(7),
        &mut super::ReplayBudget::new(),
    )
    .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(actual, expected);
}
//! Transition, exit and edge replay over one path's ownership state.
//!
//! Relocated verbatim from `replay.rs`, which has a recorded size ceiling; the
//! lexical exit continuations added by cleanup plan v18 live here with the rest.
pub(super) use super::super::super::transition::ExitFlow;
use super::*;

#[allow(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "keep independent held authority and canonical replay inputs explicit"
)]
pub(super) fn execute_replay_transition<E: semantic_refusal::Error>(
    program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    transition: &CleanupTransition,
    state: &mut PathState,
    storage: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'_>>,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), E> {
    if budget.selected() {
        return transition_storage::execute::<E>(
            program, function, transition, state, storage, leaves, helpers, budget,
        );
    }
    if state.published {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup transition occurs after result publication",
        )
        .into());
    }
    if state.selected_failure.is_some()
        && !matches!(transition, CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. })
    {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "ordinary cleanup transition occurs after failure selection",
        )
        .into());
    }
    if state.pending_failure.is_some()
        && !matches!(transition, CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. })
    {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "operation failure is not selected before another transition",
        )
        .into());
    }

    match transition {
        CleanupTransition::Initialize { destination, .. } => {
            let flags = validate_place(function, destination, storage, leaves)?;
            append_dead_flags(function, state, flags, "initialize transition")?;
        }
        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, binding } => renewal::reserve(
            program, function, at, binding, state, storage, leaves, helpers, budget,
        )?,
        CleanupTransition::Renew {
            at,
            source,
            destination,
        } => renewal::renew(
            program,
            function,
            at,
            (source, destination),
            state,
            storage,
            leaves,
            helpers,
            budget,
        )?,
        CleanupTransition::Transfer {
            at,
            source,
            destination,
        } => {
            renewal::reject_unmarked_finish(program, function, at, destination, helpers, budget)?;
            let append = strings::reserve_append(function, at, source, destination, state)?;
            replay_transfer(
                function,
                state,
                source,
                destination,
                storage,
                leaves,
                budget,
            )?;
            seal_try_residual(program, function, at, destination, state, storage, leaves)?;
            strings::publish_append(function, append, state)?;
        }
        CleanupTransition::TransferVariant {
            source,
            destination,
            variant,
            ..
        } => {
            if !state
                .conditional_variants
                .iter()
                .any(|conditional| conditional.root == *source)
            {
                materialize_constructed_variant(
                    program, function, state, source, variant, storage, leaves,
                )?;
            }
            replay_transfer(
                function,
                state,
                source,
                destination,
                storage,
                leaves,
                budget,
            )?;
        }
        CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {
            destination,
            variant,
            ..
        } => {
            let flags = validate_place(function, destination, storage, leaves)?;
            if flags.iter().any(|flag| {
                state.live_order.contains(flag)
                    || state.conditional_variants.iter().any(|conditional| {
                        conditional
                            .cases
                            .iter()
                            .any(|(_, case_flags)| case_flags.contains(flag))
                    })
            }) {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "variant initialization targets a live cleanup place",
                )
                .into());
            }
            let slot = function
                .cleanup_plan
                .slots
                .iter()
                .find(|slot| slot.storage == destination.storage)
                .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "variant initialization has no slot"))?;
            let FieldLivenessShape::Variant { cases, .. } = &slot.field_liveness_shape else {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "variant initialization destination is not conditional storage",
                )
                .into());
            };
            let conditional_cases = cases
                .iter()
                .map(|case| {
                    let prefix = destination
                        .projections
                        .iter()
                        .chain(std::iter::once(&case.case))
                        .cloned()
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    let case_flags = flags
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|flag| leaves[flag].place.projections.starts_with(&prefix))
                        .copied()
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    (case.case.clone(), case_flags)
                })
                .collect();
            state.conditional_variants.push(ReplayConditionalVariant {
                root: destination.clone(),
                variant: variant.clone(),
                cases: conditional_cases,
            });
        }
        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase {
            source,
            variant,
            case,
            ..
        } => {
            if !state
                .conditional_variants
                .iter()
                .any(|entry| entry.root == *source)
            {
                materialize_constructed_variant(
                    program, function, state, source, variant, storage, leaves,
                )?;
            }
            if let Some(index) = state
                .conditional_variants
                .iter()
                .position(|candidate| candidate.root == *source && candidate.variant == *variant)
            {
                let conditional = state.conditional_variants.remove(index);
                let flags = conditional
                    .cases
                    .into_iter()
                    .find_map(|(candidate, flags)| (candidate == *case).then_some(flags))
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        replay_error(function, "conditional state omits authenticated case")
                    })?;
                let flags = if flags.is_empty() {
                    let prefix = source.projected(case.clone()).projections;
                    validate_place(function, source, storage, leaves)?
                        .into_iter()
                        .filter(|flag| leaves[flag].place.projections.starts_with(&prefix))
                        .collect()
                } else {
                    flags
                };
                // A valid selected case may carry only Copy fields. Its authenticated case state is consumed even though there are no cleanup flags to
                // materialize.
                if !flags.is_empty() {
                    append_dead_flags(function, state, flags, "variant authentication")?;
                }
            }
            let prefix = source
                .projections
                .iter()
                .chain(std::iter::once(case))
                .cloned()
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            if validate_place(function, source, storage, leaves)?
                .iter()
                .any(|flag| {
                    state.live_order.contains(flag)
                        && !leaves[flag].place.projections.starts_with(&prefix)
                })
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "variant authentication retains a live inactive-case payload",
                )
                .into());
            }
        }
        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => {
            let mut consumed = BTreeSet::new();
            let mut consumed_conditional_roots = BTreeSet::new();
            for argument in arguments {
                if let Some(index) = state
                    .conditional_variants
                    .iter()
                    .position(|variant| variant.root == argument.source)
                {
