                    if !consumed_conditional_roots.insert(argument.source.clone()) {
                        return Err(E::structural(
                            function,
                            semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedVariantEpoch(call.clone()),
                        ));
                    }
                    let conditional = state.conditional_variants.remove(index);
                    for flag in conditional.cases.into_iter().flat_map(|(_, flags)| flags) {
                        if !consumed.insert(flag) {
                            return Err(E::structural(
                                function,
                                semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedCallFlag(call.clone(), flag),
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                for flag in validate_place(function, &argument.source, storage, leaves)? {
                    if !state.live_order.contains(&flag) {
                        return Err(E::structural(
                            function,
                            semantic_refusal::Atom::DeadCallFlag(call.clone(), flag),
                        ));
                    }
                    if !consumed.insert(flag) {
                        return Err(E::structural(
                            function,
                            semantic_refusal::Atom::RepeatedCallFlag(call.clone(), flag),
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
            for history in state.renewals.values_mut() {
                history.commit(&consumed);
            }
            state.live_order.retain(|flag| !consumed.contains(flag));
        }
        CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { source } => {
            state.renewals.clear();
            if state.selected_failure.is_some() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "failure selection is not write-once during path replay",
                )
                .into());
            }
            if state.pending_failure.as_ref() != Some(source) {
                return Err(E::structural(
                    function,
                    semantic_refusal::Atom::MismatchedFailure(source.expression.clone()),
                ));
            }
            state.pending_failure = None;
            state.selected_failure = Some(source.clone());
        }
        CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {
            if state.staged_copy_result.is_some() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "Copy aggregate result is staged more than once on one path",
                )
                .into());
            }
            if !state.live_order.is_empty() || !state.conditional_variants.is_empty() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "Copy aggregate result staging carries resource liveness",
                )
                .into());
            }
            state.staged_copy_result = Some(source.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn replay_transfer(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &mut PathState,
    source: &CleanupPlace,
    destination: &CleanupPlace,
    storage: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if budget.selected() {
        return transition_storage::transfer(
            function,
            state,
            source,
            destination,
            storage,
            leaves,
            budget,
        );
    }
    let source_flags = validate_place(function, source, storage, leaves)?;
    let destination_flags = validate_place(function, destination, storage, leaves)?;
    let source_set = source_flags.iter().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let destination_set = destination_flags.iter().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    if source_set.len() != destination_set.len() || !source_set.is_disjoint(&destination_set) {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup transfer does not have disjoint equal-size ownership epochs",
        ));
    }
    if let Some(index) = state
        .conditional_variants
        .iter()
        .position(|variant| variant.root == *source)
    {
        let mapping = transfer_mapping(function, source, destination, leaves)?;
        let variant = state.conditional_variants.remove(index);
        let cases = variant
            .cases
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(case, flags)| {
                flags
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|flag| {
                        mapping.get(&flag).copied().ok_or_else(|| {
                            replay_error(function, "conditional cleanup transfer omits a case leaf")
                        })
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, Diagnostic>>()
                    .map(|flags| (case, flags))
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, Diagnostic>>()?;
        state.conditional_variants.push(ReplayConditionalVariant {
            root: destination.clone(),
            variant: variant.variant,
            cases,
        });
        return Ok(());
    }
    if source_set
        .iter()
        .any(|flag| !state.live_order.contains(flag))
    {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup transfer reads a dead source leaf",
        ));
    }
    if destination_set
        .iter()
        .any(|flag| state.live_order.contains(flag))
    {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup transfer initializes a live destination leaf",
        ));
    }

    let mapping = transfer_mapping(function, source, destination, leaves)?;
    // A whole-source transfer is a completed aggregate boundary, authenticated by the typed control skeleton. Filling every owned destination field is not:
    // later Copy initializers can still fail, so preserve their preceding field-initialization history until the constructor actually completes.
    let source_history = if source.projections.is_empty() {
        source_flags
    } else {
        state
            .live_order
            .iter()
            .filter(|flag| source_set.contains(flag))
            .copied()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    };
    for history in state.renewals.values_mut() {
        history.stage(|flag| mapping.get(&flag).copied());
    }
    state.live_order.retain(|flag| !source_set.contains(flag));
    if destination.projections.is_empty() {
        state.live_order.extend(destination_flags);
    } else {
        for source_flag in source_history {
            state.live_order.push(mapping[&source_flag]);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn find_resolved_expression<'a>(
    function: &'a ResolvedFunction,
    identity: &ExpressionId,
) -> Option<&'a ResolvedExpr> {
    let mut stack = function
        .requires
        .iter()
        .chain(std::iter::once(&function.body))
        .chain(&function.ensures)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    while let Some(expression) = stack.pop() {
        if expression.id == *identity {
            return Some(expression);
        }
        let mut index = 0;
        while let Some(child) = replay_expression_child(expression, index) {
            stack.push(child);
            index += 1;
        }
    }
    None
}

pub(super) fn transfer_mapping(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    source: &CleanupPlace,
    destination: &CleanupPlace,
    leaves: &Leaves,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<LivenessFlagId, LivenessFlagId>, Diagnostic> {
    let mut mapping = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut destinations = BTreeSet::new();
    for (source_flag, source_leaf) in leaves.iter().filter(|(_, leaf)| {
        leaf.place.storage == source.storage
            && leaf.place.projections.starts_with(&source.projections)
    }) {
        let relative = source_leaf
            .place
            .projections
            .strip_prefix(source.projections.as_slice())
            .ok_or_else(|| replay_error(function, "transfer source is not a projection prefix"))?;
        let projections = destination
            .projections
            .iter()
            .chain(relative)
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let Some((destination_flag, destination_leaf)) = leaves.iter().find(|(_, leaf)| {
            leaf.place.storage == destination.storage && leaf.place.projections == projections
        }) else {
            return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "cleanup transfer leaf shapes do not correspond",
            ));
        };
        if source_leaf.lifecycle != destination_leaf.lifecycle
            || !destinations.insert(*destination_flag)
        {
            return Err(replay_error(
                function,
                "cleanup transfer changes a leaf lifecycle or aliases its destination",
            ));
        }
        mapping.insert(*source_flag, *destination_flag);
    }
    if mapping.is_empty() {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup transfer has no mapped ownership leaves",
        ));
    }
    Ok(mapping)
}

pub(super) fn append_dead_flags(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &mut PathState,
    flags: Vec<LivenessFlagId>,
    operation: &str,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if flags.is_empty()
        || flags.iter().any(|flag| {
            state.live_order.contains(flag)
                || state.conditional_variants.iter().any(|variant| {
                    variant
                        .cases
                        .iter()
                        .any(|(_, case_flags)| case_flags.contains(flag))
                })
        })
    {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            format_args!("{operation} initializes an empty or live cleanup place"),
        ));
    }
    state.live_order.extend(flags);
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn state_for_edge(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    mut state: PathState,
    condition: &EdgeCondition,
    contract_sources: &BTreeMap<ExpressionId, StatusSourceId>,
) -> Result<PathState, Diagnostic> {
    if state.pending_failure.is_some() || state.selected_failure.is_some() || state.published {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "conditional edge follows pending, selected, or published state",
        ));
    }
    match condition {
        EdgeCondition::Always => {}
        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, false) => {
            if let Some(source) = contract_sources.get(expression) {
                state.pending_failure = Some(source.clone());
            }
        }
        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(_, true)
        | EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. }
        | EdgeCondition::ArmSelected { .. }
        | EdgeCondition::StatusZero(_) => {}
        EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(source) => {
            state.pending_failure = Some(source.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(state)
}

#[allow(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "keep independent held authority and canonical replay inputs explicit"
)]
pub(super) fn replay_exit(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    exit: &ExitTarget,
    mut state: PathState,
    storage_regions: &BTreeMap<StorageId, CleanupRegionId>,
    storage: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    extra_disposed: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<ExitFlow, Diagnostic> {
    if budget.selected() {
        return transition_storage::exit(
            function,
            exit,
            state,
            storage_regions,
            storage,
            leaves,
            extra_disposed,
            budget,
        );
    }
    if state.published {
        return Err(replay_error(function, "cleanup exit follows publication"));
    }
    let leaving = exit.leaves_regions.iter().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let protected_result = match &exit.continuation {
        ExitContinuation::CommitResult {
            source: CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage: result },
        } => validate_place(function, result, storage, leaves)?
            .into_iter()
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>(),
        _ => BTreeSet::new(),
    };
    let expected = state
        .live_order
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .filter_map(|flag| {
            let leaf = &leaves[flag];
            let region = storage_regions[&leaf.place.storage];
            ((leaving.contains(&region) || extra_disposed.contains(&leaf.place.storage))
                && !protected_result.contains(flag))
            .then_some(*flag)
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut expected_conditional = Vec::new();
    for variant in state.conditional_variants.iter().rev() {
        let region = storage_regions[&variant.root.storage];
        let protected = matches!(
            &exit.continuation,
            ExitContinuation::CommitResult {
                source: CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage },
            } if storage == &variant.root
        );
        if !(leaving.contains(&region) || extra_disposed.contains(&variant.root.storage))
            || protected
        {
            continue;
        }
        for (case, flags) in variant.cases.iter().rev() {
            for flag in flags.iter().rev() {
                expected_conditional.push((
                    *flag,
                    crate::cleanup_plan::VariantCaseGuard {
                        storage: variant.root.storage.clone(),
                        variant: variant.variant.clone(),
                        case: case.clone(),
                    },
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    let actual = exit
        .finalize_in_order
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|action| {
            state
                .live_order
                .contains(&action.guard_flag)
                .then_some(action.guard_flag)
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if actual != expected {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            format_args!(
                "exit {} does not finalize its live region leaves in reverse initialization order",
                exit.id.0
            ),
        ));
    }
    let actual_conditional = exit
        .finalize_in_order
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|action| {
            action
                .active_case
                .as_ref()
                .map(|condition| (action.guard_flag, condition.clone()))
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if actual_conditional != expected_conditional {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "exit does not preserve exact conditional variant finalizers",
        ));
    }
    let finalized = expected.into_iter().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    state.live_order.retain(|flag| !finalized.contains(flag));
    state.conditional_variants.retain(|variant| {
        !(leaving.contains(&storage_regions[&variant.root.storage])
            || extra_disposed.contains(&variant.root.storage))
            || matches!(
                &exit.continuation,
                ExitContinuation::CommitResult {
                    source: CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage },
                } if storage == &variant.root
            )
    });
    if state.live_order.iter().any(|flag| {
        let leaf = &leaves[flag];
        leaving.contains(&storage_regions[&leaf.place.storage]) && !protected_result.contains(flag)
    }) {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "cleanup exit retains a live non-result leaf in a region it leaves",
        ));
    }

    finish_exit(function, exit, state, storage, leaves, budget)
}

pub(super) fn finish_exit(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    exit: &ExitTarget,
    mut state: PathState,
    storage: &BTreeSet<StorageId>,
    leaves: &Leaves,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<ExitFlow, Diagnostic> {
    match &exit.continuation {
        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) | ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. } => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some() || state.selected_failure.is_some() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "normal cleanup continuation carries a failure state",
                ));
            }
            Ok(ExitFlow::Edge(*edge, state))
        }
        ExitContinuation::LoopLatch { .. } => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some()
                || state.selected_failure.is_some()
                || state.staged_copy_result.is_some()
                || state.returned.is_some()
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "loop latch carries a failure, staged-result or return state",
                ));
            }
            Ok(ExitFlow::Latch(state))
        }
        ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, source, .. } => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some()
                || state.selected_failure.is_some()
                || state.staged_copy_result.is_some()
                || state.returned.is_some()
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "function return carries a failure, staged-result or earlier return state",
                ));
            }
            state.returned = Some(match source {
                CleanupResultSource::Scalar { expression } => {
                    ReturnedSource::Scalar(expression.clone())
                }
                CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage: result } => {
                    let held = if state
                        .conditional_variants
                        .iter()
                        .any(|variant| variant.root == *result)
                    {
                        true
                    } else {
                        let flags = path_join::storage::validate_place(
                            function, result, storage, leaves, budget,
                        )?;
                        flags.iter().all(|flag| state.live_order.contains(flag))
                    };
                    if !held {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "owned function return has an incomplete provisional result",
                        ));
                    }
                    budget.reserve_clone(function, result, "returned provisional place")?;
                    ReturnedSource::Owned(result.clone())
                }
            });
            Ok(ExitFlow::Edge(*edge, state))
        }
        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { source } => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some()
                || state.selected_failure.as_ref() != Some(source)
                || !state.live_order.is_empty()
                || !state.conditional_variants.is_empty()
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "failure return changes status or retains live ownership",
                ));
            }
            Ok(ExitFlow::Terminal)
        }
        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { source } => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some() || state.selected_failure.is_some() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "result commit follows a pending or selected failure",
                ));
            }
            match (&state.returned, source) {
                (None, CleanupResultSource::Scalar { expression })
                    if expression != &function.body.id =>
                {
                    return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "ordinary scalar result commit does not publish the function body",
                    ));
                }
                (None, _) => {}
                (
                    Some(ReturnedSource::Scalar(expected)),
                    CleanupResultSource::Scalar { expression },
                ) if expected == expression => {}
                (Some(ReturnedSource::Owned(expected)), CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage })
                    if expected == storage => {}
                (Some(_), _) => {
                    return Err(replay_error(
                        function,
                        "return domain commits a result other than its handed-off source",
                    ));
                }
            }
            match source {
                CleanupResultSource::Scalar { .. } => {
                    if !state.live_order.is_empty() || !state.conditional_variants.is_empty() {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "scalar result commits before non-result cleanup completes",
                        ));
                    }
                    if state.returned.is_none()
                        && !budget.selected()
                        && expression_has_try(&function.body)
                    {
                        let staged = state.staged_copy_result.take().ok_or_else(|| {
                            replay_error(
                                function,
                                "Copy Result commit has no authenticated staged producer",
                            )
                        })?;
                        validate_staged_target(function, &staged)?;
                    } else if state.staged_copy_result.is_some() {
                        return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "non-try scalar result carries a staged Copy aggregate",
                        ));
                    }
                }
                CleanupResultSource::Owned { storage: result } => {
                    if let Some(index) = state
                        .conditional_variants
                        .iter()
                        .position(|variant| variant.root == *result)
                    {
                        if !state.live_order.is_empty() || state.conditional_variants.len() != 1 {
                            return Err(replay_error(
                                function,
                                "conditional owned result retains non-result ownership",
                            ));
                        }
                        state.conditional_variants.remove(index);
                    } else {
                        let result_flags = path_join::storage::validate_place(
                            function, result, storage, leaves, budget,
                        )?;
                        if result_flags
                            .iter()
                            .any(|flag| !state.live_order.contains(flag))
                            || state.live_order.len() != result_flags.len()
                        {
                            return Err(replay_error(
                            function,
                            "owned result commit has incomplete result or remaining non-result ownership",
                        ));
                        }
                        if budget.selected() {
                            state.live_order.clear();
                        } else {
                            let result_flags = result_flags.into_iter().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
                            state.live_order.retain(|flag| !result_flags.contains(flag));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            state.published = true;
            if !state.live_order.is_empty() || !state.conditional_variants.is_empty() {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "result publication leaves cleanup ownership live",
                ));
            }
            Ok(ExitFlow::Terminal)
        }
        ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {
            if state.pending_failure.is_some()
                || state.selected_failure.is_some()
                || !state.live_order.is_empty()
                || !state.conditional_variants.is_empty()
            {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "unit return follows failure or incomplete cleanup",
                ));
            }
            state.published = true;
            Ok(ExitFlow::Terminal)
        }
    }
}

/// How one replayed exit continues the proof flow of its domain.
pub(super) enum FrozenExitFlow {
    /// A published result or returned failure ends the path.
    Terminal,
    /// A CFG edge carries the settled state to its target block.
    Edge(EdgeId, PathState),
    /// A finite iteration reaches its latch with the settled state.
    Latch(PathState),
}

pub(super) fn require_normal_flow_state(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    state: &PathState,
    block: BlockId,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if state.pending_failure.is_none() && state.selected_failure.is_none() && !state.published {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(replay_error(
            function,
            format_args!(
                "block {} continues ordinary control flow with failure or publication state",
                block.0
            ),
        ))
    }
}

pub(super) fn validate_staged_target(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    source: &StagedCopyResultSource,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    let target = match source {
        StagedCopyResultSource::Body {
            expression,
            instance,
        } => {
            if expression != &function.body.id {
                return Err(replay_error(
                    function,
                    "body result staging references another expression",
                ));
            }
            instance
        }
        StagedCopyResultSource::TryResidual {
            target_instance, ..
        }
        | StagedCopyResultSource::TryOptionNone {
            target_instance, ..
        } => target_instance,
    };
    if target != &function.return_type {
        return Err(replay_error(
            function,
            "staged Copy result targets another concrete function result",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}
//! Paid ordinary frontier controls and transport of the existing allocation.
use super::*;
use std::mem::size_of;

// These banks cover the new directory, selector, iterator, partial-Drop and
// call receiving roles before they are formed. The complete original backing
// and all original work remain separately charged by their existing owners.
pub(super) fn reserve_directory(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    count: usize,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        size_of::<(
            &ResolvedFunction,
            usize,
            &mut ReplayBudget,
            Result<(), Diagnostic>,
            Vec<frontier::Incoming<PathState>>,
            &mut Vec<frontier::Incoming<PathState>>,
            fn() -> frontier::Incoming<PathState>,
        )>() + HELD_EDGE_TERMINAL,
        "ordinary frontier directory receiving",
    )?;
    budget.reserve_array::<(
        frontier::Incoming<PathState>,
        frontier::Incoming<PathState>,
        frontier::Incoming<PathState>,
        &mut fn() -> frontier::Incoming<PathState>,
    )>(
        function,
        count,
        "ordinary frontier repeated default receiving",
    )
}

// Direct lexical producers remove the two forwarding Result wrappers and
// owned Box/Result<Box> edge boundary. Direct singleton fields also remove the
// frontier iterator/forwarded next and consuming IntoIter carriers. Every
// remaining Box, Incoming, authority, selector, and terminal bank is retained.
pub(super) const BLOCK_CONTROLS: usize = 4 * size_of::<frontier::Incoming<PathState>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&frontier::Incoming<PathState>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&BTreeSet<Box<PathState>>>()
    + 8 * size_of::<Box<PathState>>()
    + 6 * size_of::<&Box<PathState>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&PathState>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>()
    + size_of::<std::iter::Empty<&PathState>>()
    + size_of::<BlockId>()
    + size_of::<(
        &ResolvedFunction,
        &EdgeCondition,
        &BTreeMap<ExpressionId, StatusSourceId>,
        &mut ReplayBudget,
        &ExpressionId,
        &StatusSourceId,
        StatusSourceId,
        Option<&StatusSourceId>,
        bool,
    )>();

// One terminal local Diagnostic and its conversion operand, plus the actual
// and formal Box of explicit drop before converting the selected error.
pub(super) const HELD_EDGE_TERMINAL: usize =
    2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>() + 2 * size_of::<Box<PathState>>();

macro_rules! held_edge {
    ($function:expr, $state:ident, $condition:expr, $sources:ident) => {{
        if $state.pending_failure.is_some() || $state.selected_failure.is_some() || $state.published
        {
            let error = replay_error(
                $function,
                "conditional edge follows pending, selected, or published state",
            );
            // The removed callee dropped its owned Box before returning its
            // Diagnostic to the caller for E conversion. Keep that exact order.
            drop($state);
            return Err(error.into());
        }
        match $condition {
            EdgeCondition::Always => {}
            EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, false) => {
                if let Some(source) = $sources.get(expression) {
                    $state.pending_failure = Some(source.clone());
                }
            }
            EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(_, true)
            | EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. }
            | EdgeCondition::ArmSelected { .. }
            | EdgeCondition::StatusZero(_) => {}
            EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(source) => {
                $state.pending_failure = Some(source.clone());
            }
        }
    }};
}
pub(super) use held_edge;
//! One invocation's explicitly paid insertion receivers and terminal report.
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::ClassifierLedger;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_budget::ByteFailure;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, marker::PhantomData, mem::size_of};

pub(super) struct Insertions<T> {
    pub(super) failed: bool,
    refusal: Option<ByteFailure>,
    entry: bool,
    group_entry: bool,
    function: *const ResolvedFunction,
    budget: *const ReplayBudget,
    ledger: ClassifierLedger,

    marker: PhantomData<fn() -> T>,
}
impl<T: Ord> Insertions<T> {
    // Aggregate initializer, named mutable result and caller receiving owner;
    // the Result<Self> wrapper remains separate, plus constructor/payment Results,
    // inert ledger return, compact refusal None/Some/take and terminal Diagnostic moves.
    // Every full Diagnostic/ByteFailure terminal bank remains: positive failures
    // retain their actual ByteFailure until failure() moves its identical Cow into
    // the Diagnostic. Foreign rejection still constructs its original Diagnostic
    // first and compacts only after the actual held ledger rejected storage.
    pub(super) fn controls() -> usize {
        3 * size_of::<Self>()
            + size_of::<Result<Self, Diagnostic>>()
            + size_of::<Result<(), Diagnostic>>()
            + size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()
            + 3 * size_of::<Option<ByteFailure>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
            + size_of::<&mut Self>()
            + size_of::<&mut Option<ByteFailure>>()
            + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
            + ClassifierLedger::insertion_terminal_controls()
            // One independent tree-group entry bank shares the exact held
            // authority/error owner. The original node/renewal tariff remains.
            + Self::GROUP_ENTRY_CONTROLS
            // At most one positive-payment failure reaches conversion. Pay its
            // actual/formal compact values and Diagnostic construction/return
            // once, before any entry; sticky failure forbids reuse.
            + 2 * size_of::<ByteFailure>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
            // A foreign/function/budget rejection still constructs the actual
            // original Diagnostic before compacting it. This NEW affine call
            // owns a Diagnostic actual/formal and returned compact carriers;
            // its bank is separate from the retained failure() conversion.
            + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
            + 2 * size_of::<ByteFailure>()
    }
    // A single entry's actual method/gateway/positive-reservation receivers.
    // Each entry consumes this bank and pays the next bank afresh. The final
    // unused entry remains reserved: no reset, refund or allowance donation.
    const ENTRY_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut Self>()
            + 4 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
            + 4 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
            + size_of::<&mut Option<ByteFailure>>()
            + size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
            + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls()
            + 6 * size_of::<Incoming<T>>()
            + 6 * size_of::<Box<T>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<BTreeSet<Box<T>>>()
            + 3 * size_of::<usize>()
            // contains result + named duplicate, each branch predicate and
            // match selector. The renewed bank precedes all warm hits too.
            + 8 * size_of::<bool>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&mut Incoming<T>>()
            // The lexical match keeps its actual &Incoming view. The old
            // contains callee's independent formal &Incoming no longer exists.
            + size_of::<&Incoming<T>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<&T>();
    pub(super) fn entry_controls() -> usize {
        Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS
    }
    // Exact original tree entry price; only borrowed Self references depend on
    // the receiver type, and both remain thin references to a sized owner.
    pub(super) const GROUP_ENTRY_CONTROLS: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut Self>()
        + 4 * size_of::<&ResolvedFunction>()
        + 4 * size_of::<&mut ReplayBudget>()
        + size_of::<&mut Option<ByteFailure>>()
        + size_of::<Result<(), ByteFailure>>()
        + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls();
    const NODE: usize = match const_node_upper::<Box<T>, ()>() {
        Some(bytes) => bytes,
        None => usize::MAX,
    };
    const BOXED: usize = size_of::<T>().saturating_add(2 * size_of::<Box<T>>());
    const OWNED_EMPTY: usize = Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS.saturating_add(Self::BOXED);
    const TWO_NODES: usize = Self::NODE.saturating_mul(2);
    const HELD_ONE: usize = Self::TWO_NODES.saturating_add(Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS);
    const OWNED_ONE: usize = Self::HELD_ONE.saturating_add(Self::BOXED);
    const HELD_MANY: usize = Self::NODE.saturating_add(Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS);
    const OWNED_MANY: usize = Self::HELD_MANY.saturating_add(Self::BOXED);
    const GROUP_HELD: usize = Self::NODE.saturating_add(Self::GROUP_ENTRY_CONTROLS);
    pub(super) fn acquire(
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) -> Result<Self, Diagnostic> {
        if budget.pays_allocations() {
            budget.reserve_bytes(
                function,
                Self::controls() + Self::entry_controls(),
                "ownership insertion receiving controls",
            )?;
            #[cfg(test)]
            contains_tests::record_entry_bank();
        }
        let mut result = Self {
            failed: false,
            refusal: None,
            entry: true,
            group_entry: true,
            function: std::ptr::from_ref(function),
            budget: std::ptr::from_ref(budget),
            ledger: ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving(),
            marker: PhantomData,
        };
        result.ledger.capture_current_into();
        Ok(result)
    }
    fn authenticate(&mut self, function: &ResolvedFunction, budget: &mut ReplayBudget) {
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        assert!(self.entry);
        self.entry = false;
        // Compare exact receiver identity before querying a possibly foreign
        // payer. The held ledger poisons only its original owner on mismatch.
        if self.function != std::ptr::from_ref(function)
            || self.budget != std::ptr::from_ref(budget)
            || !self.ledger.current()
        {
            self.ledger.reject_storage();
            self.refusal = Some(ByteFailure::from_budget(Diagnostic::io(
                "SPX-H006",
                String::new(),
            )));
            self.failed = true;
            return;
        }
        budget.authenticate_zero_compact_into(
            function,
            "incoming ownership state authority",
            &mut self.refusal,
        );
        self.failed = self.refusal.is_some();
    }
    // Existing owner/ledger authentication consumes exactly one entry bank.
    // The complete next bank is prepaid even for Empty, equal and held hits.
    pub(super) fn insert_owned(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        target: &mut Incoming<T>,
        value: T,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) {
        self.authenticate(function, budget);
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        let duplicate = match &*target {
            Incoming::Empty => false,
            Incoming::One(old) => old.as_ref().cmp(&value) == std::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
            Incoming::Many(v) => v.contains(&value),
        };
        let bytes = if duplicate {
            Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS
        } else {
            match target {
                Incoming::Empty => Self::OWNED_EMPTY,
                Incoming::One(_) => Self::OWNED_ONE,
                Incoming::Many(_) => Self::OWNED_MANY,
            }
        };
        if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            bytes,
            "compact incoming owned state and publication renewal",
        ) {
            self.refusal = Some(error);
            self.failed = true;
            return;
        }
        #[cfg(test)]
        if budget.pays_allocations() {
            contains_tests::record_entry_bank();
        }
        #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
        if duplicate {
            crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::Duplicate,
            );
        }
        if !duplicate {
            #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
            crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::OwnedBox,
            );
            target.publish(Box::new(value));
        }
        self.entry = true;
    }
    pub(super) fn insert_held(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        target: &mut Incoming<T>,
        value: Box<T>,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) {
        self.authenticate(function, budget);
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        let duplicate = match &*target {
            Incoming::Empty => false,
            Incoming::One(old) => old.as_ref().cmp(value.as_ref()) == std::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
            Incoming::Many(v) => v.contains(value.as_ref()),
        };
        let bytes = if duplicate {
            Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS
        } else {
            match target {
                Incoming::Empty => Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS,
                Incoming::One(_) => Self::HELD_ONE,
                Incoming::Many(_) => Self::HELD_MANY,
            }
        };
        if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
            function,
            bytes,
            "compact incoming held state and publication renewal",
        ) {
            self.refusal = Some(error);
            self.failed = true;
            return;
        }
        #[cfg(test)]
        if budget.pays_allocations() {
            contains_tests::record_entry_bank();
        }
        #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
        if duplicate {
            crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::Duplicate,
            );
        }
        if !duplicate {
            #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
            crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::HeldTransfer,
            );
            target.publish(value);
        }
        self.entry = true;
    }
    // Complete original held-tree producer, sharing only retained ownership.
    fn authenticate_group(&mut self, function: &ResolvedFunction, budget: &mut ReplayBudget) {
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        assert!(self.group_entry);
        self.group_entry = false;
        // Compare exact receiver identity before querying a possibly foreign
        // payer. The held ledger poisons only its original owner on mismatch.
        if self.function != std::ptr::from_ref(function)
            || self.budget != std::ptr::from_ref(budget)
            || !self.ledger.current()
        {
            self.ledger.reject_storage();
            self.refusal = Some(ByteFailure::from_budget(Diagnostic::io(
                "SPX-H006",
                String::new(),
            )));
            self.failed = true;
            return;
        }
        budget.authenticate_zero_compact_into(
            function,
            "incoming ownership state authority",
            &mut self.refusal,
        );
        self.failed = self.refusal.is_some();
    }
    pub(super) fn insert_group_held(
        &mut self,
        function: &ResolvedFunction,
        target: &mut BTreeSet<Box<T>>,
        value: Box<T>,
        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    ) {
        self.authenticate_group(function, budget);
        if self.failed {
            return;
        }
        if target.contains(value.as_ref()) {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                Self::GROUP_ENTRY_CONTROLS,
                "ownership held duplicate receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error);
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
        } else {
            if let Err(error) = budget.reserve_compact_bytes(
                function,
                Self::GROUP_HELD,
                "incoming held ownership state node and receiving renewal",
            ) {
                self.refusal = Some(error);
                self.failed = true;
                return;
            }
            target.insert(value);
        }
        self.group_entry = true;
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn observed_prices() -> [usize; 7] {
        [
            Self::OWNED_EMPTY,
            Self::ENTRY_CONTROLS,
            Self::OWNED_ONE,
            Self::HELD_ONE,
            Self::OWNED_MANY,
            Self::HELD_MANY,
            Self::GROUP_HELD,
        ]
    }
    pub(super) fn failure(&mut self) -> Diagnostic {
        assert!(self.failed);
        self.refusal
            .take()
            .expect("ownership insertion report moves once")
            .into_diagnostic()
    }
}

// Exact original B-tree layout algorithm, evaluated only by NODE above.
// Its six independently rounded fields and every checked failure keep the
// complete original usize::MAX fallback; no aggregate is formed per entry.
#[allow(
    clippy::manual_saturating_arithmetic,
    reason = "retain exact original checked layout/sentinel semantics"
)]
pub(super) const fn const_node_upper<K, V>() -> Option<usize> {
    use std::mem::align_of;
    let mut alignment = align_of::<K>();
    if align_of::<V>() > alignment {
        alignment = align_of::<V>();
    }
    if align_of::<usize>() > alignment {
        alignment = align_of::<usize>();
    }
    let keys = match size_of::<K>().checked_mul(11) {
        Some(bytes) => bytes,
        None => return None,
    };
    let values = match size_of::<V>().checked_mul(11) {
        Some(bytes) => bytes,
        None => return None,
    };
    let children = match size_of::<usize>().checked_mul(12) {
        Some(bytes) => bytes,
        None => return None,
    };
    let fields = [
        size_of::<Option<std::ptr::NonNull<()>>>(),
        size_of::<u16>(),
        size_of::<u16>(),
        keys,
        values,
        children,
    ];
    let mut total = 0usize;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < fields.len() {
        let rounded = match fields[index].checked_add(alignment - 1) {
            Some(bytes) => bytes / alignment * alignment,
            None => return None,
        };
        total = match total.checked_add(rounded) {
            Some(bytes) => bytes,
            None => return None,
        };
        index += 1;
    }
    Some(total)
}

// Invocation-local incoming states: singleton ownership does not allocate a tree node.
#[cfg(test)]
use std::collections::btree_set;
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(super) enum Incoming<T> {
    Empty,
    One(Box<T>),
    Many(BTreeSet<Box<T>>),
}
#[allow(
    clippy::derivable_impls,
    reason = "unconditional Default preserves non-Default T and the paid callback receiver contract"
)]
impl<T> Default for Incoming<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::Empty
    }
}
impl<T: Ord> Incoming<T> {
    #[allow(
        clippy::borrowed_box,
        reason = "retain the exact existing boxed owner without constructing a tree"
    )]
    pub(super) fn one(&self) -> &Box<T> {
        let Self::One(v) = self else {
            unreachable!("singleton frontier")
        };
        v
    }
    pub(super) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::Empty => 0,
            Self::One(_) => 1,
            Self::Many(v) => v.len(),
        }
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
    pub(super) fn observe_incoming(&self) {
        use crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::{event, Event};
        event(match self {
            Self::Empty => Event::InputEmpty,
            Self::One(_) => Event::InputOne,
            Self::Many(_) => Event::InputMany,
        });
    }
    pub(super) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }
    // Called only after all box, node/split, move, empty replacement and Result
    // roles have been acquired. On a refused payment no target is taken.
    fn publish(&mut self, value: Box<T>) {
        match self {
            Self::Empty => {
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::Empty,
                );
                *self = Self::One(value);
            }
            Self::One(_) => {
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                {
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                        crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::One,
                    );
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                        crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::Promotion,
                    );
                }
                let Self::One(old) = std::mem::take(self) else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let mut tree = BTreeSet::new();
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::TreeInsert,
                );
                tree.insert(old);
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::TreeInsert,
                );
                tree.insert(value);
                *self = Self::Many(tree);
            }
            Self::Many(tree) => {
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::Many,
                );
                #[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
                crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::event(
                    crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::path_census::Event::TreeInsert,
                );
                tree.insert(value);
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn iter(&self) -> Iter<'_, T> {
        match self {
            Self::Empty => Iter::One(None.into_iter()),
            Self::One(v) => Iter::One(Some(v).into_iter()),
            Self::Many(v) => Iter::Many(v.iter()),
        }
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(super) fn into_one(self) -> std::option::IntoIter<Box<T>> {
        let Self::One(v) = self else {
            unreachable!("singleton frontier")
        };
        Some(v).into_iter()
    }
    pub(super) fn into_many(self) -> BTreeSet<Box<T>> {
        let Self::Many(v) = self else {
            unreachable!("multiple-state frontier")
        };
        v
    }
}
#[allow(
    clippy::borrowed_box,
    reason = "borrow the exact boxed owner for held insertion and same-box transport"
)]
#[cfg(test)]
pub(super) enum Iter<'a, T> {
    One(std::option::IntoIter<&'a Box<T>>),
    Many(btree_set::Iter<'a, Box<T>>),
}
#[cfg(test)]
impl<'a, T> Iterator for Iter<'a, T> {
    type Item = &'a Box<T>;
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        match self {
            Self::One(v) => v.next(),
            Self::Many(v) => v.next(),
        }
    }
}
//! Compact storage controls; every measurement includes the final owning Drop.
use super::frontier::{Incoming, Insertions};
use super::*;
// Keep every original direct helper control against its complete old producer.
use super::held_edge_before as boxed_flow;
use crate::bounded_output::{
    active_remaining, reserve_active_required, set_active_floor, with_limit_usage_refusal,
};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::{current_metrics, measure};
use std::{cell::Cell, mem::size_of};
thread_local! { static DROPS:Cell<usize> = const { Cell::new(0) }; }
#[derive(Eq, PartialEq, Ord, PartialOrd, Debug)]
struct State([u64; 50]);
impl Drop for State {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        DROPS.with(|n| n.set(n.get() + 1));
    }
}
fn function() -> ResolvedFunction {
    crate::hir::resolve(
        &crate::check(
            "module compact; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {0}",
            "compact.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap()
    .functions
    .remove(0)
}
fn scalar(value: u64) -> State {
    State([value; 50])
}
fn pointer<T: Ord>(value: &Incoming<T>) -> *const T {
    std::ptr::from_ref(value.one().as_ref())
}
fn bootstrap(f: &ResolvedFunction) -> usize {
    f.id.as_str().len() + 512
}
fn empty() -> PathState {
    PathState {
        renewals: BTreeMap::new(),
        live_order: Vec::new(),
        conditional_variants: Vec::new(),
        pending_failure: None,
        selected_failure: None,
        staged_copy_result: None,
        published: false,
        returned: None,
    }
}
#[test]
fn empty_one_duplicate_promotion_both_orders_and_tree_splits_keep_exact_owners() {
    let f = function();
    for reverse in [false, true] {
        DROPS.with(|n| n.set(0));
        let (((), allocation), refused, paid, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(1 << 24, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
                let mut receiver = Insertions::acquire(&f, &mut budget).unwrap();
                let mut target = Incoming::default();
                assert!(target.is_empty());
                let first = if reverse { 127 } else { 0 };
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(first), &mut budget);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                let original = pointer(&target);
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(first), &mut budget);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                assert_eq!(pointer(&target), original);
                assert_eq!(DROPS.with(Cell::get), 1);
                for step in 1..128 {
                    let n = if reverse { 127 - step } else { step };
                    receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(n), &mut budget);
                    assert!(!receiver.failed);
                }
                assert!(matches!(target, Incoming::Many(_)));
                assert_eq!(target.len(), 128);
                assert_eq!(
                    target.iter().map(|s| s.0[0]).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                    (0..128).collect::<Vec<_>>()
                );
                assert!(target
                    .iter()
                    .any(|s| std::ptr::from_ref(s.as_ref()) == original));
                drop(target);
                drop(receiver);
                drop(budget);
                assert_eq!(DROPS.with(Cell::get), 129);
            })
        });
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
        assert!(allocation.allocated <= paid);
    }
}
#[test]
fn held_singleton_transfer_and_equal_held_duplicate_never_rebox_or_replace_existing_owner() {
    let f = function();
    DROPS.with(|n| n.set(0));
    let (((), allocation), refused, paid, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(1 << 20, || {
        measure(|| {
            let mut b = ReplayBudget::new();
            let mut r = Insertions::acquire(&f, &mut b).unwrap();
            let mut source = Incoming::default();
            let mut target = Incoming::default();
            r.insert_owned(&f, &mut source, scalar(7), &mut b);
            let original = pointer(&source);
            let held = std::mem::take(&mut source).into_one().next().unwrap();
            let allocations = current_metrics().allocations;
            r.insert_held(&f, &mut target, held, &mut b);
            assert!(!r.failed);
            assert_eq!(pointer(&target), original);
            assert_eq!(current_metrics().allocations, allocations);
            r.insert_owned(&f, &mut source, scalar(7), &mut b);
            r.insert_held(&f, &mut target, source.into_one().next().unwrap(), &mut b);
            assert!(!r.failed);
            assert_eq!(pointer(&target), original);
            assert_eq!(DROPS.with(Cell::get), 1);
            drop(target);
            drop(r);
            drop(b);
            assert_eq!(DROPS.with(Cell::get), 2);
        })
    });
    assert!(!refused);
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    assert!(allocation.allocated <= paid);
}
#[test]
fn each_constructor_one_and_promotion_payment_frontier_preserves_partial_drop_and_sticky_first_report(
) {
    let f = function();
    let acquisition =
        bootstrap(&f) + Insertions::<State>::controls() + Insertions::<State>::entry_controls();
    let one =
        size_of::<State>() + 2 * size_of::<Box<State>>() + Insertions::<State>::entry_controls();
    let promotion =
        2 * crate::cleanup_plan::replay::physical_storage::btree_node_upper::<Box<State>, ()>()
            .unwrap()
            + one;
    for limit in [
        0,
        acquisition - 1,
        acquisition,
        acquisition + one - 1,
        acquisition + one,
        acquisition + one + promotion - 1,
        acquisition + one + promotion,
    ] {
        let ((success, a), refused, paid, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut b = ReplayBudget::new();
                let mut target = Incoming::default();
                let mut r = match Insertions::acquire(&f, &mut b) {
                    Ok(r) => r,
                    Err(e) => {
                        drop(e);
                        return false;
                    }
                };
                r.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(1), &mut b);
                if !r.failed {
                    r.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(2), &mut b);
                }
                let success = !r.failed;
                if !success {
                    let before = target.len();
                    let allocations = current_metrics().allocations;
                    r.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, scalar(3), &mut b);
                    assert_eq!(target.len(), before);
                    assert_eq!(current_metrics().allocations, allocations);
                    drop(r.failure());
                }
                drop(target);
                drop(r);
                drop(b);
                success
            })
        });
        assert_eq!(success, limit == acquisition + one + promotion);
        assert_eq!(refused, !success);
        assert_eq!(first.is_some(), !success);
        assert!(paid <= limit);
        assert!(!a.invalid && a.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
        assert!(a.allocated <= paid);
    }
}

#[test]
fn actual_paid_goto_chain_and_final_sibling_move_the_same_box_through_frontiers() {
    let f = function();
    let (((), a), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(1 << 24, || {
        measure(|| {
            let mut b = ReplayBudget::with_physical(&f, 1 << 23).unwrap();
            let mut receiver = Insertions::<PathState>::acquire(&f, &mut b).unwrap();
            let mut current = Incoming::default();
            receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut current, empty(), &mut b);
            assert!(!receiver.failed);
            let original = pointer(&current);
            let sources = BTreeMap::new();
            for _ in 0..32 {
                let state = current.into_one().next().unwrap();
                let state =
                    boxed_flow::state_for_edge(&f, state, &EdgeCondition::Always, &sources, &mut b)
                        .unwrap();
                current = Incoming::default();
                receiver.insert_held(&f, &mut current, state, &mut b);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                assert_eq!(pointer(&current), original);
            }
            let state = current.into_one().next().unwrap();
            storage::reserve_state_clone(&f, &state, &mut b, "ownership branch clone").unwrap();
            let earlier = state.as_ref().clone();
            let earlier = state_for_edge(&f, earlier, &EdgeCondition::Always, &sources).unwrap();
            let mut sibling = Incoming::default();
            receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut sibling, earlier, &mut b);
            assert!(!receiver.failed);
            assert_ne!(pointer(&sibling), original);
            let final_sibling =
                boxed_flow::state_for_edge(&f, state, &EdgeCondition::Always, &sources, &mut b)
                    .unwrap();
            let mut final_target = Incoming::default();
            receiver.insert_held(&f, &mut final_target, final_sibling, &mut b);
            assert!(!receiver.failed);
            assert_eq!(pointer(&final_target), original);
            drop(sibling);
            drop(final_target);
            drop(receiver);
            drop(b);
        })
    });
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!a.invalid && a.live == 0);
    assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
}

#[test]
fn promotion_comparison_unwind_drops_both_owners_once_after_prepublication_payment() {
    thread_local! { static COMPARES:Cell<usize> = const { Cell::new(0) }; }
    #[derive(Eq, PartialEq)]
    struct Unwind(State);
    impl Ord for Unwind {
        fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
            COMPARES.with(|n| {
                let next = n.get() + 1;
                n.set(next);
                assert_ne!(next, 2, "injected publication comparison unwind");
            });
            self.0.cmp(&other.0)
        }
    }
    impl PartialOrd for Unwind {
        fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> {
            Some(self.cmp(other))
        }
    }
    let f = function();
    DROPS.with(|n| n.set(0));
    COMPARES.with(|n| n.set(0));
    let (((), a), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(1 << 20, || {
        measure(|| {
            let mut b = ReplayBudget::new();
            let mut receiver = Insertions::<Unwind>::acquire(&f, &mut b).unwrap();
            let mut target = Incoming::default();
            receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, Unwind(scalar(1)), &mut b);
            assert!(!receiver.failed);
            let result = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut target, Unwind(scalar(2)), &mut b)
            }));
            assert!(result.is_err());
            drop(result);
            assert!(target.is_empty());
            assert_eq!(DROPS.with(Cell::get), 2);
            drop(target);
            drop(receiver);
            drop(b);
        })
    });
    assert!(!refused);
    assert!(!a.invalid && a.live == 0);
    assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
}

#[test]
fn final_original_box_reaches_either_branch_destination_with_equal_duplicate_preserved() {
    let f = function();
    for destination in 0..2 {
        let (((), a), refused, paid, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(1 << 24, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut b = ReplayBudget::new();
                let mut receiver = Insertions::<PathState>::acquire(&f, &mut b).unwrap();
                let mut initial = Incoming::default();
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut initial, empty(), &mut b);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                let original = pointer(&initial);
                let state = initial.into_one().next().unwrap();
                boxed_flow::reserve_block(&f, &mut b).unwrap();
                storage::reserve_state_clone(&f, &state, &mut b, "ownership branch clone").unwrap();
                let clone = state.as_ref().clone();
                let mut targets = [Incoming::default(), Incoming::default()];
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut targets[1 - destination], clone, &mut b);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                let state = boxed_flow::state_for_edge(
                    &f,
                    state,
                    &EdgeCondition::Always,
                    &BTreeMap::new(),
                    &mut b,
                )
                .unwrap();
                receiver.insert_held(&f, &mut targets[destination], state, &mut b);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                assert_eq!(pointer(&targets[destination]), original);
                assert_ne!(pointer(&targets[1 - destination]), original);
                receiver.insert_owned(&f, &mut targets[destination], empty(), &mut b);
                assert!(!receiver.failed);
                assert_eq!(pointer(&targets[destination]), original);
                drop(targets);
                drop(receiver);
                drop(b);
            })
        });
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
        assert!(!a.invalid && a.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
        assert!(a.allocated <= paid);
    }
}

#[test]
fn same_box_edge_preserves_all_original_conditions_and_six_field_diagnostics() {
    let f = function();
    let status = StatusSourceId {
        expression: f.body.id.clone(),
        lane: StatusLane::OperationFailure,
    };
    let mut sources = BTreeMap::new();
    sources.insert(f.body.id.clone(), status.clone());
    for condition in [
        EdgeCondition::Always,
        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(f.body.id.clone(), false),
        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(f.body.id.clone(), true),
        EdgeCondition::StatusZero(status.clone()),
        EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(status.clone()),
    ] {
        for case in 0..4 {
            let mut value = empty();
            match case {
                1 => value.pending_failure = Some(status.clone()),
                2 => value.selected_failure = Some(status.clone()),
                3 => value.published = true,
                _ => {}
            }
            let expected = before_frontier::edge_before(&f, value.clone(), &condition, &sources);
            let mut b = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
            let boxed = Box::new(value);
            let original = std::ptr::from_ref(boxed.as_ref());
            let actual = boxed_flow::state_for_edge(&f, boxed, &condition, &sources, &mut b);
            if let Ok(value) = &actual {
                assert_eq!(std::ptr::from_ref(value.as_ref()), original);
            }
            assert_eq!(actual.map(|v| *v), expected);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn many_keeps_full_sorted_prefix_validation_and_join_in_both_promotion_orders() {
    let program = crate::hir::resolve(
        &crate::check(
            "module ordinary.many; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {0}",
            "many.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let f = &program.functions[0];
    for reverse in [false, true] {
        let mut b = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
        let mut receiver = Insertions::acquire(f, &mut b).unwrap();
        let mut incoming = Incoming::default();
        let mut original = BTreeSet::new();
        for history in if reverse {
            [[1, 3], [1, 2]]
        } else {
            [[1, 2], [1, 3]]
        } {
            let mut state = empty();
            state.live_order = history.into_iter().map(LivenessFlagId).collect();
            original.insert(Box::new(state.clone()));
            receiver.insert_owned(f, &mut incoming, state, &mut b);
            assert!(!receiver.failed);
        }
        assert_eq!(incoming.len(), 2);
        let states = incoming.into_many();
        assert_eq!(states, original);
        let mut old = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
        let mut current = ReplayBudget::unobserved();
        let expected = before_frontier::validate_group_before(f, &original, BlockId(7), &mut old);
        assert_eq!(
            validate_control_group_with_budget(f, &states, BlockId(7), &mut current),
            expected
        );
        assert_eq!(current.remaining, old.remaining);
        assert_eq!(
            joined_ownership_state(&program, f, &states, &mut current),
            before_frontier::join_before(&program, f, &original, &mut old)
        );
        assert_eq!(current.remaining, old.remaining);
        assert_eq!(current.skeleton_remaining, old.skeleton_remaining);
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "unstable-workflow-profiling")]
#[test]
fn actual_ordinary_driver_reports_bound_body_frontier_and_complete_terminal_arity() {
    use crate::bounded_output::exclusive_debits::{attempt, path_census::Event};
    use crate::workflow_profile::plan_comparison::{Binding, Capture};
    let program=crate::hir::resolve(&crate::check(
        "module census; @id(\"f\") fn f(flag:bool)->i64 {if flag {1}else{2}} @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {f(false)}",
        "census.spx").unwrap()).unwrap();
    let function = program.functions.iter().find(|f| f.name == "main").unwrap();
    let c = Capture::begin(Binding::caller_labelled(
        "actual ordinary path census",
        [0; 32],
    ))
    .unwrap();
    let ((outcome, remaining), refused, paid, _) =
        crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage_refusal(64 << 20, || {
            let mut a = attempt(0, 0, 0);
            let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
            let outcome = (|| {
                let storage = validate_slots_paid(function, &mut budget)?;
                let leaves = collect_leaves_paid(function, &mut budget)?;
                validate_path_states::<Diagnostic>(
                    &program,
                    function,
                    &storage,
                    &leaves,
                    &mut budget,
                    None,
                    None,
                )
            })();
            let remaining = budget.remaining;
            a.complete(outcome.is_ok());
            (outcome, remaining)
        });
    assert!(outcome.is_ok() && !refused && remaining < MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS && paid > 0);
    let r = c.finish().unwrap().resolved_core;
    assert!(r.complete && !r.invalid);
    let row = r.attempts[0].path_census[1];
    assert_eq!(
        (row.entries, row.successes, row.events[Event::Body as usize]),
        (1, 1, 1)
    );
    assert!(row.events[Event::InputOne as usize] > 0 && row.events[Event::OwnedBox as usize] > 0);
    assert!(row.terminal_paths > 0 && row.successful_paths > 0 && row.admitted_requests > 0);
}
//! Whole-source inverse and immutable shared dependency binding for the oracle.
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    format!("{:x}", crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(bytes)))
}
#[test]
fn complete_immediate_old_driver_and_each_helper_restore_their_whole_preimages() {
    let root = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
    assert_eq!(
        digest(include_bytes!("../before_frontier/custody/inverse.json")),
        "86a572cc73c1b4981a710e5d7fba725ef9723f62586a30c38fb2bc4b9f0fe510"
    );
    let rows: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../before_frontier/custody/inverse.json")).unwrap();
    for row in rows.as_array().unwrap() {
        let mut actual =
            std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(row["compiled"].as_str().unwrap())).unwrap();
        let original = std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(row["before"].as_str().unwrap())).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(digest(original.as_bytes()), row["sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
        for change in row["inverse"].as_array().unwrap().iter().rev() {
            let at = change[0].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;
            let current = change[1].as_str().unwrap();
            let before = change[2].as_str().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(actual.get(at..at + current.len()), Some(current));
            actual.replace_range(at..at + current.len(), before);
        }
        assert_eq!(actual, original, "whole inverse for {}", row["compiled"]);
    }
    assert_eq!(
        include_str!("../before_frontier/whole.rs.txt"),
        include_str!("../before_frontier/custody/mod.rs.txt")
    );
}
