// The old scratch control still inspects the actual complete source, through
// this exact additive inverse, before applying every unchanged old assertion.
pub(crate) fn before_source(current: &str) -> String {
    let mut source = current.to_owned();
    let stage = "    if !caller.interfaces.is_empty() {\n        // Pay the new receiving boundary before forming its borrowed arguments.\n        reserve_builder_structure(interface_census::CALL)?;\n        interface_census::scan(&mut *census, caller)?;\n    }\n";
    assert_eq!(source.matches(stage).count(), 2);
    source = source.replace(stage, "");
    let owned = stage.replace("&mut *census", "&mut census");
    assert_eq!(source.matches(&owned).count(), 1);
    source = source.replacen(&owned, "", 1);
    assert_eq!(source.matches("if !caller.protocols.is_empty()").count(), 3);
    source = source.replace(
        "if !caller.protocols.is_empty()",
        "if !caller.interfaces.is_empty()\n        || !caller.protocols.is_empty()",
    );
    let suffix = "\n#[path = \"names/interface_census.rs\"]\nmod interface_census;\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[path = \"names/interface_tests.rs\"]\nmod interface_tests;\n#[cfg(test)]\npub(super) use interface_tests::before_source as before_interface_source;\n";
    source = source.strip_suffix(suffix).unwrap().to_owned();
    assert_eq!(source, include_str!("interface_before.rs"));
    source
}
//! Invocation-local immutable classification DATA, never content authority.
use super::{
    lexical_skeleton, size_of, ClassifierLedger, Diagnostic, ExprSkeletonPath, ObservationDag,
    ObservationDagKind, Observations, Rc, SkeletonWork, PAYMENT,
};

struct Entry {
    root: Rc<ObservationDag>,
    visits: usize,
}

// The exclusive real work loan binds both function and budget without a raw
// address capability. An entry owns its immutable Rc, preventing ABA/mutation.
struct Validation<'scope, 'function, 'budget> {
    work: &'scope mut SkeletonWork<'function, 'budget>,
    ledger: ClassifierLedger,
    last: Option<Entry>,
}
type Scope = Validation<'static, 'static, 'static>;
type Pending = Vec<&'static ObservationDag>;
type Paths = std::iter::Chain<
    std::slice::Iter<'static, ExprSkeletonPath>,
    std::slice::Iter<'static, ExprSkeletonPath>,
>;

// Actual/formal loans, live/moved/returned owners, setup iterators and complete
// error/Drop receivers. Dynamic Vec backing is separately acquired below.
pub(super) const CALL: usize = 8 * size_of::<&[ExprSkeletonPath]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut SkeletonWork<'static, 'static>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Scope>()
    + 2 * size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()
    + 3 * size_of::<Option<Entry>>()
    + 12 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, ExprSkeletonPath>>() // two iterator results, chain/IntoIterator owners
    + 2 * size_of::<Paths>()
    + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
    + AUTH
    + PAYMENT;
// CALL prepays the first guard. Every successful reserve renews the next
// guard's borrowed receivers and minimal foreign-error return before use.
const AUTH: usize = ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls()
    + 2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>()
    + 2 * size_of::<String>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&str>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>();
const INPUT_STEP: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut Paths>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&ExprSkeletonPath>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ExprSkeletonPath>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * PAYMENT;
const CHECK: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut Scope>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Observations>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Option<Entry>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Entry>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>() // ptr_eq actual/formal pair
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * PAYMENT;
const REPLAY: usize = 2 * size_of::<usize>() + 2 * size_of::<bool>() + 2 * PAYMENT;
const COLD: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut Scope>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 3 * size_of::<Pending>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&mut Pending>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ObservationDag>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(bool, usize), Diagnostic>>()
    + 2 * PAYMENT; // macro reservation and initial pending backing reservation
const POP: usize = 6 * size_of::<&mut Pending>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&ObservationDag>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ObservationDagKind>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Option<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Vec<Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[Rc<ObservationDag>]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 3 * PAYMENT;
const CHILD: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut std::slice::Iter<'static, Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&Rc<ObservationDag>>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ObservationDag>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&mut Pending>()
    + PAYMENT;
const PUBLISH: usize = 2 * size_of::<Entry>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<Entry>>() // incoming Some and publication receiver
    + 2 * size_of::<Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Rc<ObservationDag>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + PAYMENT;

// Lexical expansion avoids an unpaid payment-helper argument/Result boundary.
// Foreign lenders are rejected before any reserve/diagnostic renderer on them.
macro_rules! pay {
    ($scope:ident, $bytes:expr, $phase:literal) => {{
        if !$scope.ledger.current() {
            return Err(Diagnostic::io("SPX-H006", String::new()));
        }
        $scope
            .work
            .budget
            .reserve_bytes($scope.work.function, $bytes + AUTH, $phase)?;
    }};
}

pub(super) fn inputs(
    prefixes: &[ExprSkeletonPath],
    suffixes: &[ExprSkeletonPath],
    work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
    ledger.capture_current_into();
    let mut scope = Validation {
        work,
        ledger,
        last: None,
    };
    let mut paths = prefixes.iter().chain(suffixes.iter());
    loop {
        pay!(scope, INPUT_STEP, "complete HIR memo input receivers");
        let Some(path) = paths.next() else { break };
        scope
            .work
            .budget
            .charge(scope.work.function, 1, "complete HIR fork input selection")?;
        if !matches!(path.continuation, lexical_skeleton::Continuation::Normal) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        pay!(scope, CHECK, "complete HIR memo validation receivers");
        if !scope.check(&path.observations)? {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
    // Scope/Rc owners drop before the caller consumes any prefix owner.
    Ok(true)
}

impl Validation<'_, '_, '_> {
    fn check(&mut self, observations: &Observations) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
        let Some(root) = &observations.prefix else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        if let Some(entry) = &self.last {
            // One fixed slot deliberately forgoes nonadjacent reuse. This
            // bounds all-disjoint lookup work linearly, without an admission
            // threshold or alternative semantic route.
            self.work
                .budget
                .charge(self.work.function, 1, "complete HIR memo root lookup")?;
            if Rc::ptr_eq(&entry.root, root) {
                #[cfg(test)]
                note(false);
                let mut left = entry.visits;
                loop {
                    pay!(self, REPLAY, "complete HIR memo replay receivers");
                    if left == 0 {
                        break;
                    }
                    self.work.budget.charge(
                        self.work.function,
                        1,
                        "complete HIR sequence validation",
                    )?;
                    left -= 1;
                }
                return Ok(true);
            }
        }
        pay!(self, COLD, "complete HIR memo cold receivers");
        #[cfg(test)]
        note(true);
        let (valid, visits) = self.classify(root)?;
        if !valid {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        pay!(self, PUBLISH, "complete HIR memo publication receivers");
        // The old root remains owned through full cold classification and
        // successful publication payment. Replacing it drops exactly one Rc;
        // caller inputs still own every source until this scope is destroyed.
        self.last = Some(Entry {
            root: root.clone(),
            visits,
        });
        Ok(true)
    }

    fn classify(&mut self, root: &Rc<ObservationDag>) -> Result<(bool, usize), Diagnostic> {
        self.work.queries.selector(self.work.function, &mut *self.work.budget,
            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::query_proof::SELECTOR,
            "shared sequence cold partition receivers")?;
        if matches!(self.work.budget.payer,
            crate::cleanup_plan::replay::allocation::AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder
                | crate::cleanup_plan::replay::allocation::AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved)
            && self.work.budget.admission == crate::cleanup_plan::replay::AdmissionMode::Ordinary
            && !self.work.budget.lent_skeleton && !self.work.budget.merge_paths
            && self.work.function.cleanup_plan.lexical_control.is_none()
        {
            self.work.queries.preflight(self.work.function, &mut *self.work.budget,
                crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::query_proof::CLASSIFY_CALL,
                "shared sequence classifier call receivers")?;
            return crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::query_proof::classify_paid(root, self.work);
        }
        let mut pending = Vec::new();
        let mut visits = 0usize;
        self.work.budget.reserve_vec(
            self.work.function,
            &mut pending,
            1,
            "complete HIR sequence validation backing",
        )?;
        pending.push(root.as_ref());
        loop {
            pay!(self, POP, "complete HIR memo cold step receivers");
            let Some(node) = pending.pop() else { break };
            self.work
                .budget
                .charge(self.work.function, 1, "complete HIR sequence validation")?;
            visits = visits.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| {
                self.work.budget.budget_refusal(
                    self.work.function,
                    "complete HIR validation visit count overflowed",
                    "",
                )
            })?;
            match &node.kind {
                ObservationDagKind::Alt(_) => return Ok((false, visits)),
                ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {
                    if let Some(prefix) = prefix {
                        self.work.budget.reserve_vec(
                            self.work.function,
                            &mut pending,
                            1,
                            "complete HIR sequence ancestor backing",
                        )?;
                        pending.push(prefix.as_ref());
                    }
                }
                ObservationDagKind::Cat(children) => {
                    self.work.budget.reserve_vec(
                        self.work.function,
                        &mut pending,
                        children.len(),
                        "complete HIR sequence concatenation backing",
                    )?;
                    let mut children = children.iter();
                    loop {
                        pay!(self, CHILD, "complete HIR memo child receivers");
                        let Some(child) = children.next() else { break };
                        pending.push(child.as_ref());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok((true, visits))
    }
}

// Read-only test observations; never consulted by classification/admission.
#[cfg(test)]
thread_local! {
    static COUNTS: std::cell::Cell<(usize, usize)> = const { std::cell::Cell::new((0, 0)) };
}
#[cfg(test)]
fn note(cold: bool) {
    COUNTS.with(|counts| {
        let (classify, hits) = counts.get();
        counts.set((classify + usize::from(cold), hits + usize::from(!cold)));
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;
//! Independently executable old classifier, immutable identity and full Drop.
use super::super::{sequence, VALIDATE};
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{set_active_floor, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ReplayBudget;
use crate::hir::ResolvedProgram;
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

fn fixture() -> ResolvedProgram {
    super::super::super::tests::fixture()
}

fn scope<'s, 'f, 'b>(
    work: &'s mut SkeletonWork<'f, 'b>,
) -> Result<Validation<'s, 'f, 'b>, Diagnostic> {
    work.budget
        .reserve_bytes(work.function, CALL, "test actual validation scope")?;
    let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
    ledger.capture_current_into();
    Ok(Validation {
        work,
        ledger,
        last: None,
    })
}
fn check(
    scope: &mut Validation<'_, '_, '_>,
    observations: &Observations,
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    pay!(scope, CHECK, "test actual validation caller");
    scope.check(observations)
}
fn old(work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>, observations: &Observations) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    work.budget.reserve_bytes(
        work.function,
        VALIDATE,
        "complete HIR sequence validation caller",
    )?;
    super::super::sequence_only(observations, work)
}
fn tree(work: &mut SkeletonWork<'_, '_>, depth: usize) -> Result<Observations, Diagnostic> {
    let mut prefix = None;
    for _ in 0..depth {
        work.budget.reserve_bytes(
            work.function,
            sequence::SHARE_CONTROLS,
            "validation fixture sequence node receivers",
        )?;
        prefix = Some(sequence::node(
            work,
            ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, Vec::new()),
        )?);
    }
    Ok(Observations {
        prefix,
        items: Vec::new(),
    })
}
fn fields(
    d: Diagnostic,
) -> (
    &'static str,
    crate::diagnostic::Severity,
    String,
    Option<String>,
    Option<crate::ast::Span>,
    Option<String>,
) {
    (
        d.code,
        d.severity,
        d.message.to_string(),
        d.path,
        d.span,
        d.help,
    )
}

#[test]
fn exact_whole_7082_source_and_complete_old_classifier_remain_executable() {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let before = include_str!("emission.before.txt");
    assert_eq!(before.len(), 20646);
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(before.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "93d8038785b042f61b5d6bd100b24930d800d0ccc1ae6dfa7b9c6884bb814cc7"
    );
    let restored = crate::cleanup_plan::replay::skeleton_work::query_proof::before_emission(
        include_str!("../../emission.rs"));
    let combined = restored.as_str();
    // Exact additive flat-admission test visibility stage; the whole memo and
    // every original source/body assertion below retain their original target.
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(combined.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "879722873041c2bdd8f390c91e39c14418d6d09550d5ffacd6cef9a7e6102d17"
    );
    let visible = "pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn with_before<T>";
    assert_eq!(combined.matches(visible).count(), 1);
    let memo = combined.replacen(visible, "fn with_before<T>", 1);
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(memo.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "32620bdd298e9c6a5df9246ec302f75ae65df486076bbc72341884015d9144b8"
    );
    let actual = memo.as_str();
    let start = "pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn sequence_only(";
    let end = "\n#[allow(\n    unused_macros,";
    let body = |s: &str| {
        let a = s.find(start).unwrap();
        let b = a + s[a..].find(end).unwrap();
        s[a..b].to_owned()
    };
    assert_eq!(body(actual), body(before));
    // The entire old emitter is retained; only the explicit precheck receiver,
    // its moved iterator invoice, and one child registration may differ.
    let old_loop = &before[before
        .find("    for path in prefixes.iter().chain(suffixes.iter()) {")
        .unwrap()
        ..before.find("    let mut result = Vec::new();").unwrap()];
    let new_loop = &actual[actual
        .find("    work.budget.reserve_bytes(\n        work.function,\n        validation::CALL,")
        .unwrap()
        ..actual.find("    let mut result = Vec::new();").unwrap()];
    let bank_start = before
        .find("    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, ExprSkeletonPath>>()")
        .unwrap();
    let bank_end = before[bank_start..]
        .find("    + 2 * size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()")
        .unwrap()
        + bank_start;
    let expected =
        before
            .replacen(old_loop, new_loop, 1)
            .replacen(&before[bank_start..bank_end], "", 1)
            + "\nmod validation;\n";
    assert_eq!(actual, expected);
}

#[test]
fn repeated_shared_and_equal_disjoint_roots_keep_real_logical_visit_multiplicity() {
    let program = fixture();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
        let mut work = SkeletonWork::new(&program, function, &mut budget);
        let a = tree(&mut work, 32).unwrap();
        let mut b = tree(&mut work, 32).unwrap();
        work.budget
            .reserve_bytes(
                function,
                sequence::SHARE_CONTROLS,
                "validation fixture shared Cat receivers",
            )
            .unwrap();
        work.budget
            .reserve_array::<Rc<ObservationDag>>(
                function,
                2,
                "validation fixture shared Cat backing",
            )
            .unwrap();
        let shared = Observations {
            prefix: Some(
                sequence::node(
                    &mut work,
                    ObservationDagKind::Cat(vec![
                        a.prefix.as_ref().unwrap().clone(),
                        a.prefix.as_ref().unwrap().clone(),
                    ]),
                )
                .unwrap(),
            ),
            items: Vec::new(),
        };
        let before = work.budget.remaining;
        assert!(old(&mut work, &shared).unwrap());
        let visits = before - work.budget.remaining;
        assert_eq!(visits, 65); // duplicate shared edges are distinct visits
        COUNTS.with(|counts| counts.set((0, 0)));
        let mut scope = scope(&mut work).unwrap();
        assert!(check(&mut scope, &shared).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(scope.last.as_ref().unwrap().visits, visits);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let before = scope.work.budget.remaining;
            assert!(check(&mut scope, &shared).unwrap());
            assert_eq!(before - scope.work.budget.remaining, visits + 1);
            assert!(scope.last.is_some());
        }
        assert!(check(&mut scope, &a).unwrap());
        assert!(check(&mut scope, &b).unwrap());
        assert!(!Rc::ptr_eq(
            a.prefix.as_ref().unwrap(),
            b.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()
        ));
        assert!(Rc::ptr_eq(
            &scope.last.as_ref().unwrap().root,
            b.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()
        ));
        assert!(check(&mut scope, &Observations::default()).unwrap());
        assert!(Rc::ptr_eq(
            &scope.last.as_ref().unwrap().root,
            b.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()
        ));
        // A fixed slot deliberately misses nonadjacent equal-content roots.
        for next in [&a, &b, &a, &b] {
            let before = scope.work.budget.remaining;
            assert!(check(&mut scope, next).unwrap());
            assert_eq!(before - scope.work.budget.remaining, 33);
        }
        assert_eq!(COUNTS.with(std::cell::Cell::get), (7, 8));
        assert!(Rc::get_mut(b.prefix.as_mut().unwrap()).is_none());
        drop(scope);
        assert!(Rc::get_mut(b.prefix.as_mut().unwrap()).is_some());
    });
}

#[test]
fn late_alt_and_every_original_node_work_cut_cannot_publish_a_success_entry() {
    let program = fixture();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let alt = Rc::new(ObservationDag::legacy(ObservationDagKind::Alt(Vec::new())));
        let root = Rc::new(ObservationDag::legacy(ObservationDagKind::Seq(
            Some(alt),
            Vec::new(),
        )));
        let observations = Observations {
            prefix: Some(root),
            items: Vec::new(),
        };
        let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
        let mut work = SkeletonWork::new(&program, function, &mut budget);
        assert!(!old(&mut work, &observations).unwrap());
        let mut scope = scope(&mut work).unwrap();
        assert!(!check(&mut scope, &observations).unwrap());
        assert!(scope.last.is_none());
    });
    for cut in 0..=9 {
        let attempt = |prior| {
            with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                let mut work = SkeletonWork::new(&program, function, &mut budget);
                let observations = tree(&mut work, 9).unwrap();
                work.budget.remaining = cut;
                if prior {
                    old(&mut work, &observations)
                } else {
                    let mut scope = scope(&mut work).unwrap();
                    let result = check(&mut scope, &observations);
                    assert_eq!(scope.last.is_some(), result.is_ok());
                    result
                }
                .map_err(fields)
            })
            .0
        };
        let prior = attempt(true);
        let current = attempt(false);
        assert_eq!(prior.is_ok(), cut == 9);
        assert_eq!(prior, current);
        // The hit has one new real lookup work event. Give that event its
        // distinct unit, then compare EVERY original node frontier without
        // claiming numerical parity for the enlarged total free-work stream.
        let hit = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
            let mut work = SkeletonWork::new(&program, function, &mut budget);
            let observations = tree(&mut work, 9).unwrap();
            let mut scope = scope(&mut work).unwrap();
            assert!(check(&mut scope, &observations).unwrap());
            scope.work.budget.remaining = cut + 1;
            let result = check(&mut scope, &observations).map_err(fields);
            assert!(scope.last.is_some());
            result
        })
        .0;
        assert_eq!(prior, hit);
    }
}

#[test]
fn foreign_scope_keeps_original_owner_sticky_without_charging_foreign_lender() {
    let program = fixture();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    let ((), owner_refused, _, owner_first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
        let mut work = SkeletonWork::new(&program, function, &mut budget);
        let observations = tree(&mut work, 3).unwrap();
        let mut scope = scope(&mut work).unwrap();
        assert!(check(&mut scope, &observations).unwrap());
        let before = scope.work.budget.remaining;
        let (result, refused, paid, first) =
            with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || check(&mut scope, &observations));
        assert_eq!(result.unwrap_err().code, "SPX-H006");
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
        assert_eq!(paid, 0);
        assert_eq!(scope.work.budget.remaining, before);
        assert!(scope.last.is_some());
        // current() poisons the held owner on a foreign ACTIVE scope. Merely
        // restoring that scope cannot revive credit or reuse its certificate.
        assert_eq!(
            check(&mut scope, &observations).unwrap_err().code,
            "SPX-H006"
        );
        assert_eq!(scope.work.budget.remaining, before);
        assert!(Rc::ptr_eq(
            &scope.last.as_ref().unwrap().root,
            observations.prefix.as_ref().unwrap()
        ));
        assert!(!crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(0));
    });
    assert!(owner_refused && owner_first.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn cold_repeated_and_disjoint_actual_payers_cover_exact_short_floor_and_full_drop() {
    let program = fixture();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    for (depth, count, distinct) in [(0, 1, false), (1, 1, false), (32, 16, false), (32, 8, true)] {
        let run = |limit, floor| {
            with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
                measure(|| {
                    assert!(set_active_floor(floor));
                    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                    let result = (|| {
                        let mut work =
                            SkeletonWork::with_index(&program, function, &mut budget, None)?;
                        let observations = tree(&mut work, depth)?;
                        let mut scope = scope(&mut work)?;
                        for _ in 0..count {
                            if distinct {
                                let next = tree(scope.work, depth)?;
                                assert!(check(&mut scope, &next)?);
                            } else {
                                assert!(check(&mut scope, &observations)?);
                            }
                        }
                        Ok::<(), Diagnostic>(())
                    })();
                    if result.is_err() {
                        assert!(budget
                            .reserve_bytes(function, 0, "validation sticky zero")
                            .is_err());
                    }
                    drop(budget);
                    result.map_err(|d| {
                        let code = d.code;
                        drop(d);
                        code
                    })
                })
            })
        };
        let ((result, heap), refused, paid, _) = run(usize::MAX, 0);
        result.unwrap();
        assert!(!refused && !heap.invalid && heap.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(heap.allocated, heap.freed);
        assert!(heap.allocated <= paid);
        for (limit, floor, success) in [
            (paid, 0, true),
            (paid - 1, 0, false),
            (0, 0, false),
            (paid, paid, false),
        ] {
            let ((result, heap), refused, _, first) = run(limit, floor);
            assert_eq!(result.is_ok(), success);
            assert!(!heap.invalid && heap.live == 0);
            assert_eq!(heap.allocated, heap.freed);
            if !success {
                assert!(refused && first.is_some());
                assert_eq!(result.unwrap_err(), "SPX-H006");
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn whole_classifier_measurements_keep_cold_and_repeated_costs_separate() {
    let program = fixture();
    let function = &program.functions[0];
    for (depth, count, alternating) in [
        (0, 1, false),
        (1, 1, false),
        (32, 1, false),
        (32, 64, false),
        (32, 16, true),
    ] {
        let mut old_paid = 0usize;
        for prior in [true, false] {
            let ((result, heap), refused, paid, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                measure(|| {
                    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(usize::MAX);
                    let result = (|| {
                        let mut work =
                            SkeletonWork::with_index(&program, function, &mut budget, None)?;
                        let observations = tree(&mut work, depth)?;
                        let other = if alternating {
                            Some(tree(&mut work, depth)?)
                        } else {
                            None
                        };
                        COUNTS.with(|counts| counts.set((0, 0)));
                        if prior {
                            for index in 0..count {
                                let next = if index % 2 == 1 {
                                    other.as_ref().unwrap_or(&observations)
                                } else {
                                    &observations
                                };
                                assert!(old(&mut work, next)?);
                            }
                        } else {
                            let mut scope = scope(&mut work)?;
                            for index in 0..count {
                                let next = if index % 2 == 1 {
                                    other.as_ref().unwrap_or(&observations)
                                } else {
                                    &observations
                                };
                                assert!(check(&mut scope, next)?);
                            }
                        }
                        Ok::<(), Diagnostic>(())
                    })();
                    drop(budget);
                    result
                })
            });
            result.unwrap();
            assert!(!refused && !heap.invalid && heap.live == 0);
            assert_eq!(heap.allocated, heap.freed);
            assert!(heap.allocated <= paid);
            let (cold, hits) = COUNTS.with(std::cell::Cell::get);
            if prior || depth == 0 {
                assert_eq!((cold, hits), (0, 0));
            } else if alternating {
                assert_eq!((cold, hits), (count, 0));
            } else {
                assert_eq!((cold, hits), (1, count - 1));
            }
            if prior {
                old_paid = paid;
            }
            eprintln!("sequence-validation depth={depth} count={count} alternating={alternating} old={prior} cold={cold} hits={hits} paid={paid} old_minus_current={} allocated={} highwater={}", old_paid as i128 - paid as i128, heap.allocated, heap.highwater);
        }
    }
}
//! Fresh shape selection for independent PLAN histories over already-flat HIR.
//!
//! A branch is a real copy site in the old flat PLAN walk; a Goto is not. This
//! scan never certifies equality, shares HIR evidence, or enables the old pending
//! selector. Every accepted function still constructs PLAN independently and
//! passes the original complete content, terminal and multiplicity comparator.
use super::{
    AdmissionMode, AllocationPayer, Diagnostic, ReplayBudget, ResolvedFunction, SkeletonPath,
    PAYMENT,
};
use crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::ClassifierLedger;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_receiving::{
    charge_into, prepare_into, refuse_into, reserve_into, Failure,
};
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::replay_error;
#[cfg(test)]
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::{ReplayWorkRefusal, REPLAY_WORK_REFUSAL};
use crate::cleanup_plan::{
    CleanupBlock, CleanupTerminator, CleanupTransition, ExitContinuation, ExitTarget, ExitTargetId,
};
use std::mem::size_of;

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) const CALL: usize =
    2 * size_of::<(&ResolvedFunction, &mut ReplayBudget, &mut [SkeletonPath])>()
        + 2 * size_of::<Result<bool, Diagnostic>>()
        + 2 * size_of::<&mut Vec<SkeletonPath>>()
        + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
        + PAYMENT;
const AUTH_ERROR: usize =
    2 * size_of::<Diagnostic>() + 2 * size_of::<String>() + 2 * size_of::<&str>();
// This producer writes the one invocation-owned error; successful checks form
// neither a Diagnostic nor a Result. Keep current() itself and every renewed
// ACTIVE clone/TLS receipt exactly as before (including sticky mismatch).
fn current_into(ledger: &ClassifierLedger, authenticated: &mut bool, failure: &mut Failure<'_>) {
    if failure.error.is_some() {
        *authenticated = false;
        return;
    }
    *authenticated = ledger.current();
    if !*authenticated {
        failure.error = Some(Diagnostic::io("SPX-H006", String::new()));
    }
}
const AUTH: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&ClassifierLedger, &mut bool, &mut Failure<'_>)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Option<Diagnostic>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<bool>();
// Macro expansion physically removes the returning method's Diagnostic sum.
// Retain the complete old argument transport conservatively. Add the lexical
// byte/phase bindings, both exact-source/payer ptr::eq actual/formal inputs,
// Option::is_some loans and Boolean branches for prepare/reserve/work/terminal.
// No old budget-internal bank or ACTIVE/TLS inventory is a credit here.
const INTO_PAYMENT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(&mut ReplayBudget, &ResolvedFunction, usize, &str)>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&str>()
    + 4 * size_of::<*const ResolvedFunction>()
    + 4 * size_of::<*const ReplayBudget>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&Option<Diagnostic>>()
    + 24 * size_of::<bool>();
// One initialized output owner, reset at the same paid advance/check sites.
struct Scan<'a> {
    block: Option<&'a CleanupBlock>,
    transition: Option<&'a CleanupTransition>,
    authenticated: bool,
}
const OWNER: usize =
    Failure::acquisition_bytes() + AUTH_ERROR + size_of::<Scan<'_>>() + size_of::<bool>();
const SETUP: usize = 2 * size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Vec<CleanupBlock>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[CleanupBlock]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, CleanupBlock>>()
    + 12 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * PAYMENT;
// The current-ledger calls below are separately prepaid at each reached step.
// Each iterator next, its terminal None, work call and following reservation
// has a distinct renewed bank. No setup frame funds an unbounded loop.
const BLOCK: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut std::slice::Iter<'static, CleanupBlock>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&CleanupBlock>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&CleanupBlock>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ExitTargetId>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&CleanupTerminator>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&Vec<crate::cleanup_plan::EdgeId>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 6 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 4 * INTO_PAYMENT;
const TRANSITIONS: usize = 2 * size_of::<&Vec<CleanupTransition>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[CleanupTransition]>()
    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, CleanupTransition>>()
    + INTO_PAYMENT;
const TRANSITION: usize = 2 * size_of::<&mut std::slice::Iter<'static, CleanupTransition>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&CleanupTransition>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&CleanupTransition>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * INTO_PAYMENT;
const EXIT: usize = 2 * size_of::<&Vec<ExitTarget>>()
    + 4 * size_of::<&[ExitTarget]>()
    + 4 * size_of::<usize>() // ID cast, get actual/formal index and receive
    + 2 * size_of::<Option<&ExitTarget>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ExitTarget>()
    + 2 * size_of::<&ExitContinuation>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>();

pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn try_compare(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    expected: &mut [SkeletonPath],
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    budget.reserve_bytes(
        function,
        SETUP
            + OWNER
            + AUTH
            + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
            + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls(),
        "flat HIR independent PLAN selection setup",
    )?;
    let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
    ledger.capture_current_into();
    let mut failure = Failure {
        error: None,
        function,
        budget: &*budget,
    };
    let mut scan = Scan {
        block: None,
        transition: None,
        authenticated: false,
    };
    // These lexical producers preserve the same debit sites and labels. A
    // terminal branch consumes the single paid first-error owner exactly once.
    macro_rules! paid {
        ($bytes:expr, $phase:expr) => {
            if !reserve_into!(budget, function, failure, $bytes, $phase) {
                return Err(failure
                    .error
                    .take()
                    .expect("flat selection first reservation error"));
            }
        };
    }
    macro_rules! work {
        ($phase:expr) => {
            if !charge_into!(budget, function, failure, 1, $phase) {
                return Err(failure
                    .error
                    .take()
                    .expect("flat selection first work error"));
            }
        };
    }
    macro_rules! authenticate {
        () => {
            current_into(&ledger, &mut scan.authenticated, &mut failure);
            if !scan.authenticated {
                return Err(failure
                    .error
                    .take()
                    .expect("flat selection first authentication error"));
            }
        };
    }
    authenticate!();
    // CALL pays these received places and selection results. Unsupported payers
    // are normally excluded by finish_current before it reserves CALL at all.
    match budget {
        ReplayBudget {
            admission: AdmissionMode::Ordinary,
            payer: AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved | AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder,
            lent_skeleton: false,
            merge_paths: false,
            ..
        } => {}
        _ => return Ok(false),
    }
    match function.cleanup_plan.lexical_control {
        None => {}
        Some(_) => return Ok(false),
    }
    let mut branch = false;
    let mut blocks = function.cleanup_plan.blocks.iter();
    loop {
        paid!(
            BLOCK + AUTH + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls(),
            "flat HIR PLAN block selection receivers"
        );
        authenticate!();
        scan.block = blocks.next();
        let Some(block) = scan.block else {
            break;
        };
        work!("flat HIR PLAN block selection");
        paid!(TRANSITIONS, "flat HIR PLAN transition iterator");
        let mut transitions = block.transitions.iter();
        loop {
            paid!(
                TRANSITION + AUTH + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls(),
                "flat HIR PLAN transition selection receivers"
            );
            authenticate!();
            scan.transition = transitions.next();
            let Some(transition) = scan.transition else {
                break;
            };
            work!("flat HIR PLAN transition selection");
            match transition {
                CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { .. } | CleanupTransition::Renew { .. } => {
                    return Ok(false)
                }
                CleanupTransition::Initialize { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::Transfer { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::TransferVariant { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::CallCommit { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. }
                | CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { .. } => {}
            }
        }
        match &block.terminator {
            CleanupTerminator::Goto(_) => {}
            CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {
                if edges.len() > 1 {
                    branch = true;
                }
            }
            CleanupTerminator::Exit(index) => {
                paid!(EXIT, "flat HIR PLAN exit selection receivers");
                let Some(exit) = function.cleanup_plan.exits.get(index.0 as usize) else {
                    return Ok(false);
                };
                match &exit.continuation {
                    ExitContinuation::Continue(_)
                    | ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. }
                    | ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. }
                    | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {}
                    ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { .. }
                    | ExitContinuation::LoopLatch { .. }
                    | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { .. } => return Ok(false),
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if !branch {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    // Preserve PLAN-before-HIR-sort failure ordering. Neither producer derives
    // observations from the other, and no pointer/ordinal authorizes equality.
    paid!(
        super::view::PRODUCE_CALL + AUTH + PAYMENT + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls(),
        "flat HIR independent PLAN caller"
    );
    authenticate!();
    let produced = super::view::produce(function, budget)?;
    paid!(
        super::enumerated_prefix::ENTRY_CALL + PAYMENT,
        "flat HIR complete content sort caller"
    );
    super::enumerated_prefix::sort(expected, function, budget)?;
    paid!(
        super::view::COMPARE_CALL,
        "flat HIR independent full comparison caller"
    );
    super::view::compare(produced, expected, budget)?;
    Ok(true)
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "flat_admission/tests.rs"]
mod tests;

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "flat_admission/immediate_before.rs"]
#[rustfmt::skip]
mod immediate_before;
//! Authored owning controls, not an executed application or saving claim.
use super::{current_into, try_compare, Failure, AUTH, CALL, OWNER};
use crate::bounded_output::classifier_string::ClassifierLedger;
use crate::bounded_output::{set_active_floor, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_plan_history::completed_fork::emission;
use crate::cleanup_plan::replay::{
    hir_skeleton_paths, ordinary_plan_history, reserve_program_skeleton_work, validate_program,
    AdmissionMode, AllocationPayer, Diagnostic, ReplayBudget, SkeletonPath, SkeletonTerminal,
};
use crate::cleanup_plan::{CleanupTerminator, ExitContinuation};
use crate::hir::{ResolvedFunction, ResolvedProgram};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

fn dense(n: usize) -> ResolvedProgram {
    let calls = std::iter::repeat_n("f()", n)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" + ");
    let source = format!("module ordinary; @id(\"ordinary.f\") fn f()->i64 {{1}} @id(\"ordinary.main\") fn main()->i64 {{{calls}}}");
    let checked = crate::check(&source, "ordinary.spx").unwrap();
    crate::hir::resolve(&checked).unwrap()
}
fn budget(program: &ResolvedProgram, function: &ResolvedFunction) -> ReplayBudget {
    let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
    reserve_program_skeleton_work(program, std::iter::once(function), &mut budget).unwrap();
    budget
}
fn flat(program: &ResolvedProgram, function: &ResolvedFunction) -> Vec<SkeletonPath> {
    let mut budget = budget(program, function);
    let paths =
        emission::with_before(|| hir_skeleton_paths(program, function, &mut budget)).unwrap();
    assert!(paths.iter().all(|path| path.observations.prefix.is_none()));
    paths
}
fn call(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    expected: &mut [SkeletonPath],
) -> Result<bool, Diagnostic> {
    budget.reserve_bytes(function, CALL, "flat admission test caller")?;
    try_compare(function, budget, expected)
}
fn dispatch(
    function: &ResolvedFunction,
    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,
    mut expected: Vec<SkeletonPath>,
    fell_back: &mut bool,
) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_plan_history::completed_fork::shipping::finish_current!(
        function, budget, expected
    );
    *fell_back = true;
    Ok(())
}
fn same_error(a: Diagnostic, b: Diagnostic) {
    assert_eq!(
        (a.code, a.severity, a.message, a.path, a.span, a.help),
        (b.code, b.severity, b.message, b.path, b.span, b.help)
    );
}

#[test]
fn dense_checked_add_branches_use_independent_plan_and_preserve_every_old_path() {
    for n in [2, 8, 64] {
        let program = dense(n);
        let function = program
            .functions
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
            .unwrap();
        // Owning source construction maps each of the n-1 checked additions
        // through split_status. Count actual resolved branches as well.
        assert!(
            function
                .cleanup_plan
                .blocks
                .iter()
                .filter(
                    |b| matches!(&b.terminator, CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) if edges.len()>1)
                )
                .count()
                >= n - 1
        );
        let mut expected = flat(&program, function);
        let mut old_budget = budget(&program, function);
        let mut old = ordinary_plan_history::before::produce(function, &mut old_budget).unwrap();
        old.sort();
        expected.sort();
        assert_eq!(expected, old);
        let mut actual_budget = budget(&program, function);
        assert!(call(function, &mut actual_budget, &mut expected).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(actual_budget.skeleton_spent, old_budget.skeleton_spent);
        assert_eq!(expected, old);
        let tiny = program
            .functions
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.f")
            .unwrap();
        let mut tiny_expected = flat(&program, tiny);
        let unchanged = tiny_expected.clone();
        let mut tiny_budget = budget(&program, tiny);
        assert!(!call(tiny, &mut tiny_budget, &mut tiny_expected).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(
            tiny_expected, unchanged,
            "no branch means complete old fallback"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn full_old_comparator_rejects_the_same_late_content_terminal_and_multiplicity() {
    let program = dense(4);
    let function = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, function);
    assert!(expected.len() > 1);
    for change in 0..3 {
        let mut changed = expected.clone();
        match change {
            0 => {
                changed.pop();
            }
            1 => changed.last_mut().unwrap().terminal = SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch,
            _ => {
                let path = changed
                    .iter_mut()
                    .rev()
                    .find(|path| !path.observations.items.is_empty())
                    .unwrap();
                assert!(path.observations.items.pop().is_some());
            }
        }
        changed.sort();
        // This frozen history comparator predates public unobserved backing:
        // its reserve_vec receiver requires the original ActiveBuilder owner.
        // Keep its complete bytes and every six-field diagnostic comparison.
        let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            let mut old_budget = budget(&program, function);
            assert_eq!(old_budget.payer, AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder);
            let produced = ordinary_plan_history::produce(function, &mut old_budget).unwrap();
            let old = ordinary_plan_history::before_comparison::compare(
                function,
                &mut old_budget,
                produced,
                &changed,
            )
            .unwrap_err();
            let mut actual_budget = budget(&program, function);
            assert_eq!(actual_budget.payer, AllocationPayer::ActiveBuilder);
            let mut actual_expected = changed.clone();
            let actual = call(function, &mut actual_budget, &mut actual_expected).unwrap_err();
            same_error(actual, old);
        });
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none());

        // The complete immediate-old flat admission caller already admits
        // LegacyUnobserved and supplies real public cursor backing. Compare
        // the actual public route for ALL of the same hostile mutations too.
        let mut old_budget = budget(&program, function);
        assert_eq!(old_budget.payer, AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved);
        old_budget
            .reserve_bytes(
                function,
                super::immediate_before::CALL,
                "flat admission test caller",
            )
            .unwrap();
        let mut old_expected = changed.clone();
        let old =
            super::immediate_before::try_compare(function, &mut old_budget, &mut old_expected)
                .unwrap_err();
        let mut actual_budget = budget(&program, function);
        assert_eq!(actual_budget.payer, AllocationPayer::LegacyUnobserved);
        let actual = call(function, &mut actual_budget, &mut changed).unwrap_err();
        same_error(actual, old);
    }
}

#[test]
fn every_original_plan_skeleton_event_cut_keeps_all_six_refusal_fields() {
    let program = dense(2);
    let function = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, function);
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut baseline = budget(&program, function);
        ordinary_plan_history::before::produce(function, &mut baseline).unwrap();
        let count = baseline.skeleton_spent;
        assert!(count > 0);
        for cut in 0..=count {
            let mut old_budget = budget(&program, function);
            old_budget.skeleton_remaining = cut;
            let old = ordinary_plan_history::before::produce(function, &mut old_budget).map(drop);
            let mut actual_budget = budget(&program, function);
            actual_budget.skeleton_remaining = cut;
            let mut changed = expected.clone();
            let actual =
                call(function, &mut actual_budget, &mut changed).map(|selected| assert!(selected));
            assert_eq!(old_budget.skeleton_spent, actual_budget.skeleton_spent);
            assert_eq!(old.is_ok(), cut == count);
            assert_eq!(actual.is_ok(), cut == count);
            if let (Err(a), Err(b)) = (old, actual) {
                same_error(a, b);
            }
        }
    });
}

#[test]
fn exact_short_zero_floor_and_complete_drop_charge_every_new_owner() {
    let program = dense(8);
    let function = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, function);
    let run = |limit, floor| {
        let mut changed = expected.clone(); // Fixture construction is outside observation.
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            set_active_floor(floor);
            measure(|| {
                let mut budget = ReplayBudget::new();
                let result =
                    reserve_program_skeleton_work(&program, std::iter::once(function), &mut budget)
                        .and_then(|_reserved| call(function, &mut budget, &mut changed));
                if result.is_err() {
                    assert!(budget
                        .reserve_bytes(function, 0, "flat admission sticky zero")
                        .is_err());
                }
                let success = matches!(result, Ok(true));
                drop(result); // Include the complete refusal-text owner in Drop observation.
                success
            })
        })
    };
    let ((result, allocation), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX, 0);
    assert!(result);
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none() && !allocation.invalid);
    assert!(paid >= allocation.allocated);
    assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
    assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    let ((result, allocation), refused, exact, first) = run(paid, 0);
    assert!(result && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert_eq!(exact, paid);
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    for (limit, floor) in [(0, 0), (paid - 1, 0), (paid, 1)] {
        let ((result, allocation), refused, _, first) = run(limit, floor);
        assert!(!result && refused && first.is_some());
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

#[test]
fn unsupported_payers_and_lexical_exits_keep_hir_unchanged_and_foreign_auth_is_sticky() {
    let program = dense(2);
    let function = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, function);
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        for excluded in 0..6 {
            let mut budget = budget(&program, function);
            let mut changed = expected.clone();
            let mut altered = function.clone();
            match excluded {
                0 => budget.admission = AdmissionMode::SelectedRetained,
                1 => budget.lent_skeleton = true,
                2 => budget.merge_paths = true,
                3 => {
                    altered.cleanup_plan.exits[0].continuation = ExitContinuation::LoopLatch {
                        target: crate::hir::ControlTarget::Function(
                            crate::hir::FunctionExecutionId::Monomorphic(function.id.clone()),
                        ),
                    }
                }
                4 => altered.cleanup_plan.blocks[0].transitions.push(
                    crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal {
                        at: altered.body.id.clone(),
                        binding: crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupPlace {
                            storage: crate::cleanup_plan::StorageId::ProvisionalResult,
                            projections: Vec::new(),
                        },
                    },
                ),
                _ => altered.cleanup_plan.blocks.clear(),
            }
            if excluded < 3 {
                let mut fell_back = false;
                dispatch(&altered, &mut budget, changed, &mut fell_back).unwrap();
                assert!(
                    fell_back,
                    "unsupported payer must not enter the new selector"
                );
            } else {
                assert!(!call(&altered, &mut budget, &mut changed).unwrap());
                assert_eq!(changed, expected);
            }
        }
    });
    let ((inner, restored), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut budget = budget(&program, function);
        budget
            .reserve_bytes(
                function,
                AUTH + OWNER
                    + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
                    + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls(),
                "held flat auth test",
            )
            .unwrap();
        let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
        ledger.capture_current_into();
        let mut failure = Failure {
            error: None,
            function,
            budget: &budget,
        };
        let mut authenticated = false;
        let inner = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            current_into(&ledger, &mut authenticated, &mut failure);
            if authenticated {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(failure.error.take().unwrap())
            }
        });
        assert!(inner.0.is_err() && !inner.1 && inner.2 == 0 && inner.3.is_none());
        let restored = budget.reserve_bytes(function, 0, "flat auth restored sticky owner");
        (inner, restored)
    });
    assert!(inner.0.is_err() && restored.is_err() && refused && first.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn complete_old_root_bypass_and_source_inverse_survive_actual_whole_callers() {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let before = include_str!("before_shipping.rs.txt");
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(before.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "e9d21c81c7596c9c5b81f6ec66b70e9b803bcc9d5ab48ca6d27e3ee21e7ca000"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(include_bytes!("before_emission.rs.txt")))
        ),
        "93d8038785b042f61b5d6bd100b24930d800d0ccc1ae6dfa7b9c6884bb814cc7"
    );
    let mut current = include_str!("../../shipping.rs").to_owned();
    let registration="\n#[path = \"shipping/flat_admission.rs\"]\npub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) mod flat_admission;\n";
    assert_eq!(current.matches(registration).count(), 1);
    current = current.replacen(registration, "", 1);
    let hook=concat!(
        "                $budget.reserve_bytes($function,\n",
        "                    $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_plan_history::completed_fork::shipping::flat_admission::CALL,\n",
        "                    \"flat HIR independent PLAN admission caller\")?;\n",
        "                if $crate::cleanup_plan::replay::ordinary_plan_history::completed_fork::shipping::flat_admission::try_compare(\n",
        "                    $function, $budget, &mut $expected)? { return Ok(()); }\n");
    assert_eq!(current.matches(hook).count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(current.replacen(hook, "", 1), before);
    let current = include_str!("../../emission.rs");
    let visible = "pub(in crate::cleanup_plan::replay) fn with_before<T>";
    assert_eq!(current.matches(visible).count(), 1);
    let memo = current.replacen(visible, "fn with_before<T>", 1);
    // Preserve the entire independently captured memo producer, then compose
    // its three finite original stages to the same complete a966 predecessor.
    assert_eq!(memo, include_str!("memo_emission.rs.txt"));
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(memo.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "32620bdd298e9c6a5df9246ec302f75ae65df486076bbc72341884015d9144b8"
    );
    let before_emission = include_str!("before_emission.rs.txt");
    let old_loop = &before_emission[before_emission
        .find("    for path in prefixes.iter().chain(suffixes.iter()) {")
        .unwrap()
        ..before_emission
            .find("    let mut result = Vec::new();")
            .unwrap()];
    let new_loop = &memo[memo
        .find("    work.budget.reserve_bytes(\n        work.function,\n        validation::CALL,")
        .unwrap()..memo.find("    let mut result = Vec::new();").unwrap()];
    let bank_start = before_emission
        .find("    + 2 * size_of::<std::slice::Iter<'static, ExprSkeletonPath>>()")
        .unwrap();
    let bank_end = bank_start
        + before_emission[bank_start..]
            .find("    + 2 * size_of::<ClassifierLedger>()")
            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(before_emission.matches(old_loop).count(), 1);
    let expected_memo = before_emission.replacen(old_loop, new_loop, 1).replacen(
        &before_emission[bank_start..bank_end],
        "",
        1,
    ) + "\nmod validation;\n";
    assert_eq!(memo, expected_memo);
    let program = dense(8);
    emission::with_before(|| validate_program(&program)).unwrap();
    validate_program(&program).unwrap();
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        emission::with_before(|| validate_program(&program)).unwrap();
        validate_program(&program).unwrap();
    });
}

#[test]
fn immediate_flat_driver_and_every_helper_binding_are_exact_source_controls() {
    let captured = include_str!("immediate_before.rs.txt");
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(captured.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "4392abffc59dee7596e750e1523f0e2b0f4c23a5f35c67caa475de5785c4f568"
    );
    let executable = include_str!("immediate_before.rs");
    let tail = "\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[path = \"flat_admission/tests.rs\"]\nmod tests;\n";
    assert!(captured.ends_with(tail));
    let rebound = captured
        .strip_suffix(tail)
        .unwrap()
        .replacen("use super::{", "use super::super::{", 1)
        .replace("super::view::", "super::super::view::")
        .replace(
            "super::enumerated_prefix::",
            "super::super::enumerated_prefix::",
        );
    assert_eq!(executable, rebound);
    // The old authentication producer and each old returning payment remain
    // independently compiled; no successor macro or output owner is shared.
    assert!(executable.contains("fn current(ledger: &ClassifierLedger) -> Result<(), Diagnostic>"));
    assert_eq!(executable.matches("current(&ledger)?;").count(), 4);
    assert_eq!(executable.matches("budget.charge(function, 1,").count(), 2);
    assert!(!executable.contains("reserve_into!"));
    assert!(!executable.contains("charge_into!"));
    // Match the successor producer's complete identifier. The immutable old
    // source already calls capture_current_into(), a distinct ledger API.
    assert_eq!(
        executable.matches("ledger.capture_current_into();").count(),
        1
    );
    assert!(!executable
        .split(|character: char| !(character.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || character == '_'))
        .any(|identifier| identifier == "current_into"));
}

#[test]
fn every_immediate_flat_work_cut_and_malformed_fallback_keep_exact_outputs() {
    let program = dense(4);
    let original = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, original);
    for malformed in 0..5 {
        let mut function = original.clone();
        match malformed {
            0 => {}
            1 => function.cleanup_plan.blocks.clear(),
            2 => function.cleanup_plan.exits.clear(),
            3 => function.cleanup_plan.blocks[0].transitions.push(
                crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal {
                    at: function.body.id.clone(),
                    binding: crate::cleanup_plan::CleanupPlace {
                        storage: crate::cleanup_plan::StorageId::ProvisionalResult,
                        projections: Vec::new(),
                    },
                },
            ),
            _ => {
                function.cleanup_plan.exits[0].continuation = ExitContinuation::LoopLatch {
                    target: crate::hir::ControlTarget::Function(
                        crate::hir::FunctionExecutionId::Monomorphic(function.id.clone()),
                    ),
                }
            }
        }
        let mut unlimited = budget(&program, &function);
        let initial_remaining = unlimited.remaining;
        let mut old_expected = expected.clone();
        super::immediate_before::try_compare(&function, &mut unlimited, &mut old_expected).unwrap();
        let normal_work = initial_remaining - unlimited.remaining;
        // Retain every original held-skeleton cut. Independently cut ordinary
        // scan work as well: it uses remaining rather than skeleton_remaining.
        let cuts = (0..=unlimited.skeleton_spent)
            .map(|cut| (cut, None))
            .chain((0..=normal_work).map(|cut| (unlimited.skeleton_spent, Some(cut))));
        for (skeleton_cut, normal_cut) in cuts {
            let mut old_budget = budget(&program, &function);
            let mut new_budget = budget(&program, &function);
            old_budget.skeleton_remaining = skeleton_cut;
            new_budget.skeleton_remaining = skeleton_cut;
            if let Some(cut) = normal_cut {
                old_budget.remaining = cut;
                new_budget.remaining = cut;
            }
            let mut old_expected = expected.clone();
            let mut new_expected = expected.clone();
            let old =
                super::immediate_before::try_compare(&function, &mut old_budget, &mut old_expected);
            let current = call(&function, &mut new_budget, &mut new_expected);
            assert_eq!(old_budget.remaining, new_budget.remaining);
            assert_eq!(old_budget.skeleton_spent, new_budget.skeleton_spent);
            assert_eq!(old_budget.skeleton_remaining, new_budget.skeleton_remaining);
            assert_eq!(old_expected, new_expected);
            match (old, current) {
                (Ok(a), Ok(b)) => assert_eq!(a, b),
                (Err(a), Err(b)) => same_error(a, b),
                _ => panic!("immediate flat driver changed work or fallback result"),
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn authored_paid_flat_receiver_reduction_includes_complete_cold_drop() {
    let program = dense(64);
    let function = program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == "ordinary.main")
        .unwrap();
    let expected = flat(&program, function);
    let run = |old: bool| {
        let mut paths = expected.clone();
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            measure(|| {
                let mut budget = budget(&program, function);
                let result = if old {
                    budget
                        .reserve_bytes(
                            function,
                            super::immediate_before::CALL,
                            "immediate flat test caller",
                        )
                        .unwrap();
                    super::immediate_before::try_compare(function, &mut budget, &mut paths)
                } else {
                    call(function, &mut budget, &mut paths)
                };
                assert!(matches!(result, Ok(true)));
                drop(result);
                // ReplayBudget, its complete refusal backing and all driver locals
                // drop within the allocation observer on both independently run arms.
            })
        })
    };
    let (((), old_alloc), old_refused, old_paid, old_first) = run(true);
    let (((), new_alloc), new_refused, new_paid, new_first) = run(false);
    assert!(!old_refused && !new_refused && old_first.is_none() && new_first.is_none());
    assert!(
        new_paid < old_paid,
        "new fixed owner must earn its complete renewed receiver invoice"
    );
    for allocation in [old_alloc, new_alloc] {
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}
//! V12 interns only named positional views, then restores the entire V11 value.
use super::super::{canonical, SOURCE_CAP};
use super::{expand_v11, SCHEMA_V11};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

pub(in super::super) const SCHEMA_V12: &str = "semaprax.finite-source-overlay-page.v12";
const PAGE_CAP: usize = 262144;
const KEYS: [&str; 7] = [
    "schema",
    "index",
    "total_pages",
    "predecessor",
    "replacements",
    "additions",
    "archive_prefixes",
];

fn envelope(page: &Value, schema: &str, dictionary: bool) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let object = page.as_object().ok_or("v12 envelope")?;
    if page["schema"] != schema
        || object.len() != KEYS.len() + usize::from(dictionary)
        || !KEYS.iter().all(|key| object.contains_key(*key))
        || (dictionary && !object.contains_key("view_labels"))
    {
        return Err("v12 envelope");
    }
    Ok(())
}

type Convert<'a> = dyn FnMut(&mut Value) -> Result<(), &'static str> + 'a;
fn views(value: &mut Value, convert: &mut Convert<'_>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    for view in value.as_array_mut().ok_or("v12 views")? {
        // Full object pins, including every unknown field, stay opaque.
        if view.is_object() {
            continue;
        }
        let tuple = view.as_array_mut().ok_or("v12 named pin arity")?;
        if tuple.len() != 3 && tuple.len() != 4 {
            return Err("v12 named pin arity");
        }
        convert(&mut tuple[0])?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn row(value: &mut Value, convert: &mut Convert<'_>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let object = value.as_object_mut().ok_or("v12 literal row")?;
    if let Some(value) = object.get_mut("views") {
        views(value, convert)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn fragments(value: &mut Value, convert: &mut Convert<'_>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if value.is_null() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    for fragment in value.as_array_mut().ok_or("v12 fragments")? {
        if !fragment.is_object() {
            return Err("v12 fragment row");
        }
        if fragment.get(super::REFERENCE).is_none() {
            row(fragment, convert)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn view_slots(page: &mut Value, convert: &mut Convert<'_>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    for group in ["replacements", "additions"] {
        for value in page[group].as_array_mut().ok_or("v12 rows")? {
            let object = value.as_object_mut().ok_or("v12 row")?;
            if object.contains_key("old519_index") {
                if group != "replacements" || object.len() != 1 {
                    return Err("v12 indexed row");
                }
                let tuple = object
                    .get_mut("old519_index")
                    .unwrap()
                    .as_array_mut()
                    .ok_or("v12 old519 arity")?;
                if tuple.len() != 4 {
                    return Err("v12 old519 arity");
                }
                views(&mut tuple[2], convert)?;
                fragments(&mut tuple[3], convert)?;
            } else {
                row(value, convert)?;
                if let Some(value) = value.get_mut("fragments") {
                    fragments(value, convert)?;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn index(value: &Value, count: usize) -> Result<usize, &'static str> {
    let index = usize::try_from(value.as_u64().ok_or("v12 unknown label index")?)
        .map_err(|_| "v12 unknown label index")?;
    if index >= count {
        return Err("v12 unknown label index");
    }
    Ok(index)
}

fn expand_to_v11(page: &Value) -> Result<Value, &'static str> {
    envelope(page, SCHEMA_V12, true)?;
    if canonical(page).len() > PAGE_CAP {
        return Err("v12 same one-page cap");
    }
    let declarations = page["view_labels"].as_array().ok_or("v12 dictionary")?;
    let mut labels = Vec::new();
    let mut sizes = Vec::new();
    let mut unique = BTreeSet::new();
    for (position, declaration) in declarations.iter().enumerate() {
        let tuple = declaration.as_array().ok_or("v12 declaration arity")?;
        if tuple.len() != 2 {
            return Err("v12 declaration arity");
        }
        if tuple[0].as_u64() != u64::try_from(position).ok() {
            return Err("v12 duplicate or noncontiguous index");
        }
        let label = tuple[1]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or("v12 duplicate or nonstring label")?;
        if !unique.insert(label) {
            return Err("v12 duplicate or nonstring label");
        }
        labels.push(label);
        sizes.push(
            serde_json::to_string(label)
                .map_err(|_| "v12 label JSON")?
                .len(),
        );
    }
    let mut result = page.clone();
    let mut seen = vec![false; labels.len()];
    let mut next = 0usize;
    let mut expanded = 0usize;
    // Bound all quoted label expansion before publishing any expanded string.
    view_slots(&mut result, &mut |value| {
        let index = index(value, labels.len())?;
        if !seen[index] {
            if index != next {
                return Err("v12 noncanonical first-use order");
            }
            seen[index] = true;
            next = next.checked_add(1).ok_or("v12 index overflow")?;
        }
        expanded = expanded
            .checked_add(sizes[index])
            .ok_or("v12 expanded label bound")?;
        if expanded > SOURCE_CAP {
            return Err("v12 expanded label bound");
        }
        Ok(())
    })?;
    if next != labels.len() {
        return Err("v12 unreferenced declaration");
    }
    view_slots(&mut result, &mut |value| {
        *value = labels[index(value, labels.len())?].into();
        Ok(())
    })?;
    result.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("view_labels");
    result["schema"] = SCHEMA_V11.into();
    Ok(result)
}

// Explicit opt-in only. Existing V11 serialization and all old encoders retain
// their exact implementations and limits. The full V11 inverse is mandatory.
fn encode_v12(page: &Value) -> Result<Value, &'static str> {
    envelope(page, SCHEMA_V11, false)?;
    let mut result = page.clone();
    let mut indices = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut labels = Vec::new();
    view_slots(&mut result, &mut |value| {
        let label = value.as_str().ok_or("v12 V11 named label")?;
        let index = if let Some(index) = indices.get(label) {
            *index
        } else {
            let index = labels.len();
            indices.insert(label.to_owned(), index);
            labels.push(serde_json::json!([index, label]));
            index
        };
        *value = index.into();
        Ok(())
    })?;
    result["schema"] = SCHEMA_V12.into();
    result["view_labels"] = labels.into();
    if canonical(&result).len() > PAGE_CAP {
        return Err("v12 same one-page cap");
    }
    if expand_to_v11(&result)? != *page {
        return Err("v12 ENTIRE V11 page inverse");
    }
    Ok(result)
}

pub(in super::super) fn expand_v12(
    before: &Value,
    policy: &Value,
    page: &Value,
) -> Result<Value, &'static str> {
    expand_v11(before, policy, &expand_to_v11(page)?)
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "main_e177_overlay_labels_v12/tests.rs"]
mod tests;
use super::*;
use serde_json::json;

fn pair() -> (Value, Value) {
    (
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("parity-v11.json")).unwrap(),
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("parity-v12.json")).unwrap(),
    )
}

#[test]
fn v12_exact_python_rust_vector_preserves_repeated_occurrences_and_unknown_metadata() {
    let (full, compact) = pair();
    assert_eq!(encode_v12(&full).unwrap(), compact);
    assert_eq!(
        canonical(&encode_v12(&full).unwrap()).as_slice(),
        include_bytes!("parity-v12.json")
    );
    assert_eq!(expand_to_v11(&compact).unwrap(), full);
    assert_eq!(compact["view_labels"], json!([[0, "same"], [1, "other"]]));
    let views = &compact["replacements"][0]["old519_index"][2];
    assert_eq!(views[0][0], 0);
    assert_eq!(views[1][0], 0); // repeated references preserve both occurrences
    assert_eq!(views[2], full["replacements"][0]["old519_index"][2][2]);
    assert_eq!(
        compact["additions"][0]["extra"],
        full["additions"][0]["extra"]
    );
}

#[test]
fn v12_complete_frozen_v11_inverse_keeps_every_row_view_prefix_and_canonical_byte() {
    const FULL: &[u8] = include_bytes!("v11.before.json");
    let full: Value = serde_json::from_slice(FULL).unwrap();
    let compact = encode_v12(&full).unwrap();
    let restored = expand_to_v11(&compact).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored, full);
    assert_eq!(canonical(&restored).as_slice(), FULL);
    assert_eq!(compact["archive_prefixes"], full["archive_prefixes"]);
    assert_eq!(full["archive_prefixes"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 23);
    assert!(canonical(&compact).len() < FULL.len());
    assert!(canonical(&compact).len() <= PAGE_CAP);

    // The live page includes this test's source identity. Compare complete
    // bytes through both real codecs rather than creating a circular hash pin.
    use std::io::Read;
    use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
    let root = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
    let page_bytes =
        std::fs::read(root.join("docs/evidence/finite-source-overlay-v2-20261018/page.json"))
            .unwrap();
    assert!(page_bytes.len() <= PAGE_CAP);
    let page: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&page_bytes).unwrap();
    if page["schema"] == super::super::SCHEMA_V13 {
        super::super::verify_current_v13(&page);
        return;
    }
    let expanded = expand_to_v11(&page).unwrap();
    let expanded_bytes = canonical(&expanded);
    assert!(expanded_bytes.len() <= SOURCE_CAP);
    assert_eq!(canonical(&encode_v12(&expanded).unwrap()), page_bytes);
    let mut python = Command::new("python3")
        .args(["-B", "-c", r#"
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
codec = runpy.run_path(str(root / 'docs/evidence/finite-source-overlay-v2-20261018/overlay_page.py'), run_name='v12_current_page_parity')
raw = (root / 'docs/evidence/finite-source-overlay-v2-20261018/page.json').read_bytes()
page = codec['parse'](raw)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(codec['canonical'](codec['expand_v12_view_labels'](page)))
"#])
        .arg(root)
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .spawn()
        .expect("current-page parity requires standard-library Python 3");
    let mut python_bytes = Vec::new();
    // Drop the pipe before waiting even if a hostile producer exceeds the
    // bound, so an overfull pipe cannot leave the child blocked in write.
    let read = python
        .stdout
        .take()
        .unwrap()
        .take((SOURCE_CAP + 1) as u64)
        .read_to_end(&mut python_bytes);
    let status = python.wait().unwrap();
    read.unwrap();
    assert!(
        status.success(),
        "current-page Python decoder failed: {status}"
    );
    assert!(python_bytes.len() <= SOURCE_CAP);
    assert_eq!(python_bytes, expanded_bytes);
}

#[test]
fn v12_duplicate_declarations_unknown_indices_unreferenced_and_noncanonical_order_refuse() {
    let (_, compact) = pair();
    for bad in [
        json!([0, "other"]),
        json!([1, "same"]),
        json!([true, "other"]),
        json!({"index":1,"name":"other","unknown":true}),
        json!([1, 17]),
    ] {
        let mut hostile = compact.clone();
        hostile["view_labels"][1] = bad;
        assert!(expand_to_v11(&hostile).is_err());
    }
    let mut unused = compact.clone();
    unused["view_labels"]
        .as_array_mut()
        .unwrap()
        .push(json!([2, "unused"]));
    assert_eq!(
        expand_to_v11(&unused).unwrap_err(),
        "v12 unreferenced declaration"
    );
    for bad in [
        json!(true),
        json!(false),
        json!(-1),
        json!(2),
        json!(u64::MAX),
        json!("unknown"),
        json!(null),
        json!({}),
        json!([]),
    ] {
        let mut hostile = compact.clone();
        hostile["replacements"][0]["old519_index"][2][0][0] = bad;
        assert_eq!(
            expand_to_v11(&hostile).unwrap_err(),
            "v12 unknown label index"
        );
    }
    let mut out_of_order = compact;
    out_of_order["replacements"][0]["old519_index"][2][0][0] = json!(1);
    assert_eq!(
        expand_to_v11(&out_of_order).unwrap_err(),
        "v12 noncanonical first-use order"
    );
}
