#[test]
fn v12_full_original_controller_dispatch_and_old_v11_source_inverses_are_exact() {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    fn hash(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        format!("{:x}", crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(bytes)))
    }
    let before = include_str!("root.before.rs.txt");
    assert_eq!(
        hash(before.as_bytes()),
        "1bae91431b48d61bd482028a99fc30f967d4b153e8e68acdf8d25e45aa20719e"
    );
    let v13_root = super::super::v13_before(
        "src/source_reflows_merge/main_e177_overlay_v2.rs",
        include_str!("../main_e177_overlay_v2.rs"),
    );
    let acquired = crate::source_reflows::next_custody_before(
        "v12-root",
        "src/source_reflows_merge/main_e177_overlay_v2.rs",
        &v13_root,
    );
    let current = acquired.as_str();
    let new = "    if page[\"schema\"] == fragments_v3::SCHEMA_V12 {\n        let expanded = fragments_v3::expand_v12(&before, policy, page)?;\n        compose_values_v2(before, policy, &expanded)\n    } else if page[\"schema\"] == fragments_v3::SCHEMA_V11 {\n";
    let old = "    if page[\"schema\"] == fragments_v3::SCHEMA_V11 {\n";
    assert_eq!(current.matches(new).count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(current.replacen(new, old, 1), before);
    let before = include_str!("fragments.before.rs.txt");
    assert_eq!(
        hash(before.as_bytes()),
        "af953cf250bc63c7e102ac0ed9c4014432c60aab5878bd1094b27353f128c60c"
    );
    let current = include_str!("../main_e177_overlay_fragments_v3.rs");
    let prior = super::super::v13_before(
        "src/source_reflows_merge/main_e177_overlay_fragments_v3.rs",
        current,
    );
    let current = prior.as_str();
    let acquired = crate::source_reflows::next_custody_before(
        "main295-v12-fragments",
        "src/source_reflows_merge/main_e177_overlay_fragments_v3.rs",
        current,
    );
    let current = acquired.as_str();
    let added = "\n#[path = \"main_e177_overlay_labels_v12.rs\"]\nmod labels_v12;\npub(super) use labels_v12::{expand_v12, SCHEMA_V12};\n";
    assert_eq!(current.matches(added).count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(current.replacen(added, "", 1), before);
    assert_eq!(
        hash(include_bytes!("../main_e177_overlay_pins_v11.rs")),
        "09c2917ac3709e570b12478de503049d383bfde84e1dd57fa8bbc18dc9352c9e"
    );
    assert_eq!(PAGE_CAP, 262144);
    assert_eq!(SOURCE_CAP, 9753094);
}
//! Reuse immutable directory DATA while a separate callee certificate is live.
use super::super::super::shared_local_callees::{Context, Costs, Failure};
use super::super::joint::modular_census as joint;
use super::{
    size_of, Directory, Header, ImportDeclaration, Index, InterfaceDeclaration, Program, Proof,
    Source, SELECTOR,
};
type Error = Failure;

#[allow(
    clippy::manual_range_contains,
    reason = "keep explicitly invoiced scalar comparisons"
)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn count(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
) -> Result<(Proof, Costs), Error> {
    let program = context.program;
    let mut selector = Proof {
        roots: 0,
        bytes: SELECTOR.saturating_add(
            2 * size_of::<(Context<'_, '_>, bool, Result<(Proof, Costs), Error>)>(),
        ),
    };
    let mut length = program.functions.len();
    if imports {
        length = length.saturating_add(program.module_uses.len());
    }
    let mut interfaces = program.interfaces.iter();
    loop {
        bill!(selector; 2 * &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, InterfaceDeclaration>);
        bill!(selector; (Option<&InterfaceDeclaration>, &InterfaceDeclaration, &Vec<ImportDeclaration>, &Vec<ImportDeclaration>, usize, usize, usize));
        let Some(interface) = interfaces.next() else {
            break;
        };
        length = length.saturating_add(interface.imports.len());
    }
    // The separate monomorphized frames retain only the selected capacity.
    // Small and over-capacity programs keep the complete original scan; the
    // selector is still honestly added, never refunded or described as free.
    if length >= 64 && length <= 128 {
        bill!(selector; 2 * (&Program, &Index<'_>, bool, usize, Proof));
        indexed::<128>(context, imports, selector.bytes)
    } else if length >= 129 && length <= 512 {
        bill!(selector; 2 * (&Program, &Index<'_>, bool, usize, Proof));
        indexed::<512>(context, imports, selector.bytes)
    } else {
        joint::linear(context, imports, selector.bytes)
    }
}

fn indexed<const N: usize>(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
    selector: usize,
) -> Result<(Proof, Costs), Error> {
    let program = context.program;
    let mut proof = Proof {
        roots: 0,
        bytes: selector,
    };
    bill!(proof; 2 * Directory<'_, N>);
    bill!(proof; ([Header<'_>; N], Header<'_>, Source<'_>, &Program, &Index<'_>, bool, usize, Option<usize>));
    let mut directory = Directory {
        rows: [Header::EMPTY; N],
        len: 0,
        last: None,
    };
    bill!(proof; 2 * (&mut Directory<'_, N>, &Program, bool, &mut Proof));
    directory.populate(program, imports, &mut proof);
    bill!(proof; 2 * (&mut Directory<'_, N>, &mut Proof));
    directory.sort(&mut proof);
    joint::count_with_lookup(context, imports, proof, &mut directory)
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn indexed_loan<const N: usize>(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
    name: &str,
    arity: usize,
) -> (bool, bool) {
    let mut proof = Proof::default();
    let mut directory = Directory {
        rows: [Header::EMPTY; N],
        len: 0,
        last: None,
    };
    directory.populate(context.program, imports, &mut proof);
    directory.sort(&mut proof);
    let loan = super::super::joint::Lookup::target(
        &mut directory,
        context.authored,
        name,
        arity,
        &mut proof,
    );
    (loan.auxiliary, loan.local.is_some())
}
//! Complete existing visitor with a separate imported-module local certificate.
use super::super::super::shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session;
use super::{
    call_identity, size_of, Context, Costs, Error, Expr, ExprKind, Function, Linear, Lookup, Names,
    Proof, Statement, Type,
};
fn plain(ty: &Type) -> bool {
    matches!(
        ty,
        Type::Named { arguments, .. } if arguments.is_empty()
    ) || matches!(
        ty,
        Type::I64
            | Type::I32
            | Type::U8
            | Type::Usize
            | Type::Char
            | Type::F32
            | Type::F64
            | Type::Bool
            | Type::String
            | Type::Bytes
            | Type::Str
            | Type::SliceU8
    )
}
fn ordinary_data(function: &Function, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
    proof.charge(&(function, &function.params, &function.return_type));
    function.explicit_id
        && function.type_parameters.is_empty()
        && function.yields.is_none()
        && function.follows.is_none()
        && plain(&function.return_type)
        && function.params.iter().all(|p| {
            proof.charge(&p);
            plain(&p.ty)
        })
}
fn supported(expression: &Expr, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
    proof.charge(&(expression, &expression.kind));
    match &expression.kind {
        ExprKind::Call { .. }
        | ExprKind::If { .. }
        | ExprKind::Unary { .. }
        | ExprKind::Binary { .. }
        | ExprKind::Project { .. }
        | ExprKind::Var(_)
        | ExprKind::Int(_)
        | ExprKind::Int32(_)
        | ExprKind::Uint8(_)
        | ExprKind::Usize(_)
        | ExprKind::Char(_)
        | ExprKind::Float32(_)
        | ExprKind::Float64(_)
        | ExprKind::Bool(_)
        | ExprKind::String(_)
        | ExprKind::BorrowedUtf8Literal(_)
        | ExprKind::ArrayU8(_)
        | ExprKind::RepeatArrayU8 { .. } => true,
        ExprKind::Block { statements, .. } => statements.iter().all(|s| {
            proof.charge(&s);
            match s {
                Statement::Let { declared, .. } => declared.as_ref().is_none_or(plain),
                Statement::Assign { field: None, .. } | Statement::While { .. } => true,
                _ => false,
            }
        }),
        _ => false,
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn count(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
) -> Result<(Proof, Costs), Vec<crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic>> {
    // The directory owns its original selector and selected capacity. Its
    // coupled entry will invoke the same visitor below on that already-built DATA.
    super::super::directory::count_modular(context, imports).map_err(|_| {
        vec![super::super::super::super::limit_error(
            "builder_bytes",
            super::super::super::super::active_builder_limit(),
        )]
    })
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn linear(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
    selector: usize,
) -> Result<(Proof, Costs), Error> {
    let mut lookup = Linear {
        program: context.program,
        imports,
    };
    let proof = Proof {
        roots: 0,
        bytes: selector,
    };
    count_with_lookup(context, imports, proof, &mut lookup)
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn count_with_lookup<'p, 'a, L: Lookup<'p>>(
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    imports: bool,
    mut proof: Proof,
    lookup: &mut L,
) -> Result<(Proof, Costs), Error> {
    let program = context.program;
    proof.charge(&(program, context.authored, imports));
    proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(size_of::<Proof>());
    proof.charge(&(context, &mut *lookup, Option::<Session<'_, '_>>::None));
    let mut session = None;
    for function in &program.functions {
        proof.charge(&function);
        if !function.type_parameters.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut names = Names {
            entries: [None; 128],
            len: 0,
        };
        proof.charge(&names);
        let mut complete = function.params.iter().all(|p| {
            proof.charge(&p);
            names.insert(&p.name, &mut proof)
        });
        for root in call_identity::roots(function) {
            proof.bytes = proof
                .bytes
                .saturating_add(size_of::<[Option<(&Expr, usize)>; 129]>());
            complete &= call_identity::walk(root, &mut |expression| {
                proof.charge(&expression);
                match &expression.kind {
                    ExprKind::Block { statements, .. } => statements.iter().all(|s| match s {
                        Statement::Let { name, .. } | Statement::Assign { name, .. } => {
                            names.insert(name, &mut proof)
                        }
                        Statement::For { item, .. } | Statement::ForOwn { item, .. } => {
                            names.insert(item, &mut proof)
                        }
                        Statement::ForBorrow { item, index, .. } => {
                            names.insert(item, &mut proof)
                                && index
                                    .as_ref()
                                    .is_none_or(|i| names.insert(&i.name, &mut proof))
                        }
                        _ => true,
                    }),
                    ExprKind::Closure { params, .. } => params.iter().all(|p| {
                        proof.charge(&p);
                        names.insert(&p.name, &mut proof)
                    }),
                    ExprKind::Match { arms, .. } => arms
                        .iter()
                        .all(|a| names.pattern(&a.pattern, 0, &mut proof)),
                    _ => true,
                }
            });
        }
        proof.charge(&complete);
        if !complete {
            continue;
        }
        let before = proof.roots;
        let callee_before = Session::checkpoint(&session);
        let body_allowed = Session::eligible(program) && ordinary_data(function, &mut proof);
        let mut body_complete = true;
        proof.charge(&(before, callee_before, body_allowed, body_complete));
        for root in call_identity::roots(function) {
            if !visit(
                root,
                false,
                true,
                0,
                &names,
                lookup,
                context,
                function,
                body_allowed && std::ptr::eq(root, &function.body),
                &mut body_complete,
                &mut session,
                &mut proof,
            )? {
                proof.roots = before;
                body_complete = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if !body_complete {
            Session::rollback(&mut session, callee_before)?;
        }
    }
    let costs = Session::finish(session, context)?;
    Ok((proof, costs))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn visit<'p, 'a, L: Lookup<'p>>(
    expression: &Expr,
    free: bool,
    outside: bool,
    depth: usize,
    names: &Names<'_>,
    lookup: &mut L,
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    owner: &'p Function,
    body: bool,
    body_complete: &mut bool,
    session: &mut Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    proof: &mut Proof,
) -> Result<bool, Error> {
    proof.charge(&(
        expression,
        free,
        outside,
        depth,
        names,
        &mut *lookup,
        context,
        owner,
        body,
        &mut *body_complete,
        &mut *session,
    ));
    proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(size_of::<Result<bool, Error>>());
    if depth == 128 {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    if body && !supported(expression, proof) {
        *body_complete = false;
    }
    if let ExprKind::Call {
        name,
        type_arguments,
        args,
    } = &expression.kind
    {
        let callee = body && *body_complete && outside;
        proof.charge(&callee);
        if (free || callee) && outside && type_arguments.is_empty() && !names.contains(name, proof)
        {
            let loan = lookup.target(context.authored, name, args.len(), proof);
            if free && loan.auxiliary {
                proof.roots = proof.roots.saturating_add(1);
            }
            if callee {
                if let Some(target) = loan.local {
                    Session::observe(session, context, owner, target, args.len())?;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let outside = outside && !matches!(expression.kind, ExprKind::Closure { .. });
    let mut index = 0;
    while let Some(child) = expression.child(index) {
        let free = match &expression.kind {
            ExprKind::Unary { .. }
            | ExprKind::Binary { .. }
            | ExprKind::If { .. }
            | ExprKind::Call { .. } => true,
            ExprKind::Block { tail, .. } => std::ptr::eq(child, tail.as_ref()),
            _ => false,
        };
        proof.charge(&(index, child, free, outside));
        if !visit(
            child,
            free,
            outside,
            depth + 1,
            names,
            lookup,
            context,
            owner,
            body,
            body_complete,
            session,
            proof,
        )? {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    let complete = true;
    proof.charge(&complete);
    Ok(complete)
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn linear_loan(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    imports: bool,
    name: &str,
    arity: usize,
) -> (bool, bool) {
    let mut lookup = Linear {
        program: context.program,
        imports,
    };
    let loan = lookup.target(context.authored, name, arity, &mut Proof::default());
    (loan.auxiliary, loan.local.is_some())
}
//! Two bounded consumers of one invocation's immutable literal census.
//! The finished certificate remains DATA; every handoff has its own lender fee.
use super::super::{call_carriers, held_projection, private_layout, SyntheticBuilderCosts};
use super::{size_of, Context, Costs, Failure, Index, Invoice, Program};
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;

type ResultPair = Result<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs), Vec<Diagnostic>>;
// Internal lender rejection must not format/debit a diagnostic in a foreign
// current budget. Only the owning production boundary publishes diagnostics.
#[derive(Debug)]
enum ReadError {
    Payment(Failure),
    Census(Vec<Diagnostic>),
}
type ReadResult = Result<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs), ReadError>;

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) struct Census<'p, 'a> {
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    invoice: Invoice,
    cached: Option<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs)>,
    used: u8,
    reusable: bool,
    failed: bool,
}

fn diagnostic(_: Failure) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
    vec![super::super::super::limit_error(
        "builder_bytes",
        super::super::super::active_builder_limit(),
    )]
}

impl<'p, 'a> Census<'p, 'a> {
    fn acquire(
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
        mode: u8,
        first_imports: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire_with::<Acquire<'p, 'a>>().map_err(diagnostic)?;
        if mode != 6 || !first_imports {
            return Err(diagnostic(Failure::Foreign));
        }
        // These are the ONLY source surfaces inspected by the lookup selector
        // under include_imports. With both empty, true/false select the exact
        // same directory, names walk, body and constructor loans. The bool's
        // typed control width is equal; no arbitrary model equivalence is used.
        let reusable =
            context.program.module_uses.is_empty() && context.program.interfaces.is_empty();
        Ok(Self {
            context,
            invoice,
            cached: None,
            used: 0,
            reusable,
            failed: false,
        })
    }

    #[allow(
        clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
        reason = "direct discriminants preserve separately prepaid receiver boundaries"
    )]
    fn read(&mut self, context: Context<'p, 'a>, imports: bool) -> ReadResult {
        // The live Invoice checks the real current lender BEFORE either use.
        // Its cumulative paid bytes remain in both conservative forecasts;
        // retaining a scalar fee does not debit a second census in the ledger.
        self.invoice
            .pay::<Read<'_, '_>>()
            .map_err(ReadError::Payment)?;
        if !std::ptr::eq(self.context.program, context.program)
            || !std::ptr::eq(self.context.authored, context.authored)
            || !std::ptr::eq(self.context.programs, context.programs)
            || self.failed
            || !matches!((self.used, imports), (0, true) | (1, false))
        {
            return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign));
        }
        // Consume this phase before any fallible fallback. A failed read is
        // never a token that may be replayed after restoring the old budget.
        self.used += 1;
        let fresh = if !self.reusable || matches!(self.cached, None) {
            match call_carriers::count_modular(context, imports) {
                Ok(fresh) => Some(fresh),
                Err(error) => {
                    self.failed = true;
                    return Err(ReadError::Census(error));
                }
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
        let (proof, mut cost) = if self.reusable {
            if let Some(fresh) = fresh {
                self.cached = Some(fresh);
            }
            let Some((proof, cost)) = &self.cached else {
                return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign));
            };
            (
                call_carriers::Proof {
                    roots: proof.roots,
                    bytes: proof.bytes,
                },
                Costs {
                    slots: cost.slots,
                    bytes: cost.bytes,
                },
            )
        } else {
            match fresh {
                Some(fresh) => fresh,
                None => return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign)),
            }
        };
        cost.bytes = cost
            .bytes
            .checked_add(self.invoice.bytes())
            .ok_or(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Arithmetic))?;
        Ok((proof, cost))
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn read_or_count<'p, 'a>(
    census: Option<&mut Census<'p, 'a>>,
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    imports: bool,
) -> ResultPair {
    match census {
        Some(census) => census.read(context, imports).map_err(|error| match error {
            ReadError::Payment(failure) => diagnostic(failure),
            ReadError::Census(error) => error,
        }),
        None => call_carriers::count_modular(context, imports),
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn estimates<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a Index<'a>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum: Option<usize>,
    mode: u8,
    first_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let context = Context {
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
    };
    let mut census = Census::acquire(context, mode, first_imports)?;
    let full = held_projection::modular_projection::estimate_with_census(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum,
        6,
        true,
        registry,
        &mut census,
    )?;
    let retained = held_projection::modular_projection::estimate_with_census(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum,
        6,
        false,
        registry,
        &mut census,
    )?;
    Ok((full, retained))
}

// This invocation wrapper is not HIR backing or a callee-slot discount. Its
// actual lender pays before selecting either complete producer; no Drop refund
// or cache entry can return that consumed reservation.
const SELECT: usize = 2 * size_of::<(
    &Program,
    &Index<'_>,
    &[Program],
    Option<usize>,
    u8,
    bool,
    Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>>,
)>() + 2 * size_of::<&Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>>()
    + 2 * size_of::<bool>()
    + 2 * size_of::<usize>()
    + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Vec<Diagnostic>>>();

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn selected_estimates<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a Index<'a>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum: Option<usize>,
    mode: u8,
    first_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    super::super::reserve_builder_structure(SELECT)?;
    if program.module_uses.is_empty() {
        super::paired::estimates(
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
            maximum,
            mode,
            first_imports,
            registry,
        )
    } else {
        estimates(
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
            maximum,
            mode,
            first_imports,
            registry,
        )
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "modular_pair_tests.rs"]
mod tests;
//! Real imported-module shipping forecasts against BOTH complete old equations.
use super::super::super::{
    before_shared_local_projection as pre916, cached_exact, dependency_identity_max, uncached_peak,
    HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
};
use super::super::modular_session::tests::{context, programs};
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

#[test]
fn real_imports_force_two_independent_censuses_and_never_reuse_full_as_retained() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap();
        assert!(!census.reusable && census.cached.is_none());
        let full = census.read(ctx, true).unwrap();
        let retained = census.read(ctx, false).unwrap();
        assert!(census.cached.is_none());
        assert!(
            full.0.roots > retained.0.roots,
            "real imported call is present only in full auxiliary census"
        );
        assert_eq!((full.1.slots, retained.1.slots), (2, 2));
        for (imports, actual) in [(true, full), (false, retained)] {
            let independent = call_carriers::count_modular(ctx, imports).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (actual.0.roots, actual.0.bytes),
                (independent.0.roots, independent.0.bytes)
            );
            assert_eq!(actual.1.slots, independent.1.slots);
            assert!(
                actual.1.bytes > independent.1.bytes,
                "each handoff has its own invoice"
            );
        }
    });
}

#[test]
fn full_old_pre916_and_original916_equations_keep_all_remaining_identity_terms() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    let maximum = dependency_identity_max(ctx.program, &i, &p).unwrap();
    let unit = maximum * HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR;
    assert_eq!(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR, 16);
    let original_proof = super::super::costs(ctx).unwrap();
    let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap();
    for imports in [true, false] {
        let old = pre916::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
            ctx.program,
            &i,
            &p,
            Some(maximum),
            imports,
            (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
            None,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let original916 =
            held_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                ctx.program,
                &i,
                &p,
                Some(maximum),
                imports,
                (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
                None,
            )
            .unwrap();
        let raw = call_carriers::count(ctx.program, &i, imports);
        let (proof, local) = census.read(ctx, imports).unwrap();
        let current = held_projection::modular_projection::estimate_with_census(
            ctx.program,
            &i,
            &p,
            Some(maximum),
            6,
            imports,
            None,
            &mut Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap(),
        );
        // The retained-only phase must follow a full phase in its own fresh
        // lender. Use the real pair API for the complete current estimate.
        if imports {
            assert!(current.is_ok());
        } else {
            assert!(current.is_err());
        }
        let pair = estimates(ctx.program, &i, &p, Some(maximum), 6, true, None).unwrap();
        let current = if imports { pair.0 } else { pair.1 };
        assert_eq!(local.slots, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            original916.retained_hir + original_proof.slots * unit,
            old.retained_hir + original_proof.bytes
        );
        assert_eq!(
            current.retained_hir + local.slots * unit + raw.bytes,
            old.retained_hir + proof.bytes + local.bytes
        );
        assert_eq!(
            current.retained_clone_and_hir + local.slots * unit + raw.bytes,
            old.retained_clone_and_hir + proof.bytes + local.bytes
        );
        assert_eq!(current.synthetic_ast, old.synthetic_ast);
        assert_eq!(current.runtime, old.runtime);
        assert_eq!(current.transient_import_clone, old.transient_import_clone);
        eprintln!("modular-proof imports={imports} pre916={} original916={} current={} slot={} proof={} originalfee={}",old.retained_hir,original916.retained_hir,current.retained_hir,local.slots,local.bytes,original_proof.bytes);
    }
}

#[test]
fn actual_two_module_uncached_shipping_peak_and_full_drop_are_observed() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let mut entries = Vec::new();
    for (index, program) in p.iter().enumerate() {
        let maximum = Some(dependency_identity_max(program, &i, &p).unwrap());
        let (full, retained) = if program.module_uses.is_empty() {
            super::super::paired::estimates(program, &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None)
        } else {
            estimates(program, &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None)
        }
        .unwrap();
        entries.push((index, full.retained_hir, retained.retained_hir));
    }
    entries.sort_unstable_by(|left, right| {
        right
            .1
            .saturating_sub(right.2)
            .cmp(&left.1.saturating_sub(left.2))
            .then_with(|| p[left.0].path.cmp(&p[right.0].path))
    });
    let mut retained = 0;
    let mut peak = 0;
    for &(_, full, held) in &entries {
        peak = peak.max(retained + full);
        retained += held;
    }
    let ((layout, allocation), refused, paid, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        measure(|| uncached_peak::uncached_output_layout(&p, &i).unwrap())
    });
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
    assert_eq!(layout.forecast, peak.max(retained));
    assert_eq!(layout.order[..2], [entries[0].0, entries[1].0]);
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    eprintln!(
        "modular-two-module-shipping forecast={} actualpaid={paid} allocated={} highwater={}",
        layout.forecast, allocation.allocated, allocation.highwater
    );
}

#[test]
fn selector_and_real_modular_pair_keep_exact_short_zero_sticky_and_full_drop() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    let run = |limit| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                // The physical selector/census frontier is distinct from the
                // estimator's logical final-forecast limit (covered above).
                let result = (|| {
                    super::super::super::reserve_builder_structure(SELECT)?;
                    let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true)?;
                    let full = read_or_count(Some(&mut census), ctx, true)?;
                    let retained = read_or_count(Some(&mut census), ctx, false)?;
                    Ok::<_, Vec<Diagnostic>>((full, retained))
                })();
                let ok = result.is_ok();
                drop(result);
                if !ok {
                    assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
                }
                ok
            })
        })
    };
    let ((ok, allocation), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX);
    assert!(ok && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    for (limit, expected) in [(paid, true), (paid - 1, false), (0, false)] {
        let ((ok, allocation), refused, _, first) = run(limit);
        assert_eq!(ok, expected);
        assert_eq!(refused, !expected);
        assert_eq!(first.is_some(), !expected);
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

#[test]
fn alias_free_dispatch_keeps_the_complete_original_pair_and_cache_predicate() {
    let p = [crate::parse(
        "module scalar.local; @id(\"m\") fn main()->i64{1}",
        "scalar.spx",
    )
    .unwrap()];
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let maximum = Some(dependency_identity_max(&p[0], &i, &p).unwrap());
    let original = super::super::paired::estimates(&p[0], &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None).unwrap();
    let selected = selected_estimates(&p[0], &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (original.0.retained_hir, original.1.retained_hir),
        (selected.0.retained_hir, selected.1.retained_hir)
    );
    let source = include_str!("modular_pair.rs");
    assert!(source.contains(
        "context.program.module_uses.is_empty() && context.program.interfaces.is_empty()"
    ));
    let old = include_str!("paired.rs");
    assert!(old.contains(
        "context.program.module_uses.is_empty() && context.program.interfaces.is_empty()"
    ));
}
//! Uncached coupled census; the complete immediate-old estimate stays live.
//! Only local-callee acquisition changes. Fixed/nominal/expression/writer and
//! all sixteen identity copies retain their original independent equations.
use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    generic_instance_source_cost, import_stub, limit_error, private_layout,
    synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite, AuthoredDeclaration, StructuralCost,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};
use crate::ast::{ModuleUseKind, Program};
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;
use crate::{hir, prelude};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

#[allow(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "complete original forecast inputs plus same-invocation census loan"
)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn estimate_with_census<'p, 'a>(
    program: &'p Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    layout_mode: u8,
    include_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    census: &mut super::super::shared_local_callees::modular_pair::Census<'p, 'a>,
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    if layout_mode != 6 {
        return Err(vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())]);
    }
    let core = None;
    let retention = cached_exact::Retention::Parsed;
    let mut raw = StructuralCost::raw_ast(layout_mode >= 1).with_inline_values(layout_mode >= 2);
    ast_program_cost(program, &mut raw, include_imports)?;
    let (call_data, shared_callees) =
        super::super::shared_local_callees::modular_pair::read_or_count(
            Some(census),
            super::super::shared_local_callees::Context {
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
            },
            include_imports,
        )?;
    raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = call_data.roots;
    let call_proof = call_data.bytes;
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut identity_slots = ast_program_identity_slots(program)?;
    let mut runtime = StructuralCost::new();
    let mut default_memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut transient_import_clone = 0usize;
    layout.add_costs(
        program,
        programs,
        &mut raw,
        &mut runtime,
        &mut identity_slots,
    )?;
    for module_use in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| include_imports) {
        if module_use.kind == ModuleUseKind::Protocol {
            continue;
        }
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        runtime.string(&module_use.alias)?;
        if let Some(function) = target.function {
            // `synthetic_program` retains an imported function as a stub: the
            // signature it rewrites, with `requires` and `ensures` cleared and
            // the body replaced by the return type's default expression. Only
            // the retained signature is charged here; the default body is
            // charged as runtime cost below. The provider's own contract and
            // body reach the resolver exactly once, through the defining
            // module's own `ast_program_cost`.
            ast_function_signature_cost(function, &mut raw)?;
            // Preserve old fitting receipts even though ordinary stubs now
            // clone only their signature. The historical transient-body debit
            // remains conservative; only mode 4 removes its peak after all
            // older estimates refuse. Intrinsic wrapper bodies are separately
            // charged as retained runtime structures below.
            transient_import_clone =
                transient_import_clone.max(ast_function_contract_cost(function)?.total);
            if programs
                .iter()
                .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
                .is_some_and(|provider| {
                    crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                        || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                })
            {
                ast_function_cost(function, &mut runtime)?;
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_function_identity_slots(function)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_identity_slots(&function.return_type)?,
            )?;
            for param in &function.params {
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_type_identity_slots(&param.ty)?)?;
                type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                    &param.ty,
                    target.module,
                    program,
                    programs,
                    &mut runtime,
                    Some(layout),
                )?;
            }
            type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                &function.return_type,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            let cost = import_stub::default_expr_expanded_cost_with_layout(
                function,
                target.module,
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
                &mut default_memo,
                &mut BTreeSet::new(),
                super::super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                    program, target, authored, programs, layout,
                ),
                import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                    function,
                    target.module,
                    byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
                )?,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            runtime.add_split(cost.bytes, cost.string_bytes)?;
            runtime.add_identity_carriers(cost.identity_carriers)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, cost.identity_slots)?;
        } else {
            let declaration = target.ty.expect("validated type target");
            ast_type_declaration_cost(declaration, &mut raw)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_declaration_identity_slots(declaration)?,
            )?;
            super::super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_runtime_cost_with_layout(
                declaration,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if !program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        let synthetic_main = synthetic_main_runtime_cost(&program.module)?;
        runtime.add_split(synthetic_main.total, synthetic_main.string_bytes)?;
        runtime.add_identity_carriers(synthetic_main.identity_carriers)?;
    }
    if layout_mode >= 2 {
        identity_slots = identity_slots
            .checked_sub(call_identity::discount_with_imports(
                program,
                authored,
                include_imports,
            ))
            .expect("scalar calls retain their expression and callee identity slots");
    }
    identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(raw.scalar_identity_discount)
        .expect("raw scalar discount retains each expression identity slot");
    let generic_instances = generic_instance_source_cost(program)?;
    identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, generic_instances.identity_slots)?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        runtime.total,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        hir_input,
        generic_instances.bytes,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(raw.string_bytes, runtime.string_bytes)?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(string_input, generic_instances.string_bytes)?;
    // String contents are part of `hir_input`; only the remaining structural
    // bytes expand by the structural factor.
    let structure_input = hir_input.saturating_sub(string_input);
    let fixed_hir_upper = structure_input
        .checked_mul(HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
        .and_then(|structure| {
            string_input
                .checked_mul(HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|strings| structure.checked_add(strings))
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let maximum_identity_bytes = maximum_identity.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        authored
            .keys()
            .map(|id| id.len())
            .chain(prelude::all_ids().into_iter().map(str::len))
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
    });
    #[cfg(test)]
    let prior_fixed_hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper;
    let fixed_hir_upper = if layout_mode == cached_exact::MODE {
        cached_exact::fixed_upper(fixed_hir_upper, &raw, &runtime, retention)?
    } else {
        fixed_hir_upper
            .checked_sub(cost::fixed_hir_discount(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?)
            .expect("literal storage discount retains the complete reduced fixed bundle")
    };
    // Only the final uncached route has no semantic-cache serialization owner.
    // This independently paid source certificate concerns local callee backing,
    // not the auxiliary-carrier absence counter, BASE, or an expression ID.
    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)
        .expect("a certified raw call retains its callee slot until this separate proof");
    let identity_occurrence_upper = identity_slots
        .checked_mul(maximum_identity_bytes)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // Heap carriers are prebound independently of inline layouts and shared clones.
    let identity_carriers = cost::identity_carriers(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?;
    let identity_carriers =
        checked_builder_sum(identity_carriers, generic_instances.identity_carriers)?;
    let identity_carrier_bytes = identity_carriers
        .checked_mul(hir::ExpressionId::SHARED_ALLOCATION_CARRIER_BYTES)
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // The resolver's source chain also retains the compiler-owned base
    // variants. They are absent from synthetic AST and cannot spend an authored
    // expression discount. Borrow their producer metadata, without warming or
    // constructing the process prelude table during estimation.
    let prelude_hir_upper = super::super::prelude_forecast::retained_upper(
        &prelude::base_schema::BASE,
        maximum_identity_bytes,
    )?;
    let hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper
        .checked_add(call_proof)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(shared_callees.bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(prelude_hir_upper))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_carrier_bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_occurrence_upper))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let retained_clone_and_hir = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        hir_upper,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    #[cfg(test)]
    let original_mode7_fixed_upper = raw
        .exact_expressions
        .checked_add(runtime.exact_expressions)
        .and_then(|count| {
            count
                .checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_FIXED_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<crate::ast::Expr>()))
                .and_then(|old| prior_fixed_hir_upper.checked_sub(old))
                .and_then(|base| {
                    count
                        .checked_mul(if retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic {
                            2
                        } else {
                            1
                        })
                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
                        .and_then(|exact| base.checked_add(exact))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::super::forecast_observation::record_components(
        &program.path,
        layout_mode,
        retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
        include_imports,
        [
            raw.total,
            raw.string_bytes,
            raw.exact_expressions,
            raw.literal_fixed_discount,
            runtime.total,
            runtime.string_bytes,
            runtime.exact_expressions,
            structure_input,
            string_input,
            prior_fixed_hir_upper,
            fixed_hir_upper,
            identity_occurrence_upper,
            identity_carrier_bytes,
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            generic_instances.bytes,
            transient_import_clone,
            original_mode7_fixed_upper,
            prelude_hir_upper,
            hir_upper,
        ],
    );
    let result = SyntheticBuilderCosts {
        raw_clone_and_hir: checked_usage(
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            transient_import_clone,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
        retained_clone_and_hir,
        transient_import_clone,
        runtime: runtime.total,
        retained_hir: hir_upper,
        synthetic_ast: checked_usage(
            raw.total,
            runtime.total,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
    };
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(result)
}
//! Distinct local constructor proof in an imported module; no import discount.
//! No auxiliary-carrier count, name index or pointer alone grants identity scope.
use super::{
    compiler, local, Context, Costs, Failure, Function, Index, Invoice, Program, MAX_HEADERS,
};
type Error = Failure;

// These loans can only be formed after the full ordinary/local source check.
// The surrounding Session owns their exact immutable Context and Invoice.
struct CheckedFunction<'p> {
    function: &'p Function,
    arity: usize,
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) struct Session<'p, 'a> {
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    invoice: Invoice,
    slots: usize,
    exhausted: bool,
    excluded: bool,
    owner: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
    target: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
}
type Eligibility<'p> = (
    &'p Program,
    &'p Program,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
);
type Acquire<'p, 'a> = (
    Eligibility<'p>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    usize,
    usize,
    Option<usize>,
    Result<usize, Failure>,
    bool,
);

impl<'p, 'a> Session<'p, 'a> {
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn eligible(program: &Program) -> bool {
        // Each constructor independently excludes ALL competing import aliases,
        // including on retained-only passes; lookup's flag is not that proof.
        program.functions.len() <= MAX_HEADERS
            && program.interfaces.is_empty()
            && program.protocols.is_empty()
            && program.implementations.is_empty()
            && program.session_protocols.is_empty()
            && program.agents.is_empty()
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn checkpoint(
        current: &Option<Self>,
    ) -> usize {
        current.as_ref().map_or(0, |held| held.slots)
    }

    // Closed caller prerequisite: owner and target come from this Context's
    // actual Program.functions traversal/unique Source::Function lookup. This
    // authenticates that loan; an arbitrary fabricated Index plus copied
    // Function is not a membership witness for this internal entry.
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn observe(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
        owner: &'p Function,
        target: &'p Function,
        arity: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        let result = (|| {
            if current.is_none() {
                let invoice = Invoice::acquire_with::<Acquire<'p, 'a>>()?;
                *current = Some(Self {
                    context,
                    invoice,
                    slots: 0,
                    exhausted: false,
                    excluded: !Self::eligible(context.program),
                    owner: None,
                    target: None,
                });
            }
            let held = current.as_mut().expect("fresh local certificate lender");
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                Option<usize>,
                usize,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            if held.excluded || held.exhausted {
                return Ok(());
            }
            // Pointer equality is only lookup of a SEALED constructor loan,
            // never its creation. No result escapes this exact lender/context;
            // both immutable source owners remain borrowed until finish.
            if !matches!(&held.owner, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, owner)) {
                if !record_signatures::ordinary(context, owner, &held.invoice)?
                    || !local(context, owner, &held.invoice)?
                    || !unaliased(context, owner, &held.invoice)?
                {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.owner = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: owner,
                    arity: owner.params.len(),
                });
            }
            if !matches!(&held.target, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, target)) {
                if !record_signatures::ordinary(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                    || !local(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                    || compiler(&target.name, &held.invoice)?
                    || !unaliased(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.target = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: target,
                    arity: target.params.len(),
                });
            }
            let Some(target) = &held.target else {
                unreachable!("authenticated target loan");
            };
            if target.arity == arity {
                held.slots = held.slots.checked_add(1).ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        match result {
            Err(Failure::Work) => {
                if let Some(held) = current {
                    held.slots = 0;
                    held.exhausted = true;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            other => other,
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn rollback(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        before: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        if let Some(held) = current {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                usize,
                usize,
                bool,
                bool,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
            )>()?;
            if held.exhausted {
                held.slots = 0;
            } else if before <= held.slots {
                held.slots = before;
            } else {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    #[allow(
        clippy::let_and_return,
        reason = "retain separately invoiced receiving and returned Result owners"
    )]
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn finish(
        current: Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    ) -> Result<Costs, Error> {
        let Some(held) = current else {
            return Ok(Costs { slots: 0, bytes: 0 });
        };
        let result = (|| {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                Self,
                Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Invoice,
                &Invoice,
                Costs,
                Costs,
                Result<Costs, Failure>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            Ok(Costs {
                slots: held.slots,
                bytes: held.invoice.bytes(),
            })
        })();
        result
    }
}

// A local Source::Function loan cannot borrow an alias's resolution priority.
// This scan is independent of include_imports and of the alias target's kind,
// provider existence, arity or validity. Every matching spelling closes proof.
fn unaliased(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    function: &Function,
    invoice: &Invoice,
) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
    invoice.pay::<(
        Context<'_, '_>,
        Context<'_, '_>,
        &Function,
        &Function,
        &Invoice,
        &Invoice,
        &Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        &Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        Result<bool, Failure>,
        Result<bool, Failure>,
    )>()?;
    let mut aliases = context.program.module_uses.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<(
            &Invoice,
            &Invoice,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            Option<&crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            Option<&crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            &crate::ast::ModuleUse,
            &crate::ast::ModuleUse,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            bool,
            bool,
            Result<(), Failure>,
            Result<(), Failure>,
        )>()?;
        let Some(alias) = aliases.next() else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        invoice.work(
            alias
                .alias
                .len()
                .saturating_add(function.name.len())
                .saturating_add(1),
        )?;
        if str::eq(alias.alias.as_str(), function.name.as_str()) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
}

#[path = "modular_tests.rs"]

//! Local loans stay separate from every imported alias and its target.
use super::super::WORK;
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) const SOURCE: &str = "module modular.local; use function @id(\"provider.remote\") from provider as remote; @id(\"helper\") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{x} @id(\"other\") fn other(x:i64)->i64{x} @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64{remote(0)+helper(1)+helper(2)}";
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn programs() -> [Program; 2] {
    [
        crate::parse(SOURCE, "modular.spx").unwrap(),
        crate::parse(
            "module provider; @id(\"provider.remote\") fn remote(x:i64)->i64{x}",
            "provider.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    ]
}
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn context<'a>(
    programs: &'a [Program],
    index: &'a Index<'a>,
) -> Context<'a, 'a> {
    Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored: index,
        programs,
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn restore(path: &str, source: &str) -> String {
    let imports = imports_before(path, source);
    let source = imports.as_str();
    let record = super::record_signatures::tests::restore(path, source);
    let source = record.as_str();
    let packet: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("modular_inverse.json")).unwrap();
    let canonical = if path.starts_with("src/") {
        path.to_owned()
    } else {
        format!("src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/{path}")
    };
    let Some(entry) = packet["entries"].get(&canonical) else {
        return source.to_owned();
    };
    let hash = |s: &str| {
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(s.as_bytes()))
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(hash(source), entry["current_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    let mut prior = source.to_owned();
    for splice in entry["splices"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let current = splice["current"].as_str().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(prior.matches(current).count(), 1);
        prior = prior.replacen(current, splice["prior"].as_str().unwrap(), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(hash(&prior), entry["prior_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    prior
}

#[test]
fn actual_linear_and_directory_loans_never_promote_use_to_local() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    for imports in [false, true] {
        for name in ["helper", "remote"] {
            let expected = if name == "helper" {
                (true, true)
            } else {
                (imports, false)
            };
            assert_eq!(
                super::super::super::call_carriers::modular_linear_loan(ctx, imports, name, 1),
                expected
            );
            assert_eq!(
                super::super::super::call_carriers::modular_indexed_loan::<128>(
                    ctx, imports, name, 1
                ),
                expected
            );
        }
        let (aux, proof) = super::super::super::call_carriers::count_modular(ctx, imports).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(proof.slots, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            aux.roots,
            super::super::super::call_carriers::count(ctx.program, &i, imports).roots
        );
        assert_eq!(
            super::super::super::call_carriers::count_joint(ctx, imports)
                .unwrap()
                .1
                .slots,
            0
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn every_competing_alias_kind_closes_owner_or_target_even_without_provider() {
    for alias in ["helper", "main"] {
        for kind in [
            crate::ast::ModuleUseKind::Function,
            crate::ast::ModuleUseKind::Type,
            crate::ast::ModuleUseKind::Protocol,
        ] {
            let mut p = programs();
            p[0].module_uses.push(crate::ast::ModuleUse {
                kind,
                persistent_id: "missing.id".into(),
                target_module: "missing.provider".into(),
                alias: alias.into(),
                span: crate::ast::Span::default(),
            });
            let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
            let ctx = context(&p, &i);
            for imports in [false, true] {
                // Parser-only malformed namespace/provider hostiles claim no
                // workspace validity. The retained flag cannot bypass alias proof.
                let (_, proof) =
                    super::super::super::call_carriers::count_modular(ctx, imports).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(proof.slots, 0, "{alias} {kind:?} imports={imports}");
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn duplicate_local_names_generic_default_shadow_and_unknown_bodies_keep_full_slots() {
    for replacement in [
        "{remote(0)+helper<i64>(1)}",
        "{let helper=1;helper(1)}",
        "{let x=match 1{0=>helper(1),_=>0,};0}",
    ] {
        let mut p = programs();
        p[0] = crate::parse(
            &SOURCE.replace("{remote(0)+helper(1)+helper(2)}", replacement),
            "modular.spx",
        )
        .unwrap();
        let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            super::super::super::call_carriers::count_modular(context(&p, &i), false)
                .unwrap()
                .1
                .slots,
            0
        );
    }
    for attack in 0..3 {
        let mut p = programs();
        match attack {
            0 => {
                let mut duplicate = p[0].functions[0].clone();
                duplicate.stable_id = "duplicate".into();
                p[0].functions.push(duplicate);
            }
            1 => p[0].functions[0].explicit_id = false,
            _ => {
                p[0] = crate::parse(
                    &SOURCE.replace("fn helper(x:i64)", "fn helper<T>(x:i64)"),
                    "modular.spx",
                )
                .unwrap();
            }
        }
        let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            super::super::super::call_carriers::count_modular(context(&p, &i), false)
                .unwrap()
                .1
                .slots,
            0
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn foreign_function_context_lender_and_optional_work_never_mint_modular_slots() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let other = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    let owner = &p[0].functions[2];
    let target = &p[0].functions[0];
    let copy = target.clone();
    let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, &copy, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        assert!(Session::observe(
            &mut current,
            Context {
                authored: &other,
                ..ctx
            },
            owner,
            target,
            1
        )
        .is_err());
        let ((), foreign_refused, paid, foreign_first) =
            with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                assert!(Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).is_err());
            });
        assert!(!foreign_refused && foreign_first.is_none());
        assert_eq!(paid, 0);
        assert!(Session::finish(current, ctx).is_err());
        assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
    });
    assert!(refused && first.is_some());
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            current.as_ref().unwrap().invoice.work(WORK),
            Err(Failure::Work)
        );
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, &p[0].functions[1], 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 0);
        Session::rollback(&mut current, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::finish(current, ctx).unwrap().slots, 0);
    });
}

#[test]
fn actual_imported_module_proof_pays_exact_short_zero_and_drops_completely() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&p, &i);
    let run = |limit| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                let result = super::super::super::call_carriers::count_modular(ctx, false);
                let ok = result.is_ok();
                drop(result);
                if !ok {
                    assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
                }
                ok
            })
        })
    };
    let ((ok, allocation), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX);
    assert!(ok && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    for (limit, success) in [(paid, true), (paid - 1, false), (0, false)] {
        let ((ok, allocation), refused, _, first) = run(limit);
        assert_eq!(ok, success);
        assert_eq!(refused, !success);
        assert_eq!(first.is_some(), !success);
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

// Exact entry only: explicit imports and the two scoped compiler annotations
// precede the record/modular/paired historical stages. Unknown scopes are not
// rewritten, and a known scope must authenticate its COMPLETE current bytes.
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn imports_before(
    path: &str,
    source: &str,
) -> String {
    let canonical_entry = if path.starts_with("src/") {
        path.to_owned()
    } else {
        format!("src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/{path}")
    };
    let production =
        crate::source_reflows::next_custody_before("production7834", &canonical_entry, source);
    let entry = crate::source_reflows::next_custody_before(
        "modular916",
        &canonical_entry,
        production.as_str(),
    );
    let source = entry.as_str();
    let packet: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("modular_inverse.json")).unwrap();
    let canonical = if path.starts_with("src/") {
        path.to_owned()
    } else {
        format!("src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/{path}")
    };
    let Some(entry) = packet["import_entry_stages"].get(&canonical) else {
        return source.to_owned();
    };
    let hash = |raw: &str| {
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(raw.as_bytes()))
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(
        (source.len(), hash(source)),
        (
            entry["current_bytes"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize,
            entry["current_sha256"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned()
        )
    );
    let mut restored = source.to_owned();
    for splice in entry["splices"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let current = splice["current"].as_str().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(restored.matches(current).count(), 1);
        restored = restored.replacen(current, splice["prior"].as_str().unwrap(), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(
        (restored.len(), hash(&restored)),
        (
            entry["prior_bytes"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize,
            entry["prior_sha256"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned()
        )
    );
    restored
}
//! Two bounded consumers of one invocation's immutable literal census.
//! The finished certificate remains DATA; every handoff has its own lender fee.
use super::super::{call_carriers, held_projection, private_layout, SyntheticBuilderCosts};
use super::{Context, Costs, Failure, Index, Invoice, Program};
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;

type ResultPair = Result<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs), Vec<Diagnostic>>;
// Internal lender rejection must not format/debit a diagnostic in a foreign
// current budget. Only the owning production boundary publishes diagnostics.
#[derive(Debug)]
enum ReadError {
    Payment(Failure),
    Census(Vec<Diagnostic>),
}
type ReadResult = Result<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs), ReadError>;

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) struct Census<'p, 'a> {
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    invoice: Invoice,
    cached: Option<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs)>,
    used: u8,
    reusable: bool,
    failed: bool,
}

type Entry<'p, 'a> = (
    &'p Program,

    &'a Index<'a>,
    &'a [Program],
    &'a [Program],
    Option<usize>,
    Option<usize>,
    u8,
    u8,
    bool,
    bool,
    Option<&'p private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'p>>,
    Option<&'p private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'p>>,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts,
    Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>>,
    Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>>,
);
type Acquire<'p, 'a> = (
    ReadResult,
    ReadResult,
    ReadError,
    ReadError,
    Entry<'p, 'a>,
    Census<'p, 'a>,
    Census<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    &'p Program,

    Option<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs)>,
    ResultPair,
    ResultPair,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
);

type Read<'p, 'a> = (
    ReadResult,
    ReadResult,
    ReadError,
    ReadError,
    Option<&'p mut Census<'p, 'a>>,
    Option<&'p mut Census<'p, 'a>>,
    &'p mut Census<'p, 'a>,
    &'p mut Census<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,

    Option<(call_carriers::Proof, Costs)>,
    bool,
