fn diagnostic(_: Failure) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
    vec![super::super::super::limit_error(
        "builder_bytes",
        super::super::super::active_builder_limit(),
    )]
}

impl<'p, 'a> Census<'p, 'a> {
    fn acquire(
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
        mode: u8,
        first_imports: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire_with::<Acquire<'p, 'a>>().map_err(diagnostic)?;
        if mode != 6 || !first_imports {
            return Err(diagnostic(Failure::Foreign));
        }
        // These are the ONLY source surfaces inspected by the lookup selector
        // under include_imports. With both empty, true/false select the exact
        // same directory, names walk, body and constructor loans. The bool's
        // typed control width is equal; no arbitrary model equivalence is used.
        let reusable =
            context.program.module_uses.is_empty() && context.program.interfaces.is_empty();
        Ok(Self {
            context,
            invoice,
            cached: None,
            used: 0,
            reusable,
            failed: false,
        })
    }

    #[allow(
        clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
        reason = "direct discriminants preserve separately prepaid receiver boundaries"
    )]
    fn read(&mut self, context: Context<'p, 'a>, imports: bool) -> ReadResult {
        // The live Invoice checks the real current lender BEFORE either use.
        // Its cumulative paid bytes remain in both conservative forecasts;
        // retaining a scalar fee does not debit a second census in the ledger.
        self.invoice
            .pay::<Read<'_, '_>>()
            .map_err(ReadError::Payment)?;
        if !std::ptr::eq(self.context.program, context.program)
            || !std::ptr::eq(self.context.authored, context.authored)
            || !std::ptr::eq(self.context.programs, context.programs)
            || self.failed
            || !matches!((self.used, imports), (0, true) | (1, false))
        {
            return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign));
        }
        // Consume this phase before any fallible fallback. A failed read is
        // never a token that may be replayed after restoring the old budget.
        self.used += 1;
        let fresh = if !self.reusable || matches!(self.cached, None) {
            match call_carriers::count_joint(context, imports) {
                Ok(fresh) => Some(fresh),
                Err(error) => {
                    self.failed = true;
                    return Err(ReadError::Census(error));
                }
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
        let (proof, mut cost) = if self.reusable {
            if let Some(fresh) = fresh {
                self.cached = Some(fresh);
            }
            let Some((proof, cost)) = &self.cached else {
                return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign));
            };
            (
                call_carriers::Proof {
                    roots: proof.roots,
                    bytes: proof.bytes,
                },
                Costs {
                    slots: cost.slots,
                    bytes: cost.bytes,
                },
            )
        } else {
            match fresh {
                Some(fresh) => fresh,
                None => return Err(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Foreign)),
            }
        };
        cost.bytes = cost
            .bytes
            .checked_add(self.invoice.bytes())
            .ok_or(ReadError::Payment(Failure::Arithmetic))?;
        Ok((proof, cost))
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn read_or_count<'p, 'a>(
    census: Option<&mut Census<'p, 'a>>,
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    imports: bool,
) -> ResultPair {
    match census {
        Some(census) => census.read(context, imports).map_err(|error| match error {
            ReadError::Payment(failure) => diagnostic(failure),
            ReadError::Census(error) => error,
        }),
        None => call_carriers::count_joint(context, imports),
    }
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn estimates<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a Index<'a>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum: Option<usize>,
    mode: u8,
    first_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<(SyntheticBuilderCosts, SyntheticBuilderCosts), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let context = Context {
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
    };
    let mut census = Census::acquire(context, mode, first_imports)?;
    let full = held_projection::paired_projection::estimate_with_census(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum,
        6,
        true,
        registry,
        &mut census,
    )?;
    let retained = held_projection::paired_projection::estimate_with_census(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum,
        6,
        false,
        registry,
        &mut census,
    )?;
    Ok((full, retained))
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "paired_tests.rs"]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) mod tests;
//! Uncached coupled census; the complete immediate-old estimate stays live.
//! Only local-callee acquisition changes. Fixed/nominal/expression/writer and
//! all sixteen identity copies retain their original independent equations.
use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    generic_instance_source_cost, import_stub, limit_error, private_layout,
    synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite, AuthoredDeclaration, StructuralCost,
    SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};
use crate::ast::{ModuleUseKind, Program};
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;
use crate::{hir, prelude};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

#[allow(
    clippy::too_many_arguments,
    reason = "complete original forecast inputs plus same-invocation census loan"
)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn estimate_with_census<'p, 'a>(
    program: &'p Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    layout_mode: u8,
    include_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    census: &mut super::super::shared_local_callees::paired::Census<'p, 'a>,
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    if layout_mode != 6 {
        return Err(vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())]);
    }
    let core = None;
    let retention = cached_exact::Retention::Parsed;
    let mut raw = StructuralCost::raw_ast(layout_mode >= 1).with_inline_values(layout_mode >= 2);
    ast_program_cost(program, &mut raw, include_imports)?;
    let (call_data, shared_callees) = super::super::shared_local_callees::paired::read_or_count(
        Some(census),
        super::super::shared_local_callees::Context {
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
        },
        include_imports,
    )?;
    raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = call_data.roots;
    let call_proof = call_data.bytes;
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut identity_slots = ast_program_identity_slots(program)?;
    let mut runtime = StructuralCost::new();
    let mut default_memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut transient_import_clone = 0usize;
    layout.add_costs(
        program,
        programs,
        &mut raw,
        &mut runtime,
        &mut identity_slots,
    )?;
    for module_use in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| include_imports) {
        if module_use.kind == ModuleUseKind::Protocol {
            continue;
        }
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        runtime.string(&module_use.alias)?;
        if let Some(function) = target.function {
            // `synthetic_program` retains an imported function as a stub: the
            // signature it rewrites, with `requires` and `ensures` cleared and
            // the body replaced by the return type's default expression. Only
            // the retained signature is charged here; the default body is
            // charged as runtime cost below. The provider's own contract and
            // body reach the resolver exactly once, through the defining
            // module's own `ast_program_cost`.
            ast_function_signature_cost(function, &mut raw)?;
            // Preserve old fitting receipts even though ordinary stubs now
            // clone only their signature. The historical transient-body debit
            // remains conservative; only mode 4 removes its peak after all
            // older estimates refuse. Intrinsic wrapper bodies are separately
            // charged as retained runtime structures below.
            transient_import_clone =
                transient_import_clone.max(ast_function_contract_cost(function)?.total);
            if programs
                .iter()
                .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
                .is_some_and(|provider| {
                    crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                        || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                })
            {
                ast_function_cost(function, &mut runtime)?;
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_function_identity_slots(function)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_identity_slots(&function.return_type)?,
            )?;
            for param in &function.params {
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_type_identity_slots(&param.ty)?)?;
                type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                    &param.ty,
                    target.module,
                    program,
                    programs,
                    &mut runtime,
                    Some(layout),
                )?;
            }
            type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                &function.return_type,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            let cost = import_stub::default_expr_expanded_cost_with_layout(
                function,
                target.module,
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
                &mut default_memo,
                &mut BTreeSet::new(),
                super::super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                    program, target, authored, programs, layout,
                ),
                import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                    function,
                    target.module,
                    byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
                )?,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            runtime.add_split(cost.bytes, cost.string_bytes)?;
            runtime.add_identity_carriers(cost.identity_carriers)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, cost.identity_slots)?;
        } else {
            let declaration = target.ty.expect("validated type target");
            ast_type_declaration_cost(declaration, &mut raw)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_declaration_identity_slots(declaration)?,
            )?;
            super::super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_runtime_cost_with_layout(
                declaration,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if !program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        let synthetic_main = synthetic_main_runtime_cost(&program.module)?;
        runtime.add_split(synthetic_main.total, synthetic_main.string_bytes)?;
        runtime.add_identity_carriers(synthetic_main.identity_carriers)?;
    }
    if layout_mode >= 2 {
        identity_slots = identity_slots
            .checked_sub(call_identity::discount_with_imports(
                program,
                authored,
                include_imports,
            ))
            .expect("scalar calls retain their expression and callee identity slots");
    }
    identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(raw.scalar_identity_discount)
        .expect("raw scalar discount retains each expression identity slot");
    let generic_instances = generic_instance_source_cost(program)?;
    identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, generic_instances.identity_slots)?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        runtime.total,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        hir_input,
        generic_instances.bytes,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(raw.string_bytes, runtime.string_bytes)?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(string_input, generic_instances.string_bytes)?;
    // String contents are part of `hir_input`; only the remaining structural
    // bytes expand by the structural factor.
    let structure_input = hir_input.saturating_sub(string_input);
    let fixed_hir_upper = structure_input
        .checked_mul(HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
        .and_then(|structure| {
            string_input
                .checked_mul(HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|strings| structure.checked_add(strings))
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let maximum_identity_bytes = maximum_identity.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        authored
            .keys()
            .map(|id| id.len())
            .chain(prelude::all_ids().into_iter().map(str::len))
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
    });
    #[cfg(test)]
    let prior_fixed_hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper;
    let fixed_hir_upper = if layout_mode == cached_exact::MODE {
        cached_exact::fixed_upper(fixed_hir_upper, &raw, &runtime, retention)?
    } else {
        fixed_hir_upper
            .checked_sub(cost::fixed_hir_discount(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?)
            .expect("literal storage discount retains the complete reduced fixed bundle")
    };
    // Only the final uncached route has no semantic-cache serialization owner.
    // This independently paid source certificate concerns local callee backing,
    // not the auxiliary-carrier absence counter, BASE, or an expression ID.
    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)
        .expect("a certified raw call retains its callee slot until this separate proof");
    let identity_occurrence_upper = identity_slots
        .checked_mul(maximum_identity_bytes)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // Heap carriers are prebound independently of inline layouts and shared clones.
    let identity_carriers = cost::identity_carriers(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?;
    let identity_carriers =
        checked_builder_sum(identity_carriers, generic_instances.identity_carriers)?;
    let identity_carrier_bytes = identity_carriers
        .checked_mul(hir::ExpressionId::SHARED_ALLOCATION_CARRIER_BYTES)
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // The resolver's source chain also retains the compiler-owned base
    // variants. They are absent from synthetic AST and cannot spend an authored
    // expression discount. Borrow their producer metadata, without warming or
    // constructing the process prelude table during estimation.
    let prelude_hir_upper = super::super::prelude_forecast::retained_upper(
        &prelude::base_schema::BASE,
        maximum_identity_bytes,
    )?;
    let hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper
        .checked_add(call_proof)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(shared_callees.bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(prelude_hir_upper))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_carrier_bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_occurrence_upper))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let retained_clone_and_hir = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        hir_upper,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    #[cfg(test)]
    let original_mode7_fixed_upper = raw
        .exact_expressions
        .checked_add(runtime.exact_expressions)
        .and_then(|count| {
            count
                .checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_FIXED_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<crate::ast::Expr>()))
                .and_then(|old| prior_fixed_hir_upper.checked_sub(old))
                .and_then(|base| {
                    count
                        .checked_mul(if retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic {
                            2
                        } else {
                            1
                        })
                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
                        .and_then(|exact| base.checked_add(exact))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::super::forecast_observation::record_components(
        &program.path,
        layout_mode,
        retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
        include_imports,
        [
            raw.total,
            raw.string_bytes,
            raw.exact_expressions,
            raw.literal_fixed_discount,
            runtime.total,
            runtime.string_bytes,
            runtime.exact_expressions,
            structure_input,
            string_input,
            prior_fixed_hir_upper,
            fixed_hir_upper,
            identity_occurrence_upper,
            identity_carrier_bytes,
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            generic_instances.bytes,
            transient_import_clone,
            original_mode7_fixed_upper,
            prelude_hir_upper,
            hir_upper,
        ],
    );
    let result = SyntheticBuilderCosts {
        raw_clone_and_hir: checked_usage(
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            transient_import_clone,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
        retained_clone_and_hir,
        transient_import_clone,
        runtime: runtime.total,
        retained_hir: hir_upper,
        synthetic_ast: checked_usage(
            raw.total,
            runtime.total,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
    };
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(result)
}
//! Fresh pair handoffs, complete independent producers, and one-use lenders.
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
const SOURCE: &str = "module pair.local; @id(\"helper\") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{x} @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64{helper(1)+helper(2)}";
fn context<'a>(programs: &'a [Program], authored: &'a Index<'a>) -> Context<'a, 'a> {
    Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored,
        programs,
    }
}
fn components(cost: &SyntheticBuilderCosts) -> [usize; 6] {
    [
        cost.raw_clone_and_hir,
        cost.retained_clone_and_hir,
        cost.transient_import_clone,
        cost.runtime,
        cost.retained_hir,
        cost.synthetic_ast,
    ]
}

// Exact current→416 entry stages precede every unchanged older inverse. The
// packet authenticates whole files as well as each unique literal splice.
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn restore(
    path: &str,
    current: &str,
) -> String {
    let modular = super::super::modular_session::tests::restore(path, current);
    let current = modular.as_str();
    let packet: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("paired_inverse.json")).unwrap();
    let entry = &packet["entries"][path];
    let hash = |raw: &str| {
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(raw.as_bytes()))
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(hash(current), entry["current_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    let mut restored = current.to_owned();
    for splice in entry["splices"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let after = splice["current"].as_str().unwrap();
        let before = splice["prior"].as_str().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(restored.matches(after).count(), 1);
        restored = restored.replacen(after, before, 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(hash(&restored), entry["prior_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    restored
}

#[test]
fn alias_free_pair_uses_one_finished_census_with_distinct_paid_handoffs() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "pair.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    let ((first, second, fee), refused, paid, status) =
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap();
            assert!(census.reusable && census.cached.is_none());
            let (first_proof, first) = census.read(ctx, true).unwrap();
            let held = census.cached.as_ref().unwrap();
            let core = held.1.bytes;
            let first_fee = census.invoice.bytes();
            assert_eq!(first.bytes, core + first_fee);
            let (second_proof, second) = census.read(ctx, false).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (first_proof.roots, first_proof.bytes),
                (second_proof.roots, second_proof.bytes)
            );
            assert_eq!(census.cached.as_ref().unwrap().1.bytes, core);
            assert_eq!(second.bytes, core + census.invoice.bytes());
            assert!(
                second.bytes > first.bytes,
                "the second receiver is not free"
            );
            assert_eq!((first.slots, second.slots), (2, 2));
            (first.bytes, second.bytes, census.invoice.bytes())
        });
    assert!(!refused && status.is_none());
    assert_eq!(
        paid, second,
        "one core Invoice plus the cumulative handoff Invoice"
    );
    assert!(first < second && fee > 0);
    for imports in [true, false] {
        let ((_, independent), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            call_carriers::count_joint(ctx, imports).unwrap()
        });
        assert!(!refused);
        assert_eq!(independent.slots, 2);
        assert_eq!(independent.bytes + fee, second);
    }
}

#[test]
fn paired_complete_estimates_retain_independent_equations_and_real_shipping_peak() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "pair.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    let maximum =
        super::super::super::dependency_identity_max(ctx.program, &authored, &programs).unwrap();
    let (full, retained) = estimates(
        ctx.program,
        &authored,
        &programs,
        Some(maximum),
        6,
        true,
        None,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut previous_fee = 0;
    for (imports, paired) in [(true, full), (false, retained)] {
        let old = held_projection::coupled_uncached_estimate(
            ctx.program,
            &authored,
            &programs,
            Some(maximum),
            6,
            imports,
            None,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let delta = paired.retained_hir.checked_sub(old.retained_hir).unwrap();
        assert!(delta > previous_fee);
        previous_fee = delta;
        let a = components(&paired);
        let b = components(&old);
        assert_eq!(a[0], b[0] + delta);
        assert_eq!(a[1], b[1] + delta);
        assert_eq!(a[2], b[2]);
        assert_eq!(a[3], b[3]);
        assert_eq!(a[5], b[5]);
        eprintln!(
            "paired-census imports={imports} immediate416={} paired={} handoff={delta}",
            old.retained_hir, paired.retained_hir
        );
    }
    let ((full, retained), refused, paid_pair, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        estimates(
            ctx.program,
            &authored,
            &programs,
            Some(maximum),
            6,
            true,
            None,
        )
        .unwrap()
    });
    let expected = full.retained_hir.max(retained.retained_hir);
    let (layout, refused_shipping, paid_shipping, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        super::super::super::uncached_peak::uncached_output_layout(&programs, &authored).unwrap()
    });
    assert!(!refused && !refused_shipping);
    assert_eq!(layout.forecast, expected);
    eprintln!("paired-real-shipping forecast={expected} paid_pair={paid_pair} paid_shipping={paid_shipping}");
}

#[test]
fn import_surface_keeps_two_independent_actual_censuses_and_profile_exclusions() {
    let source = SOURCE.replace(
        "module pair.local;",
        "module pair.local; use function @id(\"remote.f\") from provider as remote;",
    );
    let programs = [
        crate::parse(&source, "pair.spx").unwrap(),
        crate::parse(
            "module provider; @id(\"remote.f\") fn remote(x:i64)->i64{x}",
            "provider.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    ];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap();
        assert!(!census.reusable);
        for imports in [true, false] {
            let (proof, cost) = census.read(ctx, imports).unwrap();
            assert!(census.cached.is_none());
            let (independent, original) = call_carriers::count_joint(ctx, imports).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                (proof.roots, proof.bytes),
                (independent.roots, independent.bytes)
            );
            assert_eq!(cost.slots, original.slots);
            assert_eq!(cost.bytes, original.bytes + census.invoice.bytes());
        }
        assert!(census.read(ctx, false).is_err());
        for mode in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 255] {
            assert!(Census::acquire(ctx, mode, true).is_err());
        }
        assert!(Census::acquire(ctx, 6, false).is_err());
    });
}

#[test]
fn phase_replay_foreign_context_and_foreign_lender_never_publish_cached_data() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "pair.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let foreign = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    let wrong = Context {
        authored: &foreign,
        ..ctx
    };
    let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).unwrap();
        assert!(census.read(ctx, false).is_err());
        assert!(census.cached.is_none());
        assert!(census.read(wrong, true).is_err());
        assert!(census.cached.is_none());
        census.read(ctx, true).unwrap();
        assert!(census.read(ctx, true).is_err());
        let ((), inner_refused, _, inner_first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            assert!(census.read(ctx, false).is_err());
        });
        assert!(!inner_refused && inner_first.is_none());
        assert!(census.read(ctx, false).is_err());
        assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
    });
    assert!(refused && first.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn actual_pair_lender_exact_short_zero_and_complete_drop() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "pair.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    let run = |limit| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                let result = (|| {
                    let mut census = Census::acquire(ctx, 6, true).map_err(ReadError::Census)?;
                    census.read(ctx, true)?;
                    census.read(ctx, false)
                })();
                let success = result.is_ok();
                drop(result);
                if !success {
                    assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
                }
                success
            })
        })
    };
    let ((success, allocation), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX);
    assert!(success && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    for (limit, succeeds) in [(paid, true), (paid - 1, false), (0, false)] {
        let ((success, allocation), refused, used, first) = run(limit);
        assert_eq!(success, succeeds);
        if succeeds {
            assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
            assert_eq!(used, paid);
        } else {
            assert!(refused && first.is_some());
        }
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

fn whole416_entry_sources_and_complete_estimator_body_remain_reconstructible() {
    restore(

    );
    restore("held_projection.rs", include_str!("../held_projection.rs"));
    restore(
        "shared_local_callees.rs",
        include_str!("../shared_local_callees.rs"),
    );
    restore("uncached_peak.rs", include_str!("../uncached_peak.rs"));
    let prior = restore(
        "shared_local_callees/paired_projection.rs",
        include_str!("paired_projection.rs"),
    );
    let original_producer = restore(
        "shared_local_callees/coupled_projection.rs",
        include_str!("coupled_projection.rs"),
    );
    assert_eq!(prior, original_producer);
}
//! Distinct local constructor proof in an imported module; no import discount.
//! No auxiliary-carrier count, name index or pointer alone grants identity scope.
use super::{
    compiler, local, ordinary, Context, Costs, Failure, Function, Index, Invoice, Program,
    MAX_HEADERS,
};
type Error = Failure;

// These loans can only be formed after the full ordinary/local source check.
// The surrounding Session owns their exact immutable Context and Invoice.
struct CheckedFunction<'p> {
    function: &'p Function,
    arity: usize,
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) struct Session<'p, 'a> {
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    invoice: Invoice,
    slots: usize,
    exhausted: bool,
    excluded: bool,
    owner: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
    target: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
}
type Eligibility<'p> = (
    &'p Program,
    &'p Program,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
);
type Acquire<'p, 'a> = (
    Eligibility<'p>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    usize,
    usize,
    Option<usize>,
    Result<usize, Failure>,
    bool,
);

impl<'p, 'a> Session<'p, 'a> {
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn eligible(program: &Program) -> bool {
        // Each constructor independently excludes ALL competing import aliases,
        // including on retained-only passes; lookup's flag is not that proof.
        program.functions.len() <= MAX_HEADERS
            && program.interfaces.is_empty()
            && program.protocols.is_empty()
            && program.implementations.is_empty()
            && program.session_protocols.is_empty()
            && program.agents.is_empty()
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn checkpoint(
        current: &Option<Self>,
    ) -> usize {
        current.as_ref().map_or(0, |held| held.slots)
    }

    // Closed caller prerequisite: owner and target come from this Context's
    // actual Program.functions traversal/unique Source::Function lookup. This
    // authenticates that loan; an arbitrary fabricated Index plus copied
    // Function is not a membership witness for this internal entry.
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn observe(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
        owner: &'p Function,
        target: &'p Function,
        arity: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        let result = (|| {
            if current.is_none() {
                let invoice = Invoice::acquire_with::<Acquire<'p, 'a>>()?;
                *current = Some(Self {
                    context,
                    invoice,
                    slots: 0,
                    exhausted: false,
                    excluded: !Self::eligible(context.program),
                    owner: None,
                    target: None,
                });
            }
            let held = current.as_mut().expect("fresh local certificate lender");
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                Option<usize>,
                usize,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            if held.excluded || held.exhausted {
                return Ok(());
            }
            // Pointer equality is only lookup of a SEALED constructor loan,
            // never its creation. No result escapes this exact lender/context;
            // both immutable source owners remain borrowed until finish.
            if !matches!(&held.owner, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, owner)) {
                if !ordinary(owner, &held.invoice)?
                    || !local(context, owner, &held.invoice)?
                    || !unaliased(context, owner, &held.invoice)?
                {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.owner = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: owner,
                    arity: owner.params.len(),
                });
            }
            if !matches!(&held.target, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, target)) {
                if !ordinary(target, &held.invoice)?
                    || !local(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                    || compiler(&target.name, &held.invoice)?
                    || !unaliased(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.target = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: target,
                    arity: target.params.len(),
                });
            }
            let Some(target) = &held.target else {
                unreachable!("authenticated target loan");
            };
            if target.arity == arity {
                held.slots = held.slots.checked_add(1).ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        match result {
            Err(Failure::Work) => {
                if let Some(held) = current {
                    held.slots = 0;
                    held.exhausted = true;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            other => other,
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn rollback(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        before: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        if let Some(held) = current {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                usize,
                usize,
                bool,
                bool,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
            )>()?;
            if held.exhausted {
                held.slots = 0;
            } else if before <= held.slots {
                held.slots = before;
            } else {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    #[allow(
        clippy::let_and_return,
        reason = "retain separately invoiced receiving and returned Result owners"
    )]
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn finish(
        current: Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    ) -> Result<Costs, Error> {
        let Some(held) = current else {
            return Ok(Costs { slots: 0, bytes: 0 });
        };
        let result = (|| {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                Self,
                Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Invoice,
                &Invoice,
                Costs,
                Costs,
                Result<Costs, Failure>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            Ok(Costs {
                slots: held.slots,
                bytes: held.invoice.bytes(),
            })
        })();
        result
    }
}

// A local Source::Function loan cannot borrow an alias's resolution priority.
// This scan is independent of include_imports and of the alias target's kind,
// provider existence, arity or validity. Every matching spelling closes proof.
fn unaliased(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    function: &Function,
    invoice: &Invoice,
) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
    invoice.pay::<(
        Context<'_, '_>,
        Context<'_, '_>,
        &Function,
        &Function,
        &Invoice,
        &Invoice,
        &Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        &Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        &[crate::ast::ModuleUse],
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
        Result<bool, Failure>,
        Result<bool, Failure>,
    )>()?;
    let mut aliases = context.program.module_uses.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<(
            &Invoice,
            &Invoice,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            Option<&crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            Option<&crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
            &crate::ast::ModuleUse,
            &crate::ast::ModuleUse,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &String,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            &str,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            bool,
            bool,
            Result<(), Failure>,
            Result<(), Failure>,
        )>()?;
        let Some(alias) = aliases.next() else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        invoice.work(
            alias
                .alias
                .len()
                .saturating_add(function.name.len())
                .saturating_add(1),
        )?;
        if str::eq(alias.alias.as_str(), function.name.as_str()) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
}
//! Whole primitive-signature constructor remains executable beside local records.
use super::{ordinary, Context, Failure, Invoice};
use crate::ast::{Program, Type, TypeDeclarationKind};
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;
use crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection::{call_carriers, shared_local_callees};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

const SOURCE: &str = r#"module record.local;
use function @id("remote") from record.provider as remote;
@id("leaf") record Leaf { @id("leaf.n") n:i64, }
@id("outer") record Outer { @id("outer.leaf") leaf:Leaf, }
@id("read") fn read(v:borrow Leaf)->i64{v.n}
@id("caller") fn caller(v:borrow Outer)->i64{read(v.leaf)+read(v.leaf)}
@id("main") fn main()->i64{0}
"#;
fn programs() -> [Program; 2] {
    [
        crate::parse(SOURCE, "record.spx").unwrap(),
        crate::parse(
            "module record.provider; @id(\"remote\") fn remote()->i64{0}",
            "provider.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    ]
}
fn context<'a>(p: &'a [Program], i: &'a shared_local_callees::Index<'a>) -> Context<'a, 'a> {
    Context {
        program: &p[0],
        authored: i,
        programs: p,
    }
}

#[test]
fn nested_local_record_project_calls_share_only_the_callee_identity_slot() {
    let p = programs();
    let sources = p
        .iter()
        .map(|program| crate::workspace_graph::WorkspaceSource {
            path: program.path.clone(),
            source: crate::format::canonical(program),
        })
        .collect();
    crate::workspace_graph::build_owned(sources).unwrap();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let c = context(&p, &i);
    for imports in [true, false] {
        let (data, slots) = call_carriers::count_modular(c, imports).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(slots.slots, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            data.roots,
            call_carriers::count(c.program, &i, imports).roots
        );
    }
    // Entire immediate-old constructor, not a restated eligibility predicate.
    let mut old = None;
    shared_local_callees::modular_session::record_before::Session::observe(
        &mut old,
        c,
        &p[0].functions[1],
        &p[0].functions[0],
        1,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        shared_local_callees::modular_session::record_before::Session::checkpoint(&old),
        0
    );
    shared_local_callees::modular_session::record_before::Session::rollback(&mut old, 0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        shared_local_callees::modular_session::record_before::Session::finish(old, c)
            .unwrap()
            .slots,
        0
    );
}

#[test]
fn recursive_generic_unknown_nonrecord_and_import_alias_signatures_remain_unproved() {
    for attack in 0..7 {
        let mut p = programs();
        match attack {
            0 => {
                if let TypeDeclarationKind::Record { fields } = &mut p[0].types[0].kind {
                    fields[0].ty = Type::Named {
                        name: "Outer".into(),
                        arguments: vec![],
                    };
                }
            }
            1 => p[0].types[0].explicit_id = false,
            2 => p[0].types[0].invariants = Some(Box::new(vec![])),
            3 => p[0].types[0].extends = Some(Type::I64),
            4 => p[0].types[0].kind = TypeDeclarationKind::Resource { lifecycles: vec![] },
            5 => p[0].types[0].name = "Unknown".into(),
            _ => {
                let mut alias = p[0].module_uses[0].clone();
                alias.alias = "Leaf".into();
                p[0].module_uses.push(alias);
            }
        }
        let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
        for imports in [false, true] {
            assert_eq!(
                call_carriers::count_modular(context(&p, &i), imports)
                    .unwrap()
                    .1
                    .slots,
                0,
                "attack={attack}"
            );
        }
    }
    let mut p = programs();
    p[0] = crate::parse(
        &SOURCE.replace("record Leaf {", "record Leaf<T> {"),
        "record.spx",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        call_carriers::count_modular(context(&p, &i), false)
            .unwrap()
            .1
            .slots,
        0
    );
}

#[test]
fn copied_type_wrong_kind_provider_or_source_never_authenticate_a_record_loan() {
    let p = programs();
    let copied = p[0].types[0].clone();
    for attack in 0..4 {
        let mut i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
        let target = i.get_mut("leaf").unwrap();
        match attack {
            0 => target.ty = Some(&copied),
            1 => target.kind = crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind::Function,
            2 => target.module = "record.provider",
            _ => target.path = "other.spx",
        }
        assert_eq!(
            call_carriers::count_modular(context(&p, &i), false)
                .unwrap()
                .1
                .slots,
            0
        );
    }
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let foreign = [p[0].clone(), p[1].clone()];
    let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
    assert!(!ordinary(
        Context {
            program: &p[0],
            authored: &i,
            programs: &foreign
        },
        &p[0].functions[0],
        &invoice
    )
    .unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn record_constructor_exact_short_zero_foreign_sticky_and_full_drop() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let c = context(&p, &i);
    let run = |limit| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                let result = call_carriers::count_modular(c, false);
                let ok = result.is_ok();
                drop(result);
                if !ok {
                    assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
                }
                ok
            })
        })
    };
    let ((ok, a), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX);
    assert!(ok && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert_eq!(a.live, 0);
    assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
    for (limit, expected) in [(paid, true), (paid - 1, false), (0, false)] {
        let ((ok, a), refused, _, first) = run(limit);
        assert_eq!(ok, expected);
        assert_eq!(refused, !expected);
        assert_eq!(first.is_some(), !expected);
        assert!(!a.invalid && a.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(a.allocated, a.freed);
    }
    let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        let ((), inner_refused, paid, selected) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            assert_eq!(
                ordinary(c, &p[0].functions[0], &invoice),
                Err(Failure::Foreign)
            );
        });
        assert!(!inner_refused && selected.is_none());
        assert_eq!(paid, 0);
        assert_eq!(
            ordinary(c, &p[0].functions[0], &invoice),
            Err(Failure::Physical)
        );
        assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
    });
    assert!(refused && first.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn optional_cycle_walk_exhaustion_cannot_publish_a_partial_record_certificate() {
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let c = context(&p, &i);
    let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        invoice.work(shared_local_callees::WORK + 1),
        Err(Failure::Work)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        ordinary(c, &p[0].functions[0], &invoice),
        Err(Failure::Work)
    );
    let mut held = None;
    shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session::observe(
        &mut held,
        c,
        &p[0].functions[1],
        &p[0].functions[0],
        1,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        held.as_ref()
            .unwrap()
            .invoice
            .work(shared_local_callees::WORK + 1),
        Err(Failure::Work)
    );
    shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session::observe(
        &mut held,
        c,
        &p[0].functions[1],
        &p[0].functions[2],
        0,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session::checkpoint(&held),
        0
    );
    shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session::rollback(&mut held, 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        shared_local_callees::modular_session::Session::finish(held, c)
            .unwrap()
            .slots,
        0
    );
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn restore(
    path: &str,
    current: &str,
) -> String {
    let packet: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("record_signature_inverse.json")).unwrap();
    let canonical = if path.starts_with("src/") {
        path.to_owned()
    } else {
        format!("src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/{path}")
    };
    let Some(entry) = packet["entries"].get(&canonical) else {
        return current.to_owned();
    };
    let hash = |s: &str| {
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(s.as_bytes()))
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(hash(current), entry["current_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    let mut raw = current.to_owned();
    for splice in entry["splices"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let after = splice["current"].as_str().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(raw.matches(after).count(), 1);
        raw = raw.replacen(after, splice["prior"].as_str().unwrap(), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(hash(&raw), entry["prior_sha256"].as_str().unwrap());
    raw
}
#[test]
fn complete_immediate_old_session_census_and_executable_constructor_are_exact() {
    for (path, raw, prior) in [
        (
            "shared_local_callees/modular_session.rs",
            include_str!("modular_session.rs"),
            include_str!("record_session.before.txt"),
        ),
        (
            "shared_local_callees/modular_census.rs",
            include_str!("modular_census.rs"),
            include_str!("record_census.before.txt"),
        ),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(restore(path, raw), prior);
    }
    let tail="\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[path = \"modular_tests.rs\"]\npub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) mod tests;\n";
    assert_eq!(
        include_str!("record_before.rs"),
        include_str!("record_session.before.txt")
            .strip_suffix(tail)
            .unwrap()
    );
}

#[test]
fn full_old_forecasters_remain_independent_and_all_nonidentity_terms_match() {
    use crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection::{
        before_shared_local_projection, cached_exact, dependency_identity_max,
        HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
    };
    let p = programs();
    let i = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&p).unwrap();
    let maximum = Some(dependency_identity_max(&p[0], &i, &p).unwrap());
    let old_pair =
        shared_local_callees::paired::estimates(&p[0], &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None).unwrap();
    let current_pair =
        shared_local_callees::modular_pair::estimates(&p[0], &i, &p, maximum, 6, true, None)
            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR, 16);
    for (imports, old, current) in [
        (true, old_pair.0, current_pair.0),
        (false, old_pair.1, current_pair.1),
    ] {
        let baseline = before_shared_local_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
            &p[0], &i, &p, maximum, imports, (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed), None,
        ).unwrap();
        for observed in [&old, &current] {
            assert_eq!(observed.synthetic_ast, baseline.synthetic_ast);
            assert_eq!(observed.runtime, baseline.runtime);
            assert_eq!(
                observed.transient_import_clone,
                baseline.transient_import_clone
            );
        }
        // Observe the whole old baseline and immediate predecessor; this
        // reports the actual fee tradeoff and makes no unmeasured gain claim.
        eprintln!(
            "local-record imports={imports} pre916={} immediateold={} current={}",
            baseline.retained_hir, old.retained_hir, current.retained_hir
        );
    }
}
//! A local record signature authenticates only a callee-ID constructor.
//! It grants no nominal, field, expression, cleanup or import-edge discount.
use super::super::{Context, Failure, Invoice, MAX_FRAMES};
use crate::ast::{Function, ModuleUse, Param, Program, Type, TypeDeclaration, TypeDeclarationKind};
use crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind;

type Ancestry<'p> = [Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>; MAX_FRAMES];
type ResultBool = Result<bool, Failure>;
// Every receiving boundary below is paid before forming/traversing it. The
// ancestry owns immutable loans; pointer equality detects a cycle only AFTER
// declaration/source/provider authentication, never grants identity authority.
type Signature<'p, 'a> = (
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    &'p Function,
    &'p Function,
    &'p Invoice,
    &'p Invoice,
    Ancestry<'p>,
    Ancestry<'p>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::TypeParameterDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::TypeParameterDeclaration>,
    &'p mut Ancestry<'p>,
    &'p mut Ancestry<'p>,
    &'p Vec<Param>,
    &'p Vec<Param>,
    &'p [Param],
    &'p [Param],
    &'p [Param],
    &'p [Param],
    std::slice::Iter<'p, Param>,
    std::slice::Iter<'p, Param>,
    &'p Type,
    &'p Type,
    ResultBool,
    ResultBool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
);
type Parameter<'p> = (
    &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, Param>,
    &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, Param>,
    Option<&'p Param>,
    Option<&'p Param>,
    &'p Param,
    &'p Param,
    &'p Type,
    &'p Type,
    ResultBool,
    ResultBool,
);
type Visit<'p, 'a> = (
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    &'p Type,
    &'p Type,
    &'p Invoice,
    &'p Invoice,
    &'p mut Ancestry<'p>,
    &'p mut Ancestry<'p>,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    ResultBool,
    ResultBool,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p Vec<Type>,
    &'p Vec<Type>,
    &'p Vec<ModuleUse>,
    &'p Vec<ModuleUse>,
    &'p [ModuleUse],
    &'p [ModuleUse],
    &'p [ModuleUse],
    &'p [ModuleUse],
    std::slice::Iter<'p, ModuleUse>,
    std::slice::Iter<'p, ModuleUse>,
    &'p Vec<TypeDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<TypeDeclaration>,
    &'p [TypeDeclaration],
    &'p [TypeDeclaration],
    &'p [TypeDeclaration],
    &'p [TypeDeclaration],
    std::slice::Iter<'p, TypeDeclaration>,
    std::slice::Iter<'p, TypeDeclaration>,
    Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
    Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
    Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
    Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
);
// String equality/length receivers, iterator result and next receivers are
// independent from the held declaration/alias loans and from their payloads.
type NameStep<'p, T> = (
    &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, T>,
    &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, T>,
    Option<&'p T>,
    Option<&'p T>,
    &'p T,
    &'p T,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p String,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    &'p str,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
    ResultBool,
    ResultBool,
);

#[allow(
    clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
    reason = "direct discriminants preserve separately prepaid receiver boundaries"
)]
pub(super) fn ordinary(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    function: &Function,
    invoice: &Invoice,
) -> ResultBool {
    invoice.pay::<Signature<'_, '_>>()?;
    if !function.explicit_id
        || !function.type_parameters.is_empty()
        || matches!(function.yields, Some(_))
        || matches!(function.follows, Some(_))
    {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let mut ancestry = [None; MAX_FRAMES];
    if !visit(context, &function.return_type, invoice, &mut ancestry, 0)? {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let mut parameters = function.params.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<Parameter<'_>>()?;
        let Some(parameter) = parameters.next() else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        invoice.work(1)?;
        if !visit(context, &parameter.ty, invoice, &mut ancestry, 0)? {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
}

#[allow(
    clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
    reason = "direct discriminants preserve separately prepaid receiver boundaries"
)]
fn visit<'p>(
    context: Context<'p, '_>,
    ty: &Type,
    invoice: &Invoice,
    ancestry: &mut Ancestry<'p>,
    depth: usize,
) -> ResultBool {
    invoice.pay::<Visit<'_, '_>>()?;
    invoice.work(1)?;
    let (name, arguments) = match ty {
        Type::I64
        | Type::I32
        | Type::U8
        | Type::Usize
        | Type::Char
        | Type::F32
        | Type::F64
        | Type::Bool
        | Type::String
        | Type::Bytes
        | Type::Str
        | Type::SliceU8 => return Ok(true),
        Type::Named { name, arguments } => (name, arguments),
        _ => return Ok(false),
    };
    if !arguments.is_empty() || depth >= MAX_FRAMES {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let mut aliases = context.program.module_uses.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<NameStep<'_, ModuleUse>>()?;
        let Some(alias) = aliases.next() else {
            break;
        };
        invoice.work(
            name.len()
                .saturating_add(alias.alias.len())
                .saturating_add(1),
        )?;
        if str::eq(name.as_str(), alias.alias.as_str()) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
    let mut declarations = context.program.types.iter();
    let mut found = None;
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<NameStep<'_, TypeDeclaration>>()?;
        let Some(declaration) = declarations.next() else {
            break;
        };
        invoice.work(
            name.len()
                .saturating_add(declaration.name.len())
                .saturating_add(1),
        )?;
        if str::eq(name.as_str(), declaration.name.as_str()) {
            if matches!(found, Some(_)) {
                return Ok(false);
            }
            found = Some(declaration);
        }
    }
    let Some(declaration) = found else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    if !authenticate(context, declaration, invoice)? {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    // A complete current source loan is now established. The ancestry only
    // rejects re-entry into that exact immutable declaration on this path.
    let mut index = 0;
    while index < depth {
        invoice.pay::<(
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            usize,
            bool,
            bool,
            &Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
            &Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
            &TypeDeclaration,
            &TypeDeclaration,
            &TypeDeclaration,
            &TypeDeclaration,
        )>()?;
        invoice.work(1)?;
        if matches!(ancestry[index], Some(prior) if std::ptr::eq(prior, declaration)) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    let TypeDeclarationKind::Record { fields } = &declaration.kind else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    invoice.pay::<(
        &TypeDeclarationKind,
        &TypeDeclarationKind,
        &Vec<crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
        &Vec<crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
        &[crate::ast::FieldDeclaration],
        &[crate::ast::FieldDeclaration],
        &[crate::ast::FieldDeclaration],
        &[crate::ast::FieldDeclaration],
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
        std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
        Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
        Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
        &mut Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
        &mut Option<&TypeDeclaration>,
    )>()?;
    ancestry[depth] = Some(declaration);
    let mut fields = fields.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<(
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
            Option<&crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
            Option<&crate::ast::FieldDeclaration>,
            &crate::ast::FieldDeclaration,
            &crate::ast::FieldDeclaration,
        )>()?;
        invoice.pay::<(&Type, &Type, ResultBool, ResultBool, usize, usize)>()?;
        let Some(field) = fields.next() else {
            break;
        };
        invoice.work(1)?;
        if !visit(context, &field.ty, invoice, ancestry, depth + 1)? {
            ancestry[depth] = None;
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
    ancestry[depth] = None;
    Ok(true)
}

#[allow(
    clippy::redundant_pattern_matching,
    reason = "direct discriminants preserve separately prepaid receiver boundaries"
)]
fn authenticate(
    context: Context<'_, '_>,
    declaration: &TypeDeclaration,
    invoice: &Invoice,
) -> ResultBool {
    use crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredDeclaration;
    type Auth<'p, 'a> = (
        Context<'p, 'a>,
        Context<'p, 'a>,
        &'p TypeDeclaration,
        &'p TypeDeclaration,
        &'p Invoice,
        &'p Invoice,
        &'p Program,
        &'p Program,
        &'p [Program],
        &'p [Program],
        std::slice::Iter<'p, Program>,
        std::slice::Iter<'p, Program>,
        &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, Program>,
        &'p mut std::slice::Iter<'p, Program>,
        Option<&'p Program>,
        Option<&'p Program>,
        bool,
        bool,
        bool,
        bool,
        &'p Vec<crate::ast::TypeParameterDeclaration>,
        &'p Vec<crate::ast::TypeParameterDeclaration>,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p String,
        &'p String,
        usize,
        usize,
        usize,
        usize,
        &'p super::super::Index<'a>,
        &'p super::super::Index<'a>,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p str,
        &'p String,
        &'p String,
        Option<&'p AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
        Option<&'p AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
        &'p AuthoredDeclaration<'a>,
        &'p AuthoredDeclaration<'a>,
        Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
        Option<&'p TypeDeclaration>,
        &'p TypeDeclaration,
        &'p TypeDeclaration,
        ResultBool,
        ResultBool,
        usize,
        usize,
        usize,
        usize,
    );
    invoice.pay::<Auth<'_, '_>>()?;
    let mut providers = context.programs.iter();
    let mut present = false;
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<(
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, Program>,
            &mut std::slice::Iter<'_, Program>,
            Option<&Program>,
            Option<&Program>,
            &Program,
            &Program,
            &Program,
            &Program,
            *const Program,
            *const Program,
            bool,
            bool,
        )>()?;
        let Some(provider) = providers.next() else {
            break;
        };
        invoice.work(1)?;
        if std::ptr::eq(provider, context.program) {
            present = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if !present
        || !declaration.explicit_id
        || !declaration.type_parameters.is_empty()
        || matches!(declaration.extends, Some(_))
        || matches!(declaration.invariants, Some(_))
    {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    invoice.work(
        declaration
            .stable_id
            .len()
            .saturating_add(context.authored.len())
            .saturating_add(1),
    )?;
    let Some(target) = context.authored.get(declaration.stable_id.as_str()) else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    let Some(held) = target.ty else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    Ok(matches!(target.kind, AuthoredKind::Type)
        && target.explicit
        && target.module == context.program.module
        && target.path == context.program.path
        && std::ptr::eq(held, declaration))
}

    )
}
