//! Uncached coupled census; the complete immediate-old estimate stays live.
//! Only local-callee acquisition changes. Fixed/nominal/expression/writer and
//! all sixteen identity copies retain their original independent equations.
use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    generic_instance_source_cost, hir, import_stub, limit_error, prelude, private_layout,
    synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite, AuthoredDeclaration, BTreeMap, BTreeSet, Diagnostic,
    ModuleUseKind, Program, StructuralCost, SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn estimate<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    layout_mode: u8,
    include_imports: bool,
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    if layout_mode != 6 {
        return Err(vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())]);
    }
    let core = None;
    let retention = cached_exact::Retention::Parsed;
    let mut raw = StructuralCost::raw_ast(layout_mode >= 1).with_inline_values(layout_mode >= 2);
    ast_program_cost(program, &mut raw, include_imports)?;
    let (call_data, shared_callees) = super::super::call_carriers::count_joint(
        super::super::shared_local_callees::Context {
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
        },
        include_imports,
    )?;
    raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = call_data.roots;
    let call_proof = call_data.bytes;
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut identity_slots = ast_program_identity_slots(program)?;
    let mut runtime = StructuralCost::new();
    let mut default_memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut transient_import_clone = 0usize;
    layout.add_costs(
        program,
        programs,
        &mut raw,
        &mut runtime,
        &mut identity_slots,
    )?;
    for module_use in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| include_imports) {
        if module_use.kind == ModuleUseKind::Protocol {
            continue;
        }
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        runtime.string(&module_use.alias)?;
        if let Some(function) = target.function {
            // `synthetic_program` retains an imported function as a stub: the
            // signature it rewrites, with `requires` and `ensures` cleared and
            // the body replaced by the return type's default expression. Only
            // the retained signature is charged here; the default body is
            // charged as runtime cost below. The provider's own contract and
            // body reach the resolver exactly once, through the defining
            // module's own `ast_program_cost`.
            ast_function_signature_cost(function, &mut raw)?;
            // Preserve old fitting receipts even though ordinary stubs now
            // clone only their signature. The historical transient-body debit
            // remains conservative; only mode 4 removes its peak after all
            // older estimates refuse. Intrinsic wrapper bodies are separately
            // charged as retained runtime structures below.
            transient_import_clone =
                transient_import_clone.max(ast_function_contract_cost(function)?.total);
            if programs
                .iter()
                .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
                .is_some_and(|provider| {
                    crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                        || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                })
            {
                ast_function_cost(function, &mut runtime)?;
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_function_identity_slots(function)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_identity_slots(&function.return_type)?,
            )?;
            for param in &function.params {
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_type_identity_slots(&param.ty)?)?;
                type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                    &param.ty,
                    target.module,
                    program,
                    programs,
                    &mut runtime,
                    Some(layout),
                )?;
            }
            type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                &function.return_type,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            let cost = import_stub::default_expr_expanded_cost_with_layout(
                function,
                target.module,
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
                &mut default_memo,
                &mut BTreeSet::new(),
                super::super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                    program, target, authored, programs, layout,
                ),
                import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                    function,
                    target.module,
                    byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
                )?,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            runtime.add_split(cost.bytes, cost.string_bytes)?;
            runtime.add_identity_carriers(cost.identity_carriers)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, cost.identity_slots)?;
        } else {
            let declaration = target.ty.expect("validated type target");
            ast_type_declaration_cost(declaration, &mut raw)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_declaration_identity_slots(declaration)?,
            )?;
            super::super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_runtime_cost_with_layout(
                declaration,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if !program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        let synthetic_main = synthetic_main_runtime_cost(&program.module)?;
        runtime.add_split(synthetic_main.total, synthetic_main.string_bytes)?;
        runtime.add_identity_carriers(synthetic_main.identity_carriers)?;
    }
    if layout_mode >= 2 {
        identity_slots = identity_slots
            .checked_sub(call_identity::discount_with_imports(
                program,
                authored,
                include_imports,
            ))
            .expect("scalar calls retain their expression and callee identity slots");
    }
    identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(raw.scalar_identity_discount)
        .expect("raw scalar discount retains each expression identity slot");
    let generic_instances = generic_instance_source_cost(program)?;
    identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, generic_instances.identity_slots)?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        runtime.total,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        hir_input,
        generic_instances.bytes,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(raw.string_bytes, runtime.string_bytes)?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(string_input, generic_instances.string_bytes)?;
    // String contents are part of `hir_input`; only the remaining structural
    // bytes expand by the structural factor.
    let structure_input = hir_input.saturating_sub(string_input);
    let fixed_hir_upper = structure_input
        .checked_mul(HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
        .and_then(|structure| {
            string_input
                .checked_mul(HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|strings| structure.checked_add(strings))
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let maximum_identity_bytes = maximum_identity.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        authored
            .keys()
            .map(|id| id.len())
            .chain(prelude::all_ids().into_iter().map(str::len))
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
    });
    #[cfg(test)]
    let prior_fixed_hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper;
    let fixed_hir_upper = if layout_mode == cached_exact::MODE {
        cached_exact::fixed_upper(fixed_hir_upper, &raw, &runtime, retention)?
    } else {
        fixed_hir_upper
            .checked_sub(cost::fixed_hir_discount(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?)
            .expect("literal storage discount retains the complete reduced fixed bundle")
    };
    // Only the final uncached route has no semantic-cache serialization owner.
    // This independently paid source certificate concerns local callee backing,
    // not the auxiliary-carrier absence counter, BASE, or an expression ID.
    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)
        .expect("a certified raw call retains its callee slot until this separate proof");
    let identity_occurrence_upper = identity_slots
        .checked_mul(maximum_identity_bytes)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // Heap carriers are prebound independently of inline layouts and shared clones.
    let identity_carriers = cost::identity_carriers(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?;
    let identity_carriers =
        checked_builder_sum(identity_carriers, generic_instances.identity_carriers)?;
    let identity_carrier_bytes = identity_carriers
        .checked_mul(hir::ExpressionId::SHARED_ALLOCATION_CARRIER_BYTES)
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // The resolver's source chain also retains the compiler-owned base
    // variants. They are absent from synthetic AST and cannot spend an authored
    // expression discount. Borrow their producer metadata, without warming or
    // constructing the process prelude table during estimation.
    let prelude_hir_upper = super::super::prelude_forecast::retained_upper(
        &prelude::base_schema::BASE,
        maximum_identity_bytes,
    )?;
    let hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper
        .checked_add(call_proof)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(shared_callees.bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(prelude_hir_upper))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_carrier_bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_occurrence_upper))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let retained_clone_and_hir = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        hir_upper,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    #[cfg(test)]
    let original_mode7_fixed_upper = raw
        .exact_expressions
        .checked_add(runtime.exact_expressions)
        .and_then(|count| {
            count
                .checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_FIXED_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<crate::ast::Expr>()))
                .and_then(|old| prior_fixed_hir_upper.checked_sub(old))
                .and_then(|base| {
                    count
                        .checked_mul(if retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic {
                            2
                        } else {
                            1
                        })
                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
                        .and_then(|exact| base.checked_add(exact))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::super::forecast_observation::record_components(
        &program.path,
        layout_mode,
        retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
        include_imports,
        [
            raw.total,
            raw.string_bytes,
            raw.exact_expressions,
            raw.literal_fixed_discount,
            runtime.total,
            runtime.string_bytes,
            runtime.exact_expressions,
            structure_input,
            string_input,
            prior_fixed_hir_upper,
            fixed_hir_upper,
            identity_occurrence_upper,
            identity_carrier_bytes,
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            generic_instances.bytes,
            transient_import_clone,
            original_mode7_fixed_upper,
            prelude_hir_upper,
            hir_upper,
        ],
    );
    let result = SyntheticBuilderCosts {
        raw_clone_and_hir: checked_usage(
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            transient_import_clone,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
        retained_clone_and_hir,
        transient_import_clone,
        runtime: runtime.total,
        retained_hir: hir_upper,
        synthetic_ast: checked_usage(
            raw.total,
            runtime.total,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
    };
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(result)
}
//! Actual uncached route, both whole predecessors, and independent source scopes.
use super::super::super::{
    before_shared_local_projection as before, cached_exact, dependency_identity_max,
    held_projection, shared_local_callees, uncached_peak, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
};
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

fn hash_explicit_import_stage(source: &str) -> String {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    format!(
        "{:x}",
        crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(source.as_bytes()))
    )
}

fn source(headers: usize, calls: usize) -> String {
    let mut source =
        String::from("module loan.local; @id(\"loan.helper\") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{x}\n");
    for i in 1..headers - 1 {
        source.push_str(&format!(
            "@id(\"loan.unused.{i}\") fn unused_{i}()->i64{{0}}\n"
        ));
    }
    source.push_str("@id(\"loan.main\") fn main()->i64{");
    source.push_str(
        &std::iter::repeat_n("helper(1)", calls)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("+"),
    );
    source.push('}');
    source
}
fn context<'a>(programs: &'a [Program], authored: &'a Index<'a>) -> Context<'a, 'a> {
    Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored,
        programs,
    }
}

#[test]
fn linear_and_indexed_joint_forecasts_keep_both_complete_predecessor_equations() {
    for headers in [2, 64, 129] {
        for calls in [1, 64] {
            let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source(headers, calls), "loan.spx").unwrap()];
            let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
            let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
            let maximum = dependency_identity_max(ctx.program, &authored, &programs).unwrap();
            let old_slots = shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap();
            for imports in [false, true] {
                let raw = super::super::count(ctx.program, &authored, imports);
                let (auxiliary, local) = count(ctx, imports).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(
                    auxiliary.roots, raw.roots,
                    "auxiliary proof remains separate"
                );
                assert_eq!(local.slots, calls);
                assert!(local.slots <= old_slots.slots);
                let baseline = before::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                    ctx.program,
                    &authored,
                    &programs,
                    Some(maximum),
                    imports,
                    (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
                    None,
                )
                .unwrap();
                let old =
                    held_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                        ctx.program,
                        &authored,
                        &programs,
                        Some(maximum),
                        imports,
                        (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
                        None,
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                let now = held_projection::coupled_uncached_estimate(
                    ctx.program,
                    &authored,
                    &programs,
                    Some(maximum),
                    6,
                    imports,
                    None,
                )
                .unwrap();
                let unit = maximum * HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR;
                assert_eq!(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR, 16);
                assert_eq!(
                    old.retained_hir + old_slots.slots * unit,
                    baseline.retained_hir + old_slots.bytes
                );
                assert_eq!(
                    now.retained_hir + local.slots * unit + raw.bytes,
                    baseline.retained_hir + auxiliary.bytes + local.bytes
                );
                assert_eq!(
                    now.retained_clone_and_hir + local.slots * unit + raw.bytes,
                    baseline.retained_clone_and_hir + auxiliary.bytes + local.bytes
                );
                // This records the actual result, including a negative gain.
                // Removing the old optional-proof fee is not a baseline win.
                eprintln!("local-reuse headers={headers} calls={calls} imports={imports} baseline={} old={} current={} certificate={} slots={} traversal_old={} traversal_new={}",
                    baseline.retained_hir, old.retained_hir, now.retained_hir,
                    local.bytes, local.slots, raw.bytes, auxiliary.bytes);
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn actual_uncached_tiny_repeated_shipping_path_and_complete_proof_drop_are_observed() {
    for calls in [1, 64] {
        let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source(2, calls), "loan.spx").unwrap()];
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
        let (((aux, local), allocation), refused, charged, first) =
            with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || measure(|| count(ctx, true).unwrap()));
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none() && !allocation.invalid);
        assert_eq!(charged, local.bytes);
        assert_eq!(local.slots, calls);
        assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
        let ((layout, allocation), refused, charged, first) =
            with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                measure(|| uncached_peak::uncached_output_layout(&programs, &authored).unwrap())
            });
        assert!(!refused && first.is_none() && !allocation.invalid);
        assert_eq!(layout.order[0], 0);
        let maximum = dependency_identity_max(ctx.program, &authored, &programs).unwrap();
        let estimate = |imports, predecessor| match predecessor {
            0 => {
                before::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                    ctx.program,
                    &authored,
                    &programs,
                    Some(maximum),
                    imports,
                    (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
                    None,
                )
                .unwrap()
                .retained_hir
            }
            1 => {
                held_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                    ctx.program,
                    &authored,
                    &programs,
                    Some(maximum),
                    imports,
                    (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
                    None,
                )
                .unwrap()
                .retained_hir
            }
            _ => {
                let (full, retained) = shared_local_callees::paired::estimates(
                    ctx.program,
                    &authored,
                    &programs,
                    Some(maximum),
                    6,
                    true,
                    None,
                )
                .unwrap();
                if imports {
                    full.retained_hir
                } else {
                    retained.retained_hir
                }
            }
        };
        // One module has no preceding retention: the real shipping peak is
        // exactly max(full, retained), rather than merely a positive number.
        let original = estimate(true, 0).max(estimate(false, 0));
        let immediate = estimate(true, 1).max(estimate(false, 1));
        let expected = estimate(true, 2).max(estimate(false, 2));
        assert_eq!(layout.forecast, expected);
        for limit in [expected, expected - 1, 0] {
            let ((result, allocation), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
                measure(|| {
                    let result = uncached_peak::uncached_output_layout(&programs, &authored);
                    let success = result.is_ok();
                    drop(result);
                    success
                })
            });
            assert_eq!(result, limit == expected, "real shipping frontier {limit}");
            assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
            assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
            if limit == 0 {
                assert!(
                    refused && first.is_some(),
                    "physical zero refusal remains sticky"
                );
            }
        }
        eprintln!("actual-one-module-shipping calls={calls} pre916={original} immediate2a={immediate} candidate={expected}");
        assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
        eprintln!("uncached-local-reuse calls={calls} forecast={} actual_paid={charged} allocated={} highwater={} proof={} traversal={}",
            layout.forecast, allocation.allocated, allocation.highwater, local.bytes, aux.bytes);
    }
}

#[test]
fn real_joint_lender_exact_short_zero_and_sticky_drop() {
    let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source(2, 64), "loan.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    let run = |limit| {
        with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                let result = count(ctx, true);
                let success = result.is_ok();
                drop(result);
                if !success {
                    assert!(!reserve_active_required(0));
                }
                success
            })
        })
    };
    let ((success, allocation), refused, paid, first) = run(usize::MAX);
    assert!(success && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    let ((success, allocation), refused, exact, first) = run(paid);
    assert!(success && !refused && first.is_none());
    assert_eq!(exact, paid);
    assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
    for limit in [0, paid - 1] {
        let ((success, allocation), refused, _, first) = run(limit);
        assert!(!success && refused && first.is_some());
        assert!(!allocation.invalid && allocation.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
    }
}

#[test]
fn unknown_shadow_generic_contract_and_default_routes_never_inflate_local_slots() {
    let source = source(2, 1);
    for source in [
        source.replace("{helper(1)}", "{let helper=1;helper(1)}"),
        source.replace("{helper(1)}", "{let x=match 1{0=>helper(1),_=>0,};0}"),
        source.replace("fn helper(x:i64)", "fn helper<T>(x:i64)"),
        source.replace("fn main()->i64", "fn main()->i64 requires helper(1)>0"),
        source.replace("@id(\"loan.helper\")", ""),
    ] {
        let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source, "hostile-loan.spx").unwrap()];
        // Malformed parser-only cases authenticate their exact raw source;
        // they never assert language or provider admission.
        let mut authored = Index::new();
        for program in &programs {
            for function in &program.functions {
                authored.insert(
                    function.stable_id.as_str(),
                    AuthoredDeclaration {
                        path: &program.path,
                        module: &program.module,
                        explicit: function.explicit_id,
                        kind: crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind::Function,
                        function: Some(function),
                        ty: None,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
        let old = shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap();
        let (aux, current) = count(ctx, false).unwrap();
        assert!(current.slots <= old.slots);
        assert_eq!(
            aux.roots,
            super::super::count(ctx.program, &authored, false).roots
        );
    }
}

        let bytes = Self::setup_bytes()

#[test]
fn coupled_estimate_retains_the_whole_old_algorithm_and_rejects_other_modes() {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let source_owned = shared_local_callees::paired::tests::restore(
        "shared_local_callees/coupled_projection.rs",
        include_str!("coupled_projection.rs"),
    );
    let _historical_coupled = source_owned.as_str();
    let source = include_str!("coupled_projection.rs");
    assert_eq!(
        (source.len(), hash_explicit_import_stage(source)),
        (
            14427,
            "f95beb41205dc47d5707ed4f189bf04dacde802016039e6b335be04b3bf213ef".to_owned()
        )
    );
    let declaration = r######"use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    generic_instance_source_cost, hir, import_stub, limit_error, prelude, private_layout,
    synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite, AuthoredDeclaration, BTreeMap, BTreeSet, Diagnostic,
    ModuleUseKind, Program, StructuralCost, SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};"######;
    assert_eq!(source.matches(declaration).count(), 1);
    let mut acquired = source.replacen(declaration, "use super::*;", 1);
    let compact = r######"                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
"######;
    let expanded = r######"                        .and_then(|n| {
                            n.checked_mul(super::super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE)
                        })
"######;
    assert_eq!(acquired.matches(compact).count(), 1);
    acquired = acquired.replacen(compact, expanded, 1);
    assert_eq!(
        (acquired.len(), hash_explicit_import_stage(&acquired)),
        (
            13789,
            "398e439602aab6dcfb3835923c9e9db42c9f5556b7167fd45be00d93eed3113e".to_owned()
        )
    );
    let source = acquired.as_str();
    let start = source.find("    if layout_mode != 6 {").unwrap();
    let end = source.rfind("\n}").unwrap();
    let mut body = source[start..end].replace("super::super::", "super::");
    let changed = r#####"    if layout_mode != 6 {
        return Err(vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())]);
    }
    let core = None;
    let retention = cached_exact::Retention::Parsed;
"#####;
    let old = r#####"    let (registry, core) = proofs;
    let (layout_mode, retention) = profile;
"#####;
    assert_eq!(body.matches(changed).count(), 1);
    body = body.replacen(changed, old, 1);
    let changed = r#####"    let (call_data, shared_callees) = super::call_carriers::count_joint(
        super::shared_local_callees::Context {
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
        },
        include_imports,
    )?;
    raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = call_data.roots;
    let call_proof = call_data.bytes;
"#####;
    let old = r#####"    let call_proof = if layout_mode >= 5 {
        let proof = super::call_carriers::count(program, authored, include_imports);
        raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = proof.roots;
        proof.bytes
    } else {
        0
    };
"#####;
    assert_eq!(body.matches(changed).count(), 1);
    body = body.replacen(changed, old, 1);
    let changed = r#####"    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)"#####;
    let old = r#####"    let shared_callees = if layout_mode == 6 && retention == cached_exact::Retention::Parsed {
        super::shared_local_callees::costs(super::shared_local_callees::Context {
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
        })?
    } else {
        super::shared_local_callees::Costs { slots: 0, bytes: 0 }
    };
    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)"#####;
    assert_eq!(body.matches(changed).count(), 1);
    body = body.replacen(changed, old, 1);
    let changed = r#####"                        .and_then(|n| {
                            n.checked_mul(super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE)
                        })"#####;
    let old = r#####"                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))"#####;
    assert_eq!(body.matches(changed).count(), 1);
    body = body.replacen(changed, old, 1);
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(body.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "2ed613cad2b84da178d0a1f6101bd1f43d6dee8fcccdeb4c4122beefeb30abe9"
    );
    let programs = vec![crate::parse(&self::source(2, 1), "mode.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    for mode in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, u8::MAX] {
        assert!(held_projection::coupled_uncached_estimate(
            &programs[0],
            &authored,
            &programs,
            None,
            mode,
            true,
            None
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn nested_zero_ambiguous_and_imported_calls_preserve_independent_censuses() {
    for headers in [2, 64, 129] {
        let plain = source(headers, 1);
        let nested = plain.replace("{helper(1)}", "{helper(helper(1))}");
        let programs = [crate::parse(&nested, "nested.spx").unwrap()];
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
        let (_, candidate) = count(ctx, true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(candidate.slots, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            candidate.slots,
            shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap().slots
        );

        // Duplicate raw names have distinct authored identities. Neither the
        // linear scan nor a sorted directory may select its first occurrence.
        let mut programs = [crate::parse(&plain, "ambiguous.spx").unwrap()];
        let mut duplicate = programs[0].functions[0].clone();
        duplicate.stable_id = "loan.duplicate".into();
        programs[0].functions.push(duplicate);
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
        for imports in [false, true] {
            let (auxiliary, candidate) = count(ctx, imports).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(candidate.slots, 0);
            assert_eq!(candidate.bytes, 0, "no constructor is reached");
            assert_eq!(shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap().slots, 0);
            assert_eq!(
                auxiliary.roots,
                super::super::count(ctx.program, &authored, imports).roots
            );
        }
    }
    for body in [
        "{0}",
        "{helper<i64>(1)}",
        "{let helper=1;helper(1)}",
        "{let outer={let helper=1;helper(1)};0}",
    ] {
        let programs =
            [crate::parse(&source(2, 1).replace("{helper(1)}", body), "excluded.spx").unwrap()];
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
        let (auxiliary, candidate) = count(ctx, true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((candidate.slots, candidate.bytes), (0, 0));
        assert_eq!(shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap().slots, 0);
        assert_eq!(
            auxiliary.roots,
            super::super::count(ctx.program, &authored, true).roots
        );
    }
    let main = source(2, 1)
        .replace(
            "module loan.local;",
            "module loan.local; use function @id(\"provider.remote\") from provider as remote;",
        )
        .replace("{helper(1)}", "{remote(1)+helper(1)}");
    let programs = [
        crate::parse(&main, "consumer.spx").unwrap(),
        crate::parse(
            "module provider; @id(\"provider.remote\") fn remote(x:i64)->i64{x}",
            "provider.spx",
        )
        .unwrap(),
    ];
    let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
    let ctx = context(&programs, &authored);
    for imports in [false, true] {
        let (auxiliary, candidate) = count(ctx, imports).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (candidate.slots, candidate.bytes),
            (0, 0),
            "aliases exclude the callee certificate even when output omits imports"
        );
        assert!(candidate.slots <= shared_local_callees::costs(ctx).unwrap().slots);
        assert_eq!(
            auxiliary.roots,
            super::super::count(ctx.program, &authored, imports).roots
        );
    }
}
//! Distinct callee-constructor certificate on a borrowed lookup result.
//! No auxiliary-carrier count, name index or pointer alone grants identity scope.
use super::{
    compiler, local, ordinary, Context, Costs, Failure, Function, Index, Invoice, Program,
    MAX_HEADERS,
};
type Error = Failure;

// These loans can only be formed after the full ordinary/local source check.
// The surrounding Session owns their exact immutable Context and Invoice.
struct CheckedFunction<'p> {
    function: &'p Function,
    arity: usize,
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) struct Session<'p, 'a> {
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    invoice: Invoice,
    slots: usize,
    exhausted: bool,
    excluded: bool,
    owner: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
    target: Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
}
type Eligibility<'p> = (
    &'p Program,
    &'p Program,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<Function>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ModuleUse>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::InterfaceDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::ProtocolImplementation>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::SessionProtocolDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    &'p Vec<crate::ast::AgentDeclaration>,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
);
type Acquire<'p, 'a> = (
    Eligibility<'p>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Context<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Session<'p, 'a>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Option<Session<'p, 'a>>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    Result<Invoice, Failure>,
    usize,
    usize,
    Option<usize>,
    Result<usize, Failure>,
    bool,
);

impl<'p, 'a> Session<'p, 'a> {
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn eligible(program: &Program) -> bool {
        // Alias-free is deliberately narrower than the old lexical certificate.
        // Hidden import aliases cannot become local headers on retained-only passes.
        program.functions.len() <= MAX_HEADERS
            && program.module_uses.is_empty()
            && program.interfaces.is_empty()
            && program.protocols.is_empty()
            && program.implementations.is_empty()
            && program.session_protocols.is_empty()
            && program.agents.is_empty()
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn checkpoint(
        current: &Option<Self>,
    ) -> usize {
        current.as_ref().map_or(0, |held| held.slots)
    }

    // Closed caller prerequisite: owner and target come from this Context's
    // actual Program.functions traversal/unique Source::Function lookup. This
    // authenticates that loan; an arbitrary fabricated Index plus copied
    // Function is not a membership witness for this internal entry.
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn observe(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
        owner: &'p Function,
        target: &'p Function,
        arity: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        let result = (|| {
            if current.is_none() {
                let invoice = Invoice::acquire_with::<Acquire<'p, 'a>>()?;
                *current = Some(Self {
                    context,
                    invoice,
                    slots: 0,
                    exhausted: false,
                    excluded: !Self::eligible(context.program),
                    owner: None,
                    target: None,
                });
            }
            let held = current.as_mut().expect("fresh local certificate lender");
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                Option<usize>,
                usize,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                CheckedFunction<'p>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &CheckedFunction<'p>,
                &Option<CheckedFunction<'p>>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                &Vec<crate::ast::Param>,
                usize,
                usize,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                &Function,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            if held.excluded || held.exhausted {
                return Ok(());
            }
            // Pointer equality is only lookup of a SEALED constructor loan,
            // never its creation. No result escapes this exact lender/context;
            // both immutable source owners remain borrowed until finish.
            if !matches!(&held.owner, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, owner)) {
                if !ordinary(owner, &held.invoice)? || !local(context, owner, &held.invoice)? {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.owner = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: owner,
                    arity: owner.params.len(),
                });
            }
            if !matches!(&held.target, Some(checked) if std::ptr::eq(checked.function, target)) {
                if !ordinary(target, &held.invoice)?
                    || !local(context, target, &held.invoice)?
                    || compiler(&target.name, &held.invoice)?
                {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                held.target = Some(CheckedFunction {
                    function: target,
                    arity: target.params.len(),
                });
            }
            let Some(target) = &held.target else {
                unreachable!("authenticated target loan");
            };
            if target.arity == arity {
                held.slots = held.slots.checked_add(1).ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        match result {
            Err(Failure::Work) => {
                if let Some(held) = current {
                    held.slots = 0;
                    held.exhausted = true;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            other => other,
        }
    }

    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn rollback(
        current: &mut Option<Self>,
        before: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        if let Some(held) = current {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                &mut Self,
                &mut Self,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                &mut Option<Self>,
                usize,
                usize,
                bool,
                bool,
                Result<(), Failure>,
                Result<(), Error>,
                Result<(), Error>,
            )>()?;
            if held.exhausted {
                held.slots = 0;
            } else if before <= held.slots {
                held.slots = before;
            } else {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    #[allow(
        clippy::let_and_return,
        reason = "retain the separately invoiced receiving and returned Result owners"
    )]
    pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) fn finish(
        current: Option<Self>,
        context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    ) -> Result<Costs, Error> {
        let Some(held) = current else {
            return Ok(Costs { slots: 0, bytes: 0 });
        };
        let result = (|| {
            held.invoice.pay::<(
                Self,
                Self,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                Context<'p, 'a>,
                &Invoice,
                &Invoice,
                Costs,
                Costs,
                Result<Costs, Failure>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                Result<Costs, Error>,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Program,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &Index<'a>,
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                &[Program],
                bool,
                bool,
                bool,
            )>()?;
            if !std::ptr::eq(held.context.program, context.program)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.authored, context.authored)
                || !std::ptr::eq(held.context.programs, context.programs)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Foreign);
            }
            Ok(Costs {
                slots: held.slots,
                bytes: held.invoice.bytes(),
            })
        })();
        result
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "reused_controls.rs"]
mod tests;
//! Constructor/lender controls use real loans; no forged certificate constructor.
use super::super::WORK;
use super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{reserve_active_required, with_limit_usage_refusal};
use crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredDeclaration;
const SOURCE: &str = "module constructor.loan; @id(\"helper\") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{x} @id(\"other\") fn other()->i64{0} @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64{helper(1)}";
fn index(programs: &[Program]) -> Index<'_> {
    let mut result = Index::new();
    for program in programs {
        for function in &program.functions {
            result.insert(
                function.stable_id.as_str(),
                AuthoredDeclaration {
                    path: &program.path,
                    module: &program.module,
                    explicit: function.explicit_id,
                    kind: crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind::Function,
                    function: Some(function),
                    ty: None,
                },
            );
        }
    }
    result
}

#[test]
fn foreign_function_source_context_and_budget_cannot_reuse_constructor_loans() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "constructor.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = index(&programs);
    let foreign = index(&programs);
    let target_copy = programs[0].functions[0].clone();
    let ctx = Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored: &authored,
        programs: &programs,
    };
    let owner = &programs[0].functions[2];
    let target = &programs[0].functions[0];
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, &target_copy, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            Session::checkpoint(&current),
            1,
            "copied header is not the live Function"
        );
        let wrong = Context {
            authored: &foreign,
            ..ctx
        };
        assert!(Session::observe(&mut current, wrong, owner, target, 1).is_err());
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        let complete = Session::finish(current, ctx).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(complete.slots, 1);
        assert!(complete.bytes > 0);
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert!(Session::finish(current, wrong).is_err());
    });
    let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        let ((), inner_refused, _, inner_first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            assert!(Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).is_err());
        });
        assert!(
            !inner_refused && inner_first.is_none(),
            "foreign current lender is untouched"
        );
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        assert!(Session::finish(current, ctx).is_err());
        assert!(
            !reserve_active_required(0),
            "restoring scope cannot revive old credit"
        );
    });
    assert!(refused && first.is_some());
}

#[test]
fn incomplete_body_rollback_and_exhausted_optional_work_cannot_create_credit() {
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "constructor.spx").unwrap()];
    let authored = index(&programs);
    let ctx = Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored: &authored,
        programs: &programs,
    };
    let owner = &programs[0].functions[2];
    let target = &programs[0].functions[0];
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert!(Session::rollback(&mut current, 2).is_err());
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 1);
        let before = current.as_ref().unwrap().invoice.bytes();
        assert_eq!(
            current.as_ref().unwrap().invoice.work(WORK),
            Err(Failure::Work)
        );
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, &programs[0].functions[1], 0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 0);
        Session::rollback(&mut current, 1).unwrap();
        Session::observe(&mut current, ctx, owner, target, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::checkpoint(&current), 0);
        let final_cost = Session::finish(current, ctx).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(final_cost.slots, 0);
        assert!(final_cost.bytes > before);
        // Bounded optional source work is distinct from physical exhaustion.
        assert!(reserve_active_required(0));
    });
}

#[test]
fn direct_constructor_rejects_alias_and_forged_authored_source() {
    let mut programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "constructor.spx").unwrap()];
    // Copy a real parsed alias declaration rather than inventing an authority.
    let mut imported = crate::parse("module alias.guard; use function @id(\"external.helper\") from x.y as hidden; @id(\"m\") fn main()->i64{0}", "alias.spx").unwrap();
    {
        programs[0].module_uses = std::mem::take(&mut imported.module_uses);
        assert!(!programs[0].module_uses.is_empty());
        let authored = index(&programs);
        let ctx = Context {
            program: &programs[0],
            authored: &authored,
            programs: &programs,
        };
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            let mut current = None;
            Session::observe(
                &mut current,
                ctx,
                &programs[0].functions[2],
                &programs[0].functions[0],
                1,
            )
            .unwrap();
            let cost = Session::finish(current, ctx).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(cost.slots, 0);
            assert!(cost.bytes > 0);
        });
    }
    let programs = [crate::parse(SOURCE, "constructor.spx").unwrap()];
    let mut authored = index(&programs);
    authored.get_mut("helper").unwrap().path = "foreign.spx";
    let ctx = Context {
        program: &programs[0],
        authored: &authored,
        programs: &programs,
    };
    with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let mut current = None;
        Session::observe(
            &mut current,
            ctx,
            &programs[0].functions[2],
            &programs[0].functions[0],
            1,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(Session::finish(current, ctx).unwrap().slots, 0);
    });
}
//! Shared source-held closure consumption for forecast and synthetic construction.
use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    default_expr, generic_instance_source_cost, graph_error, import_stub, limit_error,
    private_layout, reserve_builder_structure, synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite,
    AuthoredDeclaration, StructuralCost, SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};
use crate::ast::{Expr, ExprKind, Function, ModuleUseKind, Program, Span, Type, TypeDeclaration};
use crate::bounded_output::budgeted_format;
