pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    programs: &[Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum_identity,
        include_imports,
        profile,
        (registry, None),
    )
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_core<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    proofs: (
        Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
        &mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>,
    ),
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum_identity,
        include_imports,
        profile,
        (proofs.0, Some(proofs.1)),
    )
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using<
    'a,
>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    proofs: (
        Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
        Option<&mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>>,
    ),
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let (registry, core) = proofs;
    let (layout_mode, retention) = profile;
    let mut raw = StructuralCost::raw_ast(layout_mode >= 1).with_inline_values(layout_mode >= 2);
    ast_program_cost(program, &mut raw, include_imports)?;
    let call_proof = if layout_mode >= 5 {
        let proof = super::call_carriers::count(program, authored, include_imports);
        raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = proof.roots;
        proof.bytes
    } else {
        0
    };
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut identity_slots = ast_program_identity_slots(program)?;
    let mut runtime = StructuralCost::new();
    let mut default_memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut transient_import_clone = 0usize;
    layout.add_costs(
        program,
        programs,
        &mut raw,
        &mut runtime,
        &mut identity_slots,
    )?;
    for module_use in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| include_imports) {
        if module_use.kind == ModuleUseKind::Protocol {
            continue;
        }
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        runtime.string(&module_use.alias)?;
        if let Some(function) = target.function {
            // `synthetic_program` retains an imported function as a stub: the
            // signature it rewrites, with `requires` and `ensures` cleared and
            // the body replaced by the return type's default expression. Only
            // the retained signature is charged here; the default body is
            // charged as runtime cost below. The provider's own contract and
            // body reach the resolver exactly once, through the defining
            // module's own `ast_program_cost`.
            ast_function_signature_cost(function, &mut raw)?;
            // Preserve old fitting receipts even though ordinary stubs now
            // clone only their signature. The historical transient-body debit
            // remains conservative; only mode 4 removes its peak after all
            // older estimates refuse. Intrinsic wrapper bodies are separately
            // charged as retained runtime structures below.
            transient_import_clone =
                transient_import_clone.max(ast_function_contract_cost(function)?.total);
            if programs
                .iter()
                .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
                .is_some_and(|provider| {
                    crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                        || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                })
            {
                ast_function_cost(function, &mut runtime)?;
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_function_identity_slots(function)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_identity_slots(&function.return_type)?,
            )?;
            for param in &function.params {
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_type_identity_slots(&param.ty)?)?;
                type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                    &param.ty,
                    target.module,
                    program,
                    programs,
                    &mut runtime,
                    Some(layout),
                )?;
            }
            type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                &function.return_type,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            let cost = import_stub::default_expr_expanded_cost_with_layout(
                function,
                target.module,
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
                &mut default_memo,
                &mut BTreeSet::new(),
                super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                    program, target, authored, programs, layout,
                ),
                import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                    function,
                    target.module,
                    byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
                )?,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            runtime.add_split(cost.bytes, cost.string_bytes)?;
            runtime.add_identity_carriers(cost.identity_carriers)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, cost.identity_slots)?;
        } else {
            let declaration = target.ty.expect("validated type target");
            ast_type_declaration_cost(declaration, &mut raw)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_declaration_identity_slots(declaration)?,
            )?;
            super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_runtime_cost_with_layout(
                declaration,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if !program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        let synthetic_main = synthetic_main_runtime_cost(&program.module)?;
        runtime.add_split(synthetic_main.total, synthetic_main.string_bytes)?;
        runtime.add_identity_carriers(synthetic_main.identity_carriers)?;
    }
    if layout_mode >= 2 {
        identity_slots = identity_slots
            .checked_sub(call_identity::discount_with_imports(
                program,
                authored,
                include_imports,
            ))
            .expect("scalar calls retain their expression and callee identity slots");
    }
    identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(raw.scalar_identity_discount)
        .expect("raw scalar discount retains each expression identity slot");
    let generic_instances = generic_instance_source_cost(program)?;
    identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, generic_instances.identity_slots)?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        runtime.total,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        hir_input,
        generic_instances.bytes,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(raw.string_bytes, runtime.string_bytes)?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(string_input, generic_instances.string_bytes)?;
    // String contents are part of `hir_input`; only the remaining structural
    // bytes expand by the structural factor.
    let structure_input = hir_input.saturating_sub(string_input);
    let fixed_hir_upper = structure_input
        .checked_mul(HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
        .and_then(|structure| {
            string_input
                .checked_mul(HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|strings| structure.checked_add(strings))
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let maximum_identity_bytes = maximum_identity.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        authored
            .keys()
            .map(|id| id.len())
            .chain(prelude::all_ids().into_iter().map(str::len))
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
    });
    #[cfg(test)]
    let prior_fixed_hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper;
    let fixed_hir_upper = if layout_mode == cached_exact::MODE {
        cached_exact::fixed_upper(fixed_hir_upper, &raw, &runtime, retention)?
    } else {
        fixed_hir_upper
            .checked_sub(cost::fixed_hir_discount(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?)
            .expect("literal storage discount retains the complete reduced fixed bundle")
    };
    let identity_occurrence_upper = identity_slots
        .checked_mul(maximum_identity_bytes)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // Heap carriers are prebound independently of inline layouts and shared clones.
    let identity_carriers = cost::identity_carriers(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?;
    let identity_carriers =
        checked_builder_sum(identity_carriers, generic_instances.identity_carriers)?;
    let identity_carrier_bytes = identity_carriers
        .checked_mul(hir::ExpressionId::SHARED_ALLOCATION_CARRIER_BYTES)
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // The resolver's source chain also retains the compiler-owned base
    // variants. They are absent from synthetic AST and cannot spend an authored
    // expression discount. Borrow their producer metadata, without warming or
    // constructing the process prelude table during estimation.
    let prelude_hir_upper = super::prelude_forecast::retained_upper(
        &prelude::base_schema::BASE,
        maximum_identity_bytes,
    )?;
    let hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper
        .checked_add(call_proof)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(prelude_hir_upper))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_carrier_bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_occurrence_upper))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let retained_clone_and_hir = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        hir_upper,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    #[cfg(test)]
    let original_mode7_fixed_upper = raw
        .exact_expressions
        .checked_add(runtime.exact_expressions)
        .and_then(|count| {
            count
                .checked_mul(super::super::HIR_FIXED_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<crate::ast::Expr>()))
                .and_then(|old| prior_fixed_hir_upper.checked_sub(old))
                .and_then(|base| {
                    count
                        .checked_mul(if retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic {
                            2
                        } else {
                            1
                        })
                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
                        .and_then(|exact| base.checked_add(exact))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::forecast_observation::record_components(
        &program.path,
        layout_mode,
        retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
        include_imports,
        [
            raw.total,
            raw.string_bytes,
            raw.exact_expressions,
            raw.literal_fixed_discount,
            runtime.total,
            runtime.string_bytes,
            runtime.exact_expressions,
            structure_input,
            string_input,
            prior_fixed_hir_upper,
            fixed_hir_upper,
            identity_occurrence_upper,
            identity_carrier_bytes,
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            generic_instances.bytes,
            transient_import_clone,
            original_mode7_fixed_upper,
            prelude_hir_upper,
            hir_upper,
        ],
    );
    let result = SyntheticBuilderCosts {
        raw_clone_and_hir: checked_usage(
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            transient_import_clone,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
        retained_clone_and_hir,
        transient_import_clone,
        runtime: runtime.total,
        retained_hir: hir_upper,
        synthetic_ast: checked_usage(
            raw.total,
            runtime.total,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
    };
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(result)
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_with_registry(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    programs: &[Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_program_with_registry_using(program, authored, programs, registry, None)
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_core<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    core: &mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_program_with_registry_using(program, authored, programs, registry, Some(core))
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_with_registry_using<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    core: Option<&mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut synthetic = program.clone();
    synthetic.module_uses.clear();
    // Project validation already authenticated static implementation sidecars.
    // Runtime HIR has no witness or dispatch representation for them.
    synthetic.implementations.clear();
    for module_use in program
        .module_uses
        .iter()
        .filter(|item| item.kind == ModuleUseKind::Type)
    {
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        let mut ty = target.ty.expect("validated type target").clone();
        ty.name = crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone(&module_use.alias);
        super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_with_layout(
            &mut ty,
            target.module,
            program,
            programs,
            Some(layout),
        )?;
        synthetic.types.push(ty);
    }
    layout.append_types(&mut synthetic, program, programs)?;
    let type_index_bytes = synthetic
        .types
        .len()
        .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<(&str, &TypeDeclaration)>())
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    reserve_builder_structure(type_index_bytes)?;
    let mut type_declarations = Vec::with_capacity(synthetic.types.len());
    for declaration in &synthetic.types {
        type_declarations.push((declaration.name.as_str(), declaration));
    }
    type_declarations.sort_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(right.0));
    if type_declarations
        .windows(2)
        .any(|items| items[0].0 == items[1].0)
    {
        return Err(vec![graph_error(
            "SPX-G173",
            "synthetic workspace type-name index is not unique",
        )]);
    }
    for module_use in program
        .module_uses
        .iter()
        .filter(|item| item.kind == ModuleUseKind::Function)
    {
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        let target_function = target.function.expect("validated function target");
        let retain_body = programs
            .iter()
            .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
            .is_some_and(|provider| {
                crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, target_function).is_some()
                    || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, target_function).is_some()
            });
        let mut function = if retain_body {
            target_function.clone()
        } else {
            import_stub::signature(target_function)
        };
        function.name = crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone(&module_use.alias);
        if retain_body {
            synthetic.functions.push(function);
            continue;
        }
        for param in &mut function.params {
            type_rewrite::rewrite_with_layout(
                &mut param.ty,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
        type_rewrite::rewrite_with_layout(
            &mut function.return_type,
            target.module,
            program,
            programs,
            Some(layout),
        )?;
        // Clearing would retain the cloned contracts' Vec capacities in every
        // finished stub. Replace the vectors so the full imported contracts
        // remain transient, matching the final peak-only pre-bound.
        function.requires = Vec::new();
        function.ensures = Vec::new();
        function.body = default_expr(
            &function,
            &type_declarations,
            super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                program, target, authored, programs, layout,
            ),
            import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                target_function,
                target.module,
                byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
            )?,
        )?;
        synthetic.functions.push(function);
    }
    if !synthetic
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        reserve_builder_structure(std::mem::size_of::<Function>())?;
        reserve_builder_structure(std::mem::size_of::<Expr>())?;
        synthetic.functions.push(Function {
            stable_id: budgeted_format(format_args!(
                "workspace.synthetic.main.{}",
                synthetic.module
            )),
            explicit_id: true,
            name: crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone("main"),
            name_span: Span::default(),
            type_parameters: Vec::new(),
            params: Vec::new(),
            return_type: Type::I64,
            effects: Vec::new(),
            yields: None,
            follows: None,
            requires: Vec::new(),
            ensures: Vec::new(),
            body: Expr {
                kind: ExprKind::Int(0),
                span: Span::default(),
            },
            span: Span::default(),
        });
    }
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(synthetic)
}
//! Exact-source certificate hostiles and real proof allocation frontiers.
//! Parser-only malformed fixtures below test conservative forecast refusal;
//! none grants language, imported-source or HIR authority.
use super::super::*;
use crate::bounded_output::{
    active_remaining, reserve_active_required, set_active_floor, with_limit_usage_refusal,
};
use crate::test_allocation_observer::measure;

const SOURCE: &str = r#"module audit.local;
@id("audit.helper") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{x}
@id("audit.main") fn main()->i64{helper(1)}
"#;
fn parsed(s: &str) -> Program {
    crate::parse(s, "callee-audit.spx").unwrap()
}
fn index(programs: &[Program]) -> Index<'_> {
    let mut rows = Index::new();
    for p in programs {
        for f in &p.functions {
            rows.insert(
                f.stable_id.as_str(),
                AuthoredDeclaration {
                    path: &p.path,
                    module: &p.module,
                    explicit: f.explicit_id,
                    kind: crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind::Function,
                    function: Some(f),
                    ty: None,
                },
            );
        }
    }
    rows
}
fn context<'a>(p: &'a [Program], i: &'a Index<'a>) -> Context<'a, 'a> {
    Context {
        program: &p[0],
        authored: i,
        programs: p,
    }
}
fn counted(p: &[Program], i: &Index<'_>) -> usize {
    let (c, refused, paid, first) =
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || costs(context(p, i)).unwrap());
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
    assert_eq!(c.bytes, paid);
    c.slots
}
#[test]
fn local_plain_call_certificate_excludes_shadow_prelude_generic_default_and_import_routes() {
    let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 1);
    let p = [parsed(&SOURCE.replace(
        "fn main()->i64{helper(1)}",
        "fn main()->i64 requires helper(1)>0 {helper(1)}",
    ))];
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(
        counted(&p, &i),
        1,
        "contract callee slots retain their complete old bound"
    );
    for body in [
        "{let helper=1;helper(1)}",
        "{let outer={let helper=1;helper(1)};0}",
        "{helper<i64>(1)}",
        "{let hidden=match 1 {0=>helper(1),_=>0,};0}",
    ] {
        let p = [parsed(&SOURCE.replace("{helper(1)}", body))];
        let i = index(&p);
        assert_eq!(
            counted(&p, &i),
            0,
            "parser-only unsupported/shadowed body {body}"
        );
    }
    let p = [parsed(
        &SOURCE.replace("fn helper(x:i64)", "fn helper<T>(x:i64)"),
    )];
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0);
    let p = [parsed(&SOURCE.replace("helper", "string_len"))];
    let i = index(&p);
    let (is_compiler, refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        compiler("string_len", &invoice).unwrap()
    });
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(is_compiler);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0);
    // Generated/default prototypes are not explicitly authored local bodies.
    let mut p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    p[0].functions[0].explicit_id = false;
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0);
    let mut p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    p[0].functions[1].explicit_id = false;
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0);
    // Alias collision cannot be relabeled as the same-module function, even if
    // an output-only forecast later omits its independently priced import stub.
    let mut p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    p[0].module_uses.push(crate::ast::ModuleUse {
        kind: crate::ast::ModuleUseKind::Function,
        persistent_id: "provider.helper".into(),
        target_module: "provider".into(),
        alias: "helper".into(),
        span: crate::ast::Span::default(),
    });
    let i = index(&p);
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0);
}
#[test]
fn forged_authored_kind_path_module_origin_and_function_pointer_never_certify() {
    for attack in 0..5 {
        let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
        let mut i = index(&p);
        let row = i.get_mut("audit.helper").unwrap();
        match attack {
            0 => row.kind = crate::workspace_graph::AuthoredKind::Type,
            1 => row.path = "foreign.spx",
            2 => row.module = "foreign.module",
            3 => row.explicit = false,
            _ => row.function = Some(&p[0].functions[1]),
        }
        assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 0, "forged authored row {attack}");
    }
    // Equal text is insufficient: the target Program must be the actual held
    // member of the exact provider slice, not a copied or stale source image.
    let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    let i = index(&p);
    let copy = p[0].clone();
    let (c, refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        costs(Context {
            program: &copy,
            authored: &i,
            programs: &p,
        })
        .unwrap()
    });
    assert!(!refused);
    assert_eq!(c.slots, 0);
}
#[test]
fn certificate_consume_rejects_equal_copies_stale_context_and_wrong_lender() {
    let p = [
        parsed(SOURCE),
        parsed("module other;@id(\"other.main\") fn main()->i64{0}"),
    ];
    let i = index(&p);
    let other = index(&p);
    let copy = p[0].clone();
    let provider_copy = p.to_vec();
    let ((), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        for attack in 0..4 {
            let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
            let c = context(&p, &i);
            let cert = Certificate::acquire(c, &invoice).unwrap();
            let bad = match attack {
                0 => Context {
                    program: &copy,
                    ..c
                },
                1 => Context {
                    authored: &other,
                    ..c
                },
                2 => Context {
                    programs: &provider_copy,
                    ..c
                },
                _ => Context {
                    programs: &p[..1],
                    ..c
                },
            };
            assert_eq!(cert.consume(bad, &invoice).err(), Some(Failure::Foreign));
        }
        let original = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        let alien = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        let cert = Certificate::acquire(context(&p, &i), &original).unwrap();
        let alien_bytes = alien.bytes();
        assert_eq!(
            cert.consume(context(&p, &i), &alien).err(),
            Some(Failure::Foreign)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            alien.bytes(),
            alien_bytes,
            "incoming lender is never charged"
        );
    });
    assert!(!refused);
}
#[test]
fn foreign_scope_never_charges_current_foreign_lender_and_old_owner_stays_refused() {
    let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    let i = index(&p);
    let ((), outer_refused, _, outer_first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let original = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        let cert = Certificate::acquire(context(&p, &i), &original).unwrap();
        let original_bytes = original.bytes();
        let ((), inner_refused, _, inner_first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
            let alien = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
            let before = active_remaining();
            let bytes = alien.bytes();
            assert_eq!(
                cert.consume(context(&p, &i), &alien).err(),
                Some(Failure::Foreign)
            );
            assert_eq!(active_remaining(), before);
            assert_eq!(alien.bytes(), bytes);
        });
        assert!(!inner_refused && inner_first.is_none());
        assert_eq!(original.bytes(), original_bytes);
        assert_eq!(
            original.pay::<()>(),
            Err(Failure::Physical),
            "restoring scope cannot restore refused credit"
        );
    });
    assert!(outer_refused && outer_first.is_some());
}
#[test]
fn exact_short_zero_floor_and_first_sticky_refusal_release_every_proof_owner() {
    let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    let i = index(&p);
    let ((result, heap), refused, paid, first) =
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || measure(|| costs(context(&p, &i))));
    let c = result.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(c.slots, 1);
    assert_eq!(c.bytes, paid);
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
    assert!(!heap.invalid && heap.live == 0);
    assert_eq!(heap.allocated, heap.freed);
    assert!(heap.allocated <= paid);
    for (limit, floor, success) in [
        (paid, 0, true),
        (paid - 1, 0, false),
        (0, 0, false),
        (paid, paid, false),
    ] {
        // A compact Failure remains inline inside the measurement. Legacy diagnostic
        // rendering belongs to the already-owned outer compatibility boundary.
        let ((result, heap), refused, spent, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(limit, || {
            measure(|| {
                assert!(set_active_floor(floor));
                let invoice = Invoice::acquire()?;
                Certificate::acquire(context(&p, &i), &invoice)?.consume(context(&p, &i), &invoice)
            })
        });
        assert_eq!(
            result.is_ok() && !refused,
            success,
            "limit={limit} floor={floor}"
        );
        if success {
            assert_eq!(result.unwrap().slots, 1);
            assert_eq!(spent, paid);
        } else {
            assert_eq!(result.err(), Some(Failure::Physical));
            assert!(refused && first.is_some());
        }
        assert!(!heap.invalid && heap.live == 0);
        assert_eq!(heap.allocated, heap.freed);
    }
    let ((), refused, _, first) = with_limit_usage_refusal(paid, || {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        let _ = Certificate::acquire(context(&p, &i), &invoice);
        // Select a real refusal first. A zero-size role still needs its renewed
        // gateway, and neither later requests nor floor restoration may recover.
        assert!(!reserve_active_required(usize::MAX));
        let before = active_remaining();
        assert!(set_active_floor(0));
        assert_eq!(invoice.pay::<()>(), Err(Failure::Physical));
        assert_eq!(active_remaining(), before);
    });
    assert!(refused && first.is_some());
}
#[test]
fn exhausted_work_keeps_spent_invoice_and_cannot_publish_partial_slots_or_new_credit() {
    let p = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    let i = index(&p);
    let ((), refused, _, _) = with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
        let invoice = Invoice::acquire().unwrap();
        invoice.work(WORK).unwrap();
        let before = invoice.bytes();
        assert_eq!(
            Certificate::acquire(context(&p, &i), &invoice).err(),
            Some(Failure::Work)
        );
        assert!(invoice.bytes() > before);
        let paid = invoice.bytes();
        assert_eq!(invoice.work(1), Err(Failure::Work));
        assert!(invoice.bytes() > paid);
    });
    assert!(
        !refused,
        "logical proof decline must retain charges without fabricating a physical refusal"
    );
    // A parser-independent hostile AST exhausts the bounded optional proof at
    // its first header. The input backing is prepared outside the measured
    // invocation, and no partial certificate or fresh work budget is returned.
    let mut bounded = [parsed(SOURCE)];
    bounded[0].functions[0].name = "n".repeat(WORK);
    let authored = index(&bounded);
    let (cost, refused, spent, first) =
        with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || costs(context(&bounded, &authored)).unwrap());
    assert_eq!(cost.slots, 0);
    assert_eq!(cost.bytes, spent);
    assert!(spent > Invoice::setup_bytes());
    assert!(!refused && first.is_none());
}

#[test]
fn synthesized_vector_default_keeps_all_fresh_ids_and_carriers_separately_priced() {
    let source =
        format!("{SOURCE}\n@id(\"audit.vector\") fn vector(rows:borrow Vec<i64>)->i64{{0}}");
    let p = [parsed(&source)];
    let i = index(&p);
    let ty = Type::Named {
        name: "Vec".to_owned(),
        arguments: vec![Type::I64],
    };
    let default = || {
        let mut memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
        let mut visiting = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        super::super::super::defaults::default_expr_expanded_cost(
            &ty,
            &p[0].module,
            &p[0],
            &i,
            &p,
            &mut memo,
            &mut visiting,
            true,
        )
        .unwrap()
    };
    let before = default();
    assert_eq!(before.identity_slots, 9);
    assert_eq!(before.identity_carriers, 6);
    assert!(before.bytes >= 2 * size_of::<Expr>());
    assert_eq!(counted(&p, &i), 1);
    let after = default();
    assert_eq!(
        (
            before.bytes,
            before.string_bytes,
            before.identity_slots,
            before.identity_carriers
        ),
        (
            after.bytes,
            after.string_bytes,
            after.identity_slots,
            after.identity_carriers
        ),
        "a local-source certificate cannot claim the default's fresh constructor slots",
    );
}
//! New proof storage and every receiving bank are paid before use.
use super::{
    size_of, AuthoredDeclaration, Cell, Certificate, ClassifierLedger, Context, Costs, Function,
    Headers, Index, Program, Type, WORK,
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub(in crate::workspace_graph::expected_projection) enum Failure {
    Physical,
    Arithmetic,
    Foreign,
    Work,
}

pub(super) struct Invoice {
    bytes: Cell<usize>,
    remaining: Cell<usize>,
    ledger: ClassifierLedger,
}

// One initial gateway and one renewed gateway after every successful payment.
// A terminal failed gateway cannot be reused. The final unused bank is retained.
fn gateway() -> usize {
    4 * size_of::<&Invoice>()
        + 4 * size_of::<usize>()
        + 2 * size_of::<Option<usize>>()
        + 2 * size_of::<Result<(), Failure>>()
        + 3 * size_of::<bool>()
        + 4 * size_of::<&Cell<usize>>()
        + ClassifierLedger::current_receiving_controls()
}

impl Invoice {
    pub(super) fn setup_bytes() -> usize {
        3 * size_of::<Self>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Context<'_, '_>>()
            + 3 * size_of::<Costs>()
            + 3 * size_of::<Result<Costs, Failure>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Result<Costs, Vec<crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic>>>()
            + 2 * size_of::<Result<Self, Failure>>()
            + 3 * size_of::<Cell<usize>>()
            + ClassifierLedger::capture_into_controls()
            + ClassifierLedger::insertion_terminal_controls()
            + gateway()
    }

    pub(super) fn acquire() -> Result<Self, Failure> {
        let bytes = Self::setup_bytes();
        if !crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(bytes) {
            return Err(Failure::Physical);
        }
        let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
        ledger.capture_current_into();
        Ok(Self {
            bytes: Cell::new(bytes),
            remaining: Cell::new(WORK),
            ledger,
        })
    }

    // A distinct same-invocation constructor pays its own actual/formal and
    // returned owners before formation; the original certificate is unchanged.
    pub(super) fn acquire_with<T>() -> Result<Self, Failure> {
        let bytes = Self::setup_bytes()
            .checked_add(size_of::<T>())
            .ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
        if !crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(bytes) {
            return Err(Failure::Physical);
        }
        let mut ledger = ClassifierLedger::empty_receiving();
        ledger.capture_current_into();
        Ok(Self {
            bytes: Cell::new(bytes),
            remaining: Cell::new(WORK),
            ledger,
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn pay<T>(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.pay_bytes(size_of::<T>())
    }

    fn pay_bytes(&self, bytes: usize) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        if !self.ledger.current() {
            return Err(Failure::Foreign);
        }
        let bytes = bytes.checked_add(gateway()).ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
        let next = self
            .bytes
            .get()
            .checked_add(bytes)
            .ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
        if !crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(bytes) {
            return Err(Failure::Physical);
        }
        self.bytes.set(next);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn pay_node<K, V>(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.pay::<(Option<usize>, usize, Result<(), Failure>)>()?;
        let bytes =
            crate::cleanup_plan::compiler_btree_node_upper::<K, V>().ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
        self.pay_bytes(bytes)
    }

    pub(super) fn work(&self, units: usize) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.pay::<(
            &Self,
            usize,
            &Cell<usize>,
            usize,
            Option<usize>,
            usize,
            Result<(), Failure>,
        )>()?;
        let Some(next) = self.remaining.get().checked_sub(units) else {
            self.remaining.set(0);
            return Err(Failure::Work);
        };
        self.remaining.set(next);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.bytes.get()
    }
}

//! Complete immediate-old forecast and real shared-backing controls.
use super::super::{
    before_shared_local_projection as before, cached_exact, dependency_identity_max,
    held_projection,
};
