fn source(calls: usize) -> String {
    let body = std::iter::repeat_n("helper(1)", calls)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" + ");
    format!("module shared.local; @id(\"shared.helper\") fn helper(x:i64)->i64{{x}} @id(\"shared.main\") fn main()->i64{{{body}}}")
}

#[test]
fn full_immediate_old_projection_keeps_all_modes_and_exact_new_invoice() {
    for count in [1, 64] {
        let source = source(count);
        let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source, "shared.spx").unwrap()];
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let program = &programs[0];
        let maximum = dependency_identity_max(program, &authored, &programs).unwrap();
        let proof = costs(Context {
            program,
            authored: &authored,
            programs: &programs,
        })
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(proof.slots, count);
        assert!(proof.bytes > 0);
        for mode in 0..=7 {
            for retention in [
                cached_exact::Retention::Parsed,
                cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
            ] {
                for imports in [false, true] {
                    let old = before::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                        program,
                        &authored,
                        &programs,
                        Some(maximum),
                        imports,
                        (mode, retention),
                        None,
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                    let now = held_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
                        program, &authored, &programs, Some(maximum), imports, (mode, retention), None).unwrap();
                    let (fee, removed) =
                        if mode == 6 && retention == cached_exact::Retention::Parsed {
                            (
                                proof.bytes,
                                proof.slots * maximum * super::super::HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
                            )
                        } else {
                            (0, 0)
                        };
                    assert_eq!(now.retained_hir + removed, old.retained_hir + fee);
                    assert_eq!(
                        now.retained_clone_and_hir + removed,
                        old.retained_clone_and_hir + fee
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn shared_calls(expression: &ResolvedExpr, program: &ResolvedProgram) -> usize {
    let mut count = 0;
    match &expression.kind {
        ResolvedExprKind::Call {
            callee,
            type_arguments,
            instance,
            args,
            ..
        } => {
            assert!(type_arguments.is_empty());
            assert!(instance.is_none());
            let declaration = program
                .functions
                .iter()
                .find(|function| function.id == *callee)
                .unwrap();
            let held = program.declarations.function_id(&declaration.name).unwrap();
            assert!(callee.shared_allocation_key().is_some());
            assert_eq!(callee.shared_allocation_key(), held.shared_allocation_key());
            assert_eq!(
                callee.shared_allocation_key(),
                declaration.id.shared_allocation_key()
            );
            assert_eq!(
                callee.owned_allocation_bytes(),
                held.owned_allocation_bytes()
            );
            count += 1;
            for argument in args {
                count += shared_calls(argument, program);
            }
        }
        ResolvedExprKind::Block { statements, tail } => {
            assert!(statements.is_empty());
            count += shared_calls(tail, program);
        }
        ResolvedExprKind::Binary { left, right, .. } => {
            count += shared_calls(left, program);
            count += shared_calls(right, program);
        }
        ResolvedExprKind::Int(_) | ResolvedExprKind::Place(_) => {}
        other => panic!("closed fixture added unowned HIR shape: {other:?}"),
    }
    count
}

#[test]
fn tiny_repeated_proof_and_whole_resolver_backing_are_measured_through_drop() {
    for count in [1, 64] {
        let source = source(count);
        let programs = vec![crate::parse(&source, "shared.spx").unwrap()];
        let authored = crate::workspace_graph::index_authored(&programs).unwrap();
        let context = Context {
            program: &programs[0],
            authored: &authored,
            programs: &programs,
        };
        // Budget harness setup precedes observation; the complete proof,
        // captured ledger loan, header nodes and their Drop remain inside.
        let ((proof, proof_alloc), refused, charged, first) =
            crate::bounded_output::with_limit_usage_refusal(usize::MAX, || {
                crate::test_allocation_observer::measure(|| costs(context).unwrap())
            });
        assert!(!refused);
        assert!(first.is_none());
        assert_eq!(proof.slots, count);
        assert_eq!(proof.bytes, charged);
        assert!(!proof_alloc.invalid);
        assert_eq!(proof_alloc.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(proof_alloc.allocated, proof_alloc.freed);
        assert!(proof_alloc.highwater <= charged);
        let checked = crate::check(&source, "shared.spx").unwrap();
        let ((actual, after_resolve, after_validate), allocation) =
            crate::test_allocation_observer::measure_with_capacity(1 << 16, || {
                let resolved = crate::hir::resolve(&checked).unwrap();
                let after_resolve = crate::test_allocation_observer::current_metrics();
                crate::hir::validate(&resolved).unwrap();
                let after_validate = crate::test_allocation_observer::current_metrics();
                let actual = resolved
                    .functions
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|function| function.id.as_str().starts_with("shared."))
                    .map(|function| shared_calls(&function.body, &resolved))
                    .sum::<usize>();
                drop(resolved);
                (actual, after_resolve, after_validate)
            });
        assert_eq!(actual, count);
        assert!(!allocation.invalid);
        assert_eq!(allocation.live, 0);
        assert_eq!(allocation.allocated, allocation.freed);
        let maximum = Some(dependency_identity_max(context.program, &authored, &programs).unwrap());
        let old = before::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
            context.program,
            &authored,
            &programs,
            maximum,
            true,
            (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
            None,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let now = held_projection::synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
            context.program,
            &authored,
            &programs,
            maximum,
            true,
            (6, cached_exact::Retention::Parsed),
            None,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(allocation.highwater <= now.retained_hir);
        eprintln!("LOCAL_CALLEE_SHARED_BACKING calls={count} proof_slots={} proof_charged={charged} proof_allocation={proof_alloc:?} before_forecast={} current_forecast={} after_resolve={after_resolve:?} after_validate={after_validate:?} whole_after_drop={allocation:?}; requested layouts and conservative reservations are distinct; no RSS or application admission claim", proof.slots, old.retained_hir, now.retained_hir);
    }
}

#[test]
fn immediate_old_bytes_and_serialized_phase_boundary_remain_explicit() {
    let old = include_str!("before_projection.rs");
    assert_eq!(
        format!(
            "{:x}",
            crate::digest_hex::LowerHex(Sha256::digest(old.as_bytes()))
        ),
        "3e0d38a5c01f87a8b05815d9831f80b2604df5e37c15d0dcbf0cf0055656e942"
    );
    let current = include_str!("../held_projection.rs");
    let uncached = include_str!("../uncached_peak.rs");
    let source_callables = include_str!("../../source_callables.rs");
    let core = include_str!("../../../workspace_graph.rs");
    assert!(current.contains("layout_mode == 6 && retention == cached_exact::Retention::Parsed"));
    assert!(current.contains("checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)"));
    assert!(current.contains("checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR)"));
    assert!(uncached.contains("program, authored, programs, maximum, 6, true, registry"));
    assert!(
        source_callables
            .find("synthetic_builder_bytes(program, &authored, &programs)")
            .unwrap()
            < source_callables
                .find("graph::to_hir_json(&resolved, defining_revision)")
                .unwrap()
    );
    assert!(core.contains("retain_workspace_module("));
    assert!(!core.contains("graph::to_hir_json("));
    // All physical helper banks stay joined to the source owner.
    for child in [
        include_str!("../shared_local_callees.rs"),
        include_str!("invoice.rs"),
        include_str!("walk.rs"),
    ] {
        assert!(!child.is_empty());
    }
}
//! Explicit lexical scopes; unfamiliar lowerings keep the complete old charge.
use super::{
    compiler, invoice, local, ordinary, plain, Context, Expr, ExprKind, Failure, Function, Headers,
    Invoice, Statement, Type, MAX_FRAMES, MAX_NAMES,
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Frame<'a> {
    Expr(&'a Expr),
    Block(&'a [Statement], usize, &'a Expr, usize),
    Bind(&'a str),
    Restore(usize),
    Args(&'a [Expr], usize),
}

struct Scratch<'a> {
    frames: [Option<Frame<'a>>; MAX_FRAMES],
    length: usize,
    names: [Option<&'a str>; MAX_NAMES],
    bound: usize,
}
type Entry<'a> = (
    &'a Function,
    &'a Function,
    &'a Headers<'a>,
    &'a Headers<'a>,
    &'a Invoice,
    &'a Invoice,
    Scratch<'a>,
    Push<'a>,
    std::slice::Iter<'a, crate::ast::Param>,
    usize,
    Result<Option<usize>, Failure>,
    Option<usize>,
);
type Push<'a> = (
    &'a mut Scratch<'a>,
    &'a mut Scratch<'a>,
    Frame<'a>,
    Frame<'a>,
    Option<Frame<'a>>,
    &'a mut [Option<Frame<'a>>; MAX_FRAMES],
    &'a mut [Option<Frame<'a>>; MAX_FRAMES],
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    usize,
    bool,
    bool,
);
type Turn<'a> = (
    Push<'a>,
    Push<'a>,
    Push<'a>,
    &'a Invoice,
    &'a mut Scratch<'a>,
    &'a [Option<Frame<'a>>; MAX_FRAMES],
    &'a mut [Option<Frame<'a>>; MAX_FRAMES],
    usize,
    usize,
    Option<Frame<'a>>,
    Frame<'a>,
    Frame<'a>,
    &'a Expr,
    &'a ExprKind,
    &'a [Statement],
    &'a Statement,
    Option<&'a Statement>,
    &'a [Expr],
    Option<&'a Expr>,
    &'a Option<Type>,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    bool,
    usize,
);
type Binding<'a> = (
    Result<bool, Failure>,
    Result<bool, Failure>,
    &'a mut Scratch<'a>,
    &'a str,
    Option<&'a str>,
    usize,
    usize,
    &'a mut Scratch<'a>,
    &'a str,
    &'a Invoice,
    &'a mut [Option<&'a str>; MAX_NAMES],
    usize,
    Option<&'a str>,
    bool,
    bool,
    usize,
);
type Probe<'a> = (
    Result<bool, Failure>,
    Result<bool, Failure>,
    &'a Scratch<'a>,
    &'a str,
    Option<&'a str>,
    Option<&'a str>,
    usize,
    usize,
    &'a Scratch<'a>,
    &'a str,
    &'a Invoice,
    &'a [Option<&'a str>; MAX_NAMES],
    usize,
    &'a Option<&'a str>,
    &'a str,
    &'a str,
    bool,
    bool,
);

impl<'a> Scratch<'a> {
    fn push(&mut self, frame: Frame<'a>) -> bool {
        if self.length == MAX_FRAMES {
            return false;
        }
        self.frames[self.length] = Some(frame);
        self.length += 1;
        true
    }
    fn bind(&mut self, name: &'a str, invoice: &Invoice) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
        invoice.pay::<Binding<'_>>()?;
        if self.bound == MAX_NAMES {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        self.names[self.bound] = Some(name);
        self.bound += 1;
        Ok(true)
    }
    fn shadowed(&self, name: &str, invoice: &Invoice) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
        let mut index = 0;
        loop {
            invoice.pay::<Probe<'_>>()?;
            if index == self.bound {
                break;
            }
            invoice.work(name.len().saturating_add(1))?;
            if self.names[index] == Some(name) {
                return Ok(true);
            }
            index += 1;
        }
        Ok(false)
    }
}

pub(super) fn count<'p, 'a>(
    context: Context<'p, 'a>,
    function: &'p Function,
    headers: &Headers<'p>,
    invoice: &Invoice,
) -> Result<Option<usize>, Failure> {
    invoice.pay::<Entry<'_>>()?;
    let mut scratch = Scratch {
        frames: [None; MAX_FRAMES],
        length: 0,
        names: [None; MAX_NAMES],
        bound: 0,
    };
    let mut parameters = function.params.iter();
    loop {
        invoice.pay::<invoice::Advance<'_, crate::ast::Param>>()?;
        let Some(parameter) = parameters.next() else {
            break;
        };
        if !scratch.bind(&parameter.name, invoice)? {
            return Ok(None);
        }
    }
    // Only authored body expressions are counted. Contract/default/generic
    // expansion identities retain the old independent allowance in full.
    scratch.push(Frame::Expr(&function.body));
    let mut count = 0usize;
    while scratch.length != 0 {
        invoice.pay::<Turn<'_>>()?;
        invoice.work(1)?;
        scratch.length -= 1;
        let frame = scratch.frames[scratch.length]
            .take()
            .expect("occupied frontier");
        let complete = match frame {
            Frame::Bind(name) => scratch.bind(name, invoice)?,
            Frame::Restore(bound) => {
                scratch.bound = bound;
                true
            }
            Frame::Args(args, index) => {
                if let Some(argument) = args.get(index) {
                    scratch.push(Frame::Args(args, index + 1))
                        && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(argument))
                } else {
                    true
                }
            }
            Frame::Block(statements, index, tail, bound) => {
                if let Some(statement) = statements.get(index) {
                    if !scratch.push(Frame::Block(statements, index + 1, tail, bound)) {
                        return Ok(None);
                    }
                    match statement {
                        Statement::Let {
                            name,
                            declared,
                            value,
                            ..
                        } if match declared {
                            None => true,
                            Some(ty) => plain(ty),
                        } =>
                        {
                            scratch.push(Frame::Bind(name)) && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(value))
                        }
                        Statement::Assign {
                            field: None, value, ..
                        } => scratch.push(Frame::Expr(value)),
                        Statement::While {
                            condition, body, ..
                        } => {
                            scratch.push(Frame::Expr(body)) && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(condition))
                        }
                        _ => false,
                    }
                } else {
                    scratch.push(Frame::Restore(bound)) && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(tail))
                }
            }
            Frame::Expr(expression) => match &expression.kind {
                ExprKind::Call {
                    name,
                    type_arguments,
                    args,
                } => {
                    invoice.pay::<invoice::Query<'_>>()?;
                    invoice.work(name.len().saturating_add(headers.len()).saturating_add(1))?;
                    if type_arguments.is_empty()
                        && !compiler(name, invoice)?
                        && !scratch.shadowed(name, invoice)?
                    {
                        if let Some(Some(target)) = headers.get(name.as_str()) {
                            invoice.work(
                                target
                                    .stable_id
                                    .len()
                                    .saturating_add(target.params.len())
                                    .saturating_add(1),
                            )?;
                            if ordinary(target, invoice)?
                                && target.params.len() == args.len()
                                && local(context, target, invoice)?
                            {
                                count = count.checked_add(1).ok_or(Failure::Arithmetic)?;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    scratch.push(Frame::Args(args, 0))
                }
                ExprKind::Block { statements, tail } => {
                    scratch.push(Frame::Block(statements, 0, tail, scratch.bound))
                }
                ExprKind::If {
                    condition,
                    then_branch,
                    else_branch,
                } => {
                    scratch.push(Frame::Expr(else_branch))
                        && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(then_branch))
                        && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(condition))
                }
                ExprKind::Unary { value, .. } => scratch.push(Frame::Expr(value)),
                ExprKind::Binary { left, right, .. } => {
                    scratch.push(Frame::Expr(right)) && scratch.push(Frame::Expr(left))
                }
                ExprKind::Var(_)
                | ExprKind::Int(_)
                | ExprKind::Int32(_)
                | ExprKind::Uint8(_)
                | ExprKind::Usize(_)
                | ExprKind::Char(_)
                | ExprKind::Float32(_)
                | ExprKind::Float64(_)
                | ExprKind::Bool(_)
                | ExprKind::String(_)
                | ExprKind::BorrowedUtf8Literal(_)
                | ExprKind::ArrayU8(_)
                | ExprKind::RepeatArrayU8 { .. } => true,
                // Includes closure/indirect/method/nominal/pattern/for/default
                // lowerings; a future shape cannot silently enter this proof.
                _ => false,
            },
        };
        if !complete {
            return Ok(None);
        }
    }
    Ok(Some(count))
}
//! Source markers must match current typed sites; an ordinary Block grants no v81 provenance.
use crate::workspace_graph::{graph_error, reserve_builder_structure, MAX_CALLS};
use crate::{ast, diagnostic::Diagnostic, hir};

fn refused() -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
    vec![graph_error(
        "SPX-G173",
        "Vec constructor source provenance disagrees with retained HIR",
    )]
}
struct Work(usize);
impl Work {
    fn debit(&mut self, bytes: usize) -> Result<(), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
        self.0 = self
            .0
            .checked_add(bytes)
            .filter(|n| *n <= MAX_CALLS)
            .ok_or_else(refused)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}
fn walk<'a>(
    roots: impl Iterator<Item = &'a hir::ResolvedExpr>,
    work: &mut Work,
    visit: &mut impl FnMut(&'a hir::ResolvedExpr, &mut Work) -> Result<(), Vec<Diagnostic>>,
) -> Result<(), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    use hir::lexical_exit::ChildCursor;
    reserve_builder_structure(std::mem::size_of::<[Option<ChildCursor<'_>>; 514]>())?;
    let mut frames = [None; 514];
    for root in roots {
        frames[0] = Some(ChildCursor::new(root));
        let mut len = 1;
        while len != 0 {
            let cursor = frames[len - 1]
                .as_mut()
                .expect("retained constructor cursor");
            if !cursor.is_started() {
                work.debit(1)?;
                visit(cursor.expression(), work)?;
            }
            if let Some(child) = cursor.next() {
                if len == frames.len() {
                    return Err(refused());
                }
                frames[len] = Some(ChildCursor::new(child));
                len += 1;
            } else {
                len -= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn verify(
    source: &ast::Program,
    resolved: &hir::ResolvedProgram,
) -> Result<(), Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    // Node-only presence uses the existing admitted source depth, with no
    // path, identity, or proof-vector allocation. HIR presence remains
    // independent so a typed-only forged marker cannot hide behind absence.
    fn source_presence(
        expression: &ast::Expr,
        depth: usize,
        work: &mut usize,
    ) -> Result<bool, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
        *work = work
            .checked_add(1)
            .filter(|n| *n <= super::super::MAX_TOTAL_SOURCE_BYTES)
            .ok_or_else(refused)?;
        if depth > 128 {
            return Err(refused());
        }
        if matches!(expression.kind, ast::ExprKind::VecConstructor { .. }) {
            return Ok(true);
        }
        for child in ast::vec_constructor::NodeCursor::new(expression) {
            if source_presence(child, depth + 1, work)? {
                return Ok(true);
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    }
    let mut source_has_marker = false;
    let mut presence_work = 0usize;
    for function in &source.functions {
        for root in function
            .requires
            .iter()
            .chain(std::iter::once(&function.body))
            .chain(&function.ensures)
        {
            source_has_marker |= source_presence(root, 1, &mut presence_work)?;
        }
    }
    if !source_has_marker && !hir::vec_constructor::program_uses(resolved).map_err(|e| vec![e])? {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let mut work = Work(0);
    for function in &source.functions {
        let ordinary = resolved
            .functions
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == function.stable_id);
        let template = resolved
            .function_templates
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.id.as_str() == function.stable_id);
        let (requires, body, ensures) = match (ordinary, template) {
            (Some(f), None) => (f.requires.as_slice(), &f.body, f.ensures.as_slice()),
            (None, Some(f)) => (f.requires.as_slice(), &f.body, f.ensures.as_slice()),
            _ => return Err(refused()),
        };
        let roots = || requires.iter().chain(std::iter::once(body)).chain(ensures);
        let mut sites = Vec::new();
        walk(roots(), &mut work, &mut |expression, _| {
            if matches!(
                expression.kind,
                hir::ResolvedExprKind::VecConstructor { .. }
            ) {
                hir::vec_constructor::authenticate(expression).map_err(|_| refused())?;
                if sites.len() == sites.capacity() {
                    let capacity = sites.capacity().saturating_mul(2).max(4);
                    reserve_builder_structure(
                        capacity
                            .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<&hir::ResolvedExpr>())
                            .ok_or_else(refused)?,
                    )?;
                    sites
                        .try_reserve_exact(capacity - sites.len())
                        .map_err(|_| refused())?;
                    if sites.capacity() > capacity {
                        return Err(refused());
                    }
                }
                sites.push(expression);
            }
            Ok(())
        })?;
        let mut expected = 0usize;
        for (path, expression) in function
            .requires
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, e)| {
                (
                    crate::bounded_output::budgeted_format(format_args!("requires.{i}")),
                    e,
                )
            })
            .chain(std::iter::once((
                crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone("body"),
                &function.body,
            )))
            .chain(function.ensures.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, e)| {
                (
                    crate::bounded_output::budgeted_format(format_args!("ensures.{i}")),
                    e,
                )
            }))
        {
            super::super::source_callables::visit_ast_expression_sites(
                expression,
                &path,
                &mut |expression, path| {
                    let ast::ExprKind::VecConstructor { .. } = &expression.kind else {
                        return Ok(());
                    };
                    work.debit(1)?;
                    expected += 1;
                    let expansion =
                        ast::vec_constructor::inspect(expression).map_err(|_| refused())?;
                    let identity =
                        hir::budgeted_workspace_expression_identity_text(&function.stable_id, path);
                    if crate::bounded_output::active_refused() {
                        return Err(refused());
                    }
                    let mut found = 0usize;
                    for typed in &sites {
                        work.debit(typed.id.as_str().len().max(identity.len()))?;
                        if typed.id.as_str() != identity {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let Some(typed_expansion) = hir::vec_constructor::expansion(typed) else {
                            return Err(refused());
                        };
                        if typed_expansion.count != expansion.count
                            || !same_type(
                                source,
                                function,
                                expansion.element,
                                typed_expansion.element,
                                0,
                                &mut work,
                            )?
                        {
                            return Err(refused());
                        }
                        found += 1;
                    }
                    if found != 1 {
                        return Err(refused());
                    }
                    Ok(())
                },
            )?;
        }
        if expected != sites.len() {
            return Err(refused());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn same_type(
    source: &ast::Program,
    function: &ast::Function,
    source_type: &ast::Type,
    typed: &hir::ResolvedType,
    depth: usize,
    work: &mut Work,
) -> Result<bool, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    use ast::Type as A;
    use hir::ResolvedType as H;
    work.debit(1)?;
    if depth >= 129 {
        return Err(refused());
    }
    Ok(match (source_type, typed) {
        (A::I64, H::I64)
        | (A::I32, H::I32)
        | (A::Char, H::Char)
        | (A::U8, H::U8)
        | (A::Usize, H::Usize)
        | (A::F32, H::F32)
        | (A::F64, H::F64)
        | (A::Bool, H::Bool)
        | (A::String, H::String)
        | (A::Bytes, H::Bytes)
        | (A::Str, H::Str)
        | (A::SliceU8, H::SliceU8)
        | (A::StringMap, H::StringMap) => true,
        (A::ArrayU8(a), H::ArrayU8(b)) => a == b,
        (A::Named { name, arguments }, H::TypeParameter { owner, index }) => {
            owner.as_str() == function.stable_id
                && arguments.is_empty()
                && function
                    .type_parameters
                    .get(*index as usize)
                    .is_some_and(|p| p.name == *name)
        }
        (
            A::Named { name, arguments },
            H::Nominal {
                declaration,
                arguments: typed_args,
            },
        ) => {
            work.debit(name.len().max(declaration.as_str().len()))?;
            let target = source
                .types
                .iter()
                .find(|d| d.name == *name)
                .map(|d| d.stable_id.as_str())
                .or_else(|| {
                    source
                        .module_uses
                        .iter()
                        .find(|u| u.kind == ast::ModuleUseKind::Type && u.alias == *name)
                        .map(|u| u.persistent_id.as_str())
                })
                .or_else(|| {
                    (name == "Vec" && !source.types.iter().any(|d| d.name == "Vec"))
                        .then_some(crate::prelude::VEC_ID)
                });
            if target != Some(declaration.as_str()) || arguments.len() != typed_args.len() {
                false
            } else {
                let mut equal = true;
                for (a, b) in arguments.iter().zip(typed_args) {
                    equal &= same_type(source, function, a, b, depth + 1, work)?;
                }
                equal
            }
        }
        _ => false,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::{ast, hir};
    const SOURCE: &str = "module constructor; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64 {let rows=vec_of<i64>(19,23); if vec_len<i64>(rows)==2usize {42}else{0}}";
    fn marker(program: &mut hir::ResolvedProgram) -> &mut hir::ResolvedExpr {
        let hir::ResolvedExprKind::Block { statements, .. } = &mut program.functions[0].body.kind
        else {
            panic!()
        };
        let hir::ResolvedStatement::Let { value, .. } = &mut statements[0] else {
            panic!()
        };
        value
    }
    #[test]
    fn imported_nominal_constructor_type_sites_keep_the_replaced_block_identity() {
        let sources = [
            ("provider.spx", "module provider.rows; @id(\"row\") record Row { @id(\"row.value\") value:i64, } @id(\"provider.main\") fn main()->i64{0}"),
            ("caller.spx", "module app.main; use type @id(\"row\") from provider.rows as Row; @id(\"main\") fn main()->i64{let rows=vec_of<Row>(Row{value:42}); if vec_len<Row>(rows)==1usize {42}else{0}}"),
        ].into_iter().map(|(path, source)| crate::workspace_graph::WorkspaceSource {
            path: path.to_owned(),
            source: crate::format::canonical(&crate::parse(source, path).unwrap()),
        }).collect();
        let build = crate::workspace_graph::build_owned(sources).unwrap();
        let path = "body.s0.value.s0.value";
        let identity = hir::workspace_expression_identity(&hir::DeclarationId::new("main"), path);
        assert!(build.edges.iter().any(|edge| edge.kind == "type_reference"
            && edge.target == "row"
            && edge.ast_path == format!("{path}.type_argument.0")
            && edge.expression == identity));
    }

    #[test]
    fn retained_constructor_requires_exact_current_source_site_and_typed_marker_inventory() {
        let source = crate::check(SOURCE, "constructor.spx").unwrap();
        let typed = hir::resolve(&source).unwrap();
        hir::validate(&typed).unwrap();
        super::verify(&source, &typed).unwrap();
        let mut stale = typed.clone();
        marker(&mut stale).id = hir::ExpressionId::from_owned("foreign.constructor".to_owned());
        assert_eq!(
            super::verify(&source, &stale).unwrap_err()[0].code,
            "SPX-G173"
        );
        let mut ordinary = typed.clone();
        let value = marker(&mut ordinary);
        let hir::ResolvedExprKind::VecConstructor {
            statements, tail, ..
        } = &mut value.kind
        else {
            panic!()
        };
        value.kind = hir::ResolvedExprKind::Block {
            statements: std::mem::take(statements),
            tail: tail.clone(),
        };
        assert_eq!(
            super::verify(&source, &ordinary).unwrap_err()[0].code,
            "SPX-G173"
        );
        let mut unmarked = source.clone();
        let ast::ExprKind::Block { statements, .. } = &mut unmarked.functions[0].body.kind else {
            panic!()
        };
        let ast::Statement::Let { value, .. } = &mut statements[0] else {
            panic!()
        };
        let ast::ExprKind::VecConstructor {
            value: expansion, ..
        } = &mut value.kind
        else {
            panic!()
        };
        *value = (**expansion).clone();
        assert_eq!(
            super::verify(&unmarked, &typed).unwrap_err()[0].code,
            "SPX-G173"
        );
    }
}
//! Shared source-held closure consumption for forecast and synthetic construction.
use super::{
    active_builder_limit, ast_function_contract_cost, ast_function_cost,
    ast_function_identity_slots, ast_function_signature_cost, ast_program_cost,
    ast_program_identity_slots, ast_type_declaration_cost, ast_type_declaration_identity_slots,
    ast_type_identity_slots, cached_exact, call_identity, checked_builder_sum, checked_usage, cost,
    default_expr, generic_instance_source_cost, graph_error, import_stub, limit_error,
    private_layout, reserve_builder_structure, synthetic_main_runtime_cost, type_rewrite,
    AuthoredDeclaration, StructuralCost, SyntheticBuilderCosts, HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR,
    HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR, HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR,
};
use crate::ast::{Expr, ExprKind, Function, ModuleUseKind, Program, Span, Type, TypeDeclaration};
use crate::bounded_output::budgeted_format;
use crate::diagnostic::Diagnostic;
use crate::{hir, prelude};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    programs: &[Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum_identity,
        include_imports,
        profile,
        (registry, None),
    )
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_core<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    proofs: (
        Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
        &mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>,
    ),
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using(
        program,
        authored,
        programs,
        maximum_identity,
        include_imports,
        profile,
        (proofs.0, Some(proofs.1)),
    )
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_builder_bytes_scoped_with_retention_with_registry_using<
    'a,
>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    maximum_identity: Option<usize>,
    include_imports: bool,
    profile: (u8, cached_exact::Retention),
    proofs: (
        Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
        Option<&mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>>,
    ),
) -> Result<SyntheticBuilderCosts, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let (registry, core) = proofs;
    let (layout_mode, retention) = profile;
    let mut raw = StructuralCost::raw_ast(layout_mode >= 1).with_inline_values(layout_mode >= 2);
    ast_program_cost(program, &mut raw, include_imports)?;
    let call_proof = if layout_mode >= 5 {
        let proof = super::call_carriers::count(program, authored, include_imports);
        raw.exact_carrier_free_calls = proof.roots;
        proof.bytes
    } else {
        0
    };
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut identity_slots = ast_program_identity_slots(program)?;
    let mut runtime = StructuralCost::new();
    let mut default_memo = [BTreeMap::new(), BTreeMap::new()];
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut transient_import_clone = 0usize;
    layout.add_costs(
        program,
        programs,
        &mut raw,
        &mut runtime,
        &mut identity_slots,
    )?;
    for module_use in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| include_imports) {
        if module_use.kind == ModuleUseKind::Protocol {
            continue;
        }
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        runtime.string(&module_use.alias)?;
        if let Some(function) = target.function {
            // `synthetic_program` retains an imported function as a stub: the
            // signature it rewrites, with `requires` and `ensures` cleared and
            // the body replaced by the return type's default expression. Only
            // the retained signature is charged here; the default body is
            // charged as runtime cost below. The provider's own contract and
            // body reach the resolver exactly once, through the defining
            // module's own `ast_program_cost`.
            ast_function_signature_cost(function, &mut raw)?;
            // Preserve old fitting receipts even though ordinary stubs now
            // clone only their signature. The historical transient-body debit
            // remains conservative; only mode 4 removes its peak after all
            // older estimates refuse. Intrinsic wrapper bodies are separately
            // charged as retained runtime structures below.
            transient_import_clone =
                transient_import_clone.max(ast_function_contract_cost(function)?.total);
            if programs
                .iter()
                .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
                .is_some_and(|provider| {
                    crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                        || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, function).is_some()
                })
            {
                ast_function_cost(function, &mut runtime)?;
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_function_identity_slots(function)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_identity_slots(&function.return_type)?,
            )?;
            for param in &function.params {
                identity_slots =
                    checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, ast_type_identity_slots(&param.ty)?)?;
                type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                    &param.ty,
                    target.module,
                    program,
                    programs,
                    &mut runtime,
                    Some(layout),
                )?;
            }
            type_rewrite::runtime_cost_with_layout(
                &function.return_type,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            let cost = import_stub::default_expr_expanded_cost_with_layout(
                function,
                target.module,
                program,
                authored,
                programs,
                &mut default_memo,
                &mut BTreeSet::new(),
                super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                    program, target, authored, programs, layout,
                ),
                import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                    function,
                    target.module,
                    byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
                )?,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
            runtime.add_split(cost.bytes, cost.string_bytes)?;
            runtime.add_identity_carriers(cost.identity_carriers)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, cost.identity_slots)?;
        } else {
            let declaration = target.ty.expect("validated type target");
            ast_type_declaration_cost(declaration, &mut raw)?;
            identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(
                identity_slots,
                ast_type_declaration_identity_slots(declaration)?,
            )?;
            super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_runtime_cost_with_layout(
                declaration,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                &mut runtime,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if !program
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        let synthetic_main = synthetic_main_runtime_cost(&program.module)?;
        runtime.add_split(synthetic_main.total, synthetic_main.string_bytes)?;
        runtime.add_identity_carriers(synthetic_main.identity_carriers)?;
    }
    if layout_mode >= 2 {
        identity_slots = identity_slots
            .checked_sub(call_identity::discount_with_imports(
                program,
                authored,
                include_imports,
            ))
            .expect("scalar calls retain their expression and callee identity slots");
    }
    identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(raw.scalar_identity_discount)
        .expect("raw scalar discount retains each expression identity slot");
    let generic_instances = generic_instance_source_cost(program)?;
    identity_slots = checked_builder_sum(identity_slots, generic_instances.identity_slots)?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        runtime.total,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let hir_input = checked_usage(
        hir_input,
        generic_instances.bytes,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(raw.string_bytes, runtime.string_bytes)?;
    let string_input = checked_builder_sum(string_input, generic_instances.string_bytes)?;
    // String contents are part of `hir_input`; only the remaining structural
    // bytes expand by the structural factor.
    let structure_input = hir_input.saturating_sub(string_input);
    let fixed_hir_upper = structure_input
        .checked_mul(HIR_STRUCTURE_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
        .and_then(|structure| {
            string_input
                .checked_mul(HIR_STRING_COPY_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|strings| structure.checked_add(strings))
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let maximum_identity_bytes = maximum_identity.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        authored
            .keys()
            .map(|id| id.len())
            .chain(prelude::all_ids().into_iter().map(str::len))
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
    });
    #[cfg(test)]
    let prior_fixed_hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper;
    let fixed_hir_upper = if layout_mode == cached_exact::MODE {
        cached_exact::fixed_upper(fixed_hir_upper, &raw, &runtime, retention)?
    } else {
        fixed_hir_upper
            .checked_sub(cost::fixed_hir_discount(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?)
            .expect("literal storage discount retains the complete reduced fixed bundle")
    };
    // Only the final uncached route has no semantic-cache serialization owner.
    // This independently paid source certificate concerns local callee backing,
    // not the auxiliary-carrier absence counter, BASE, or an expression ID.
    let shared_callees = if layout_mode == 6 && retention == cached_exact::Retention::Parsed {
        super::shared_local_callees::costs(super::shared_local_callees::Context {
            program,
            authored,
            programs,
        })?
    } else {
        super::shared_local_callees::Costs { slots: 0, bytes: 0 }
    };
    let identity_slots = identity_slots
        .checked_sub(shared_callees.slots)
        .expect("a certified raw call retains its callee slot until this separate proof");
    let identity_occurrence_upper = identity_slots
        .checked_mul(maximum_identity_bytes)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_mul(HIR_IDENTITY_COPY_FACTOR))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // Heap carriers are prebound independently of inline layouts and shared clones.
    let identity_carriers = cost::identity_carriers(layout_mode, &raw, &runtime)?;
    let identity_carriers =
        checked_builder_sum(identity_carriers, generic_instances.identity_carriers)?;
    let identity_carrier_bytes = identity_carriers
        .checked_mul(hir::ExpressionId::SHARED_ALLOCATION_CARRIER_BYTES)
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    // The resolver's source chain also retains the compiler-owned base
    // variants. They are absent from synthetic AST and cannot spend an authored
    // expression discount. Borrow their producer metadata, without warming or
    // constructing the process prelude table during estimation.
    let prelude_hir_upper = super::prelude_forecast::retained_upper(
        &prelude::base_schema::BASE,
        maximum_identity_bytes,
    )?;
    let hir_upper = fixed_hir_upper
        .checked_add(call_proof)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(shared_callees.bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(prelude_hir_upper))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_carrier_bytes))
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(identity_occurrence_upper))
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    let retained_clone_and_hir = checked_usage(
        raw.total,
        hir_upper,
        "builder_bytes",
        active_builder_limit(),
    )?;
    #[cfg(test)]
    let original_mode7_fixed_upper = raw
        .exact_expressions
        .checked_add(runtime.exact_expressions)
        .and_then(|count| {
            count
                .checked_mul(super::super::HIR_FIXED_EXPANSION_FACTOR)
                .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<crate::ast::Expr>()))
                .and_then(|old| prior_fixed_hir_upper.checked_sub(old))
                .and_then(|base| {
                    count
                        .checked_mul(if retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic {
                            2
                        } else {
                            1
                        })
                        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(super::super::HIR_EXPR_FIXED_BUNDLE))
                        .and_then(|exact| base.checked_add(exact))
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::forecast_observation::record_components(
        &program.path,
        layout_mode,
        retention == cached_exact::Retention::Semantic,
        include_imports,
        [
            raw.total,
            raw.string_bytes,
            raw.exact_expressions,
            raw.literal_fixed_discount,
            runtime.total,
            runtime.string_bytes,
            runtime.exact_expressions,
            structure_input,
            string_input,
            prior_fixed_hir_upper,
            fixed_hir_upper,
            identity_occurrence_upper,
            identity_carrier_bytes,
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            generic_instances.bytes,
            transient_import_clone,
            original_mode7_fixed_upper,
            prelude_hir_upper,
            hir_upper,
        ],
    );
    let result = SyntheticBuilderCosts {
        raw_clone_and_hir: checked_usage(
            retained_clone_and_hir,
            transient_import_clone,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
        retained_clone_and_hir,
        transient_import_clone,
        runtime: runtime.total,
        retained_hir: hir_upper,
        synthetic_ast: checked_usage(
            raw.total,
            runtime.total,
            "builder_bytes",
            active_builder_limit(),
        )?,
    };
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(result)
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_with_registry(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    programs: &[Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_program_with_registry_using(program, authored, programs, registry, None)
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_core<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    core: &mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    synthetic_program_with_registry_using(program, authored, programs, registry, Some(core))
}

pub(in crate::workspace_graph) fn synthetic_program_with_registry_using<'a>(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &'a BTreeMap<&'a str, AuthoredDeclaration<'a>>,
    programs: &'a [Program],
    registry: Option<&private_layout::registry::LayoutRegistry<'_>>,
    core: Option<&mut import_stub::core_proofs::CoreProviderProofs<'a>>,
) -> Result<Program, Vec<Diagnostic>> {
    let fresh;
    let held;
    let layout = if let Some(registry) = registry {
        held = registry.get(program, authored, programs)?;
        &*held
    } else {
        fresh = private_layout::LayoutClosure::derive(program, authored, programs)?;
        &fresh
    };
    let mut byte_proofs = import_stub::core_proofs::Phase::new(authored, programs, core)
        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    let mut synthetic = program.clone();
    synthetic.module_uses.clear();
    // Project validation already authenticated static implementation sidecars.
    // Runtime HIR has no witness or dispatch representation for them.
    synthetic.implementations.clear();
    for module_use in program
        .module_uses
        .iter()
        .filter(|item| item.kind == ModuleUseKind::Type)
    {
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        let mut ty = target.ty.expect("validated type target").clone();
        ty.name = crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone(&module_use.alias);
        super::super::generic_type_import::rewrite_declaration_with_layout(
            &mut ty,
            target.module,
            program,
            programs,
            Some(layout),
        )?;
        synthetic.types.push(ty);
    }
    layout.append_types(&mut synthetic, program, programs)?;
    let type_index_bytes = synthetic
        .types
        .len()
        .checked_mul(std::mem::size_of::<(&str, &TypeDeclaration)>())
        .ok_or_else(|| vec![limit_error("builder_bytes", active_builder_limit())])?;
    reserve_builder_structure(type_index_bytes)?;
    let mut type_declarations = Vec::with_capacity(synthetic.types.len());
    for declaration in &synthetic.types {
        type_declarations.push((declaration.name.as_str(), declaration));
    }
    type_declarations.sort_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(right.0));
    if type_declarations
        .windows(2)
        .any(|items| items[0].0 == items[1].0)
    {
        return Err(vec![graph_error(
            "SPX-G173",
            "synthetic workspace type-name index is not unique",
        )]);
    }
    for module_use in program
        .module_uses
        .iter()
        .filter(|item| item.kind == ModuleUseKind::Function)
    {
        let target = &authored[module_use.persistent_id.as_str()];
        let target_function = target.function.expect("validated function target");
        let retain_body = programs
            .iter()
            .find(|provider| provider.module == target.module)
            .is_some_and(|provider| {
                crate::vec_ops::source_wrapper(provider, target_function).is_some()
                    || crate::box_ops::source_wrapper(provider, target_function).is_some()
            });
        let mut function = if retain_body {
            target_function.clone()
        } else {
            import_stub::signature(target_function)
        };
        function.name = crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone(&module_use.alias);
        if retain_body {
            synthetic.functions.push(function);
            continue;
        }
        for param in &mut function.params {
            type_rewrite::rewrite_with_layout(
                &mut param.ty,
                target.module,
                program,
                programs,
                Some(layout),
            )?;
        }
        type_rewrite::rewrite_with_layout(
            &mut function.return_type,
            target.module,
            program,
            programs,
            Some(layout),
        )?;
        // Clearing would retain the cloned contracts' Vec capacities in every
        // finished stub. Replace the vectors so the full imported contracts
        // remain transient, matching the final peak-only pre-bound.
        function.requires = Vec::new();
        function.ensures = Vec::new();
        function.body = default_expr(
            &function,
            &type_declarations,
            super::super::owned_function_import::admitted_with_layout(
                program, target, authored, programs, layout,
            ),
            import_stub::byte_helper_authorized(
                target_function,
                target.module,
                byte_proofs.get().map_err(|error| vec![error])?,
            )?,
        )?;
        synthetic.functions.push(function);
    }
    if !synthetic
        .functions
        .iter()
        .any(|function| function.name == "main")
    {
        reserve_builder_structure(std::mem::size_of::<Function>())?;
        reserve_builder_structure(std::mem::size_of::<Expr>())?;
        synthetic.functions.push(Function {
            stable_id: budgeted_format(format_args!(
                "workspace.synthetic.main.{}",
                synthetic.module
            )),
            explicit_id: true,
            name: crate::bounded_output::budgeted_clone("main"),
            name_span: Span::default(),
            type_parameters: Vec::new(),
            params: Vec::new(),
            return_type: Type::I64,
            effects: Vec::new(),
            yields: None,
            follows: None,
            requires: Vec::new(),
            ensures: Vec::new(),
            body: Expr {
                kind: ExprKind::Int(0),
                span: Span::default(),
            },
            span: Span::default(),
        });
    }
    byte_proofs.complete().map_err(|error| vec![error])?;
    Ok(synthetic)
}

//! Authenticated authored ordinary calls. This proof owns no heap allocation.
//! Scratch exhaustion, incomplete traversal and ambiguous headers keep the old
//! charge. Synthetic/default/generic trees never enter this census.
use super::{call_identity, AuthoredDeclaration};
use crate::ast::{
    Expr, ExprKind, MatchPattern, ModuleUseKind, Program, RecordMatchFieldPattern, Statement,
};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Proof {
    pub(super) roots: usize,
    pub(super) bytes: usize,
}
impl Proof {
    fn charge<T>(&mut self, value: &T) {
        self.bytes = self
            .bytes
            .saturating_add(std::mem::size_of_val(value))
            .saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<&mut Self>())
            .saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<&T>());
    }
}

/// The names are deliberately function-wide: even a binding in a disjoint arm
/// excludes its spelling. Bounded scratch avoids an unpriced tree/index.
struct Names<'a> {
    entries: [Option<&'a str>; 128],
    len: usize,
}
impl<'a> Names<'a> {
    fn insert(&mut self, name: &'a str, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
        proof.charge(&(&*self, name));
        if self.len == self.entries.len() {
            return false;
        }
        self.entries[self.len] = Some(name);
        self.len += 1;
        true
    }
    fn contains(&self, name: &str, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
        proof.charge(&(self, name));
        // One scalar cursor. No iterator, closure environment, Some(name)
        // construction or Option equality pipeline is formed by this search.
        proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<usize>());
        let mut index = 0;
        loop {
            // Actual cursor/length comparison values and its boolean result,
            // including the terminal probe on an absent spelling.
            proof.bytes = proof
                .bytes
                .saturating_add(2 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>() + std::mem::size_of::<bool>());
            if index == self.len {
                proof.charge(&false);
                return false;
            }
            // Array Index actual/formal receivers and indices, returned option
            // loan. Matching a borrowed place forms no Option<&str> value.
            proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(
                2 * std::mem::size_of::<&[Option<&str>; 128]>()
                    + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>()
                    + std::mem::size_of::<&Option<&str>>(),
            );
            if let Some(item) = &self.entries[index] {
                // The &&str pattern binding, str::eq's actual/formal fat loans,
                // and its returned boolean all belong to this reached probe.
                proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(
                    std::mem::size_of::<&&str>()
                        + 4 * std::mem::size_of::<&str>()
                        + std::mem::size_of::<bool>(),
                );
                if str::eq(*item, name) {
                    proof.charge(&true);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<usize>());
            index += 1;
        }
    }

    fn pattern(&mut self, pattern: &'a MatchPattern, depth: usize, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
        proof.charge(&(&*self, pattern, depth));
        if depth == 128 {
            return false;
        }
        match pattern {
            MatchPattern::Binding { name, .. } => self.insert(name, proof),
            MatchPattern::Variant { fields, .. } => {
                fields.iter().all(|f| self.insert(&f.binding, proof))
            }
            MatchPattern::Record { fields, .. } => fields
                .iter()
                .all(|f| self.record(&f.pattern, depth + 1, proof)),
            MatchPattern::Or { alternatives, .. } => alternatives
                .iter()
                .all(|p| self.pattern(p, depth + 1, proof)),
            _ => true,
        }
    }
    fn record(
        &mut self,
        pattern: &'a RecordMatchFieldPattern,
        depth: usize,
        proof: &mut Proof,
    ) -> bool {
        proof.charge(&(&*self, pattern, depth));
        if depth == 128 {
            return false;
        }
        match pattern {
            RecordMatchFieldPattern::Binding { name, .. } => self.insert(name, proof),
            RecordMatchFieldPattern::Record { fields, .. } => fields
                .iter()
                .all(|f| self.record(&f.pattern, depth + 1, proof)),
            RecordMatchFieldPattern::Wildcard { .. } => true,
        }
    }
}

fn compiler_dispatch(name: &str, proof: &mut Proof) -> bool {
    let result = crate::vec_ops::field_unique::literal_call(name)
        || name == crate::vec_ops::field_update::NAME
        || name == crate::vec_field::NAME
        || name == crate::literal_format::NAME
        || crate::string_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::str_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::vec_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::box_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::iterator_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::list_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::map_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::byte_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::host_io_ops::by_name(name).is_some()
        || crate::command_io_ops::by_name(name).is_some();
    proof.charge(&(name, result));
    result
}

fn target(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    imports: bool,
    name: &str,
    arity: usize,
    proof: &mut Proof,
) -> bool {
    proof.charge(&(program, authored, imports, name, arity));
    if compiler_dispatch(name, proof) {
        return false;
    }
    for interface in &program.interfaces {
        proof.charge(&interface);
        for import in &interface.imports {
            proof.charge(&import);
            if import.name == name {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    let mut found = None;
    let mut ambiguous = false;
    for function in &program.functions {
        proof.charge(&function);
        if function.name == name {
            ambiguous |= found.is_some();
            found = Some(function);
        }
    }
    for item in program.module_uses.iter().filter(|_| imports) {
        proof.charge(&item);
        if item.alias != name {
            continue;
        }
        // Any competing nonfunction alias also closes the proof.
        if item.kind != ModuleUseKind::Function {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(header) = authored.get(item.persistent_id.as_str()) else {
            return false;
        };
        proof.charge(&header);
        if header.module != item.target_module {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(function) = header.function else {
            return false;
        };
        proof.charge(&function);
        if function.stable_id != item.persistent_id {
            return false;
        }
        ambiguous |= found.is_some();
        found = Some(function);
    }
    proof.charge(&(found, ambiguous));
    let admitted = !ambiguous
        && found.is_some_and(|f| f.type_parameters.is_empty() && f.params.len() == arity);
    proof.charge(&admitted);
    admitted
}

fn count_linear(
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    imports: bool,
) -> Proof {
    let mut proof = Proof::default();
    proof.charge(&(program, authored, imports));
    proof.bytes = proof.bytes.saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<Proof>());
    for function in &program.functions {
        proof.charge(&function);
        // Generic owner bodies can be materialized repeatedly; no discount.
        if !function.type_parameters.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut names = Names {
            entries: [None; 128],
            len: 0,
        };
        proof.charge(&names);
        let mut complete = function.params.iter().all(|p| {
            proof.charge(&p);
            names.insert(&p.name, &mut proof)
        });
        for root in call_identity::roots(function) {
            // Fixed walker scratch is retained for this complete pass, including
            // failed proofs. Each visited formal/reference is charged too.
            proof.bytes = proof
                .bytes
                .saturating_add(std::mem::size_of::<[Option<(&Expr, usize)>; 129]>());
            complete &= call_identity::walk(root, &mut |expression| {
                proof.charge(&expression);
                match &expression.kind {
                    ExprKind::Block { statements, .. } => statements.iter().all(|s| match s {
                        Statement::Let { name, .. } | Statement::Assign { name, .. } => {
                            names.insert(name, &mut proof)
                        }
                        Statement::For { item, .. } | Statement::ForOwn { item, .. } => {
                            names.insert(item, &mut proof)
                        }
                        Statement::ForBorrow { item, index, .. } => {
                            names.insert(item, &mut proof)
                                && index
                                    .as_ref()
                                    .is_none_or(|i| names.insert(&i.name, &mut proof))
                        }
                        _ => true,
                    }),
                    ExprKind::Closure { params, .. } => params.iter().all(|p| {
                        proof.charge(&p);
                        names.insert(&p.name, &mut proof)
                    }),
                    ExprKind::Match { arms, .. } => arms
                        .iter()
                        .all(|a| names.pattern(&a.pattern, 0, &mut proof)),
                    _ => true,
                }
            });
        }
        proof.charge(&complete);
        if !complete {
            continue;
        }
        let before = proof.roots;
        proof.charge(&before);
        for root in call_identity::roots(function) {
            if !visit(
                root, false, true, 0, &names, program, authored, imports, &mut proof,
            ) {
                proof.roots = before;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    proof
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn visit(
    expression: &Expr,
    free: bool,
    outside: bool,
    depth: usize,
    names: &Names<'_>,
    program: &Program,
    authored: &BTreeMap<&str, AuthoredDeclaration<'_>>,
    imports: bool,
    proof: &mut Proof,
) -> bool {
    proof.charge(&(
        expression, free, outside, depth, names, program, authored, imports,
    ));
    if depth == 128 {
        return false;
    }
    if let ExprKind::Call {
        name,
        type_arguments,
        args,
    } = &expression.kind
    {
        if free
            && outside
            && type_arguments.is_empty()
            && !names.contains(name, proof)
            && target(program, authored, imports, name, args.len(), proof)
        {
            proof.roots = proof.roots.saturating_add(1);
        }
    }
    let outside = outside && !matches!(expression.kind, ExprKind::Closure { .. });
    let mut index = 0;
    while let Some(child) = expression.child(index) {
        let free = match &expression.kind {
            ExprKind::Unary { .. }
            | ExprKind::Binary { .. }
            | ExprKind::If { .. }
            | ExprKind::Call { .. } => true,
            ExprKind::Block { tail, .. } => std::ptr::eq(child, tail.as_ref()),
            _ => false,
        };
        proof.charge(&(index, child, free, outside));
        if !visit(
            child,
            free,
            outside,
            depth + 1,
            names,
            program,
            authored,
            imports,
            proof,
        ) {
            return false;
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    let complete = true;
    proof.charge(&complete);
    complete
}
